seg.042cabe54b01.back: Lead chromate and other lead salts

seg.8310b11eab8b.src: Lead chromate is a yellow pigment used in paint. Stanford-led studies published in 2019 and 2024 found it in turmeric from parts of South Asia. FSSAI does not allow it in turmeric at all.
seg.8310b11eab8b.t: ଲେଡ୍ କ୍ରୋମେଟ୍ ହେଉଛି ପେଣ୍ଟରେ ବ୍ୟବହୃତ ଏକ ହଳଦିଆ ରଙ୍ଗଦ୍ରବ୍ୟ। 2019 ଓ 2024ରେ ପ୍ରକାଶିତ ଷ୍ଟାନଫୋର୍ଡ ନେତୃତ୍ୱାଧୀନ ଅଧ୍ୟୟନରେ ଦକ୍ଷିଣ ଏସିଆର କିଛି ଅଞ୍ଚଳର ହଳଦୀରେ ଏହା ମିଳିଥିଲା। FSSAI ହଳଦୀରେ ଏହାକୁ ଆଦୌ ଅନୁମତି ଦିଏ ନାହିଁ।
seg.8310b11eab8b.back: Lead chromate is a yellow pigment used in paint. In Stanford-led studies published in 2019 and 2024 it was found in turmeric from some regions of South Asia. FSSAI does not permit it in turmeric at all.

seg.4278e7c5416c.src: A cheap white powder that adds weight.
seg.4278e7c5416c.t: ଏକ ଶସ୍ତା ଧଳା ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ଯାହା ଓଜନ ବଢ଼ାଏ।
seg.4278e7c5416c.back: A cheap white powder that increases weight.

seg.5a8b446bbce0.src: Flour or starch from other crops. FSSAI's standard rules it out too.
seg.5a8b446bbce0.t: ଅନ୍ୟ ଫସଲର ଅଟା ବା ଷ୍ଟାର୍ଚ୍ଚ। FSSAIର ମାନକ ଏହାକୁ ମଧ୍ୟ ମନା କରେ।
seg.5a8b446bbce0.back: Flour or starch of other crops. FSSAI's standard forbids this too.

seg.1b1af7f63ffd.src: Fill a clear glass with water at room temperature.
seg.1b1af7f63ffd.t: ଏକ ସ୍ୱଚ୍ଛ ଗ୍ଲାସରେ ସାଧାରଣ ତାପମାତ୍ରାର ପାଣି ଭରନ୍ତୁ।
seg.1b1af7f63ffd.back: Fill a clear glass with water at normal temperature.

seg.653731f2ed6f.src: Sprinkle one level teaspoon of turmeric powder on top. Do not stir.
seg.653731f2ed6f.t: ଉପରେ ଏକ ସମତଳ ଚା ଚାମଚ ହଳଦୀ ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ଛିଞ୍ଚନ୍ତୁ। ଘାଣ୍ଟନ୍ତୁ ନାହିଁ।
seg.653731f2ed6f.back: Sprinkle one level teaspoon of turmeric powder on top. Do not stir.

seg.ea5b43cf8436.src: Watch the first minute as the powder sinks. Look for coloured trails running down from it.
seg.ea5b43cf8436.t: ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ବୁଡ଼ୁଥିବା ବେଳେ ପ୍ରଥମ ମିନିଟଟି ଦେଖନ୍ତୁ। ତାହାରୁ ତଳକୁ ବହୁଥିବା ରଙ୍ଗୀନ ଧାର ଖୋଜନ୍ତୁ।
seg.ea5b43cf8436.back: Watch the first minute while the powder sinks. Look for coloured streaks flowing down from it.

seg.e37698aaa3fb.src: Leave it for 15 to 20 minutes. Then hold the glass against a white wall or a sheet of paper and look at the water above the settled powder.
seg.e37698aaa3fb.t: 15 ରୁ 20 ମିନିଟ ଛାଡ଼ି ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ। ତାପରେ ଗ୍ଲାସକୁ ଏକ ଧଳା କାନ୍ଥ ବା କାଗଜ ସାମ୍ନାରେ ଧରି, ବସିଯାଇଥିବା ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ଉପରର ପାଣିକୁ ଦେଖନ୍ତୁ।
seg.e37698aaa3fb.back: Leave it for 15 to 20 minutes. Then hold the glass in front of a white wall or paper, and look at the water above the settled powder.

seg.e8937cebf136.src: Pale yellow water, powder at the bottom
seg.e8937cebf136.back: Pale yellow water, powder at the bottom

seg.256ce5cf303d.src: Strong yellow trails, or deep yellow water within minutes
seg.256ce5cf303d.t: ଗାଢ଼ ହଳଦିଆ ଧାର, କିମ୍ବା କିଛି ମିନିଟ ଭିତରେ ଗାଢ଼ ହଳଦିଆ ପାଣି
seg.256ce5cf303d.back: Deep yellow streaks, or deep yellow water within a few minutes

seg.ce06c8148072.src: Possible added colour. Stop using that batch and get it tested.
seg.ce06c8148072.t: ମିଶାଯାଇଥିବା ରଙ୍ଗ ଥାଇପାରେ। ସେହି ବ୍ୟାଚ ବ୍ୟବହାର ବନ୍ଦ କରନ୍ତୁ ଓ ପରୀକ୍ଷା କରାନ୍ତୁ।
seg.ce06c8148072.back: There may be added colour. Stop using that batch and get it tested.

seg.53d9c5db264d.src: ⟦1⟧Why it works.⟦/1⟧ Turmeric's own yellow, curcumin, hardly dissolves in water, so the powder sinks and only tints the water. Dyes such as metanil yellow dissolve easily and colour the water fast.
seg.53d9c5db264d.t: ⟦1⟧ଏହା କାହିଁକି କାମ କରେ।⟦/1⟧ ହଳଦୀର ନିଜ ହଳଦିଆ ରଙ୍ଗ, କରକ୍ୟୁମିନ, ପାଣିରେ ପ୍ରାୟ ମିଳେଇ ନାହିଁ, ତେଣୁ ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ବୁଡ଼ିଯାଏ ଓ ପାଣିକୁ କେବଳ ହାଲୁକା ରଙ୍ଗ ଦିଏ। ମେଟାନିଲ ୟେଲୋ ପରି ରଙ୍ଗ ସହଜରେ ମିଳେଇଯାଏ ଓ ପାଣିକୁ ଶୀଘ୍ର ରଙ୍ଗୀନ କରେ।
seg.53d9c5db264d.back: ⟦1⟧Why this works.⟦/1⟧ Turmeric's own yellow colour, curcumin, hardly dissolves in water, so the powder sinks and gives the water only a light colour. Colours like metanil yellow dissolve easily and colour the water quickly.

seg.af4442c6e910.src: ⟦1⟧What it misses.⟦/1⟧ Lead chromate and chalk do not dissolve in water either, so turmeric mixed with them can pass this check. Only a lab test can rule them out.
seg.af4442c6e910.t: ⟦1⟧ଏହା କଣ ଧରିପାରେ ନାହିଁ।⟦/1⟧ ଲେଡ୍ କ୍ରୋମେଟ୍ ଓ ଖଡ଼ି ମଧ୍ୟ ପାଣିରେ ମିଳେଇ ନାହିଁ, ତେଣୁ ସେଗୁଡ଼ିକ ମିଶା ହଳଦୀ ଏହି ଯାଞ୍ଚରେ ପାସ୍ କରିପାରେ। କେବଳ ଲ୍ୟାବ ପରୀକ୍ଷା ହିଁ ସେଗୁଡ଼ିକ ନାହିଁ ବୋଲି କହିପାରେ।
seg.af4442c6e910.back: ⟦1⟧What this cannot catch.⟦/1⟧ Lead chromate and chalk also do not dissolve in water, so turmeric mixed with them can pass this check. Only a lab test can say they are absent.

seg.a8b61850b87d.src: Very fine powder can keep the water cloudy for a while. Cloudy is fine; a clear, strong yellow is what to look for.
seg.a8b61850b87d.t: ବହୁତ ସରୁ ଗୁଣ୍ଡ କିଛି ସମୟ ପାଣିକୁ ଘୋଳିଆ ରଖିପାରେ। ଘୋଳିଆ ହେବା ଠିକ ଅଛି; ସ୍ୱଚ୍ଛ, ଗାଢ଼ ହଳଦିଆ ରଙ୍ଗ ହିଁ ଦେଖିବାର କଥା।
seg.a8b61850b87d.back: Very fine powder can keep the water cloudy for some time. Cloudiness is fine; a clear, deep yellow colour is the thing to watch for.

seg.c3455d1f4c96.src: Check 2: if you buy whole turmeric
seg.c3455d1f4c96.t: ଯାଞ୍ଚ 2: ଯଦି ଆପଣ ଗୋଟା ହଳଦୀ କିଣନ୍ତି
seg.c3455d1f4c96.back: Check 2: If you buy whole turmeric

seg.3d4e366bb488.src: Snap a finger of dried turmeric in half. Turmeric is yellow-orange right through, so the inside should look much like the outside. A bright yellow skin over a pale or dull core can mean colour was added to the surface. Ask the seller about it, or get it tested.
seg.3d4e366bb488.t: ଗୋଟିଏ ଶୁଖିଲା ହଳଦୀ ଗଣ୍ଠିକୁ ଅଧା କରି ଭାଙ୍ଗନ୍ତୁ। ହଳଦୀ ଭିତର ଯାଏ ହଳଦିଆ-କମଳା, ତେଣୁ ଭିତର ପ୍ରାୟ ବାହାର ପରି ଦେଖାଯିବା ଉଚିତ। ଫିକା ବା ମଳିନ ଭିତର ଉପରେ ଉଜ୍ଜ୍ୱଳ ହଳଦିଆ ଚୋପା ଥିଲେ, ତାହାର ଅର୍ଥ ହୋଇପାରେ ଉପରେ ରଙ୍ଗ ଲଗାଯାଇଛି। ବିକ୍ରେତାଙ୍କୁ ଏହା ବିଷୟରେ ପଚାରନ୍ତୁ, କିମ୍ବା ପରୀକ୍ଷା କରାନ୍ତୁ।
seg.3d4e366bb488.back: Break one dry turmeric finger in half. Turmeric is yellow-orange all the way inside, so the inside should look almost like the outside. If there is a bright yellow skin over a pale or dull inside, that may mean colour has been applied on top. Ask the seller about this, or get it tested.

seg.4c4dc95561d2.src: Iodine turns blue-black when it meets starch, and it is often suggested for spotting flour in turmeric. But turmeric is starchy itself, so it turns blue-black either way. That is why FSSAI's own manual uses the iodine test for powdered spices other than turmeric.
seg.4c4dc95561d2.t: ଆୟୋଡିନ ଷ୍ଟାର୍ଚ୍ଚ ସଂସ୍ପର୍ଶରେ ଆସିଲେ ନୀଳ-କଳା ହୋଇଯାଏ, ଆଉ ହଳଦୀରେ ଅଟା ଧରିବା ପାଇଁ ଏହାକୁ ପ୍ରାୟତଃ ପରାମର୍ଶ ଦିଆଯାଏ। କିନ୍ତୁ ହଳଦୀରେ ନିଜେ ଷ୍ଟାର୍ଚ୍ଚ ଥାଏ, ତେଣୁ ଯେକୌଣସି ଅବସ୍ଥାରେ ଏହା ନୀଳ-କଳା ହୋଇଯାଏ। ସେଥିପାଇଁ FSSAIର ନିଜ ପୁସ୍ତିକା ଆୟୋଡିନ ପରୀକ୍ଷାକୁ ହଳଦୀ ଛଡ଼ା ଅନ୍ୟ ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ମସଲା ପାଇଁ ବ୍ୟବହାର କରେ।
seg.4c4dc95561d2.back: Iodine turns blue-black on contact with starch, and it is often suggested for catching flour in turmeric. But turmeric itself contains starch, so it turns blue-black in any case. That is why FSSAI's own manual uses the iodine test for ground spices other than turmeric.

seg.fc16ff8016e3.src: FSSAI's tests for lead, metanil yellow and chalk in turmeric use concentrated hydrochloric or sulphuric acid. These acids burn skin and eyes. They belong in a lab, not a kitchen.
seg.fc16ff8016e3.t: ହଳଦୀରେ ସୀସା, ମେଟାନିଲ ୟେଲୋ ଓ ଖଡ଼ି ପାଇଁ FSSAIର ପରୀକ୍ଷାରେ ଘଞ୍ଚ ହାଇଡ୍ରୋକ୍ଲୋରିକ ବା ସଲଫ୍ୟୁରିକ ଏସିଡ୍ ବ୍ୟବହାର ହୁଏ। ଏହି ଏସିଡ୍ ଚର୍ମ ଓ ଆଖିକୁ ପୋଡ଼ିଦିଏ। ଏଗୁଡ଼ିକର ସ୍ଥାନ ଲ୍ୟାବରେ, ରୋଷେଇଘରେ ନୁହେଁ।
seg.fc16ff8016e3.back: FSSAI's tests for lead, metanil yellow and chalk in turmeric use concentrated hydrochloric or sulphuric acid. These acids burn skin and eyes. Their place is in a lab, not in the kitchen.

seg.1dd87aa7bdc7.src: For a sure answer: a food testing lab
seg.1dd87aa7bdc7.t: ନିଶ୍ଚିତ ଉତ୍ତର ପାଇଁ: ଖାଦ୍ୟ ପରୀକ୍ଷା ଲ୍ୟାବ
seg.1dd87aa7bdc7.back: For a definite answer: a food testing lab

seg.1883beca4d73.src: A NABL-accredited food testing lab can test turmeric for lead and for added colours. Ask the lab how much sample it needs, keep the powder in its sealed pack or a clean sealed bag, and note the batch number printed on the pack. FSSAI publishes a list of notified food testing labs on its website.
seg.1883beca4d73.t: NABL ମାନ୍ୟତାପ୍ରାପ୍ତ ଖାଦ୍ୟ ପରୀକ୍ଷା ଲ୍ୟାବ ହଳଦୀରେ ସୀସା ଓ ମିଶାଯାଇଥିବା ରଙ୍ଗ ପାଇଁ ପରୀକ୍ଷା କରିପାରେ। ଲ୍ୟାବକୁ ପଚାରନ୍ତୁ କେତେ ନମୁନା ଦରକାର, ଗୁଣ୍ଡକୁ ତାର ସିଲ୍ ହୋଇଥିବା ପ୍ୟାକେଟରେ ବା ଏକ ସଫା ସିଲ୍ ବ୍ୟାଗରେ ରଖନ୍ତୁ, ଆଉ ପ୍ୟାକେଟରେ ଛପା ବ୍ୟାଚ ନମ୍ବର ଲେଖି ରଖନ୍ତୁ। FSSAI ନିଜ ୱେବସାଇଟରେ ବିଜ୍ଞାପିତ ଖାଦ୍ୟ ପରୀକ୍ଷା ଲ୍ୟାବଗୁଡ଼ିକର ତାଲିକା ପ୍ରକାଶ କରେ।
seg.1883beca4d73.back: An NABL-accredited food testing lab can test turmeric for lead and added colour. Ask the lab how much sample is needed, keep the powder in its sealed packet or in a clean sealed bag, and note down the batch number printed on the packet. FSSAI publishes the list of notified food testing labs on its own website.

seg.456379c75c24.src: Read the pack before you buy

seg.ff7951e2f36b.src: An FSSAI licence or registration number. You can look it up on FSSAI's FoSCoS website.
seg.ff7951e2f36b.t: ଏକ FSSAI ଲାଇସେନ୍ସ ବା ପଞ୍ଜୀକରଣ ନମ୍ବର। ଆପଣ ଏହାକୁ FSSAIର FoSCoS ୱେବସାଇଟରେ ଖୋଜି ଦେଖିପାରିବେ।
seg.ff7951e2f36b.back: An FSSAI licence or registration number. You can look it up on FSSAI's FoSCoS website.

seg.476e4849c1d8.src: The name and address of whoever made or packed it.
seg.476e4849c1d8.t: ଯିଏ ଏହାକୁ ତିଆରି ବା ପ୍ୟାକ୍ କରିଛନ୍ତି, ତାଙ୍କ ନାମ ଓ ଠିକଣା।
seg.476e4849c1d8.back: The name and address of whoever made or packed it.

seg.beee8eda6466.src: Net quantity, MRP, a batch or lot number, and a best-before date.
seg.beee8eda6466.t: ନିଟ୍ ପରିମାଣ, MRP, ବ୍ୟାଚ ବା ଲଟ୍ ନମ୍ବର, ଆଉ ବେଷ୍ଟ-ବିଫୋର ତାରିଖ।
seg.beee8eda6466.back: Net quantity, MRP, batch or lot number, and best-before date.

seg.f9270fd96202.src: Where it was grown. Turmeric from different regions differs in colour, so a named region helps you compare like with like.
seg.f9270fd96202.t: ଏହା କେଉଁଠି ଚାଷ ହୋଇଛି। ଅଲଗା ଅଲଗା ଅଞ୍ଚଳର ହଳଦୀର ରଙ୍ଗ ଅଲଗା, ତେଣୁ ଅଞ୍ଚଳର ନାମ ଥିଲେ ସମାନ ସହିତ ସମାନର ତୁଳନା କରିବାରେ ସାହାଯ୍ୟ ହୁଏ।
seg.f9270fd96202.back: Where it was grown. Turmeric from different regions has different colour, so having the region name helps in comparing like with like.

seg.7cdc58c0c7e8.src: Keep the pack zipped shut, or move the powder to a dry, airtight jar.
seg.7cdc58c0c7e8.t: ପ୍ୟାକେଟର ଜିପ୍ ବନ୍ଦ ରଖନ୍ତୁ, କିମ୍ବା ଗୁଣ୍ଡକୁ ଏକ ଶୁଖିଲା, ବାୟୁରୋଧୀ ଡବାକୁ ବଦଳାନ୍ତୁ।
seg.7cdc58c0c7e8.back: Keep the packet's zip closed, or move the powder into a dry, airtight container.

seg.bb4d61f86b55.src: Use a dry spoon. A damp spoon is what makes turmeric lumpy.
seg.bb4d61f86b55.t: ଶୁଖିଲା ଚାମଚ ବ୍ୟବହାର କରନ୍ତୁ। ଓଦା ଚାମଚ ଯୋଗୁଁ ହିଁ ହଳଦୀ ଗୁଣ୍ଡା ଗୁଣ୍ଡା ହୁଏ।
seg.bb4d61f86b55.back: Use a dry spoon. It is because of a wet spoon that turmeric becomes lumpy.

seg.a92c022ff52e.src: Keep it out of direct sunlight, which fades the colour.
seg.a92c022ff52e.t: ସିଧା ଖରାରୁ ଦୂରରେ ରଖନ୍ତୁ, ତାହା ରଙ୍ଗକୁ ଫିକା କରେ।
seg.a92c022ff52e.back: Keep away from direct sunlight, it fades the colour.

seg.6911ce63edde.src: Is very bright yellow turmeric a bad sign?
seg.6911ce63edde.t: ବହୁତ ଉଜ୍ଜ୍ୱଳ ହଳଦିଆ ହଳଦୀ କଣ ଖରାପ ସଙ୍କେତ?
seg.6911ce63edde.back: Is very bright yellow turmeric a bad sign?

seg.a0ce62cee740.src: Not by itself. Colour changes with the variety, where it was grown and how it was dried and ground, so turmerics differ a lot. What matters is colour that leaves the powder too easily, as in the water check.
seg.a0ce62cee740.t: କେବଳ ସେତିକିରେ ନୁହେଁ। ରଙ୍ଗ କିସମ, କେଉଁଠି ଚାଷ ହୋଇଛି, ଆଉ କିପରି ଶୁଖାଯାଇ ପେଷାଯାଇଛି ତା ଉପରେ ବଦଳେ, ତେଣୁ ହଳଦୀ ମଧ୍ୟରେ ବହୁତ ଫରକ ଥାଏ। ଦେଖିବାର କଥା ହେଉଛି ରଙ୍ଗ ଗୁଣ୍ଡରୁ ବହୁତ ସହଜରେ ବାହାରିଯାଉଛି କି ନାହିଁ, ପାଣି ଯାଞ୍ଚରେ ଯେପରି।
seg.a0ce62cee740.back: Not by that alone. The colour changes with the variety, where it was grown, and how it was dried and ground, so there is a lot of difference between turmerics. The thing to see is whether the colour comes out of the powder very easily or not, as in the water check.

seg.e8cc5edbb092.src: Can the water check show that turmeric has no lead?
seg.e8cc5edbb092.t: ପାଣି ଯାଞ୍ଚ କଣ ଦେଖାଇପାରେ ଯେ ହଳଦୀରେ ସୀସା ନାହିଁ?
seg.e8cc5edbb092.back: Can the water check show that turmeric has no lead?

seg.37eb38df9ce8.src: No. Lead chromate does not dissolve in water, so the water check cannot see it. Only a lab test can.
seg.37eb38df9ce8.t: ନା। ଲେଡ୍ କ୍ରୋମେଟ୍ ପାଣିରେ ମିଳେଇ ନାହିଁ, ତେଣୁ ପାଣି ଯାଞ୍ଚ ତାହାକୁ ଦେଖିପାରେ ନାହିଁ। କେବଳ ଲ୍ୟାବ ପରୀକ୍ଷା ପାରେ।
seg.37eb38df9ce8.back: No. Lead chromate does not dissolve in water, so the water check cannot see it. Only a lab test can.

seg.2b76cd3e665b.src: Moisture. A wet spoon or an open pack lets the powder take in water. Break the lumps with a dry spoon and keep the pack sealed.
seg.2b76cd3e665b.t: ଆର୍ଦ୍ରତା। ଓଦା ଚାମଚ ବା ଖୋଲା ପ୍ୟାକେଟ ଯୋଗୁଁ ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ପାଣି ଟାଣେ। ଶୁଖିଲା ଚାମଚରେ ଗୁଣ୍ଡା ଭାଙ୍ଗନ୍ତୁ ଓ ପ୍ୟାକେଟ ବନ୍ଦ ରଖନ୍ତୁ।
seg.2b76cd3e665b.back: Moisture. Because of a wet spoon or an open packet the powder pulls in water. Break the lumps with a dry spoon and keep the packet closed.

seg.87fe2929801d.src: What should I do if a check looks wrong?
seg.87fe2929801d.t: ଯାଞ୍ଚରେ କିଛି ଠିକ ନ ଲାଗିଲେ କଣ କରିବି?
seg.87fe2929801d.back: What should I do if something does not seem right in the check?

seg.e83aba6cc6df.src: Stop using that batch, keep the pack, and contact the seller with the batch number. You can also report it to FSSAI through its Food Safety Connect app. If it is ours, WhatsApp us a photo of the pack and the glass.
seg.e83aba6cc6df.t: ସେହି ବ୍ୟାଚ ବ୍ୟବହାର ବନ୍ଦ କରନ୍ତୁ, ପ୍ୟାକେଟଟି ରଖନ୍ତୁ, ଆଉ ବ୍ୟାଚ ନମ୍ବର ସହିତ ବିକ୍ରେତାଙ୍କ ସହ ଯୋଗାଯୋଗ କରନ୍ତୁ। ଆପଣ FSSAIର Food Safety Connect ଆପ୍ ଦ୍ୱାରା ମଧ୍ୟ ଏହାକୁ ଜଣାଇପାରିବେ। ଯଦି ଏହା ଆମର, ପ୍ୟାକେଟ ଓ ଗ୍ଲାସର ଫଟୋ ଆମକୁ WhatsApp କରନ୍ତୁ।
seg.e83aba6cc6df.back: Stop using that batch, keep the packet, and contact the seller with the batch number. You can also report it through FSSAI's Food Safety Connect app. If it is ours, WhatsApp us a photo of the packet and the glass.

seg.91bce9460ade.src: Kodi kura is the chicken curry that fills Andhra homes on a Sunday afternoon: bone-in chicken marinated in chilli and turmeric, cooked down in a gravy of deep-golden onions and tomatoes, and finished with garam masala. It goes to the table with hot rice, and the leftovers with dosa or chapati at night.
seg.91bce9460ade.t: କୋଡି କୂରା ହେଉଛି ସେହି ଚିକେନ ତରକାରି ଯାହା ରବିବାର ଅପରାହ୍ଣରେ ଆନ୍ଧ୍ରର ଘରେ ଘରେ ରନ୍ଧାଯାଏ: ହାଡ଼ ସହିତ ଚିକେନକୁ ଲଙ୍କା ଓ ହଳଦୀରେ ମାରିନେଟ କରି, ଗାଢ଼ ସୁନେଲି ପିଆଜ ଓ ଟମାଟାର ଗ୍ରେଭିରେ ରାନ୍ଧି, ଶେଷରେ ଗରମ ମସଲା ପକାଯାଏ। ଏହା ଗରମ ଭାତ ସହିତ ଖାଇବାକୁ ଦିଆଯାଏ, ଆଉ ବଳକା ତରକାରି ରାତିରେ ଦୋସା ବା ଚପାତି ସହିତ।
seg.91bce9460ade.back: Kodi koora is that chicken curry which is cooked in house after house in Andhra on Sunday afternoon: bone-in chicken is marinated in chilli and turmeric, cooked in a deep golden onion and tomato gravy, and garam masala is added at the end. It is served to eat with hot rice, and the leftover curry at night with dosa or chapati.

seg.2422ebb922bc.src: The heat here comes from our Teja chilli powder, the extra-hot Guntur chilli that gives Andhra curries their bite and bright red colour, with our turmeric powder in the marinade. This recipe serves 4 and is properly fiery; the tips say how to scale it down.
seg.2422ebb922bc.t: ଏଥିର ରାଗ ଆମ ତେଜା ଲଙ୍କା ଗୁଣ୍ଡରୁ ଆସେ, ଗୁଣ୍ଟୁରର ସେହି ଅତି ରାଗୁଆ ଲଙ୍କା ଯାହା ଆନ୍ଧ୍ର ତରକାରିକୁ ତାର ତୀକ୍ଷ୍ଣ ରାଗ ଓ ଉଜ୍ଜ୍ୱଳ ଲାଲ ରଙ୍ଗ ଦିଏ; ମାରିନେଡରେ ଆମ ହଳଦୀ ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ମଧ୍ୟ ପଡ଼େ। ଏହି ରେସିପି 4 ଜଣଙ୍କ ପାଇଁ ଓ ବେଶ୍ ରାଗୁଆ; ରାଗ କିପରି କମାଇବେ ତାହା ଟିପ୍ସରେ ଅଛି।
seg.2422ebb922bc.back: Its heat comes from our Teja chilli powder, that very hot chilli of Guntur which gives Andhra curry its sharp heat and bright red colour; our turmeric powder also goes into the marinade. This recipe is for 4 people and quite hot; how to reduce the heat is in the tips.

seg.4a1335d92ae2.t: 2ଟି ବଡ଼ ପିଆଜ ⟦1⟧ମିହି କରି କଟା, ପ୍ରାୟ 2 କପ⟦/1⟧

seg.3347559a7b17.src: 1 cup hot water ⟦1⟧a little more for a thinner gravy⟦/1⟧
seg.3347559a7b17.t: 1 କପ ଗରମ ପାଣି ⟦1⟧ପତଳା ଗ୍ରେଭି ପାଇଁ ଟିକିଏ ଅଧିକ⟦/1⟧
seg.3347559a7b17.back: 1 cup hot water ⟦1⟧a little more for a thinner gravy⟦/1⟧

seg.cf5fbb1e5375.t: ⟦1⟧ସନ୍ନମ ଲଙ୍କା ଗୁଣ୍ଡ⟦/1⟧ ସହିତ ମଧ୍ୟ ଭଲ ଲାଗେ।
seg.cf5fbb1e5375.back: Also goes well with ⟦1⟧Sannam chilli powder⟦/1⟧.

seg.b4fe3cc46ec4.src: Rub the chicken with curd, Teja chilli powder, turmeric powder and salt. Rest 30 minutes. Cover the bowl and keep it in the fridge if your kitchen is hot.
seg.b4fe3cc46ec4.t: ଚିକେନରେ ଦହି, ତେଜା ଲଙ୍କା ଗୁଣ୍ଡ, ହଳଦୀ ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ଓ ଲୁଣ ଘଷି ଲଗାନ୍ତୁ। 30 ମିନିଟ ରଖନ୍ତୁ। ରୋଷେଇଘର ଗରମ ଥିଲେ ବାଟିକୁ ଘୋଡ଼ାଇ ଫ୍ରିଜରେ ରଖନ୍ତୁ।
seg.b4fe3cc46ec4.back: Rub curd, Teja chilli powder, turmeric powder and salt onto the chicken. Keep for 30 minutes. If the kitchen is hot, cover the bowl and keep it in the fridge.

seg.217eb90c7dac.src: Heat the oil in a heavy pan or kadai on medium heat. Add the cloves, cardamoms and cinnamon and let them sizzle for a few seconds.
seg.217eb90c7dac.t: ଏକ ମୋଟା ପ୍ୟାନ ବା କଡ଼ାଇରେ ମଧ୍ୟମ ନିଆଁରେ ତେଲ ଗରମ କରନ୍ତୁ। ଲବଙ୍ଗ, ଅଳେଇଚ ଓ ଦାଲଚିନି ପକାଇ କିଛି ସେକେଣ୍ଡ ଛଣଛଣ ହେବାକୁ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ।
seg.217eb90c7dac.back: Heat oil on medium flame in a thick pan or kadai. Add cloves, cardamom and cinnamon and let them sizzle for a few seconds.

seg.41164e7a534a.src: Add the onions, green chillies and curry leaves.
seg.41164e7a534a.t: ପିଆଜ, କଞ୍ଚା ଲଙ୍କା ଓ ଭୃସଙ୍ଗ ପତ୍ର ପକାନ୍ତୁ।
seg.41164e7a534a.back: Add onion, green chilli and curry leaves.

seg.127dbd26bc4d.src: Fry the onions in oil till deep golden. This takes 12–15 minutes on medium heat; stir often so they brown evenly without burning.
seg.127dbd26bc4d.t: ପିଆଜକୁ ତେଲରେ ଗାଢ଼ ସୁନେଲି ହେବା ଯାଏ ଭାଜନ୍ତୁ। ମଧ୍ୟମ ନିଆଁରେ ଏଥିରେ 12–15 ମିନିଟ ଲାଗେ; ବାରମ୍ବାର ଘାଣ୍ଟନ୍ତୁ ଯେପରି ନ ପୋଡ଼ି ସମାନ ଭାବେ ଲାଲ ହୁଏ।
seg.127dbd26bc4d.back: Fry the onion in the oil until deep golden. On medium flame this takes 12–15 minutes; stir often so that it browns evenly without burning.

seg.3fa3e9f33095.src: Add ginger-garlic paste, then tomatoes, and cook till soft. Fry the paste for 1 minute until the raw smell goes, then cook the tomatoes for 5–6 minutes, mashing them, until they break down and oil shows at the edges.
seg.3fa3e9f33095.t: ଅଦା-ରସୁଣ ବଟା, ତାପରେ ଟମାଟା ପକାଇ ନରମ ହେବା ଯାଏ ରାନ୍ଧନ୍ତୁ। କଞ୍ଚା ଗନ୍ଧ ନ ଯିବା ଯାଏ ବଟାକୁ 1 ମିନିଟ ଭାଜନ୍ତୁ, ତାପରେ ଟମାଟାକୁ ଚକଟି 5–6 ମିନିଟ ରାନ୍ଧନ୍ତୁ, ଯେପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ ତାହା ଗଳି ଯାଇ କଡ଼ରେ ତେଲ ନ ଦେଖାଯାଏ।
seg.3fa3e9f33095.back: Add ginger-garlic paste, then tomato, and cook until soft. Fry the paste for 1 minute until the raw smell goes, then mash the tomato and cook 5–6 minutes, until it melts down and oil shows at the sides.

seg.24dbd7dfd784.src: Stir in the coriander powder and fry for 30 seconds.
seg.24dbd7dfd784.back: Mix in coriander powder and fry 30 seconds.

seg.461e7a0a9c22.src: Add the chicken and cook covered on medium heat till no pink remains near the bone. Fry it uncovered for the first 5 minutes until the pieces turn opaque, then pour in the hot water, cover and cook for about 20 minutes, stirring now and then.
seg.461e7a0a9c22.t: ଚିକେନ ପକାଇ ଘୋଡ଼ାଇ ମଧ୍ୟମ ନିଆଁରେ ରାନ୍ଧନ୍ତୁ, ଯେପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ ହାଡ଼ ପାଖରେ କୌଣସି ଗୋଲାପି ଅଂଶ ନ ରହେ। ପ୍ରଥମ 5 ମିନିଟ ଖୋଲା ରଖି ଭାଜନ୍ତୁ ଯେପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ ଖଣ୍ଡଗୁଡ଼ିକ ଅସ୍ୱଚ୍ଛ ନ ହୁଏ, ତାପରେ ଗରମ ପାଣି ଢାଳି, ଘୋଡ଼ାଇ ପ୍ରାୟ 20 ମିନିଟ ରାନ୍ଧନ୍ତୁ, ମଝିରେ ମଝିରେ ଘାଣ୍ଟନ୍ତୁ।
seg.461e7a0a9c22.back: Add the chicken, cover and cook on medium flame until no pink part remains near the bone. Fry uncovered for the first 5 minutes until the pieces turn opaque, then pour in hot water, cover and cook about 20 minutes, stirring now and then.

seg.22f96ed1f76e.src: Check a thick piece: the chicken is cooked when no pink remains near the bone and the juices run clear. Taste the gravy and add salt if needed.
seg.22f96ed1f76e.t: ଗୋଟିଏ ମୋଟା ଖଣ୍ଡ ଦେଖନ୍ତୁ: ହାଡ଼ ପାଖରେ କୌଣସି ଗୋଲାପି ଅଂଶ ନ ରହିଲେ ଓ ରସ ସ୍ୱଚ୍ଛ ବାହାରିଲେ ଚିକେନ ସିଝିଯାଇଛି। ଗ୍ରେଭି ଚାଖି ଦରକାର ହେଲେ ଲୁଣ ପକାନ୍ତୁ।
seg.22f96ed1f76e.back: Check one thick piece: if no pink part remains near the bone and the juice comes out clear, the chicken is cooked. Taste the gravy and add salt if needed.

seg.f10b1f5ae914.src: Stir in garam masala and coriander leaves. Simmer 3 minutes, uncovered, until the gravy is as thick as you like and a red film of oil floats on top.
seg.f10b1f5ae914.t: ଗରମ ମସଲା ଓ ଧନିଆ ପତ୍ର ମିଶାନ୍ତୁ। ଖୋଲା ରଖି 3 ମିନିଟ ଧିମା ଫୁଟାନ୍ତୁ, ଯେପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ ଗ୍ରେଭି ଆପଣଙ୍କ ପସନ୍ଦ ଅନୁସାରେ ବହଳ ନ ହୁଏ ଓ ଉପରେ ତେଲର ଲାଲ ସ୍ତର ନ ଭାସେ।
seg.f10b1f5ae914.back: Mix in garam masala and coriander leaves. Simmer uncovered 3 minutes, until the gravy is as thick as you like and a red layer of oil floats on top.

seg.a7c73631b2ca.src: Switch off and rest the curry for 10 minutes before serving; the gravy settles and the flavour comes together.
seg.a7c73631b2ca.t: ନିଆଁ ବନ୍ଦ କରି ପରଷିବା ଆଗରୁ ତରକାରିକୁ 10 ମିନିଟ ରଖନ୍ତୁ; ଗ୍ରେଭି ଥିର ହୁଏ ଓ ସ୍ୱାଦ ମିଳିମିଶି ଯାଏ।
seg.a7c73631b2ca.back: Turn off the flame and keep the curry 10 minutes before serving; the gravy settles and the flavours blend.

seg.0b948e3072fa.src: Brown the onions deep golden; the gravy's colour and body come from them.
seg.0b948e3072fa.t: ପିଆଜକୁ ଗାଢ଼ ସୁନେଲି କରି ଭାଜନ୍ତୁ; ଗ୍ରେଭିର ରଙ୍ଗ ଓ ବହଳତା ସେଥିରୁ ହିଁ ଆସେ।
seg.0b948e3072fa.back: Fry the onion deep golden; the gravy's colour and thickness come from that alone.

seg.e0365adcf1bf.src: Teja chilli powder is very hot. For a medium curry use 1 tsp, or use Sannam chilli powder for red colour with gentler heat.
seg.e0365adcf1bf.t: ତେଜା ଲଙ୍କା ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ବହୁତ ରାଗୁଆ। ମଧ୍ୟମ ରାଗର ତରକାରି ପାଇଁ 1 ଚା ଚାମଚ ନିଅନ୍ତୁ, କିମ୍ବା ଲାଲ ରଙ୍ଗ ସହିତ କମ୍ ରାଗ ପାଇଁ ସନ୍ନମ ଲଙ୍କା ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ବ୍ୟବହାର କରନ୍ତୁ।
seg.e0365adcf1bf.back: Teja chilli powder is very hot. For a medium-hot curry take 1 teaspoon, or for less heat with red colour use Sannam chilli powder.

seg.57940a63282d.src: Use bone-in pieces; the bones give the gravy its depth.
seg.57940a63282d.t: ହାଡ଼ ସହିତ ଖଣ୍ଡ ନିଅନ୍ତୁ; ହାଡ଼ ଗ୍ରେଭିକୁ ଗଭୀର ସ୍ୱାଦ ଦିଏ।
seg.57940a63282d.back: Take bone-in pieces; the bone gives the gravy a deep flavour.

seg.4f9718c3bc6f.src: Let the oil separate from the tomato masala before the chicken goes in, or the gravy tastes raw.
seg.4f9718c3bc6f.t: ଚିକେନ ପକାଇବା ଆଗରୁ ଟମାଟା ମସଲାରୁ ତେଲ ଅଲଗା ହେବାକୁ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ, ନଚେତ୍ ଗ୍ରେଭି କଞ୍ଚା ଲାଗେ।
seg.4f9718c3bc6f.back: Before adding the chicken let the oil separate from the tomato masala, otherwise the gravy tastes raw.

seg.164627c386b7.src: Kobbari kodi kura: grind 3 tbsp grated coconut with 1 tbsp poppy seeds and a little water, and stir the paste in with the garam masala for a richer gravy.
seg.164627c386b7.t: କୋବ୍ବରି କୋଡି କୂରା: 3 ଟେବୁଲ ଚାମଚ କୋରା ନଡ଼ିଆ ସହିତ 1 ଟେବୁଲ ଚାମଚ ପୋସ୍ତ ଓ ଟିକିଏ ପାଣି ମିଶାଇ ବାଟନ୍ତୁ, ଆଉ ଅଧିକ ଭରପୂର ଗ୍ରେଭି ପାଇଁ ଏହି ବଟାକୁ ଗରମ ମସଲା ସହିତ ମିଶାନ୍ତୁ।
seg.164627c386b7.back: Kobbari kodi koora: grind 3 tablespoons grated coconut with 1 tablespoon poppy seeds and a little water, and for a richer gravy mix this paste in with the garam masala.

seg.7d79f857440a.src: Ground masala: dry-roast 1 tbsp coriander seeds, 1 tsp fennel seeds, 3 cloves and a small piece of cinnamon, grind, and use instead of the coriander powder and garam masala.
seg.7d79f857440a.t: ବଟା ମସଲା: 1 ଟେବୁଲ ଚାମଚ ଧନିଆ, 1 ଚା ଚାମଚ ପାନମଧୁରୀ, 3ଟି ଲବଙ୍ଗ ଓ ଛୋଟ ଖଣ୍ଡେ ଦାଲଚିନି ତେଲ ବିନା ଭାଜି ଗୁଣ୍ଡ କରନ୍ତୁ, ଆଉ ଧନିଆ ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ଓ ଗରମ ମସଲା ବଦଳରେ ବ୍ୟବହାର କରନ୍ତୁ।
seg.7d79f857440a.back: Ground masala: dry-roast without oil 1 tablespoon coriander seeds, 1 teaspoon fennel, 3 cloves and a small piece of cinnamon and powder them, and use instead of coriander powder and garam masala.

seg.ea1fd7a2c573.src: Pressure cooker: after adding the chicken and water, cook for 2 whistles and let the pressure drop on its own.
seg.ea1fd7a2c573.t: ପ୍ରେସର କୁକର: ଚିକେନ ଓ ପାଣି ପକାଇବା ପରେ 2 ସିଟି ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ ଓ ପ୍ରେସର ନିଜେ ନିଜେ କମିବାକୁ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ।
seg.ea1fd7a2c573.back: Pressure cooker: after adding chicken and water give 2 whistles and let the pressure release by itself.

seg.8b4376996905.src: Serve hot with steamed rice and a spoon of ghee, the Sunday way. It also goes well with chapati, dosa or ragi sangati.
seg.8b4376996905.t: ଗରମ ଭାତ ଓ ଚାମଚେ ଘିଅ ସହିତ ଗରମ ଗରମ ପରଷନ୍ତୁ, ରବିବାରର ଢଙ୍ଗରେ। ଚପାତି, ଦୋସା ବା ରାଗି ସଙ୍ଗଟି ସହିତ ମଧ୍ୟ ଭଲ ଲାଗେ।
seg.8b4376996905.back: Serve piping hot with hot rice and a spoon of ghee, in the Sunday way. Also goes well with chapati, dosa or ragi sangati.

seg.45cb0a9558e6.src: Keep covered in the fridge for up to 2 days; reheat until steaming hot all the way through. The curry tastes deeper the next day.
seg.45cb0a9558e6.t: ଘୋଡ଼ାଇ ଫ୍ରିଜରେ 2 ଦିନ ପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ ରଖନ୍ତୁ; ଭିତର ଯାଏ ଭଲ ଭାବେ ଗରମ ହୋଇ ବାଷ୍ପ ବାହାରିବା ଯାଏ ପୁଣି ଗରମ କରନ୍ତୁ। ପରଦିନ ତରକାରିର ସ୍ୱାଦ ଆହୁରି ଗଭୀର ହୁଏ।
seg.45cb0a9558e6.back: Keep covered in the fridge up to 2 days; reheat until well heated through to the inside and steam comes out. The next day the curry's flavour becomes even deeper.

seg.bc11ae48bfcf.src: How do I make Andhra chicken curry less spicy?
seg.bc11ae48bfcf.t: ଆନ୍ଧ୍ର ଚିକେନ କରିକୁ କିପରି କମ୍ ରାଗୁଆ କରିବି?
seg.bc11ae48bfcf.back: How do I make Andhra chicken curry less hot?

seg.aaa9ea580a50.src: Cut the Teja chilli powder to 1 tsp, or use Sannam chilli powder, which gives the same red colour with gentler heat. A spoon of curd stirred in at the end also softens the bite.
seg.aaa9ea580a50.t: ତେଜା ଲଙ୍କା ଗୁଣ୍ଡକୁ 1 ଚା ଚାମଚକୁ କମାନ୍ତୁ, କିମ୍ବା ସନ୍ନମ ଲଙ୍କା ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ବ୍ୟବହାର କରନ୍ତୁ, ଯାହା ସେହି ଲାଲ ରଙ୍ଗ ଦିଏ କିନ୍ତୁ ରାଗ କମ୍। ଶେଷରେ ଚାମଚେ ଦହି ମିଶାଇଲେ ମଧ୍ୟ ରାଗ ନରମ ହୁଏ।
seg.aaa9ea580a50.back: Reduce Teja chilli powder to 1 teaspoon, or use Sannam chilli powder, which gives that red colour but less heat. Mixing a spoon of curd at the end also softens the heat.

seg.fe399a2a853e.src: Why is Andhra chicken curry so spicy?
seg.fe399a2a853e.t: ଆନ୍ଧ୍ର ଚିକେନ କରି ଏତେ ରାଗୁଆ କାହିଁକି?
seg.fe399a2a853e.back: Why is Andhra chicken curry so hot?

seg.ada87f188506.src: Andhra cooking uses Guntur chillies such as Teja, which are much hotter than the chilli powder used in most other regional curries. The heat is part of the dish.
seg.ada87f188506.t: ଆନ୍ଧ୍ର ରୋଷେଇରେ ତେଜା ପରି ଗୁଣ୍ଟୁର ଲଙ୍କା ବ୍ୟବହାର ହୁଏ, ଯାହା ଅନ୍ୟ ଅଧିକାଂଶ ଅଞ୍ଚଳର ତରକାରିରେ ପଡ଼ୁଥିବା ଲଙ୍କା ଗୁଣ୍ଡଠାରୁ ବହୁତ ବେଶି ରାଗୁଆ। ଏହି ରାଗ ଏହି ଖାଦ୍ୟର ଅଂଶ।
seg.ada87f188506.back: In Andhra cooking Guntur chillies like Teja are used, which are much hotter than the chilli powder used in curries of most other regions. This heat is part of this dish.

seg.fc940ab96cce.src: How do I know the chicken is cooked through?
seg.fc940ab96cce.t: ଚିକେନ ଭିତର ଯାଏ ସିଝିଛି କି ନାହିଁ କିପରି ଜାଣିବି?
seg.fc940ab96cce.back: How do I know whether the chicken is cooked through to the inside?

seg.1445f73d2fc1.src: Cut into the thickest piece near the bone. The chicken is cooked when no pink remains near the bone and the juices run clear.
seg.1445f73d2fc1.t: ହାଡ଼ ପାଖରେ ସବୁଠୁ ମୋଟା ଖଣ୍ଡଟିକୁ କାଟି ଦେଖନ୍ତୁ। ହାଡ଼ ପାଖରେ କୌଣସି ଗୋଲାପି ଅଂଶ ନ ରହିଲେ ଓ ରସ ସ୍ୱଚ୍ଛ ବାହାରିଲେ ଚିକେନ ସିଝିଯାଇଛି।
seg.1445f73d2fc1.back: Cut and check the thickest piece near the bone. If no pink part remains near the bone and the juice comes out clear, the chicken is cooked.

seg.736c9b09bcd3.src: Can I make kodi kura without curd?
seg.736c9b09bcd3.t: ଦହି ବିନା କୋଡି କୂରା ତିଆରି କରିପାରିବି କି?
seg.736c9b09bcd3.back: Can I make kodi koora without curd?

seg.f9ab2afc44b4.src: Yes. Marinate the chicken with the chilli powder, turmeric powder, salt and 1 tbsp lemon juice, and add one more tomato to the gravy.
seg.f9ab2afc44b4.t: ହଁ। ଚିକେନକୁ ଲଙ୍କା ଗୁଣ୍ଡ, ହଳଦୀ ଗୁଣ୍ଡ, ଲୁଣ ଓ 1 ଟେବୁଲ ଚାମଚ ଲେମ୍ବୁ ରସରେ ମାରିନେଟ କରନ୍ତୁ, ଆଉ ଗ୍ରେଭିରେ ଆଉ ଗୋଟିଏ ଟମାଟା ପକାନ୍ତୁ।
seg.f9ab2afc44b4.back: Yes. Marinate the chicken in chilli powder, turmeric powder, salt and 1 tablespoon lemon juice, and add one more tomato to the gravy.

seg.dcb6c98b640e.src: ఆంధ్రా కోడి కూర. The Andhra Sunday chicken curry: chicken marinated in Teja chilli powder and turmeric powder, cooked in a deep onion-tomato gravy with garam masala.
seg.dcb6c98b640e.t: ఆంధ్రా కోడి కూర. ଆନ୍ଧ୍ରର ରବିବାରର ଚିକେନ ତରକାରି: ତେଜା ଲଙ୍କା ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ଓ ହଳଦୀ ଗୁଣ୍ଡରେ ମାରିନେଟ କରା ଚିକେନ, ଗାଢ଼ ପିଆଜ-ଟମାଟା ଗ୍ରେଭିରେ ଗରମ ମସଲା ସହିତ ରନ୍ଧା।
seg.dcb6c98b640e.back: ఆంధ్రా కోడి కూర. Andhra's Sunday chicken curry: chicken marinated in Teja chilli powder and turmeric powder, cooked in a deep onion-tomato gravy with garam masala.

seg.d04209f30de4.src: ⟦#1⟧ · ⟦#2⟧ · Bellam Pongali · Gud Wala Meetha Pongal
seg.d04209f30de4.t: ⟦#1⟧ · ⟦#2⟧ · ବେଲ୍ଲମ ପୋଙ୍ଗଲି · ଗୁଡ଼ ୱାଲା ମୀଠା ପୋଙ୍ଗଲ

seg.b79702dac541.src: Bellam pongali is the sweet pongal that Telugu homes cook on Sankranti morning: rice and roasted moong dal cooked very soft, then sweetened with jaggery and enriched with ghee. It is offered as naivedyam before the festive meal, and it is also the prasadam at many temples and Friday pujas.
seg.b79702dac541.t: ବେଲ୍ଲମ ପୋଙ୍ଗଲି ହେଉଛି ସେହି ମିଠା ପୋଙ୍ଗଲ ଯାହା ତେଲୁଗୁ ଘରେ ସଙ୍କ୍ରାନ୍ତି ସକାଳେ ରନ୍ଧାଯାଏ: ଚାଉଳ ଓ ଭଜା ମୁଗ ଡାଲିକୁ ବହୁତ ନରମ କରି ସିଝାଇ, ତାପରେ ଗୁଡ଼ରେ ମିଠା କରି ଘିଅରେ ଭରପୂର କରାଯାଏ। ପର୍ବର ଭୋଜି ଆଗରୁ ଏହାକୁ ନୈବେଦ୍ୟ ଭାବେ ଅର୍ପଣ କରାଯାଏ, ଆଉ ଅନେକ ମନ୍ଦିର ଓ ଶୁକ୍ରବାର ପୂଜାରେ ଏହା ପ୍ରସାଦ ମଧ୍ୟ।
seg.b79702dac541.back: Bellam pongali is that sweet pongal which is cooked in Telugu homes on Sankranti morning: rice and roasted moong dal are boiled very soft, then sweetened with jaggery and made rich with ghee. It is offered as naivedyam before the festival feast, and it is also prasadam in many temples and at Friday puja.

seg.17053455adbb.src: Cane jaggery gives it a light brown colour and a round, toffee-like sweetness, and ghee-fried whole cashews from our Jeedipappu pack add the crunch. This recipe serves 4.
seg.17053455adbb.t: ଆଖୁ ଗୁଡ଼ ଏହାକୁ ହାଲୁକା ବାଦାମୀ ରଙ୍ଗ ଓ ଟଫି ପରି ଭରପୂର ମିଠା ଦିଏ, ଆଉ ଆମ ଜୀଡିପପ୍ପୁ ପ୍ୟାକେଟର ଘିଅରେ ଭଜା ଗୋଟା କାଜୁ କୁରକୁରିଆ ଭାବ ଆଣେ। ଏହି ରେସିପି 4 ଜଣଙ୍କ ପାଇଁ।
seg.17053455adbb.back: Sugarcane jaggery gives it a light brown colour and a toffee-like rich sweetness, and whole cashews fried in ghee from our Jeedipappu packet bring a crunchy feel. This recipe is for 4 people.

seg.50377f017e4e.src: Cook time is for a pressure cooker; allow about 15 minutes more in a pot.
seg.50377f017e4e.t: ରାନ୍ଧିବା ସମୟ ପ୍ରେସର କୁକର ପାଇଁ; ହାଣ୍ଡିରେ ପ୍ରାୟ 15 ମିନିଟ ଅଧିକ ଲାଗେ।
seg.50377f017e4e.back: The cooking time is for a pressure cooker; in a pot it takes about 15 minutes more.

seg.b323962ddab1.src: Cook roasted moong dal and rice till very soft, stir in melted cane jaggery and simmer till glossy. Finish with ghee-fried cashews, raisins and cardamom.
seg.b323962ddab1.t: ଭଜା ମୁଗ ଡାଲି ଓ ଚାଉଳକୁ ବହୁତ ନରମ ହେବା ଯାଏ ସିଝାନ୍ତୁ, ତରଳା ଆଖୁ ଗୁଡ଼ ମିଶାଇ ଚକଚକ ହେବା ଯାଏ ଧିମା ଫୁଟାନ୍ତୁ। ଶେଷରେ ଘିଅରେ ଭଜା କାଜୁ, କିସମିସ ଓ ଅଳେଇଚ ପକାନ୍ତୁ।
seg.b323962ddab1.back: Boil the roasted moong dal and rice until very soft, mix in melted sugarcane jaggery and simmer until glossy. At the end add cashews fried in ghee, raisins and cardamom.

seg.15ea2f1a2cd2.src: ¼ cup moong dal ⟦1⟧split yellow moong dal (pesarapappu), about 50 g⟦/1⟧
seg.15ea2f1a2cd2.t: ¼ କପ ମୁଗ ଡାଲି ⟦1⟧ଛୋଟ ହଳଦିଆ ମୁଗ ଡାଲି (ପେସରପପ୍ପୁ), ପ୍ରାୟ 50 g⟦/1⟧
seg.15ea2f1a2cd2.back: ¼ cup moong dal ⟦1⟧small yellow moong dal (pesarapappu), about 50 g⟦/1⟧

seg.9f8bf29ce704.src: 1 cup grated cane jaggery ⟦1⟧lightly packed, about 150 g; a little more if you like it sweeter⟦/1⟧
seg.9f8bf29ce704.t: 1 କପ କୋରା ଆଖୁ ଗୁଡ଼ ⟦1⟧ହାଲୁକା ଚାପି ମାପନ୍ତୁ, ପ୍ରାୟ 150 g; ଅଧିକ ମିଠା ପସନ୍ଦ କଲେ ଟିକିଏ ବେଶି⟦/1⟧
seg.9f8bf29ce704.back: 1 cup grated sugarcane jaggery ⟦1⟧measure lightly pressed, about 150 g; a little more if you like it sweeter⟦/1⟧

seg.8dff8f977372.src: ¼ cup water ⟦1⟧to melt the jaggery⟦/1⟧
seg.8dff8f977372.back: ¼ cup water ⟦1⟧for melting the jaggery⟦/1⟧

seg.c9f89d999d7a.src: a pinch of edible camphor (pacha karpooram) ⟦1⟧optional; a very small pinch⟦/1⟧
seg.c9f89d999d7a.t: ଚିମୁଟାଏ ଖାଇବା କର୍ପୂର (ପଚ୍ଚ କର୍ପୂରମ) ⟦1⟧ଇଚ୍ଛାଧୀନ; ବହୁତ ଅଳ୍ପ ଚିମୁଟାଏ⟦/1⟧
seg.c9f89d999d7a.back: A pinch of edible camphor (pachcha karpooram) ⟦1⟧optional; a very small pinch⟦/1⟧

seg.b1655e025b6c.back: You can also sweeten it with ⟦1⟧palm jaggery⟦/1⟧.

seg.a6184e3e789c.src: Roast the moong dal till light golden, then cook it with the rice till very soft and mushy. Start by dry-roasting the dal in a pressure cooker or heavy-bottomed pot on low heat, stirring, until it smells nutty and turns light golden, about 3–4 minutes.
seg.a6184e3e789c.t: ମୁଗ ଡାଲିକୁ ହାଲୁକା ସୁନେଲି ହେବା ଯାଏ ଭାଜନ୍ତୁ, ତାପରେ ଚାଉଳ ସହିତ ବହୁତ ନରମ ଓ ଚକଟା ହେବା ଯାଏ ସିଝାନ୍ତୁ। ପ୍ରଥମେ ପ୍ରେସର କୁକର ବା ମୋଟା ତଳ ହାଣ୍ଡିରେ ଧିମା ନିଆଁରେ ଡାଲିକୁ ତେଲ ବିନା ଘାଣ୍ଟି ଘାଣ୍ଟି ଭାଜନ୍ତୁ, ଯେପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ ବାଦାମ ପରି ବାସନା ଆସି ହାଲୁକା ସୁନେଲି ନ ହୁଏ, ପ୍ରାୟ 3–4 ମିନିଟ।
seg.a6184e3e789c.back: Fry the moong dal until light golden, then boil with the rice until very soft and mashed. First in a pressure cooker or thick-bottomed pot on low flame dry-roast the dal without oil, stirring and stirring, until a nutty aroma comes and it turns light golden, about 3–4 minutes.

seg.03597768c72a.src: Add the rice to the roasted dal, wash both together in 2–3 changes of water, and drain.
seg.03597768c72a.t: ଭଜା ଡାଲିରେ ଚାଉଳ ପକାନ୍ତୁ, ଦୁହିଁକୁ ଏକାଠି 2–3 ଥର ପାଣି ବଦଳାଇ ଧୁଅନ୍ତୁ ଓ ପାଣି ଛାଣନ୍ତୁ।
seg.03597768c72a.back: Add the rice to the roasted dal, wash the two together changing the water 2–3 times and drain the water.

seg.1c139f802ab6.src: Add the 3 cups water. Pressure cook for 4–5 whistles on medium heat and let the pressure drop on its own, or simmer covered in a pot for 25–30 minutes, adding a splash of hot water if it dries out.
seg.1c139f802ab6.t: 3 କପ ପାଣି ପକାନ୍ତୁ। ମଧ୍ୟମ ନିଆଁରେ 4–5 ସିଟି ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ ଓ ପ୍ରେସର ନିଜେ ନିଜେ କମିବାକୁ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ, କିମ୍ବା ହାଣ୍ଡିରେ ଘୋଡ଼ାଇ 25–30 ମିନିଟ ଧିମା ଫୁଟାନ୍ତୁ, ଶୁଖିଗଲେ ଟିକିଏ ଗରମ ପାଣି ପକାନ୍ତୁ।
seg.1c139f802ab6.back: Add 3 cups water. On medium flame give 4–5 whistles and let the pressure release by itself, or in a pot cover and simmer 25–30 minutes, adding a little hot water if it dries.

seg.5c9fcb8182ea.src: Open and mash the rice and dal lightly with the back of a ladle. It should be soft and porridge-like, not dry.
seg.5c9fcb8182ea.t: ଖୋଲି ଚାଉଳ ଓ ଡାଲିକୁ ଡାଡ଼ୁର ପଛ ପଟରେ ହାଲୁକା ଚକଟନ୍ତୁ। ଏହା ନରମ ଓ ଜାଉ ପରି ହେବା ଉଚିତ, ଶୁଖିଲା ନୁହେଁ।
seg.5c9fcb8182ea.back: Open and lightly mash the rice and dal with the back of a ladle. It should be soft and porridge-like, not dry.

seg.41870045e57c.src: Melt the jaggery in ¼ cup water and pour it into the rice. Warm the jaggery and water in a small pan on low heat, stirring, just until it dissolves, about 2–3 minutes; it does not need to boil.
seg.41870045e57c.t: ଗୁଡ଼କୁ ¼ କପ ପାଣିରେ ତରଳାଇ ଚାଉଳରେ ଢାଳନ୍ତୁ। ଏକ ଛୋଟ ପ୍ୟାନରେ ଧିମା ନିଆଁରେ ଗୁଡ଼ ଓ ପାଣିକୁ ଘାଣ୍ଟି ଘାଣ୍ଟି କେବଳ ମିଳେଇବା ଯାଏ ଗରମ କରନ୍ତୁ, ପ୍ରାୟ 2–3 ମିନିଟ; ଫୁଟାଇବା ଦରକାର ନାହିଁ।
seg.41870045e57c.back: Melt the jaggery in ¼ cup water and pour onto the rice. In a small pan on low flame heat the jaggery and water, stirring and stirring, only until it dissolves, about 2–3 minutes; no need to boil.

seg.ca9ed938d301.src: Simmer, stirring, till thick and glossy, 5–7 minutes; stir in 2 tbsp ghee. Keep the heat low and stir all the way to the bottom, as the pongali catches easily once the jaggery is in.
seg.ca9ed938d301.t: ଘାଣ୍ଟି ଘାଣ୍ଟି ବହଳ ଓ ଚକଚକ ହେବା ଯାଏ ଧିମା ଫୁଟାନ୍ତୁ, 5–7 ମିନିଟ; 2 ଟେବୁଲ ଚାମଚ ଘିଅ ମିଶାନ୍ତୁ। ନିଆଁ ଧିମା ରଖନ୍ତୁ ଓ ତଳ ଯାଏ ଘାଣ୍ଟନ୍ତୁ, କାରଣ ଗୁଡ଼ ପଡ଼ିବା ପରେ ପୋଙ୍ଗଲି ସହଜରେ ତଳେ ଲାଗିଯାଏ।
seg.ca9ed938d301.back: Stirring and stirring, simmer until thick and glossy, 5–7 minutes; mix in 2 tablespoons ghee. Keep the flame low and stir to the bottom, because after the jaggery goes in pongali easily sticks to the bottom.

seg.58e11747230d.src: Taste, and stir in a little more melted jaggery if you want it sweeter.
seg.58e11747230d.t: ଚାଖି ଦେଖନ୍ତୁ, ଅଧିକ ମିଠା ଚାହିଁଲେ ଟିକିଏ ଆହୁରି ତରଳା ଗୁଡ଼ ମିଶାନ୍ତୁ।
seg.58e11747230d.back: Taste, and if you want more sweetness mix in a little more melted jaggery.

seg.9eabfb77c3db.src: Fry the cashews in the rest of the ghee; add with the cardamom. Heat the remaining 2 tbsp ghee in a small pan on medium-low heat and stir the cashews until golden, about 1 minute, adding the raisins for the last few seconds until they puff up.
seg.9eabfb77c3db.t: ବାକି ଘିଅରେ କାଜୁ ଭାଜନ୍ତୁ; ଅଳେଇଚ ସହିତ ମିଶାନ୍ତୁ। ଏକ ଛୋଟ ପ୍ୟାନରେ ବାକି 2 ଟେବୁଲ ଚାମଚ ଘିଅ ମଧ୍ୟମରୁ କମ୍ ନିଆଁରେ ଗରମ କରି କାଜୁକୁ ସୁନେଲି ହେବା ଯାଏ ଘାଣ୍ଟନ୍ତୁ, ପ୍ରାୟ 1 ମିନିଟ, ଶେଷ କିଛି ସେକେଣ୍ଡରେ କିସମିସ ପକାନ୍ତୁ ଯେପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ ତାହା ଫୁଲି ନ ଉଠେ।
seg.9eabfb77c3db.back: Fry the cashews in the remaining ghee; mix with cardamom. In a small pan heat the remaining 2 tablespoons ghee on medium-to-low flame and stir the cashews until golden, about 1 minute, adding the raisins in the last few seconds until they puff up.

seg.4f12a8dd8723.src: Pour the cashews, raisins and ghee over the pongali, sprinkle in the cardamom powder and the camphor, if using, and stir well.
seg.4f12a8dd8723.t: କାଜୁ, କିସମିସ ଓ ଘିଅକୁ ପୋଙ୍ଗଲି ଉପରେ ଢାଳନ୍ତୁ, ଅଳେଇଚ ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ଓ ବ୍ୟବହାର କରୁଥିଲେ କର୍ପୂର ଛିଞ୍ଚି ଭଲ କରି ଘାଣ୍ଟନ୍ତୁ।
seg.4f12a8dd8723.back: Pour the cashews, raisins and ghee over the pongali, sprinkle cardamom powder and camphor if using, and stir well.

seg.25eb1725b7f2.src: Switch off and serve warm. Pongali thickens as it stands; loosen it with a few spoons of hot water if needed.
seg.25eb1725b7f2.t: ନିଆଁ ବନ୍ଦ କରି ଉଷୁମ ଉଷୁମ ପରଷନ୍ତୁ। ପୋଙ୍ଗଲି ରହିଲେ ବହଳ ହୁଏ; ଦରକାର ହେଲେ କିଛି ଚାମଚ ଗରମ ପାଣି ମିଶାଇ ପତଳା କରନ୍ତୁ।
seg.25eb1725b7f2.back: Turn off the flame and serve warm. Pongali thickens as it stands; if needed thin it by mixing in a few spoons of hot water.

seg.d8d20508ad3b.src: Cook the rice and dal fully soft; they stop softening once the jaggery goes in.
seg.d8d20508ad3b.t: ଚାଉଳ ଓ ଡାଲିକୁ ପୂରା ନରମ ହେବା ଯାଏ ସିଝାନ୍ତୁ; ଗୁଡ଼ ପଡ଼ିବା ପରେ ସେଗୁଡ଼ିକ ଆଉ ନରମ ହୁଏ ନାହିଁ।
seg.d8d20508ad3b.back: Boil the rice and dal until fully soft; after the jaggery goes in they no longer soften.

seg.c5408f916731.src: Roasting the moong dal gives pongali its nutty smell; keep the heat low so it turns golden, not brown.
seg.c5408f916731.t: ମୁଗ ଡାଲି ଭାଜିଲେ ପୋଙ୍ଗଲିରେ ବାଦାମ ପରି ବାସନା ଆସେ; ନିଆଁ ଧିମା ରଖନ୍ତୁ ଯେପରି ସୁନେଲି ହୁଏ, ବାଦାମୀ ନୁହେଁ।
seg.c5408f916731.back: Roasting the moong dal gives the pongali a nutty aroma; keep the flame low so it turns golden, not brown.

seg.5ed9375ff107.src: Use a heavy-bottomed pan and keep stirring once the jaggery is in; it catches and burns quickly.
seg.5ed9375ff107.t: ମୋଟା ତଳ ପ୍ୟାନ ବ୍ୟବହାର କରନ୍ତୁ ଓ ଗୁଡ଼ ପଡ଼ିବା ପରେ ଘାଣ୍ଟୁଥାନ୍ତୁ; ଏହା ଶୀଘ୍ର ତଳେ ଲାଗି ପୋଡ଼ିଯାଏ।
seg.5ed9375ff107.back: Use a thick-bottomed pan and keep stirring after the jaggery goes in; it quickly sticks to the bottom and burns.

seg.92b31a616baa.src: Take the pongali off the heat while it is still a little loose; it sets as it cools.
seg.92b31a616baa.t: ପୋଙ୍ଗଲି ଟିକିଏ ପତଳା ଥାଉ ଥାଉ ନିଆଁରୁ ଓହ୍ଲାନ୍ତୁ; ଥଣ୍ଡା ହେଲେ ଏହା ଜମିଯାଏ।
seg.92b31a616baa.back: Take the pongali off the flame while it is still a little thin; it sets when it cools.

seg.1c14403a599f.src: Palm jaggery: use the same amount of grated palm jaggery for a darker pongali with a deeper, smoky sweetness.
seg.1c14403a599f.t: ତାଳ ଗୁଡ଼: ସେତିକି ପରିମାଣର କୋରା ତାଳ ଗୁଡ଼ ବ୍ୟବହାର କଲେ ପୋଙ୍ଗଲି ଗାଢ଼ ରଙ୍ଗର ହୁଏ ଓ ମିଠାରେ ଗଭୀର, ଧୂଆଁ ପରି ସ୍ୱାଦ ଆସେ।
seg.1c14403a599f.back: Palm jaggery: using the same amount of grated palm jaggery makes the pongali dark coloured and gives the sweetness a deep, smoky taste.

seg.d1a4e19c923c.src: Chakkera pongali: use ¾ cup sugar in place of the jaggery for a pale, sugar-sweet version.
seg.d1a4e19c923c.t: ଚକ୍କେର ପୋଙ୍ଗଲି: ଫିକା ରଙ୍ଗର ଚିନି-ମିଠା ପୋଙ୍ଗଲି ପାଇଁ ଗୁଡ଼ ବଦଳରେ ¾ କପ ଚିନି ବ୍ୟବହାର କରନ୍ତୁ।
seg.d1a4e19c923c.back: Chakkera pongali: for a pale-coloured sugar-sweet pongali use ¾ cup sugar instead of jaggery.

seg.44acc6e45d4b.src: Offer it as naivedyam on Sankranti morning, then serve it warm with the festive meal, alongside pulihora and garelu.
seg.44acc6e45d4b.t: ସଙ୍କ୍ରାନ୍ତି ସକାଳେ ନୈବେଦ୍ୟ ଭାବେ ଅର୍ପଣ କରନ୍ତୁ, ତାପରେ ପର୍ବର ଭୋଜିରେ ପୁଳିହୋରା ଓ ଗାରେଲୁ ସହିତ ଉଷୁମ ଉଷୁମ ପରଷନ୍ତୁ।
seg.44acc6e45d4b.back: Offer it as naivedyam on Sankranti morning, then serve warm at the festival feast with pulihora and garelu.

seg.b4e15a70f8c8.src: Keep leftovers covered in the fridge and eat within 2 days. Warm with a splash of hot water and a little ghee, stirring, before serving.
seg.b4e15a70f8c8.t: ବଳକା ପୋଙ୍ଗଲି ଘୋଡ଼ାଇ ଫ୍ରିଜରେ ରଖନ୍ତୁ ଓ 2 ଦିନ ଭିତରେ ଖାଆନ୍ତୁ। ପରଷିବା ଆଗରୁ ଟିକିଏ ଗରମ ପାଣି ଓ ଅଳ୍ପ ଘିଅ ମିଶାଇ ଘାଣ୍ଟି ଘାଣ୍ଟି ଗରମ କରନ୍ତୁ।
seg.b4e15a70f8c8.back: Keep leftover pongali covered in the fridge and eat within 2 days. Before serving, mix in a little hot water and a little ghee and heat, stirring and stirring.

seg.70c91f153ba8.src: What is the difference between pongali and chakkera pongali?
seg.70c91f153ba8.t: ପୋଙ୍ଗଲି ଓ ଚକ୍କେର ପୋଙ୍ଗଲି ମଧ୍ୟରେ ଫରକ କଣ?
seg.70c91f153ba8.back: What is the difference between pongali and chakkera pongali?

seg.75f25d8f552a.src: Pongali on its own often means the savoury version made with pepper and cumin. Chakkera pongali and bellam pongali are the sweet versions, made with sugar or jaggery.
seg.75f25d8f552a.t: କେବଳ ପୋଙ୍ଗଲି କହିଲେ ଅନେକ ସମୟରେ ଗୋଲମରିଚ ଓ ଜିରାରେ ତିଆରି ଲୁଣିଆ ପ୍ରକାରକୁ ବୁଝାଏ। ଚକ୍କେର ପୋଙ୍ଗଲି ଓ ବେଲ୍ଲମ ପୋଙ୍ଗଲି ହେଉଛି ମିଠା ପ୍ରକାର, ଚିନି ବା ଗୁଡ଼ରେ ତିଆରି।
seg.75f25d8f552a.back: Saying just pongali often means the salty type made with black pepper and cumin. Chakkera pongali and bellam pongali are the sweet types, made with sugar or jaggery.

seg.94d3b2adcbef.src: Can I make bellam pongali in a pressure cooker?
seg.94d3b2adcbef.t: ପ୍ରେସର କୁକରରେ ବେଲ୍ଲମ ପୋଙ୍ଗଲି ତିଆରି କରିପାରିବି କି?
seg.94d3b2adcbef.back: Can I make bellam pongali in a pressure cooker?

seg.269aace6e2a8.src: Yes. Cook the roasted dal and rice with 3 cups water for 4–5 whistles, let the pressure drop on its own, then add the melted jaggery and simmer in the open cooker.
seg.269aace6e2a8.t: ହଁ। ଭଜା ଡାଲି ଓ ଚାଉଳକୁ 3 କପ ପାଣି ସହିତ 4–5 ସିଟି ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ, ପ୍ରେସର ନିଜେ ନିଜେ କମିବାକୁ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ, ତାପରେ ତରଳା ଗୁଡ଼ ମିଶାଇ ଖୋଲା କୁକରରେ ଧିମା ଫୁଟାନ୍ତୁ।
seg.269aace6e2a8.back: Yes. Give the roasted dal and rice 4–5 whistles with 3 cups water, let the pressure release by itself, then mix in melted jaggery and simmer in the open cooker.

seg.cd439685b7b5.src: Why did my pongali turn hard after cooling?
seg.cd439685b7b5.t: ଥଣ୍ଡା ହେବା ପରେ ମୋ ପୋଙ୍ଗଲି କାହିଁକି ଟାଣ ହୋଇଗଲା?
seg.cd439685b7b5.back: Why did my pongali become hard after cooling?

seg.696811a7ce7d.src: Pongali sets as it cools, and simmering too long after the jaggery goes in makes it firmer. Take it off while it is still a little loose, and loosen leftovers with hot water.
seg.696811a7ce7d.t: ପୋଙ୍ଗଲି ଥଣ୍ଡା ହେଲେ ଜମିଯାଏ, ଆଉ ଗୁଡ଼ ପଡ଼ିବା ପରେ ବହୁତ ସମୟ ଫୁଟାଇଲେ ଏହା ଆହୁରି ଟାଣ ହୁଏ। ଟିକିଏ ପତଳା ଥାଉ ଥାଉ ଓହ୍ଲାନ୍ତୁ, ଆଉ ବଳକାକୁ ଗରମ ପାଣିରେ ପତଳା କରନ୍ତୁ।
seg.696811a7ce7d.back: Pongali sets when it cools, and if boiled a long time after the jaggery goes in it becomes even harder. Take it off while still a little thin, and thin the leftover with hot water.

seg.b0499dbc1bd0.src: Can I use palm jaggery for pongali?
seg.b0499dbc1bd0.t: ପୋଙ୍ଗଲି ପାଇଁ ତାଳ ଗୁଡ଼ ବ୍ୟବହାର କରିପାରିବି କି?
seg.b0499dbc1bd0.back: Can I use palm jaggery for pongali?

seg.7ee832015d30.src: Yes. Use the same amount of grated palm jaggery (thati bellam). The pongali turns darker and tastes deeper and slightly smoky.
seg.7ee832015d30.t: ହଁ। ସେତିକି ପରିମାଣର କୋରା ତାଳ ଗୁଡ଼ (ତାଟି ବେଲ୍ଲମ) ବ୍ୟବହାର କରନ୍ତୁ। ପୋଙ୍ଗଲି ଗାଢ଼ ରଙ୍ଗର ହୁଏ ଓ ସ୍ୱାଦ ଗଭୀର ଓ ଟିକିଏ ଧୂଆଁ ପରି ଲାଗେ।
seg.7ee832015d30.back: Yes. Use the same amount of grated palm jaggery (tati bellam). The pongali becomes dark coloured and the taste feels deep and a little smoky.

seg.978f1b90a63e.src: బెల్లం పొంగలి. Bellam pongali for Sankranti: rice and roasted moong dal cooked soft, sweetened with cane jaggery and finished with ghee-fried cashews. Serves 4.
seg.978f1b90a63e.t: బెల్లం పొంగలి. ସଙ୍କ୍ରାନ୍ତି ପାଇଁ ବେଲ୍ଲମ ପୋଙ୍ଗଲି: ଚାଉଳ ଓ ଭଜା ମୁଗ ଡାଲି ନରମ କରି ସିଝାଇ, ଆଖୁ ଗୁଡ଼ରେ ମିଠା କରି, ଶେଷରେ ଘିଅରେ ଭଜା କାଜୁ। 4 ଜଣଙ୍କ ପାଇଁ।
seg.978f1b90a63e.back: బెల్లం పొంగలి. Bellam pongali for Sankranti: rice and roasted moong dal boiled soft, sweetened with sugarcane jaggery, and at the end cashews fried in ghee. For 4 people.

seg.ad0644e2314c.src: Bellam Pongali: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.ad0644e2314c.t: ବେଲ୍ଲମ ପୋଙ୍ଗଲି: 1acrefarmsର ରେସିପି କାର୍ଡ, ଉପକରଣ ଓ ପ୍ରଣାଳୀ ସହିତ
seg.ad0644e2314c.back: Bellam Pongali: 1acrefarms recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.c5dbb15b1ab8.src: a pinch of edible camphor (pacha karpooram)
seg.c5dbb15b1ab8.back: A pinch of edible camphor (pachcha karpooram)

seg.79401823a930.src: Andhra Chepala Pulusu ⟦1⟧(Andhra Tamarind Fish Curry)⟦/1⟧
seg.79401823a930.t: ଆନ୍ଧ୍ର ଚେପଲ ପୁଲୁସୁ ⟦1⟧(ଆନ୍ଧ୍ରର ତେନ୍ତୁଳି ମାଛ ତରକାରି)⟦/1⟧
seg.79401823a930.back: Andhra Chepala Pulusu ⟦1⟧(Andhra tamarind fish curry)⟦/1⟧

seg.0fff539adaed.src: Chepala pulusu is the tamarind fish curry of coastal Andhra, made with special care in the Godavari districts: thick fish steaks simmered in a sour, red tamarind gravy with onions, green chillies and curry leaves. It is a Sunday lunch dish, and many homes cook it in a clay pot and keep it for the next day, when the gravy has soaked into the fish.
seg.0fff539adaed.t: ଚେପଲ ପୁଲୁସୁ ହେଉଛି ଉପକୂଳ ଆନ୍ଧ୍ରର ତେନ୍ତୁଳି ମାଛ ତରକାରି, ଯାହା ଗୋଦାବରୀ ଜିଲ୍ଲାରେ ବିଶେଷ ଯତ୍ନରେ ତିଆରି ହୁଏ: ମୋଟା ମାଛ ଖଣ୍ଡକୁ ପିଆଜ, କଞ୍ଚା ଲଙ୍କା ଓ ଭୃସଙ୍ଗ ପତ୍ର ସହିତ ଖଟା, ଲାଲ ତେନ୍ତୁଳି ଗ୍ରେଭିରେ ଧିମା ଫୁଟାଯାଏ। ଏହା ରବିବାର ମଧ୍ୟାହ୍ନ ଭୋଜନର ଖାଦ୍ୟ, ଆଉ ଅନେକ ଘରେ ଏହାକୁ ମାଟି ହାଣ୍ଡିରେ ରାନ୍ଧି ପରଦିନ ପାଇଁ ରଖନ୍ତି, ଯେତେବେଳେ ଗ୍ରେଭି ମାଛ ଭିତରେ ପଶିଯାଇଥାଏ।
seg.0fff539adaed.back: Chepala pulusu is the tamarind fish curry of coastal Andhra, which is made with special care in the Godavari districts: thick fish pieces are simmered with onion, green chilli and curry leaves in a sour, red tamarind gravy. It is a Sunday lunch dish, and in many homes it is cooked in a clay pot and kept for the next day, by when the gravy has soaked into the fish.

seg.17fc336d9c12.src: Our turmeric powder goes into the marinade and the gravy. Sannam chilli powder gives the pulusu its deep red colour and a steady heat that balances the tamarind. This recipe serves 4.
seg.17fc336d9c12.t: ଆମ ହଳଦୀ ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ମାରିନେଡ ଓ ଗ୍ରେଭି ଦୁହିଁରେ ପଡ଼େ। ସନ୍ନମ ଲଙ୍କା ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ପୁଲୁସୁକୁ ଗାଢ଼ ଲାଲ ରଙ୍ଗ ଓ ଏକ ସ୍ଥିର ରାଗ ଦିଏ ଯାହା ତେନ୍ତୁଳିର ଖଟାକୁ ସନ୍ତୁଳିତ କରେ। ଏହି ରେସିପି 4 ଜଣଙ୍କ ପାଇଁ।
seg.17fc336d9c12.back: Our turmeric powder goes into both the marinade and the gravy. Sannam chilli powder gives the pulusu a deep red colour and a steady heat that balances the sourness of the tamarind. This recipe is for 4 people.

seg.4ba98eee496a.src: Prep includes the 15-minute marinade. The curry tastes even better after resting a few hours.
seg.4ba98eee496a.t: ପ୍ରସ୍ତୁତି ସମୟରେ 15 ମିନିଟର ମାରିନେଡ ଅଛି। କିଛି ଘଣ୍ଟା ରଖିଲେ ତରକାରିର ସ୍ୱାଦ ଆହୁରି ଭଲ ହୁଏ।
seg.4ba98eee496a.back: The preparation time includes a 15-minute marinade. If kept a few hours the curry's flavour becomes even better.

seg.aed84f9a20f5.src: Marinate fish with salt, turmeric and chilli powder, fry onions and spices, boil them in tamarind water, then simmer the fish gently in the gravy without stirring.
seg.aed84f9a20f5.t: ମାଛକୁ ଲୁଣ, ହଳଦୀ ଓ ଲଙ୍କା ଗୁଣ୍ଡରେ ମାରିନେଟ କରନ୍ତୁ, ପିଆଜ ଓ ମସଲା ଭାଜି ତେନ୍ତୁଳି ପାଣିରେ ଫୁଟାନ୍ତୁ, ତାପରେ ନ ଘାଣ୍ଟି ମାଛକୁ ଗ୍ରେଭିରେ ଧୀରେ ଧିମା ଫୁଟାନ୍ତୁ।
seg.aed84f9a20f5.back: Marinate the fish in salt, turmeric and chilli powder, fry onion and spices and boil in tamarind water, then without stirring gently simmer the fish in the gravy.

seg.5ce3c9cccf94.src: 500 g fish pieces ⟦1⟧firm fish cut into thick steaks: rohu (bocha), korameenu (murrel) or seer fish (vanjaram)⟦/1⟧
seg.5ce3c9cccf94.t: 500 g ମାଛ ଖଣ୍ଡ ⟦1⟧ଟାଣ ମାଂସର ମାଛ, ମୋଟା ଖଣ୍ଡ କରି କଟା: ରୋହି (ବୋଚ୍ଚା), କୋରମୀନୁ (ଶାଳ ମାଛ) ବା ସିର ମାଛ (ଭଞ୍ଜରମ)⟦/1⟧
seg.5ce3c9cccf94.back: 500 g fish pieces ⟦1⟧firm-fleshed fish, cut into thick pieces: rohu (bochcha), korameenu (murrel) or seer fish (vanjaram)⟦/1⟧

seg.23a800982a03.src: 40 g tamarind ⟦1⟧a lemon-sized ball, soaked in 2 cups warm water for 15 minutes⟦/1⟧
seg.23a800982a03.t: 40 g ତେନ୍ତୁଳି ⟦1⟧ଲେମ୍ବୁ ଆକାରର ଗୋଲା, 2 କପ ଉଷୁମ ପାଣିରେ 15 ମିନିଟ ଭିଜାଇଥିବା⟦/1⟧
seg.23a800982a03.back: 40 g tamarind ⟦1⟧lemon-sized ball, soaked 15 minutes in 2 cups warm water⟦/1⟧

seg.f8dec19a56f9.src: ½ tsp turmeric powder ⟦1⟧¼ tsp for the marinade, ¼ tsp for the gravy⟦/1⟧
seg.f8dec19a56f9.t: ½ ଚା ଚାମଚ ହଳଦୀ ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ⟦1⟧¼ ଚା ଚାମଚ ମାରିନେଡ ପାଇଁ, ¼ ଚା ଚାମଚ ଗ୍ରେଭି ପାଇଁ⟦/1⟧
seg.f8dec19a56f9.back: ½ teaspoon turmeric powder ⟦1⟧¼ teaspoon for the marinade, ¼ teaspoon for the gravy⟦/1⟧

seg.c78341163232.src: 2 tbsp Sannam chilli powder ⟦1⟧1 tsp for the marinade, the rest for the gravy⟦/1⟧
seg.c78341163232.t: 2 ଟେବୁଲ ଚାମଚ ସନ୍ନମ ଲଙ୍କା ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ⟦1⟧1 ଚା ଚାମଚ ମାରିନେଡ ପାଇଁ, ବାକି ଗ୍ରେଭି ପାଇଁ⟦/1⟧
seg.c78341163232.back: 2 tablespoons Sannam chilli powder ⟦1⟧1 teaspoon for the marinade, the rest for the gravy⟦/1⟧

seg.bcbd97cd906a.src: 1 tsp salt ⟦1⟧for the gravy, or to taste⟦/1⟧
seg.bcbd97cd906a.t: 1 ଚା ଚାମଚ ଲୁଣ ⟦1⟧ଗ୍ରେଭି ପାଇଁ, କିମ୍ବା ସ୍ୱାଦ ଅନୁସାରେ⟦/1⟧
seg.bcbd97cd906a.back: 1 teaspoon salt ⟦1⟧for the gravy, or as per taste⟦/1⟧

seg.ba6dcf57651d.t: ⟦1⟧ତେଜା ଲଙ୍କା ଗୁଣ୍ଡ⟦/1⟧ ସହିତ ମଧ୍ୟ ଭଲ ଲାଗେ।
seg.ba6dcf57651d.back: Also goes well with ⟦1⟧Teja chilli powder⟦/1⟧.

seg.2fafef6b8781.src: Wash the fish pieces gently in water two or three times and drain them well.
seg.2fafef6b8781.t: ମାଛ ଖଣ୍ଡଗୁଡ଼ିକୁ ପାଣିରେ ଦୁଇ ତିନି ଥର ଧୀରେ ଧୁଅନ୍ତୁ ଓ ଭଲ କରି ପାଣି ଛାଣନ୍ତୁ।
seg.2fafef6b8781.back: Gently wash the fish pieces in water two or three times and drain the water well.

seg.cf370c2b1459.src: Rub the fish with salt, turmeric and 1 tsp chilli powder; rest 15 minutes. Use 1 tsp salt and ¼ tsp of the turmeric powder for the marinade.
seg.cf370c2b1459.t: ମାଛରେ ଲୁଣ, ହଳଦୀ ଓ 1 ଚା ଚାମଚ ଲଙ୍କା ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ଘଷି ଲଗାନ୍ତୁ; 15 ମିନିଟ ରଖନ୍ତୁ। ମାରିନେଡ ପାଇଁ 1 ଚା ଚାମଚ ଲୁଣ ଓ ¼ ଚା ଚାମଚ ହଳଦୀ ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ନିଅନ୍ତୁ।
seg.cf370c2b1459.back: Rub salt, turmeric and 1 teaspoon chilli powder onto the fish; keep 15 minutes. For the marinade take 1 teaspoon salt and ¼ teaspoon turmeric powder.

seg.0c7defd6c85a.src: Squeeze the soaked tamarind well in its water and strain it. You should have about 2 cups of thin tamarind water.
seg.0c7defd6c85a.t: ଭିଜା ତେନ୍ତୁଳିକୁ ତାର ପାଣିରେ ଭଲ କରି ଚିପୁଡ଼ି ଛାଣନ୍ତୁ। ପ୍ରାୟ 2 କପ ପତଳା ତେନ୍ତୁଳି ପାଣି ହେବା ଉଚିତ।
seg.0c7defd6c85a.back: Squeeze the soaked tamarind well in its water and strain. There should be about 2 cups of thin tamarind water.

seg.a8777ed4c461.src: Heat the oil in a wide pan or clay pot on medium heat. Add the fenugreek seeds, mustard seeds and cumin seeds and let them splutter, taking care that the fenugreek does not turn dark.
seg.a8777ed4c461.t: ଏକ ଚଉଡ଼ା ପ୍ୟାନ ବା ମାଟି ହାଣ୍ଡିରେ ମଧ୍ୟମ ନିଆଁରେ ତେଲ ଗରମ କରନ୍ତୁ। ମେଥି, ସୋରିଷ ଓ ଜିରା ପକାଇ ଫୁଟିବାକୁ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ, ମେଥି ଯେପରି କଳା ନ ହୁଏ ସେଥିପ୍ରତି ଧ୍ୟାନ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ।
seg.a8777ed4c461.back: Heat oil on medium flame in a wide pan or clay pot. Add fenugreek, mustard and cumin and let them splutter, taking care that the fenugreek does not turn black.

seg.e87b5c1bcc02.src: Fry the onions, chillies and curry leaves in oil till soft; add the spice powders. Fry the onions about 6–8 minutes until soft and light golden, add the ginger-garlic paste and tomato and cook 2 minutes, then add the remaining turmeric powder, the remaining Sannam chilli powder and the coriander powder and stir for 30 seconds.
seg.e87b5c1bcc02.t: ପିଆଜ, ଲଙ୍କା ଓ ଭୃସଙ୍ଗ ପତ୍ରକୁ ତେଲରେ ନରମ ହେବା ଯାଏ ଭାଜନ୍ତୁ; ମସଲା ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ପକାନ୍ତୁ। ପିଆଜକୁ ପ୍ରାୟ 6–8 ମିନିଟ ନରମ ଓ ହାଲୁକା ସୁନେଲି ହେବା ଯାଏ ଭାଜନ୍ତୁ, ଅଦା-ରସୁଣ ବଟା ଓ ଟମାଟା ପକାଇ 2 ମିନିଟ ରାନ୍ଧନ୍ତୁ, ତାପରେ ବାକି ହଳଦୀ ଗୁଣ୍ଡ, ବାକି ସନ୍ନମ ଲଙ୍କା ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ଓ ଧନିଆ ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ପକାଇ 30 ସେକେଣ୍ଡ ଘାଣ୍ଟନ୍ତୁ।
seg.e87b5c1bcc02.back: Fry onion, chilli and curry leaves in the oil until soft; add the spice powders. Fry the onion about 6–8 minutes until soft and light golden, add ginger-garlic paste and tomato and cook 2 minutes, then add the remaining turmeric powder, the remaining Sannam chilli powder and coriander powder and stir 30 seconds.

seg.61e849535fa9.src: Pour in the tamarind water and boil 10 minutes till the oil rises. Add the salt for the gravy; the raw tamarind smell should be gone and the gravy slightly thick.
seg.61e849535fa9.t: ତେନ୍ତୁଳି ପାଣି ଢାଳି ତେଲ ଉପରକୁ ଉଠିବା ଯାଏ 10 ମିନିଟ ଫୁଟାନ୍ତୁ। ଗ୍ରେଭି ପାଇଁ ଲୁଣ ପକାନ୍ତୁ; ତେନ୍ତୁଳିର କଞ୍ଚା ଗନ୍ଧ ଚାଲିଯିବା ଉଚିତ ଓ ଗ୍ରେଭି ଟିକିଏ ବହଳ ହେବା ଉଚିତ।
seg.61e849535fa9.back: Pour in the tamarind water and boil 10 minutes until the oil rises to the top. Add salt for the gravy; the raw smell of the tamarind should go and the gravy should become a little thick.

seg.65cb3d6833cd.src: Taste the gravy. It should be clearly sour, salty and hot, as the fish will take in some of it.
seg.65cb3d6833cd.t: ଗ୍ରେଭି ଚାଖନ୍ତୁ। ଏହା ସ୍ପଷ୍ଟ ଭାବେ ଖଟା, ଲୁଣିଆ ଓ ରାଗୁଆ ହେବା ଉଚିତ, କାରଣ ମାଛ ଏଥିରୁ କିଛି ଟାଣିନେବ।
seg.65cb3d6833cd.back: Taste the gravy. It should be clearly sour, salty and hot, because the fish will draw some of it in.

seg.fc6f288cacf9.src: Slide in the fish and simmer covered 10–12 minutes; swirl, do not stir. Lay the pieces in one layer, spoon gravy over them and keep the heat low.
seg.fc6f288cacf9.t: ମାଛକୁ ଧୀରେ ଗ୍ରେଭିରେ ଛାଡ଼ନ୍ତୁ ଓ ଘୋଡ଼ାଇ 10–12 ମିନିଟ ଧିମା ଫୁଟାନ୍ତୁ; ହାଣ୍ଡିକୁ ଘୂରାନ୍ତୁ, ଘାଣ୍ଟନ୍ତୁ ନାହିଁ। ଖଣ୍ଡଗୁଡ଼ିକୁ ଗୋଟିଏ ସ୍ତରରେ ରଖନ୍ତୁ, ଉପରେ ଚାମଚରେ ଗ୍ରେଭି ଢାଳନ୍ତୁ ଓ ନିଆଁ ଧିମା ରଖନ୍ତୁ।
seg.fc6f288cacf9.back: Gently slide the fish into the gravy and simmer covered 10–12 minutes; swirl the pot, do not stir. Keep the pieces in one layer, spoon gravy over the top and keep the flame low.

seg.9fed4db6e81b.src: Check one piece at the thickest part: the fish is cooked when the flesh is white or opaque right through and comes away from the bone easily.
seg.9fed4db6e81b.t: ଗୋଟିଏ ଖଣ୍ଡର ସବୁଠୁ ମୋଟା ଭାଗ ଦେଖନ୍ତୁ: ମାଂସ ଭିତର ଯାଏ ଧଳା ବା ଅସ୍ୱଚ୍ଛ ହୋଇଗଲେ ଓ ସହଜରେ କଣ୍ଟାରୁ ଛାଡ଼ିଗଲେ ମାଛ ସିଝିଯାଇଛି।
seg.9fed4db6e81b.back: Check the thickest part of one piece: if the flesh has turned white or opaque through to the inside and comes away easily from the bone, the fish is cooked.

seg.8a5166c34dc3.src: Sprinkle the coriander leaves, switch off and let the pulusu rest at least 30 minutes, covered, before serving.
seg.8a5166c34dc3.t: ଧନିଆ ପତ୍ର ଛିଞ୍ଚନ୍ତୁ, ନିଆଁ ବନ୍ଦ କରନ୍ତୁ, ଆଉ ପରଷିବା ଆଗରୁ ପୁଲୁସୁକୁ ଘୋଡ଼ାଇ ଅତି କମରେ 30 ମିନିଟ ରଖନ୍ତୁ।
seg.8a5166c34dc3.back: Sprinkle coriander leaves, turn off the flame, and keep the pulusu covered for at least 30 minutes before serving.

seg.c6819a9980cc.src: Swirl the pan instead of stirring so the fish stays whole.
seg.c6819a9980cc.t: ଘାଣ୍ଟିବା ବଦଳରେ ପ୍ୟାନକୁ ଘୂରାନ୍ତୁ ଯେପରି ମାଛ ଗୋଟା ରହେ।
seg.c6819a9980cc.back: Instead of stirring, swirl the pan so the fish stays whole.

seg.1333bb67a0a8.src: Pick a firm fish with thick steaks; thin fillets break up in the long simmer.
seg.1333bb67a0a8.t: ମୋଟା ଖଣ୍ଡ ହେଉଥିବା ଟାଣ ମାଂସର ମାଛ ବାଛନ୍ତୁ; ପତଳା ଫିଲେ ଲମ୍ବା ସମୟ ଫୁଟିଲେ ଭାଙ୍ଗିଯାଏ।
seg.1333bb67a0a8.back: Choose firm-fleshed fish that comes in thick pieces; thin fillets break when simmered a long time.

seg.dd6f5d867621.src: Sannam chilli powder gives a medium heat. Use 1½ tbsp for a milder pulusu, or the full 2 tbsp for the usual Andhra heat.
seg.dd6f5d867621.t: ସନ୍ନମ ଲଙ୍କା ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ମଧ୍ୟମ ରାଗ ଦିଏ। କମ୍ ରାଗୁଆ ପୁଲୁସୁ ପାଇଁ 1½ ଟେବୁଲ ଚାମଚ ନିଅନ୍ତୁ, କିମ୍ବା ଆନ୍ଧ୍ରର ସାଧାରଣ ରାଗ ପାଇଁ ପୂରା 2 ଟେବୁଲ ଚାମଚ।
seg.dd6f5d867621.back: Sannam chilli powder gives medium heat. For a less hot pulusu take 1½ tablespoons, or for usual Andhra heat the full 2 tablespoons.

seg.6196c7ae078f.src: Boil the tamarind gravy well before the fish goes in; once the fish is in, you cannot cook it much longer without it breaking.
seg.6196c7ae078f.t: ମାଛ ପକାଇବା ଆଗରୁ ତେନ୍ତୁଳି ଗ୍ରେଭିକୁ ଭଲ କରି ଫୁଟାନ୍ତୁ; ମାଛ ପଡ଼ିଗଲେ, ତାକୁ ନ ଭାଙ୍ଗି ଆଉ ବେଶି ସମୟ ରାନ୍ଧି ହେବ ନାହିଁ।
seg.6196c7ae078f.back: Boil the tamarind gravy well before adding the fish; once the fish goes in, it cannot be cooked much longer without breaking it.

seg.cadf91d0b4a1.src: Teja chilli powder: for a hotter pulusu, use 1 tbsp Teja chilli powder in place of the Sannam in the gravy. Teja is very hot; start with 2 tsp if unsure.
seg.cadf91d0b4a1.t: ତେଜା ଲଙ୍କା ଗୁଣ୍ଡ: ଅଧିକ ରାଗୁଆ ପୁଲୁସୁ ପାଇଁ ଗ୍ରେଭିରେ ସନ୍ନମ ବଦଳରେ 1 ଟେବୁଲ ଚାମଚ ତେଜା ଲଙ୍କା ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ନିଅନ୍ତୁ। ତେଜା ବହୁତ ରାଗୁଆ; ନିଶ୍ଚିତ ନ ଥିଲେ 2 ଚା ଚାମଚରୁ ଆରମ୍ଭ କରନ୍ତୁ।
seg.cadf91d0b4a1.back: Teja chilli powder: for a hotter pulusu take 1 tablespoon Teja chilli powder in the gravy instead of Sannam. Teja is very hot; if not sure start with 2 teaspoons.

seg.1639b09f9df2.src: Royyala pulusu: use 400 g cleaned prawns and simmer only 5–6 minutes, until they turn pink and curl.
seg.1639b09f9df2.t: ରୋୟ୍ୟଲ ପୁଲୁସୁ: 400 g ସଫା କରା ଚିଙ୍ଗୁଡ଼ି ନିଅନ୍ତୁ ଓ କେବଳ 5–6 ମିନିଟ ଧିମା ଫୁଟାନ୍ତୁ, ଯେପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ ସେଗୁଡ଼ିକ ଗୋଲାପି ହୋଇ ମୋଡ଼ି ନ ହୁଏ।
seg.1639b09f9df2.back: Royyala pulusu: take 400 g cleaned prawns and simmer only 5–6 minutes, until they turn pink and curl.

seg.f5f2c78097e7.src: Mamidikaya pulusu: in summer, Godavari homes add slices of raw mango and use less tamarind.
seg.f5f2c78097e7.t: ମାମିଡିକାୟ ପୁଲୁସୁ: ଗ୍ରୀଷ୍ମରେ ଗୋଦାବରୀର ଘରେ କଞ୍ଚା ଆମ୍ବ ଖଣ୍ଡ ପକାନ୍ତି ଓ ତେନ୍ତୁଳି କମ୍ ଦିଅନ୍ତି।
seg.f5f2c78097e7.back: Mamidikaya pulusu: in summer, Godavari homes add raw mango pieces and use less tamarind.

seg.4bb7dd4c2c98.src: Serve with hot steamed rice and sliced onions. Many Godavari homes serve it the next day, when the flavours have settled.
seg.4bb7dd4c2c98.t: ଗରମ ଭାତ ଓ କଟା ପିଆଜ ସହିତ ପରଷନ୍ତୁ। ଗୋଦାବରୀର ଅନେକ ଘରେ ଏହାକୁ ପରଦିନ ପରଷନ୍ତି, ଯେତେବେଳେ ସ୍ୱାଦ ଥିର ହୋଇଯାଇଥାଏ।
seg.4bb7dd4c2c98.back: Serve with hot rice and chopped onion. Many Godavari homes serve it the next day, by when the flavour has settled.

seg.ec67fc31e8d9.src: Keep leftovers covered in the fridge and eat within 2 days. Reheat gently in the pan without stirring.
seg.ec67fc31e8d9.t: ବଳକା ଘୋଡ଼ାଇ ଫ୍ରିଜରେ ରଖନ୍ତୁ ଓ 2 ଦିନ ଭିତରେ ଖାଆନ୍ତୁ। ପ୍ୟାନରେ ନ ଘାଣ୍ଟି ଧୀରେ ପୁଣି ଗରମ କରନ୍ତୁ।
seg.ec67fc31e8d9.back: Keep leftovers covered in the fridge and eat within 2 days. Reheat gently in a pan without stirring.

seg.3fb4609a3953.src: Which fish is best for chepala pulusu?
seg.3fb4609a3953.t: ଚେପଲ ପୁଲୁସୁ ପାଇଁ କେଉଁ ମାଛ ସବୁଠୁ ଭଲ?
seg.3fb4609a3953.back: Which fish is best for chepala pulusu?

seg.81c757cf9b6b.src: Firm river or sea fish cut into thick steaks: rohu (bocha), murrel (korameenu), catla or seer fish. Bony small fish also work but need gentle handling.
seg.81c757cf9b6b.t: ମୋଟା ଖଣ୍ଡ କରି କଟା ନଦୀ ବା ସମୁଦ୍ରର ଟାଣ ମାଂସର ମାଛ: ରୋହି (ବୋଚ୍ଚା), ଶାଳ ମାଛ (କୋରମୀନୁ), ଭାକୁର ବା ସିର ମାଛ। କଣ୍ଟା ଥିବା ଛୋଟ ମାଛ ମଧ୍ୟ ଚଳେ, କିନ୍ତୁ ଯତ୍ନରେ ସମ୍ଭାଳିବାକୁ ପଡ଼େ।
seg.81c757cf9b6b.back: Firm-fleshed river or sea fish cut into thick pieces: rohu (bochcha), murrel (korameenu), bhakur or seer fish. Small fish with bones also do, but must be handled with care.

seg.1d2170a88905.src: Why does chepala pulusu taste better the next day?
seg.1d2170a88905.t: ଚେପଲ ପୁଲୁସୁ ପରଦିନ କାହିଁକି ଅଧିକ ସ୍ୱାଦିଷ୍ଟ ଲାଗେ?
seg.1d2170a88905.back: Why does chepala pulusu taste better the next day?

seg.566bd302c316.src: Resting gives the fish time to soak up the tamarind and chilli gravy, and the sourness and heat even out. That is why many homes cook it in the morning for dinner or the next day.
seg.566bd302c316.t: ରଖିଲେ ମାଛ ତେନ୍ତୁଳି ଓ ଲଙ୍କା ଗ୍ରେଭିକୁ ଟାଣିନେବାକୁ ସମୟ ପାଏ, ଆଉ ଖଟା ଓ ରାଗ ସମାନ ହୋଇଯାଏ। ସେଥିପାଇଁ ଅନେକ ଘରେ ଏହାକୁ ରାତି ଖାଇବା ବା ପରଦିନ ପାଇଁ ସକାଳେ ରାନ୍ଧନ୍ତି।
seg.566bd302c316.back: When kept, the fish gets time to draw in the tamarind and chilli gravy, and the sourness and heat even out. That is why many homes cook it in the morning for dinner or the next day.

seg.53fa2d1b73d6.src: How do I stop the fish from breaking in the curry?
seg.53fa2d1b73d6.back: How do I stop the fish from breaking in the curry?

seg.adc2b712af00.src: Use thick steaks, add them only after the gravy has boiled, keep the heat low and swirl the pan instead of stirring with a spoon.
seg.adc2b712af00.t: ମୋଟା ଖଣ୍ଡ ନିଅନ୍ତୁ, ଗ୍ରେଭି ଫୁଟିବା ପରେ ହିଁ ପକାନ୍ତୁ, ନିଆଁ ଧିମା ରଖନ୍ତୁ ଓ ଚାମଚରେ ଘାଣ୍ଟିବା ବଦଳରେ ପ୍ୟାନକୁ ଘୂରାନ୍ତୁ।
seg.adc2b712af00.back: Take thick pieces, add them only after the gravy boils, keep the flame low and swirl the pan instead of stirring with a spoon.

seg.9f483b378e98.src: How much tamarind for 500 g fish?
seg.9f483b378e98.back: How much tamarind for 500 g fish?

seg.f77f33d6b7c5.src: About 40 g, a lemon-sized ball, soaked in 2 cups of warm water. Use a little less if you add tomato or raw mango.
seg.f77f33d6b7c5.t: ପ୍ରାୟ 40 g, ଲେମ୍ବୁ ଆକାରର ଗୋଲା, 2 କପ ଉଷୁମ ପାଣିରେ ଭିଜାଇ। ଟମାଟା ବା କଞ୍ଚା ଆମ୍ବ ପକାଇଲେ ଟିକିଏ କମ୍ ନିଅନ୍ତୁ।
seg.f77f33d6b7c5.back: About 40 g, a lemon-sized ball, soaked in 2 cups warm water. If adding tomato or raw mango take a little less.

seg.d9010e0c2ca6.src: చేపల పులుసు · Andhra Fish Curry Recipe | 1acrefarms
seg.d9010e0c2ca6.t: చేపల పులుసు · ଆନ୍ଧ୍ର ମାଛ ତରକାରି ରେସିପି | 1acrefarms
seg.d9010e0c2ca6.back: చేపల పులుసు · Andhra fish curry recipe | 1acrefarms

seg.03c44db05afe.src: చేపల పులుసు. Godavari-style fish curry: fish simmered in a tangy tamarind gravy with onions, our turmeric and Sannam chilli powder. Serves 4, with tips and FAQs.
seg.03c44db05afe.t: చేపల పులుసు. ଗୋଦାବରୀ ଶୈଳୀର ମାଛ ତରକାରି: ପିଆଜ, ଆମ ହଳଦୀ ଓ ସନ୍ନମ ଲଙ୍କା ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ସହିତ ଖଟା ତେନ୍ତୁଳି ଗ୍ରେଭିରେ ଧିମା ଫୁଟା ମାଛ। 4 ଜଣଙ୍କ ପାଇଁ, ଟିପ୍ସ ଓ ପ୍ରଶ୍ନୋତ୍ତର ସହିତ।
seg.03c44db05afe.back: చేపల పులుసు. Godavari-style fish curry: fish simmered in a sour tamarind gravy with onion, our turmeric and Sannam chilli powder. For 4 people, with tips and Q&A.

seg.d8b8fe1085c2.src: Andhra Chepala Pulusu (Andhra Tamarind Fish Curry) · 1acrefarms
seg.d8b8fe1085c2.t: ଆନ୍ଧ୍ର ଚେପଲ ପୁଲୁସୁ (ଆନ୍ଧ୍ରର ତେନ୍ତୁଳି ମାଛ ତରକାରି) · 1acrefarms
seg.d8b8fe1085c2.back: Andhra Chepala Pulusu (Andhra tamarind fish curry) · 1acrefarms

seg.244c08d4fc5c.src: Andhra Chepala Pulusu: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.244c08d4fc5c.t: ଆନ୍ଧ୍ର ଚେପଲ ପୁଲୁସୁ: 1acrefarmsର ରେସିପି କାର୍ଡ, ଉପକରଣ ଓ ପ୍ରଣାଳୀ ସହିତ
seg.244c08d4fc5c.back: Andhra Chepala Pulusu: 1acrefarms recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.fabe2a976262.src: Gongura mamsam is mutton cooked with gongura, the sour sorrel leaf that Andhra, and Guntur above all, treats as its own. The mutton is cooked soft with chilli and turmeric, then simmered with gongura that has been sauteed down to a dark, tangy paste, until the curry is thick and the oil rises to the top.
seg.fabe2a976262.t: ଗୋଙ୍ଗୁରା ମାଂସମ ହେଉଛି ଗୋଙ୍ଗୁରା ସହିତ ରନ୍ଧା ମଟନ; ଗୋଙ୍ଗୁରା ହେଉଛି ସେହି ଖଟା ପତ୍ର ଯାହାକୁ ଆନ୍ଧ୍ର, ବିଶେଷ କରି ଗୁଣ୍ଟୁର, ନିଜର ବୋଲି ମାନେ। ମଟନକୁ ଲଙ୍କା ଓ ହଳଦୀ ସହିତ ନରମ କରି ସିଝାଇ, ତାପରେ ଭାଜି ଗାଢ଼ ଓ ଖଟା ବଟା ପରି କରାଯାଇଥିବା ଗୋଙ୍ଗୁରା ସହିତ ଧିମା ଫୁଟାଯାଏ, ଯେପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ ତରକାରି ବହଳ ହୋଇ ତେଲ ଉପରକୁ ନ ଉଠେ।
seg.fabe2a976262.back: Gongura mamsam is mutton cooked with gongura; gongura is that sour leaf which Andhra, especially Guntur, considers its own. The mutton is boiled soft with chilli and turmeric, then simmered with gongura that has been fried into a dark, sour paste, until the curry thickens and oil rises to the top.

seg.a26e996a46c7.src: Gongura's sharp sourness needs strong heat to stand up to it, and that comes from our Teja chilli powder, the extra-hot Guntur chilli, with our turmeric powder alongside. Serves 4 with rice.
seg.a26e996a46c7.t: ଗୋଙ୍ଗୁରାର ତୀବ୍ର ଖଟା ସହିତ ଟକ୍କର ଦେବାକୁ କଡ଼ା ରାଗ ଦରକାର, ଆଉ ତାହା ଆସେ ଆମ ତେଜା ଲଙ୍କା ଗୁଣ୍ଡରୁ, ଗୁଣ୍ଟୁରର ଅତି ରାଗୁଆ ଲଙ୍କା, ସାଙ୍ଗରେ ଆମ ହଳଦୀ ଗୁଣ୍ଡ। ଭାତ ସହିତ 4 ଜଣଙ୍କ ପାଇଁ।
seg.a26e996a46c7.back: To stand up to gongura's sharp sourness a strong heat is needed, and that comes from our Teja chilli powder, Guntur's very hot chilli, along with our turmeric powder. With rice, for 4 people.

seg.18985156497a.src: Pressure-cook mutton with Teja chilli powder, turmeric powder and ginger-garlic paste, then simmer it with an onion masala and sauteed gongura leaves till thick and the oil floats on top.
seg.18985156497a.t: ମଟନକୁ ତେଜା ଲଙ୍କା ଗୁଣ୍ଡ, ହଳଦୀ ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ଓ ଅଦା-ରସୁଣ ବଟା ସହିତ ପ୍ରେସର କୁକରରେ ସିଝାନ୍ତୁ, ତାପରେ ପିଆଜ ମସଲା ଓ ଭଜା ଗୋଙ୍ଗୁରା ପତ୍ର ସହିତ ବହଳ ହୋଇ ତେଲ ଉପରେ ଭାସିବା ଯାଏ ଧିମା ଫୁଟାନ୍ତୁ।
seg.18985156497a.back: Boil the mutton in a pressure cooker with Teja chilli powder, turmeric powder and ginger-garlic paste, then simmer with the onion masala and fried gongura leaves until thick and oil floats on top.

seg.b4cc59b185d3.src: 750 g mutton ⟦1⟧bone-in curry cut, washed and drained⟦/1⟧
seg.b4cc59b185d3.t: 750 g ମଟନ ⟦1⟧ହାଡ଼ ସହିତ ତରକାରି ଖଣ୍ଡ, ଧୋଇ ପାଣି ଛାଣିଥିବା⟦/1⟧
seg.b4cc59b185d3.back: 750 g mutton ⟦1⟧bone-in curry pieces, washed and drained⟦/1⟧

seg.b66b468c45f7.src: 4 cups gongura leaves ⟦1⟧about 2 bunches (150 g), picked from the stems, washed and drained well⟦/1⟧
seg.b66b468c45f7.t: 4 କପ ଗୋଙ୍ଗୁରା ପତ୍ର ⟦1⟧ପ୍ରାୟ 2 ବିଡ଼ା (150 g), ଡେମ୍ଫରୁ ଛଡ଼ାଇ, ଧୋଇ ଭଲ କରି ପାଣି ଛାଣିଥିବା⟦/1⟧
seg.b66b468c45f7.back: 4 cups gongura leaves ⟦1⟧about 2 bunches (150 g), picked off the stems, washed and well drained⟦/1⟧

seg.9d6372d75a2f.src: 4 tbsp oil ⟦1⟧groundnut oil is the usual choice⟦/1⟧

seg.c89b5d92359a.src: Put the mutton in a pressure cooker with the Teja chilli powder, turmeric powder, ginger-garlic paste and salt, mix well and leave for 15 minutes.
seg.c89b5d92359a.t: ମଟନକୁ ତେଜା ଲଙ୍କା ଗୁଣ୍ଡ, ହଳଦୀ ଗୁଣ୍ଡ, ଅଦା-ରସୁଣ ବଟା ଓ ଲୁଣ ସହିତ ପ୍ରେସର କୁକରରେ ରଖନ୍ତୁ, ଭଲ କରି ମିଶାଇ 15 ମିନିଟ ଛାଡ଼ି ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ।
seg.c89b5d92359a.back: Put the mutton in the pressure cooker with Teja chilli powder, turmeric powder, ginger-garlic paste and salt, mix well and leave 15 minutes.

seg.d7a27bd7d1d5.src: Pressure-cook the mutton with Teja chilli powder, turmeric, ginger-garlic paste, salt and water. Add the 1½ cups water and cook for 5–6 whistles on medium heat, then let the pressure drop on its own.
seg.d7a27bd7d1d5.t: ମଟନକୁ ତେଜା ଲଙ୍କା ଗୁଣ୍ଡ, ହଳଦୀ, ଅଦା-ରସୁଣ ବଟା, ଲୁଣ ଓ ପାଣି ସହିତ ପ୍ରେସର କୁକରରେ ସିଝାନ୍ତୁ। 1½ କପ ପାଣି ପକାଇ ମଧ୍ୟମ ନିଆଁରେ 5–6 ସିଟି ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ, ତାପରେ ପ୍ରେସର ନିଜେ ନିଜେ କମିବାକୁ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ।
seg.d7a27bd7d1d5.back: Boil the mutton in the pressure cooker with Teja chilli powder, turmeric, ginger-garlic paste, salt and water. Add 1½ cups water and on medium flame give 5–6 whistles, then let the pressure release by itself.

seg.c084351b01db.src: Open the cooker and check a piece: the mutton is done when it is tender and pulls away from the bone easily with a spoon. If not, cook for 1–2 more whistles.
seg.c084351b01db.t: କୁକର ଖୋଲି ଗୋଟିଏ ଖଣ୍ଡ ଦେଖନ୍ତୁ: ମଟନ ନରମ ହୋଇ ଚାମଚରେ ସହଜରେ ହାଡ଼ରୁ ଛାଡ଼ିଗଲେ ସିଝିଯାଇଛି। ନ ହୋଇଥିଲେ ଆଉ 1–2 ସିଟି ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ।
seg.c084351b01db.back: Open the cooker and check one piece: if the mutton is soft and comes away easily from the bone with a spoon, it is cooked. If not, give 1–2 more whistles.

seg.80af0da3b5a1.src: While the mutton cooks, heat the 1 tbsp oil in a pan on medium heat.
seg.80af0da3b5a1.t: ମଟନ ସିଝୁଥିବା ବେଳେ ଏକ ପ୍ୟାନରେ ମଧ୍ୟମ ନିଆଁରେ 1 ଟେବୁଲ ଚାମଚ ତେଲ ଗରମ କରନ୍ତୁ।
seg.80af0da3b5a1.back: While the mutton is boiling heat 1 tablespoon oil in a pan on medium flame.

seg.c59d6a34def2.src: Saute the gongura with green chillies in a little oil till it melts to a dark paste. This takes 8–10 minutes; stir often and mash the leaves with the back of the spoon as they wilt.
seg.c59d6a34def2.t: ଗୋଙ୍ଗୁରାକୁ କଞ୍ଚା ଲଙ୍କା ସହିତ ଅଳ୍ପ ତେଲରେ ଭାଜନ୍ତୁ ଯେପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ ତାହା ଗଳି ଗାଢ଼ ବଟା ପରି ନ ହୁଏ। ଏଥିରେ 8–10 ମିନିଟ ଲାଗେ; ବାରମ୍ବାର ଘାଣ୍ଟନ୍ତୁ ଓ ପତ୍ର ଅଉଁଳିବା ବେଳେ ଚାମଚର ପଛ ପଟରେ ଚକଟନ୍ତୁ।
seg.c59d6a34def2.back: Fry the gongura with green chillies in a little oil until it melts into a dark paste. This takes 8–10 minutes; stir often and mash with the back of a spoon as the leaves wilt.

seg.37056d0dd9cf.src: Heat the 4 tbsp oil in a heavy kadai on medium heat and add the cloves, cardamoms and cinnamon.
seg.37056d0dd9cf.t: ଏକ ମୋଟା କଡ଼ାଇରେ ମଧ୍ୟମ ନିଆଁରେ 4 ଟେବୁଲ ଚାମଚ ତେଲ ଗରମ କରି ଲବଙ୍ଗ, ଅଳେଇଚ ଓ ଦାଲଚିନି ପକାନ୍ତୁ।
seg.37056d0dd9cf.back: Heat 4 tablespoons oil on medium flame in a thick kadai and add cloves, cardamom and cinnamon.

seg.26a945a9fad3.src: Fry the onions with whole spices till golden. Add the curry leaves with the onions, and give them 10–12 minutes, stirring often.
seg.26a945a9fad3.t: ଗୋଟା ମସଲା ସହିତ ପିଆଜକୁ ସୁନେଲି ହେବା ଯାଏ ଭାଜନ୍ତୁ। ପିଆଜ ସହିତ ଭୃସଙ୍ଗ ପତ୍ର ପକାନ୍ତୁ, ଆଉ ବାରମ୍ବାର ଘାଣ୍ଟି 10–12 ମିନିଟ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ।
seg.26a945a9fad3.back: Fry the onion with the whole spices until golden. Add curry leaves with the onion, and give it 10–12 minutes stirring often.

seg.4dd72cc1abd0.src: Stir in the coriander powder and fry for 30 seconds. Add the mutton and its stock, then the gongura.
seg.4dd72cc1abd0.t: ଧନିଆ ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ମିଶାଇ 30 ସେକେଣ୍ଡ ଭାଜନ୍ତୁ। ମଟନ ଓ ତାର ଝୋଳ ପକାନ୍ତୁ, ତାପରେ ଗୋଙ୍ଗୁରା।
seg.4dd72cc1abd0.back: Mix in coriander powder and fry 30 seconds. Add the mutton and its stock, then the gongura.

seg.46f5f6c735ac.src: Simmer till thick and the oil floats on top. Keep the heat low, stir now and then, and allow 12–15 minutes. Taste and adjust the salt now, once the sourness of the gongura is in.
seg.46f5f6c735ac.t: ବହଳ ହୋଇ ତେଲ ଉପରେ ଭାସିବା ଯାଏ ଧିମା ଫୁଟାନ୍ତୁ। ନିଆଁ ଧିମା ରଖନ୍ତୁ, ମଝିରେ ମଝିରେ ଘାଣ୍ଟନ୍ତୁ, ଆଉ 12–15 ମିନିଟ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ। ଗୋଙ୍ଗୁରାର ଖଟା ମିଶିଗଲା ପରେ ଏବେ ଚାଖି ଲୁଣ ଠିକ କରନ୍ତୁ।
seg.46f5f6c735ac.back: Simmer until thick and oil floats on top. Keep the flame low, stir now and then, and give it 12–15 minutes. Once the gongura's sourness has blended in, taste now and adjust salt.

seg.0abf0f798bd3.src: Stir in garam masala. Cook 2 more minutes, then switch off and rest for 10 minutes before serving.
seg.0abf0f798bd3.t: ଗରମ ମସଲା ମିଶାନ୍ତୁ। ଆଉ 2 ମିନିଟ ରାନ୍ଧନ୍ତୁ, ତାପରେ ନିଆଁ ବନ୍ଦ କରି ପରଷିବା ଆଗରୁ 10 ମିନିଟ ରଖନ୍ତୁ।
seg.0abf0f798bd3.back: Mix in garam masala. Cook 2 more minutes, then turn off the flame and keep 10 minutes before serving.

seg.c57eb6bfb001.src: Taste after the gongura goes in; its sourness varies from bunch to bunch.
seg.c57eb6bfb001.t: ଗୋଙ୍ଗୁରା ପକାଇବା ପରେ ଚାଖନ୍ତୁ; ଏହାର ଖଟା ବିଡ଼ା ଅନୁସାରେ ଅଲଗା ଅଲଗା ହୁଏ।
seg.c57eb6bfb001.back: Taste after adding the gongura; its sourness differs from bunch to bunch.

seg.5544823d42b4.src: Teja chilli powder is very hot. For medium heat use 1 tsp, or Sannam chilli powder; do not cut it out entirely, or the gongura tastes flat and sour.
seg.5544823d42b4.t: ତେଜା ଲଙ୍କା ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ବହୁତ ରାଗୁଆ। ମଧ୍ୟମ ରାଗ ପାଇଁ 1 ଚା ଚାମଚ ନିଅନ୍ତୁ, କିମ୍ବା ସନ୍ନମ ଲଙ୍କା ଗୁଣ୍ଡ; ଏହାକୁ ପୂରା ବାଦ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ ନାହିଁ, ନଚେତ୍ ଗୋଙ୍ଗୁରା ଫିକା ଓ କେବଳ ଖଟା ଲାଗେ।
seg.5544823d42b4.back: Teja chilli powder is very hot. For medium heat take 1 teaspoon, or Sannam chilli powder; do not leave it out completely, otherwise the gongura tastes flat and only sour.

seg.62683a58a9fd.src: Do not use an aluminium pan for the gongura; its sourness reacts with the metal and darkens the curry. Use steel or cast iron.
seg.62683a58a9fd.t: ଗୋଙ୍ଗୁରା ପାଇଁ ଆଲୁମିନିୟମ ପ୍ୟାନ ବ୍ୟବହାର କରନ୍ତୁ ନାହିଁ; ଏହାର ଖଟା ଧାତୁ ସହିତ ପ୍ରତିକ୍ରିୟା କରି ତରକାରିକୁ କଳା କରିଦିଏ। ଷ୍ଟିଲ ବା ଢଳେଇ ଲୁହା ବ୍ୟବହାର କରନ୍ତୁ।
seg.62683a58a9fd.back: Do not use an aluminium pan for gongura; its sourness reacts with the metal and turns the curry black. Use steel or cast iron.

seg.d036336075e5.src: If the gongura is very sour, add 1 more onion to the masala to balance it.
seg.d036336075e5.t: ଗୋଙ୍ଗୁରା ବହୁତ ଖଟା ହେଲେ, ସନ୍ତୁଳନ ପାଇଁ ମସଲାରେ ଆଉ 1ଟି ପିଆଜ ପକାନ୍ତୁ।
seg.d036336075e5.back: If the gongura is very sour, add 1 more onion to the masala for balance.

seg.8faa3986eaa2.src: Gongura chicken: use 750 g bone-in chicken, skip the pressure cooker and cook it covered in the masala for 20–25 minutes, until no pink remains near the bone, before the gongura goes in.
seg.8faa3986eaa2.t: ଗୋଙ୍ଗୁରା ଚିକେନ: 750 g ହାଡ଼ ସହିତ ଚିକେନ ନିଅନ୍ତୁ, ପ୍ରେସର କୁକର ବାଦ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ, ଆଉ ଗୋଙ୍ଗୁରା ପକାଇବା ଆଗରୁ ମସଲାରେ ଘୋଡ଼ାଇ 20–25 ମିନିଟ ରାନ୍ଧନ୍ତୁ, ଯେପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ ହାଡ଼ ପାଖରେ କୌଣସି ଗୋଲାପି ଅଂଶ ନ ରହେ।
seg.8faa3986eaa2.back: Gongura chicken: take 750 g bone-in chicken, skip the pressure cooker, and before adding gongura cook covered in the masala 20–25 minutes, until no pink part remains near the bone.

seg.2ebce7872a6e.src: Gongura royyalu: use 500 g cleaned prawns, add them after the onions and cook 5–6 minutes, just until they turn pink and curl, then add the gongura.
seg.2ebce7872a6e.t: ଗୋଙ୍ଗୁରା ରୋୟ୍ୟଲୁ: 500 g ସଫା କରା ଚିଙ୍ଗୁଡ଼ି ନିଅନ୍ତୁ, ପିଆଜ ପରେ ପକାଇ 5–6 ମିନିଟ ରାନ୍ଧନ୍ତୁ, କେବଳ ଗୋଲାପି ହୋଇ ମୋଡ଼ି ହେବା ଯାଏ, ତାପରେ ଗୋଙ୍ଗୁରା ପକାନ୍ତୁ।
seg.2ebce7872a6e.back: Gongura royyalu: take 500 g cleaned prawns, add after the onion and cook 5–6 minutes, only until they turn pink and curl, then add the gongura.

seg.7f3c45600b1c.src: Red chilli gongura: fry 6 dried red chillies with the gongura and grind them together for a darker, sharper curry.
seg.7f3c45600b1c.t: ଶୁଖିଲା ଲାଲ ଲଙ୍କା ଗୋଙ୍ଗୁରା: ଅଧିକ ଗାଢ଼ ଓ ତୀକ୍ଷ୍ଣ ତରକାରି ପାଇଁ 6ଟି ଶୁଖିଲା ଲାଲ ଲଙ୍କା ଗୋଙ୍ଗୁରା ସହିତ ଭାଜି ଦୁହିଁକୁ ଏକାଠି ବାଟନ୍ତୁ।
seg.7f3c45600b1c.back: Dry red chilli gongura: for a darker and sharper curry fry 6 dry red chillies with the gongura and grind the two together.

seg.6fc7d7ad8ce1.src: Serve hot with steamed rice and a spoon of ghee, or with jonna rotte. A plain raw onion on the side is the Guntur way.
seg.6fc7d7ad8ce1.t: ଗରମ ଭାତ ଓ ଚାମଚେ ଘିଅ ସହିତ, କିମ୍ବା ଜୋନ୍ନା ରୋଟ୍ଟେ (ଜୁଆର ରୁଟି) ସହିତ ଗରମ ଗରମ ପରଷନ୍ତୁ। ପାଖରେ ଗୋଟିଏ କଞ୍ଚା ପିଆଜ ରଖିବା ଗୁଣ୍ଟୁରର ଢଙ୍ଗ।
seg.6fc7d7ad8ce1.back: Serve piping hot with hot rice and a spoon of ghee, or with jonna rotte (jowar roti). Keeping a raw onion alongside is the Guntur way.

seg.a4e072616940.src: Keep covered in the fridge for up to 3 days; reheat until steaming hot all the way through. Like most sour curries, it tastes better the next day.
seg.a4e072616940.t: ଘୋଡ଼ାଇ ଫ୍ରିଜରେ 3 ଦିନ ପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ ରଖନ୍ତୁ; ଭିତର ଯାଏ ଭଲ ଭାବେ ଗରମ ହୋଇ ବାଷ୍ପ ବାହାରିବା ଯାଏ ପୁଣି ଗରମ କରନ୍ତୁ। ଅଧିକାଂଶ ଖଟା ତରକାରି ପରି, ପରଦିନ ଏହା ଅଧିକ ସ୍ୱାଦିଷ୍ଟ ଲାଗେ।
seg.a4e072616940.back: Keep covered in the fridge up to 3 days; reheat until well heated through to the inside and steam comes out. Like most sour curries, it tastes better the next day.

seg.056a57b2c0f8.back: What is gongura called in English?

seg.50430ec58f61.src: Gongura is sorrel leaves, also called roselle or red sorrel (ambadi in Marathi, pitwa in Hindi). The leaves are sour and cook down to a dark paste.
seg.50430ec58f61.t: ଗୋଙ୍ଗୁରା ହେଉଛି ସରେଲ ପତ୍ର, ଯାହାକୁ ରୋଜେଲ ବା ଲାଲ ସରେଲ ମଧ୍ୟ କହନ୍ତି (ମରାଠୀରେ ଅମ୍ବାଡ଼ି, ହିନ୍ଦୀରେ ପିଟୱା)। ପତ୍ର ଖଟା ଓ ରାନ୍ଧିଲେ ଗାଢ଼ ବଟା ପରି ହୋଇଯାଏ।
seg.50430ec58f61.back: Gongura is sorrel leaf, also called roselle or red sorrel (ambadi in Marathi, pitwa in Hindi). The leaves are sour and when cooked become a dark paste.

seg.c813168eb832.src: Can I use gongura pickle instead of gongura leaves?
seg.c813168eb832.t: ଗୋଙ୍ଗୁରା ପତ୍ର ବଦଳରେ ଗୋଙ୍ଗୁରା ଆଚାର ବ୍ୟବହାର କରିପାରିବି କି?
seg.c813168eb832.back: Can I use gongura pickle instead of gongura leaves?

seg.e1453431b91a.src: Yes, in a pinch. Stir in 3–4 tbsp gongura pickle in place of the sauteed leaves and cut down the salt and chilli powder, since the pickle already has both.
seg.e1453431b91a.t: ହଁ, ଦରକାର ପଡ଼ିଲେ। ଭଜା ପତ୍ର ବଦଳରେ 3–4 ଟେବୁଲ ଚାମଚ ଗୋଙ୍ଗୁରା ଆଚାର ମିଶାନ୍ତୁ ଓ ଲୁଣ ଓ ଲଙ୍କା ଗୁଣ୍ଡ କମାନ୍ତୁ, କାରଣ ଆଚାରରେ ଦୁହେଁ ଆଗରୁ ଅଛି।
seg.e1453431b91a.back: Yes, if needed. Instead of the fried leaves mix in 3–4 tablespoons gongura pickle and reduce salt and chilli powder, because both are already in the pickle.

seg.13ee618e3c36.src: How long should I pressure-cook mutton for gongura mamsam?
seg.13ee618e3c36.t: ଗୋଙ୍ଗୁରା ମାଂସମ ପାଇଁ ମଟନକୁ କେତେ ସମୟ ପ୍ରେସର କୁକରରେ ସିଝାଇବି?
seg.13ee618e3c36.back: How long should I pressure cook the mutton for gongura mamsam?

seg.5888ba63831a.src: About 5–6 whistles on medium heat for bone-in curry-cut mutton. It is done when the meat pulls away from the bone easily; older mutton may need 1–2 more whistles.
seg.5888ba63831a.t: ହାଡ଼ ସହିତ ତରକାରି ଖଣ୍ଡ ମଟନ ପାଇଁ ମଧ୍ୟମ ନିଆଁରେ ପ୍ରାୟ 5–6 ସିଟି। ମାଂସ ସହଜରେ ହାଡ଼ରୁ ଛାଡ଼ିଗଲେ ସିଝିଯାଇଛି; ବୟସ୍କ ଛେଳି ମାଂସରେ ଆଉ 1–2 ସିଟି ଲାଗିପାରେ।
seg.5888ba63831a.back: For bone-in curry-cut mutton about 5–6 whistles on medium flame. When the meat comes away easily from the bone it is cooked; older goat meat may need 1–2 more whistles.

seg.5f47c430018f.src: How do I make gongura mutton less spicy?
seg.5f47c430018f.t: ଗୋଙ୍ଗୁରା ମଟନକୁ କିପରି କମ୍ ରାଗୁଆ କରିବି?
seg.5f47c430018f.back: How do I make gongura mutton less hot?

seg.e4fe5fb9cf48.src: Use 1 tsp Teja chilli powder or swap in Sannam chilli powder, and use 2 green chillies. Keep some heat, as it balances the sourness of the gongura.
seg.e4fe5fb9cf48.t: 1 ଚା ଚାମଚ ତେଜା ଲଙ୍କା ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ନିଅନ୍ତୁ ବା ତା ବଦଳରେ ସନ୍ନମ ଲଙ୍କା ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ, ଆଉ 2ଟି କଞ୍ଚା ଲଙ୍କା ନିଅନ୍ତୁ। କିଛି ରାଗ ରଖନ୍ତୁ, କାରଣ ତାହା ଗୋଙ୍ଗୁରାର ଖଟାକୁ ସନ୍ତୁଳିତ କରେ।
seg.e4fe5fb9cf48.back: Take 1 teaspoon Teja chilli powder or use Sannam chilli powder instead, and take 2 green chillies. Keep some heat, because it balances the gongura's sourness.

seg.df5186f8f459.src: గోంగూర మాంసం. Gongura mutton, the Guntur way: mutton cooked with Teja chilli powder and turmeric powder, then simmered with sour sorrel leaves till thick.
seg.df5186f8f459.t: గోంగూర మాంసం. ଗୁଣ୍ଟୁର ଢଙ୍ଗର ଗୋଙ୍ଗୁରା ମଟନ: ତେଜା ଲଙ୍କା ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ଓ ହଳଦୀ ଗୁଣ୍ଡରେ ରନ୍ଧା ମଟନ, ତାପରେ ଖଟା ସରେଲ ପତ୍ର ସହିତ ବହଳ ହେବା ଯାଏ ଧିମା ଫୁଟା।
seg.df5186f8f459.back: గోంగూర మాంసం. Guntur-style gongura mutton: mutton cooked in Teja chilli powder and turmeric powder, then simmered with sour sorrel leaves until thick.

seg.dffa96c4d761.src: Gongura Mamsam: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.dffa96c4d761.t: ଗୋଙ୍ଗୁରା ମାଂସମ: 1acrefarmsର ରେସିପି କାର୍ଡ, ଉପକରଣ ଓ ପ୍ରଣାଳୀ ସହିତ
seg.dffa96c4d761.back: Gongura Mamsam: 1acrefarms recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.a7dd4a4d025c.src: Gongura pachadi is the chutney Andhra is best known for: sour gongura (sorrel) leaves fried down in oil and ground with roasted spices, garlic and red chilli. Around Guntur and Palnadu it is on the table almost every day, mixed into hot rice with a spoon of ghee, with sliced onion on the side.
seg.a7dd4a4d025c.t: ଗୋଙ୍ଗୁରା ପଚ୍ଚଡ଼ି ହେଉଛି ସେହି ଚଟଣି ଯାହା ପାଇଁ ଆନ୍ଧ୍ର ସବୁଠୁ ବେଶି ଜଣାଶୁଣା: ଖଟା ଗୋଙ୍ଗୁରା (ସରେଲ) ପତ୍ରକୁ ତେଲରେ ଭାଜି ଗଳାଇ, ଭଜା ମସଲା, ରସୁଣ ଓ ଲାଲ ଲଙ୍କା ସହିତ ବଟାଯାଏ। ଗୁଣ୍ଟୁର ଓ ପଲ୍ନାଡୁ ଅଞ୍ଚଳରେ ଏହା ପ୍ରାୟ ପ୍ରତିଦିନ ଖାଇବା ଥାଳିରେ ଥାଏ, ଗରମ ଭାତରେ ଚାମଚେ ଘିଅ ସହିତ ମିଶାଇ, ପାଖରେ କଟା ପିଆଜ ସହିତ।
seg.a7dd4a4d025c.back: Gongura pachadi is the chutney for which Andhra is best known: sour gongura (sorrel) leaves are fried in oil until they melt, and ground with roasted spices, garlic and red chilli. In the Guntur and Palnadu region it is on the meal plate almost every day, mixed into hot rice with a spoon of ghee, with chopped onion alongside.

seg.73ddd8b1df98.src: Teja chilli powder gives it the deep red colour and the sharp heat that stands up to the sourness of the leaves. This recipe makes about 1½ cups, enough for 6.
seg.73ddd8b1df98.t: ତେଜା ଲଙ୍କା ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ଏହାକୁ ଗାଢ଼ ଲାଲ ରଙ୍ଗ ଓ ପତ୍ରର ଖଟା ସହିତ ଟକ୍କର ଦେଉଥିବା ତୀକ୍ଷ୍ଣ ରାଗ ଦିଏ। ଏହି ରେସିପିରେ ପ୍ରାୟ 1½ କପ ହୁଏ, 6 ଜଣଙ୍କ ପାଇଁ ଯଥେଷ୍ଟ।
seg.73ddd8b1df98.back: Teja chilli powder gives it a deep red colour and a sharp heat that stands up to the sourness of the leaves. This recipe makes about 1½ cups, enough for 6 people.

seg.1689d390a49e.src: Total includes cooling the leaves and spices before grinding.
seg.1689d390a49e.t: ମୋଟ ସମୟରେ ବାଟିବା ଆଗରୁ ପତ୍ର ଓ ମସଲା ଥଣ୍ଡା କରିବା ସମୟ ମଧ୍ୟ ଅଛି।
seg.1689d390a49e.back: The total time also includes time for cooling the leaves and spices before grinding.

seg.b4b21c43d6d9.src: Fry gongura leaves in oil till they turn to a dark mash, then grind them with roasted coriander, fenugreek, garlic, Teja chilli powder and salt. Finish with a mustard and dal tempering.
seg.b4b21c43d6d9.t: ଗୋଙ୍ଗୁରା ପତ୍ରକୁ ତେଲରେ ଗାଢ଼ ଚକଟା ହେବା ଯାଏ ଭାଜନ୍ତୁ, ତାପରେ ଭଜା ଧନିଆ, ମେଥି, ରସୁଣ, ତେଜା ଲଙ୍କା ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ଓ ଲୁଣ ସହିତ ବାଟନ୍ତୁ। ଶେଷରେ ସୋରିଷ ଓ ଡାଲିର ଛୁଙ୍କ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ।
seg.b4b21c43d6d9.back: Fry the gongura leaves in oil until dark and mashed, then grind with roasted coriander, fenugreek, garlic, Teja chilli powder and salt. At the end give a tempering of mustard and dal.

seg.bc1f3c96e98a.src: 4 cups gongura leaves ⟦1⟧picked from 2 large bunches, about 200 g⟦/1⟧
seg.bc1f3c96e98a.t: 4 କପ ଗୋଙ୍ଗୁରା ପତ୍ର ⟦1⟧2ଟି ବଡ଼ ବିଡ଼ାରୁ ଛଡ଼ା, ପ୍ରାୟ 200 g⟦/1⟧
seg.bc1f3c96e98a.back: 4 cups gongura leaves ⟦1⟧picked from 2 large bunches, about 200 g⟦/1⟧

seg.e478a092b07c.src: 1 tbsp sesame oil ⟦1⟧gingelly oil, for frying the leaves⟦/1⟧
seg.e478a092b07c.t: 1 ଟେବୁଲ ଚାମଚ ରାଶି ତେଲ ⟦1⟧ଜିଞ୍ଜେଲି ତେଲ, ପତ୍ର ଭାଜିବା ପାଇଁ⟦/1⟧
seg.e478a092b07c.back: 1 tablespoon sesame oil ⟦1⟧gingelly oil, for frying the leaves⟦/1⟧

seg.b00132daaabc.src: ¼ tsp fenugreek seeds ⟦1⟧menthulu; no more, or the pachadi turns bitter⟦/1⟧
seg.b00132daaabc.t: ¼ ଚା ଚାମଚ ମେଥି ⟦1⟧ମେନ୍ଥୁଲୁ; ଏହାଠୁ ବେଶି ନୁହେଁ, ନଚେତ୍ ପଚ୍ଚଡ଼ି ପିତା ହୋଇଯାଏ⟦/1⟧
seg.b00132daaabc.back: ¼ teaspoon fenugreek ⟦1⟧menthulu; not more than this, otherwise the pachadi turns bitter⟦/1⟧

seg.c1657b10781a.src: 2 tsp Teja chilli powder ⟦1⟧very hot; use 1 tsp for a milder pachadi⟦/1⟧
seg.c1657b10781a.t: 2 ଚା ଚାମଚ ତେଜା ଲଙ୍କା ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ⟦1⟧ବହୁତ ରାଗୁଆ; କମ୍ ରାଗୁଆ ପଚ୍ଚଡ଼ି ପାଇଁ 1 ଚା ଚାମଚ ନିଅନ୍ତୁ⟦/1⟧
seg.c1657b10781a.back: 2 teaspoons Teja chilli powder ⟦1⟧very hot; for a less hot pachadi take 1 teaspoon⟦/1⟧

seg.7e344ce94138.t: ¾ ଚା ଚାମଚ ଲୁଣ ⟦1⟧କିମ୍ବା ସ୍ୱାଦ ଅନୁସାରେ⟦/1⟧
seg.7e344ce94138.back: ¾ teaspoon salt ⟦1⟧or as per taste⟦/1⟧

seg.69e8fc35d187.src: Pick the gongura leaves off the stems and wash them in 2–3 changes of water. Spread them on a cloth and pat them completely dry; water left on the leaves splutters in the oil and shortens how long the pachadi keeps.
seg.69e8fc35d187.t: ଗୋଙ୍ଗୁରା ପତ୍ରକୁ ଡେମ୍ଫରୁ ଛଡ଼ାଇ 2–3 ଥର ପାଣି ବଦଳାଇ ଧୁଅନ୍ତୁ। ଏକ କପଡ଼ାରେ ବିଛାଇ ପୂରା ଶୁଖାଇ ପୋଛନ୍ତୁ; ପତ୍ରରେ ରହିଯାଇଥିବା ପାଣି ତେଲରେ ଛିଟିକେ ଓ ପଚ୍ଚଡ଼ି କମ୍ ଦିନ ରହେ।
seg.69e8fc35d187.back: Pick the gongura leaves from the stems and wash 2–3 times changing the water. Spread on a cloth and wipe completely dry; water left on the leaves splutters in the oil and the pachadi keeps fewer days.

seg.1b214adb5a9c.src: Roast the coriander, cumin and fenugreek till fragrant; let them cool. Use a dry pan on low heat and stir all the time: the fenugreek should turn one shade darker, about 2 minutes, but not brown.
seg.1b214adb5a9c.t: ଧନିଆ, ଜିରା ଓ ମେଥିକୁ ବାସନା ଆସିବା ଯାଏ ଭାଜନ୍ତୁ; ଥଣ୍ଡା ହେବାକୁ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ। ଧିମା ନିଆଁରେ ଶୁଖିଲା ପ୍ୟାନ ବ୍ୟବହାର କରି ସବୁବେଳେ ଘାଣ୍ଟନ୍ତୁ: ମେଥି ଏକ ଛାଇ ଗାଢ଼ ହେବା ଉଚିତ, ପ୍ରାୟ 2 ମିନିଟ, କିନ୍ତୁ ବାଦାମୀ ନୁହେଁ।
