seg.1b214adb5a9c.back: Roast coriander, cumin and fenugreek until aromatic; let cool. Use a dry pan on low flame and stir all the time: the fenugreek should turn one shade darker, about 2 minutes, but not brown.

seg.6dd2ecdfbc2f.src: Fry the gongura leaves in 1 tbsp oil till they wilt to a dark mash, 6–8 minutes. Use a wide pan on medium heat and stir often; the leaves shrink fast, turn from green to a dull olive-brown, and almost all their water cooks off.
seg.6dd2ecdfbc2f.t: ଗୋଙ୍ଗୁରା ପତ୍ରକୁ 1 ଟେବୁଲ ଚାମଚ ତେଲରେ ଅଉଁଳି ଗାଢ଼ ଚକଟା ହେବା ଯାଏ ଭାଜନ୍ତୁ, 6–8 ମିନିଟ। ମଧ୍ୟମ ନିଆଁରେ ଚଉଡ଼ା ପ୍ୟାନ ବ୍ୟବହାର କରି ବାରମ୍ବାର ଘାଣ୍ଟନ୍ତୁ; ପତ୍ର ଶୀଘ୍ର ସଙ୍କୁଚିତ ହୁଏ, ସବୁଜରୁ ଫିକା ଅଲିଭ-ବାଦାମୀ ହୁଏ, ଆଉ ପ୍ରାୟ ସବୁ ପାଣି ଶୁଖିଯାଏ।
seg.6dd2ecdfbc2f.back: Wilt the gongura leaves in 1 tablespoon oil and fry until dark and mashed, 6–8 minutes. Use a wide pan on medium flame and stir often; the leaves shrink quickly, go from green to a pale olive-brown, and almost all the water dries up.

seg.adc2540067f6.src: Spread the leaves on a plate and let them cool completely, about 10 minutes.
seg.adc2540067f6.t: ପତ୍ରକୁ ଏକ ଥାଳିରେ ବିଛାଇ ପୂରା ଥଣ୍ଡା ହେବାକୁ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ, ପ୍ରାୟ 10 ମିନିଟ।
seg.adc2540067f6.back: Spread the leaves on a plate and let them cool completely, about 10 minutes.

seg.78d34fa0267e.src: Grind the spices with the garlic, chilli powder and salt, then pulse in the leaves. Grind the roasted spices, the 6 garlic cloves, Teja chilli powder and salt to a coarse powder first.
seg.78d34fa0267e.t: ମସଲାକୁ ରସୁଣ, ଲଙ୍କା ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ଓ ଲୁଣ ସହିତ ବାଟନ୍ତୁ, ତାପରେ ପତ୍ର ପକାଇ ପଲ୍ସ କରନ୍ତୁ। ପ୍ରଥମେ ଭଜା ମସଲା, 6ଟି ରସୁଣ କୋଳି, ତେଜା ଲଙ୍କା ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ଓ ଲୁଣକୁ ଦରଦରା ଗୁଣ୍ଡ କରନ୍ତୁ।
seg.78d34fa0267e.back: Grind the spices with garlic, chilli powder and salt, then add the leaves and pulse. First make a coarse powder of the roasted spices, 6 garlic cloves, Teja chilli powder and salt.

seg.e84cadbb2f28.src: Add the cooled leaves and pulse 3–4 times to a coarse paste, without any water. Many Andhra homes pound it in a stone mortar (rolu) instead.
seg.e84cadbb2f28.t: ଥଣ୍ଡା ପତ୍ର ପକାଇ ପାଣି ନ ମିଶାଇ 3–4 ଥର ପଲ୍ସ କରି ଦରଦରା ବଟା କରନ୍ତୁ। ଆନ୍ଧ୍ରର ଅନେକ ଘରେ ଏହା ବଦଳରେ ପଥର ଖଲରେ (ରୋଲୁ) କୁଟନ୍ତି।
seg.e84cadbb2f28.back: Add the cooled leaves and without adding water pulse 3–4 times into a coarse paste. In many Andhra homes they pound it in a stone mortar (rolu) instead.

seg.c04597c43292.src: Taste: it should be sour, hot and well salted. Add a pinch more salt if the sourness feels too sharp.
seg.c04597c43292.t: ଚାଖନ୍ତୁ: ଏହା ଖଟା, ରାଗୁଆ ଓ ଭଲ ଲୁଣିଆ ହେବା ଉଚିତ। ଖଟା ବହୁତ ତୀବ୍ର ଲାଗିଲେ ଚିମୁଟାଏ ଲୁଣ ଅଧିକ ପକାନ୍ତୁ।
seg.c04597c43292.back: Taste: it should be sour, hot and well salted. If the sourness feels very sharp add a pinch more salt.

seg.317793f8bd6d.src: Temper mustard, dals, red chillies and curry leaves in the rest of the oil; mix it in. Heat the 2 tbsp sesame oil in a small pan, let the mustard seeds crackle, fry the chana dal and urad dal till golden, then add the red chillies, crushed garlic, curry leaves and asafoetida for a few seconds. Pour it over the pachadi and stir well.
seg.317793f8bd6d.t: ବାକି ତେଲରେ ସୋରିଷ, ଡାଲି, ଲାଲ ଲଙ୍କା ଓ ଭୃସଙ୍ଗ ପତ୍ରର ଛୁଙ୍କ ଦେଇ ମିଶାନ୍ତୁ। ଏକ ଛୋଟ ପ୍ୟାନରେ 2 ଟେବୁଲ ଚାମଚ ରାଶି ତେଲ ଗରମ କରି ସୋରିଷ ଫୁଟିବାକୁ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ, ବୁଟ ଡାଲି ଓ ବିରି ଡାଲିକୁ ସୁନେଲି ହେବା ଯାଏ ଭାଜନ୍ତୁ, ତାପରେ ଲାଲ ଲଙ୍କା, ଛେଚା ରସୁଣ, ଭୃସଙ୍ଗ ପତ୍ର ଓ ହେଙ୍ଗୁ ପକାଇ କିଛି ସେକେଣ୍ଡ ରଖନ୍ତୁ। ଏହାକୁ ପଚ୍ଚଡ଼ି ଉପରେ ଢାଳି ଭଲ କରି ଘାଣ୍ଟନ୍ତୁ।
seg.317793f8bd6d.back: Give a tempering of mustard, dal, red chilli and curry leaves in the remaining oil and mix in. In a small pan heat 2 tablespoons sesame oil and let the mustard splutter, fry the chana dal and urad dal until golden, then add red chilli, crushed garlic, curry leaves and asafoetida and keep a few seconds. Pour this over the pachadi and stir well.

seg.bd6dcf672985.src: Let the pachadi sit for 30 minutes if you can, so the flavours come together, then spoon it into a clean, dry glass jar.
seg.bd6dcf672985.t: ସମ୍ଭବ ହେଲେ ପଚ୍ଚଡ଼ିକୁ 30 ମିନିଟ ରଖନ୍ତୁ, ଯେପରି ସ୍ୱାଦ ମିଳିମିଶି ଯାଏ, ତାପରେ ଏକ ସଫା, ଶୁଖିଲା କାଚ ବୋତଲରେ ଚାମଚରେ ଭରନ୍ତୁ।
seg.bd6dcf672985.back: If possible keep the pachadi 30 minutes so the flavours blend, then spoon it into a clean, dry glass jar.

seg.e0bb74b2a966.src: Dry the leaves fully before frying so the pachadi keeps longer.
seg.e0bb74b2a966.t: ଭାଜିବା ଆଗରୁ ପତ୍ରକୁ ପୂରା ଶୁଖାନ୍ତୁ, ଯେପରି ପଚ୍ଚଡ଼ି ଅଧିକ ଦିନ ରହେ।
seg.e0bb74b2a966.back: Dry the leaves completely before frying, so the pachadi keeps more days.

seg.29688dc9fded.src: Teja chilli powder is very hot. For a milder pachadi use 1 tsp, or half Teja and half Sannam chilli powder.
seg.29688dc9fded.t: ତେଜା ଲଙ୍କା ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ବହୁତ ରାଗୁଆ। କମ୍ ରାଗୁଆ ପଚ୍ଚଡ଼ି ପାଇଁ 1 ଚା ଚାମଚ ନିଅନ୍ତୁ, କିମ୍ବା ଅଧା ତେଜା ଓ ଅଧା ସନ୍ନମ ଲଙ୍କା ଗୁଣ୍ଡ।
seg.29688dc9fded.back: Teja chilli powder is very hot. For a less hot pachadi take 1 teaspoon, or half Teja and half Sannam chilli powder.

seg.d1fa39431c01.src: Keep the fenugreek to ¼ tsp and roast it only one shade darker; more, or darker, makes the pachadi bitter.
seg.d1fa39431c01.t: ମେଥି ¼ ଚା ଚାମଚରେ ସୀମିତ ରଖନ୍ତୁ ଓ କେବଳ ଏକ ଛାଇ ଗାଢ଼ ହେବା ଯାଏ ଭାଜନ୍ତୁ; ବେଶି ପରିମାଣ ବା ବେଶି ଗାଢ଼ ହେଲେ ପଚ୍ଚଡ଼ି ପିତା ହୁଏ।
seg.d1fa39431c01.back: Keep fenugreek limited to ¼ teaspoon and roast only until one shade darker; a larger amount or roasting darker makes the pachadi bitter.

seg.00435dc24e2d.src: Pulse, do not grind smooth: gongura pachadi should be coarse, with bits of leaf you can see.
seg.00435dc24e2d.t: ପଲ୍ସ କରନ୍ତୁ, ମସୃଣ କରି ବାଟନ୍ତୁ ନାହିଁ: ଗୋଙ୍ଗୁରା ପଚ୍ଚଡ଼ି ଦରଦରା ହେବା ଉଚିତ, ପତ୍ରର ଖଣ୍ଡ ଦେଖାଯିବା ଉଚିତ।
seg.00435dc24e2d.back: Pulse, do not grind smooth: gongura pachadi should be coarse, with pieces of leaf visible.

seg.70ea8f84244b.src: Do not skimp on the oil; the layer of oil on top helps the pachadi keep.
seg.70ea8f84244b.t: ତେଲରେ କୃପଣତା କରନ୍ତୁ ନାହିଁ; ଉପରେ ଥିବା ତେଲର ସ୍ତର ପଚ୍ଚଡ଼ିକୁ ଅଧିକ ଦିନ ରଖିବାରେ ସାହାଯ୍ୟ କରେ।
seg.70ea8f84244b.back: Do not be stingy with the oil; the layer of oil on top helps keep the pachadi more days.

seg.bd2018335c09.src: With onion: stir 1 small onion, finely chopped, into a portion just before serving, and eat it the same day.
seg.bd2018335c09.t: ପିଆଜ ସହିତ: ପରଷିବା ଠିକ ଆଗରୁ ଗୋଟିଏ ଭାଗରେ 1ଟି ଛୋଟ ମିହି କଟା ପିଆଜ ମିଶାନ୍ତୁ, ଆଉ ସେହି ଦିନ ହିଁ ଖାଆନ୍ତୁ।
seg.bd2018335c09.back: With onion: just before serving mix 1 small finely chopped onion into one portion, and eat it that same day.

seg.77f8d979d9c5.src: Whole red chillies: in place of the chilli powder, fry 12–15 dried red chillies in a little oil and grind them with the spices.
seg.77f8d979d9c5.t: ଗୋଟା ଲାଲ ଲଙ୍କା: ଲଙ୍କା ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ବଦଳରେ 12–15ଟି ଶୁଖିଲା ଲାଲ ଲଙ୍କା ଅଳ୍ପ ତେଲରେ ଭାଜି ମସଲା ସହିତ ବାଟନ୍ତୁ।
seg.77f8d979d9c5.back: Whole red chillies: instead of chilli powder fry 12–15 dry red chillies in a little oil and grind with the spices.

seg.98bf90687f81.src: Green chilli gongura: fry 6–8 green chillies with the leaves and cut the chilli powder to 1 tsp, for a sharper, greener heat.
seg.98bf90687f81.t: କଞ୍ଚା ଲଙ୍କା ଗୋଙ୍ଗୁରା: ଅଧିକ ତୀକ୍ଷ୍ଣ, ସବୁଜ ରାଗ ପାଇଁ ପତ୍ର ସହିତ 6–8ଟି କଞ୍ଚା ଲଙ୍କା ଭାଜନ୍ତୁ ଓ ଲଙ୍କା ଗୁଣ୍ଡକୁ 1 ଚା ଚାମଚକୁ କମାନ୍ତୁ।
seg.98bf90687f81.back: Green chilli gongura: for a sharper, green heat fry 6–8 green chillies with the leaves and reduce the chilli powder to 1 teaspoon.

seg.3ffc938ce36f.src: Mix a spoon into hot rice with ghee and eat with sliced raw onion on the side. It also goes well with dosa, idli and as a side on any Andhra meal plate.
seg.3ffc938ce36f.t: ଗରମ ଭାତରେ ଘିଅ ସହିତ ଚାମଚେ ମିଶାନ୍ତୁ ଓ ପାଖରେ କଟା କଞ୍ଚା ପିଆଜ ସହିତ ଖାଆନ୍ତୁ। ଦୋସା, ଇଡ଼ଲି ସହିତ ଓ ଆନ୍ଧ୍ରର ଯେକୌଣସି ଖାଇବା ଥାଳିରେ ପାଖ ଖାଦ୍ୟ ଭାବେ ମଧ୍ୟ ଭଲ ଲାଗେ।
seg.3ffc938ce36f.back: Mix a spoonful into hot rice with ghee and eat with chopped raw onion alongside. Also goes well with dosa, idli and as a side on any Andhra meal plate.

seg.9b58b3a03e55.src: Keep it in a clean, dry glass jar in the fridge for up to 2 weeks, always using a dry spoon. A thin layer of oil on top helps it keep.
seg.9b58b3a03e55.t: ଏକ ସଫା, ଶୁଖିଲା କାଚ ବୋତଲରେ ଫ୍ରିଜରେ 2 ସପ୍ତାହ ପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ ରଖନ୍ତୁ, ସବୁବେଳେ ଶୁଖିଲା ଚାମଚ ବ୍ୟବହାର କରନ୍ତୁ। ଉପରେ ତେଲର ପତଳା ସ୍ତର ଏହାକୁ ଅଧିକ ଦିନ ରଖିବାରେ ସାହାଯ୍ୟ କରେ।
seg.9b58b3a03e55.back: Keep in a clean, dry glass jar in the fridge up to 2 weeks, always using a dry spoon. A thin layer of oil on top helps keep it more days.

seg.5fb383e7c1ab.src: What is gongura called in English?
seg.5fb383e7c1ab.back: What is gongura called in English?

seg.100f275734bd.src: Gongura is the leaf of the roselle plant, often sold as sorrel leaves or red sorrel. In Hindi- and Marathi-speaking areas it is called ambadi.
seg.100f275734bd.t: ଗୋଙ୍ଗୁରା ହେଉଛି ରୋଜେଲ ଗଛର ପତ୍ର, ଯାହା ଅନେକ ସମୟରେ ସରେଲ ପତ୍ର ବା ଲାଲ ସରେଲ ନାମରେ ବିକ୍ରି ହୁଏ। ହିନ୍ଦୀ ଓ ମରାଠୀ ଭାଷୀ ଅଞ୍ଚଳରେ ଏହାକୁ ଅମ୍ବାଡ଼ି କହନ୍ତି।
seg.100f275734bd.back: Gongura is the leaf of the roselle plant, often sold under the name sorrel leaves or red sorrel. In Hindi- and Marathi-speaking regions it is called ambadi.

seg.7f27f7848f6b.src: How do I make gongura pachadi less sour?
seg.7f27f7848f6b.t: ଗୋଙ୍ଗୁରା ପଚ୍ଚଡ଼ିକୁ କିପରି କମ୍ ଖଟା କରିବି?
seg.7f27f7848f6b.back: How do I make gongura pachadi less sour?

seg.a8b5b3cafa35.src: Add a little more salt and chilli, or stir in 1 tsp grated jaggery. Frying the leaves down well also mellows their sourness.
seg.a8b5b3cafa35.t: ଟିକିଏ ଅଧିକ ଲୁଣ ଓ ଲଙ୍କା ପକାନ୍ତୁ, କିମ୍ବା 1 ଚା ଚାମଚ କୋରା ଗୁଡ଼ ମିଶାନ୍ତୁ। ପତ୍ରକୁ ଭଲ କରି ଭାଜି ଗଳାଇଲେ ମଧ୍ୟ ଖଟା ନରମ ହୁଏ।
seg.a8b5b3cafa35.back: Add a little more salt and chilli, or mix in 1 teaspoon grated jaggery. Frying the leaves well until they melt also softens the sourness.

seg.5bc83cd0bb23.src: Why is my gongura pachadi bitter?
seg.5bc83cd0bb23.t: ମୋ ଗୋଙ୍ଗୁରା ପଚ୍ଚଡ଼ି କାହିଁକି ପିତା ଲାଗୁଛି?
seg.5bc83cd0bb23.back: Why does my gongura pachadi taste bitter?

seg.bcbd736912c5.src: Usually too much fenugreek, or fenugreek roasted too dark. Keep it to ¼ tsp and stop roasting when it is one shade darker.
seg.bcbd736912c5.t: ସାଧାରଣତଃ ବହୁତ ବେଶି ମେଥି, ବା ବହୁତ ଗାଢ଼ କରି ଭଜା ମେଥି ଯୋଗୁଁ। ଏହାକୁ ¼ ଚା ଚାମଚରେ ରଖନ୍ତୁ ଓ ଏକ ଛାଇ ଗାଢ଼ ହେଲେ ଭାଜିବା ବନ୍ଦ କରନ୍ତୁ।
seg.bcbd736912c5.back: Usually because of too much fenugreek, or fenugreek roasted too dark. Keep it to ¼ teaspoon and stop roasting when it is one shade darker.

seg.f5ec54c6b341.src: How long does gongura pachadi last?
seg.f5ec54c6b341.back: How many days does gongura pachadi keep?

seg.693b158b80df.src: About 2 weeks in the fridge in a dry glass jar, if the leaves were dried well and you always use a dry spoon. Outside the fridge, eat it within 2–3 days.
seg.693b158b80df.t: ପତ୍ର ଭଲ କରି ଶୁଖାଯାଇଥିଲେ ଓ ସବୁବେଳେ ଶୁଖିଲା ଚାମଚ ବ୍ୟବହାର କଲେ, ଶୁଖିଲା କାଚ ବୋତଲରେ ଫ୍ରିଜରେ ପ୍ରାୟ 2 ସପ୍ତାହ। ଫ୍ରିଜ ବାହାରେ 2–3 ଦିନ ଭିତରେ ଖାଆନ୍ତୁ।
seg.693b158b80df.back: If the leaves were dried well and a dry spoon is always used, about 2 weeks in a dry glass jar in the fridge. Outside the fridge eat within 2–3 days.

seg.a8b7816171d1.src: గోంగూర పచ్చడి. Gongura pachadi the Guntur way: sorrel leaves fried down, ground with roasted spices, garlic and Teja chilli powder, then tempered. Serves 6.
seg.a8b7816171d1.t: గోంగూర పచ్చడి. ଗୁଣ୍ଟୁର ଢଙ୍ଗର ଗୋଙ୍ଗୁରା ପଚ୍ଚଡ଼ି: ସରେଲ ପତ୍ରକୁ ଭାଜି ଗଳାଇ, ଭଜା ମସଲା, ରସୁଣ ଓ ତେଜା ଲଙ୍କା ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ସହିତ ବାଟି, ତାପରେ ଛୁଙ୍କ ଦିଆଯାଏ। 6 ଜଣଙ୍କ ପାଇଁ।
seg.a8b7816171d1.back: గోంగూర పచ్చడి. Guntur-style gongura pachadi: sorrel leaves fried until they melt, ground with roasted spices, garlic and Teja chilli powder, then tempered. For 6 people.

seg.de566b9f7c3e.src: Gongura Pachadi: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.de566b9f7c3e.t: ଗୋଙ୍ଗୁରା ପଚ୍ଚଡ଼ି: 1acrefarmsର ରେସିପି କାର୍ଡ, ଉପକରଣ ଓ ପ୍ରଣାଳୀ ସହିତ
seg.de566b9f7c3e.back: Gongura Pachadi: 1acrefarms recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.70fd98f238a4.src: Kodi Guddu Pulusu ⟦1⟧(Andhra Egg Curry in Tamarind Gravy)⟦/1⟧
seg.70fd98f238a4.t: କୋଡି ଗୁଡ୍ଡୁ ପୁଲୁସୁ ⟦1⟧(ତେନ୍ତୁଳି ଗ୍ରେଭିରେ ଆନ୍ଧ୍ରର ଅଣ୍ଡା ତରକାରି)⟦/1⟧
seg.70fd98f238a4.back: Kodi Guddu Pulusu ⟦1⟧(Andhra egg curry in tamarind gravy)⟦/1⟧

seg.dd0da0936d87.src: Kodi guddu pulusu is the Andhra egg curry that many homes make when there is no meat in the house: hard-boiled eggs simmered in a tangy gravy of tamarind and slow-fried onions. It is thinner and sourer than a North Indian egg curry, made to be mixed into plenty of hot rice.
seg.dd0da0936d87.t: କୋଡି ଗୁଡ୍ଡୁ ପୁଲୁସୁ ହେଉଛି ଆନ୍ଧ୍ରର ସେହି ଅଣ୍ଡା ତରକାରି ଯାହା ଘରେ ମାଂସ ନ ଥିଲେ ଅନେକ ପରିବାର ତିଆରି କରନ୍ତି: ସିଝା ଅଣ୍ଡାକୁ ତେନ୍ତୁଳି ଓ ଧୀରେ ଭଜା ପିଆଜର ଖଟା ଗ୍ରେଭିରେ ଧିମା ଫୁଟାଯାଏ। ଏହା ଉତ୍ତର ଭାରତର ଅଣ୍ଡା ତରକାରିଠାରୁ ପତଳା ଓ ଅଧିକ ଖଟା, ଅନେକ ଗରମ ଭାତରେ ମିଶାଇ ଖାଇବା ପାଇଁ ତିଆରି।
seg.dd0da0936d87.back: Kodi guddu pulusu is that Andhra egg curry which many families make when there is no meat at home: boiled eggs are simmered in a sour gravy of tamarind and slowly fried onion. It is thinner and more sour than North Indian egg curry, made for mixing into hot rice and eating.

seg.27588d5a0d73.src: Our Sannam chilli powder gives the pulusu its red colour and a steady medium heat, and our turmeric powder (Pasupu) gives the golden base. A little jaggery rounds off the sourness.
seg.27588d5a0d73.t: ଆମ ସନ୍ନମ ଲଙ୍କା ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ପୁଲୁସୁକୁ ଲାଲ ରଙ୍ଗ ଓ ସ୍ଥିର ମଧ୍ୟମ ରାଗ ଦିଏ, ଆଉ ଆମ ହଳଦୀ ଗୁଣ୍ଡ (ପସୁପୁ) ସୁନେଲି ଆଧାର ଦିଏ। ଅଳ୍ପ ଗୁଡ଼ ଖଟାକୁ ସନ୍ତୁଳିତ କରେ।
seg.27588d5a0d73.back: Our Sannam chilli powder gives the pulusu red colour and a steady medium heat, and our turmeric powder (pasupu) gives a golden base. A little jaggery balances the sourness.

seg.3c683c3f8074.src: Boil and slit the eggs. Fry onions, add turmeric, Sannam chilli powder and tamarind water, simmer, then cook the eggs in the gravy till it thickens.
seg.3c683c3f8074.t: ଅଣ୍ଡା ସିଝାଇ ଚିରନ୍ତୁ। ପିଆଜ ଭାଜି ହଳଦୀ, ସନ୍ନମ ଲଙ୍କା ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ଓ ତେନ୍ତୁଳି ପାଣି ପକାନ୍ତୁ, ଧିମା ଫୁଟାନ୍ତୁ, ତାପରେ ଅଣ୍ଡାକୁ ଗ୍ରେଭିରେ ବହଳ ହେବା ଯାଏ ରାନ୍ଧନ୍ତୁ।
seg.3c683c3f8074.back: Boil the eggs and slit them. Fry onion and add turmeric, Sannam chilli powder and tamarind water, simmer, then cook the eggs in the gravy until thick.

seg.8c348975674a.src: a pinch of turmeric powder ⟦1⟧for frying the eggs (optional)⟦/1⟧
seg.8c348975674a.back: A pinch of turmeric powder ⟦1⟧for frying the eggs (optional)⟦/1⟧

seg.3a31dc522e29.src: 20 g tamarind ⟦1⟧a lemon-sized ball, soaked in 1½ cups warm water⟦/1⟧
seg.3a31dc522e29.t: 20 g ତେନ୍ତୁଳି ⟦1⟧ଲେମ୍ବୁ ଆକାରର ଗୋଲା, 1½ କପ ଉଷୁମ ପାଣିରେ ଭିଜା⟦/1⟧
seg.3a31dc522e29.back: 20 g tamarind ⟦1⟧lemon-sized ball, soaked in 1½ cups warm water⟦/1⟧

seg.d56c07ca17af.t: 3 ଟେବୁଲ ଚାମଚ ତେଲ ⟦1⟧ବାଦାମ ବା ରାଶି ତେଲ⟦/1⟧

seg.5b3cff6eb38d.src: 2 tsp Sannam chilli powder ⟦1⟧medium heat; use 1½ tsp for milder⟦/1⟧
seg.5b3cff6eb38d.t: 2 ଚା ଚାମଚ ସନ୍ନମ ଲଙ୍କା ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ⟦1⟧ମଧ୍ୟମ ରାଗ; କମ୍ ରାଗ ପାଇଁ 1½ ଚା ଚାମଚ⟦/1⟧
seg.5b3cff6eb38d.back: 2 teaspoons Sannam chilli powder ⟦1⟧medium heat; for less heat 1½ teaspoons⟦/1⟧

seg.4b88dbe5eb6d.src: Soak the tamarind in the warm water for 15 minutes. Squeeze it well, strain and keep the tamarind water; discard the fibres and seeds.
seg.4b88dbe5eb6d.t: ତେନ୍ତୁଳିକୁ ଉଷୁମ ପାଣିରେ 15 ମିନିଟ ଭିଜାନ୍ତୁ। ଭଲ କରି ଚିପୁଡ଼ି ଛାଣି ତେନ୍ତୁଳି ପାଣି ରଖନ୍ତୁ; ଅଁଶ ଓ ମଞ୍ଜି ଫିଙ୍ଗି ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ।
seg.4b88dbe5eb6d.back: Soak the tamarind in warm water 15 minutes. Squeeze well, strain and keep the tamarind water; throw away the fibre and seeds.

seg.e7eefe0a36b0.src: Boil the eggs 10 minutes, peel them and make 3–4 shallow slits on each. Start them in room-temperature water, count 10 minutes from the boil, then cool them in water before peeling. The yolk should be firm and pale yellow right through.
seg.e7eefe0a36b0.t: ଅଣ୍ଡାକୁ 10 ମିନିଟ ସିଝାନ୍ତୁ, ଚୋପା ଛଡ଼ାଇ ପ୍ରତ୍ୟେକରେ 3–4ଟି ଅଳ୍ପ ଗଭୀର ଚିରା ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ। ସାଧାରଣ ତାପମାତ୍ରାର ପାଣିରେ ଆରମ୍ଭ କରନ୍ତୁ, ଫୁଟିବା ପରଠାରୁ 10 ମିନିଟ ଗଣନ୍ତୁ, ତାପରେ ଚୋପା ଛଡ଼ାଇବା ଆଗରୁ ପାଣିରେ ଥଣ୍ଡା କରନ୍ତୁ। କେଶର ଭିତର ଯାଏ ଟାଣ ଓ ଫିକା ହଳଦିଆ ହେବା ଉଚିତ।
seg.e7eefe0a36b0.back: Boil the eggs 10 minutes, peel and give each 3–4 shallow slits. Start in room-temperature water, count 10 minutes from when it boils, then cool in water before peeling. The yolk should be firm right through and pale yellow.

seg.6747ea35bd7d.src: Optional: heat 1 tsp of the oil with the pinch of turmeric and roll the eggs in it for 2 minutes until lightly blistered. Keep aside.
seg.6747ea35bd7d.t: ଇଚ୍ଛାଧୀନ: 1 ଚା ଚାମଚ ତେଲରେ ଚିମୁଟାଏ ହଳଦୀ ଗରମ କରି ଅଣ୍ଡାକୁ 2 ମିନିଟ ଗଡ଼ାନ୍ତୁ ଯେପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ ହାଲୁକା ଫୋଟକା ନ ପଡ଼େ। ଅଲଗା କରି ରଖନ୍ତୁ।
seg.6747ea35bd7d.back: Optional: heat a pinch of turmeric in 1 teaspoon oil and roll the eggs for 2 minutes until light blisters form. Keep aside.

seg.9d3c50e45f8b.src: Heat the rest of the oil in a kadai on medium heat. Add the fenugreek seeds and let them turn light brown; they turn bitter if they go dark.
seg.9d3c50e45f8b.t: ବାକି ତେଲକୁ କଡ଼ାଇରେ ମଧ୍ୟମ ନିଆଁରେ ଗରମ କରନ୍ତୁ। ମେଥି ପକାଇ ହାଲୁକା ବାଦାମୀ ହେବାକୁ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ; ଗାଢ଼ ହୋଇଗଲେ ପିତା ହୋଇଯାଏ।
seg.9d3c50e45f8b.back: Heat the remaining oil in the kadai on medium flame. Add fenugreek and let it turn light brown; if it goes dark it turns bitter.

seg.c867d4469da7.src: Fry the mustard seeds, curry leaves and onions in the oil till soft and golden. Add the mustard seeds first and let them splutter, then the curry leaves, green chillies and asafoetida, then the onions for about 8 minutes.
seg.c867d4469da7.t: ସୋରିଷ, ଭୃସଙ୍ଗ ପତ୍ର ଓ ପିଆଜକୁ ତେଲରେ ନରମ ଓ ସୁନେଲି ହେବା ଯାଏ ଭାଜନ୍ତୁ। ପ୍ରଥମେ ସୋରିଷ ପକାଇ ଫୁଟିବାକୁ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ, ତାପରେ ଭୃସଙ୍ଗ ପତ୍ର, କଞ୍ଚା ଲଙ୍କା ଓ ହେଙ୍ଗୁ, ତାପରେ ପିଆଜ ପ୍ରାୟ 8 ମିନିଟ।
seg.c867d4469da7.back: Fry mustard, curry leaves and onion in the oil until soft and golden. First add mustard and let it splutter, then curry leaves, green chilli and asafoetida, then the onion about 8 minutes.

seg.ae0272dd2475.src: Turn the heat to low. Add the turmeric, Sannam chilli powder and salt, then the tamarind water; simmer 10 minutes. Stir in the coriander powder with the chilli powder so it fries for a few seconds first.
seg.ae0272dd2475.t: ନିଆଁ ଧିମା କରନ୍ତୁ। ହଳଦୀ, ସନ୍ନମ ଲଙ୍କା ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ଓ ଲୁଣ ପକାନ୍ତୁ, ତାପରେ ତେନ୍ତୁଳି ପାଣି; 10 ମିନିଟ ଧିମା ଫୁଟାନ୍ତୁ। ଲଙ୍କା ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ସହିତ ଧନିଆ ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ମଧ୍ୟ ମିଶାନ୍ତୁ ଯେପରି ଏହା ପ୍ରଥମେ କିଛି ସେକେଣ୍ଡ ଭାଜି ହୁଏ।
seg.ae0272dd2475.back: Lower the flame. Add turmeric, Sannam chilli powder and salt, then the tamarind water; simmer 10 minutes. Mix in coriander powder too along with the chilli powder so it first fries a few seconds.

seg.01aeed8b749f.src: The raw tamarind smell should be gone and the gravy should look glossy. Add ½ cup water if it thickens too fast.
seg.01aeed8b749f.t: ତେନ୍ତୁଳିର କଞ୍ଚା ଗନ୍ଧ ଚାଲିଯିବା ଉଚିତ ଓ ଗ୍ରେଭି ଚକଚକ ଦେଖାଯିବା ଉଚିତ। ବହୁତ ଶୀଘ୍ର ବହଳ ହେଲେ ½ କପ ପାଣି ପକାନ୍ତୁ।
seg.01aeed8b749f.back: The raw smell of the tamarind should go and the gravy should look glossy. If it thickens too quickly add ½ cup water.

seg.74f1a1affff6.src: Slide in the eggs and simmer 5 minutes more till the gravy thickens. Spoon the gravy over the eggs now and then.
seg.74f1a1affff6.t: ଅଣ୍ଡାକୁ ଧୀରେ ପକାଇ ଗ୍ରେଭି ବହଳ ହେବା ଯାଏ ଆଉ 5 ମିନିଟ ଧିମା ଫୁଟାନ୍ତୁ। ମଝିରେ ମଝିରେ ଅଣ୍ଡା ଉପରେ ଚାମଚରେ ଗ୍ରେଭି ଢାଳନ୍ତୁ।
seg.74f1a1affff6.back: Gently add the eggs and simmer 5 more minutes until the gravy thickens. Now and then spoon gravy over the eggs.

seg.299781c49104.src: Stir in the jaggery, taste and adjust the salt or sourness, and scatter the coriander leaves.
seg.299781c49104.t: ଗୁଡ଼ ମିଶାନ୍ତୁ, ଚାଖି ଲୁଣ ବା ଖଟା ଠିକ କରନ୍ତୁ, ଆଉ ଧନିଆ ପତ୍ର ଛିଞ୍ଚନ୍ତୁ।
seg.299781c49104.back: Mix in jaggery, taste and adjust salt or sourness, and sprinkle coriander leaves.

seg.d0ce3c2b157a.src: Switch off and let the pulusu rest for 10 minutes before serving so the eggs take on the gravy.
seg.d0ce3c2b157a.t: ନିଆଁ ବନ୍ଦ କରି ପରଷିବା ଆଗରୁ ପୁଲୁସୁକୁ 10 ମିନିଟ ରଖନ୍ତୁ ଯେପରି ଅଣ୍ଡା ଗ୍ରେଭିର ସ୍ୱାଦ ନିଏ।
seg.d0ce3c2b157a.back: Turn off the flame and keep the pulusu 10 minutes before serving so the eggs take on the gravy's flavour.

seg.feebbb94999b.src: Slits let the tangy gravy into the eggs.
seg.feebbb94999b.t: ଚିରା ଦେଲେ ଖଟା ଗ୍ରେଭି ଅଣ୍ଡା ଭିତରକୁ ପଶେ।
seg.feebbb94999b.back: Slitting lets the sour gravy get inside the eggs.

seg.98394356bb39.src: Cool the boiled eggs in water before peeling; the shells come off cleanly.
seg.98394356bb39.t: ସିଝା ଅଣ୍ଡାକୁ ଚୋପା ଛଡ଼ାଇବା ଆଗରୁ ପାଣିରେ ଥଣ୍ଡା କରନ୍ତୁ; ଚୋପା ସଫା ଭାବେ ବାହାରିଯାଏ।
seg.98394356bb39.back: Cool the boiled eggs in water before peeling; the shell comes off cleanly.

seg.f4306708f8c5.src: Sannam chilli powder gives a medium heat; for a hotter pulusu add ½ tsp Teja chilli powder along with it.
seg.f4306708f8c5.t: ସନ୍ନମ ଲଙ୍କା ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ମଧ୍ୟମ ରାଗ ଦିଏ; ଅଧିକ ରାଗୁଆ ପୁଲୁସୁ ପାଇଁ ସାଙ୍ଗରେ ½ ଚା ଚାମଚ ତେଜା ଲଙ୍କା ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ପକାନ୍ତୁ।
seg.f4306708f8c5.back: Sannam chilli powder gives medium heat; for a hotter pulusu add ½ teaspoon Teja chilli powder along with it.

seg.fc1643db807e.src: Pulusu tastes better after it rests, and even more the next day, as the eggs soak up the tamarind.
seg.fc1643db807e.t: ରଖିଲେ ପୁଲୁସୁ ଅଧିକ ସ୍ୱାଦିଷ୍ଟ ହୁଏ, ପରଦିନ ଆହୁରି ବେଶି, କାରଣ ଅଣ୍ଡା ତେନ୍ତୁଳିକୁ ଟାଣିନିଏ।
seg.fc1643db807e.back: When kept, the pulusu becomes tastier, the next day even more, because the eggs draw in the tamarind.

seg.b19fe3919add.src: Tomato: add 1 chopped tomato after the onions for a softer, less sour gravy.
seg.b19fe3919add.t: ଟମାଟା: ନରମ ଓ କମ୍ ଖଟା ଗ୍ରେଭି ପାଇଁ ପିଆଜ ପରେ 1ଟି କଟା ଟମାଟା ପକାନ୍ତୁ।
seg.b19fe3919add.back: Tomato: for a softer and less sour gravy add 1 chopped tomato after the onion.

seg.0d78d434249e.src: Sesame: stir in 1 tbsp roasted sesame powder in the last 5 minutes for a thicker, nutty gravy.
seg.0d78d434249e.t: ରାଶି: ବହଳ ଓ ବାଦାମ ପରି ସ୍ୱାଦର ଗ୍ରେଭି ପାଇଁ ଶେଷ 5 ମିନିଟରେ 1 ଟେବୁଲ ଚାମଚ ଭଜା ରାଶି ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ମିଶାନ୍ତୁ।
seg.0d78d434249e.back: Sesame: for a thick, nutty-tasting gravy mix in 1 tablespoon roasted sesame powder in the last 5 minutes.

seg.e4adab31c02b.src: Mamidikaya: in summer, replace half the tamarind with a few pieces of raw mango cooked in the gravy.
seg.e4adab31c02b.t: ମାମିଡିକାୟ: ଗ୍ରୀଷ୍ମରେ ଅଧା ତେନ୍ତୁଳି ବଦଳରେ କିଛି କଞ୍ଚା ଆମ୍ବ ଖଣ୍ଡ ଗ୍ରେଭିରେ ରାନ୍ଧନ୍ତୁ।
seg.e4adab31c02b.back: Mamidikaya: in summer cook some raw mango pieces in the gravy instead of half the tamarind.

seg.bbf897873153.src: Serve hot with steamed rice and a spoon of ghee, with a crisp fry or appadalu on the side. It also goes with chapati or dosa.
seg.bbf897873153.t: ଗରମ ଭାତ ଓ ଚାମଚେ ଘିଅ ସହିତ, ପାଖରେ କୁରକୁରିଆ ଭଜା ବା ଅପ୍ପଡ଼ାଲୁ (ପାମ୍ପଡ଼) ସହିତ ଗରମ ଗରମ ପରଷନ୍ତୁ। ଚପାତି ବା ଦୋସା ସହିତ ମଧ୍ୟ ଚଳେ।
seg.bbf897873153.back: Serve piping hot with hot rice and a spoon of ghee, with a crunchy fry or appadalu (papad) alongside. Also does with chapati or dosa.

seg.7a5a4bbedfff.src: Keep leftovers covered in the fridge and eat within 2 days. Warm the pulusu gently in a pan with a splash of water.
seg.7a5a4bbedfff.t: ବଳକା ଘୋଡ଼ାଇ ଫ୍ରିଜରେ ରଖନ୍ତୁ ଓ 2 ଦିନ ଭିତରେ ଖାଆନ୍ତୁ। ପୁଲୁସୁକୁ ପ୍ୟାନରେ ଟିକିଏ ପାଣି ସହିତ ଧୀରେ ଗରମ କରନ୍ତୁ।
seg.7a5a4bbedfff.back: Keep leftovers covered in the fridge and eat within 2 days. Gently heat the pulusu in a pan with a little water.

seg.3dae693db30c.src: How long should I boil eggs for egg curry?
seg.3dae693db30c.t: ଅଣ୍ଡା ତରକାରି ପାଇଁ ଅଣ୍ଡାକୁ କେତେ ସମୟ ସିଝାଇବି?
seg.3dae693db30c.back: How long should I boil eggs for egg curry?

seg.2d6d1a298a24.src: About 10 minutes from the time the water boils. The yolk should be firm and pale yellow right through, with no runny centre, before the eggs go into the gravy.
seg.2d6d1a298a24.t: ପାଣି ଫୁଟିବା ପରଠାରୁ ପ୍ରାୟ 10 ମିନିଟ। ଗ୍ରେଭିରେ ପକାଇବା ଆଗରୁ କେଶର ଭିତର ଯାଏ ଟାଣ ଓ ଫିକା ହଳଦିଆ ହେବା ଉଚିତ, ମଝିରେ ତରଳ ନ ଥିବା ଉଚିତ।
seg.2d6d1a298a24.back: About 10 minutes from when the water boils. Before adding to the gravy the yolk should be firm right through and pale yellow, with no liquid in the middle.

seg.4abaae123f39.src: Why do you make slits on eggs for pulusu?
seg.4abaae123f39.t: ପୁଲୁସୁ ପାଇଁ ଅଣ୍ଡାରେ ଚିରା କାହିଁକି ଦିଆଯାଏ?
seg.4abaae123f39.back: Why are slits made in the eggs for pulusu?

seg.d3f5992ccd6e.src: Shallow slits let the tamarind gravy soak into the egg white. Without them the gravy stays on the surface and the egg tastes plain.
seg.d3f5992ccd6e.t: ଅଳ୍ପ ଗଭୀର ଚିରା ଦେଲେ ତେନ୍ତୁଳି ଗ୍ରେଭି ଅଣ୍ଡାର ଧଳା ଅଂଶ ଭିତରକୁ ପଶେ। ଚିରା ବିନା ଗ୍ରେଭି ଉପରେ ହିଁ ରହେ ଓ ଅଣ୍ଡା ସାଦା ଲାଗେ।
seg.d3f5992ccd6e.back: Shallow slits let the tamarind gravy get inside the egg white. Without slits the gravy stays only on top and the egg tastes plain.

seg.7a591bf728ac.src: How do I reduce the sourness of the pulusu?
seg.7a591bf728ac.back: How do I reduce the sourness of the pulusu?

seg.0a2bf657f386.src: Simmer it a few minutes longer, add a teaspoon of grated jaggery, or stir in a little water. Use a smaller ball of tamarind next time.
seg.0a2bf657f386.t: ଆଉ କିଛି ମିନିଟ ଧିମା ଫୁଟାନ୍ତୁ, ଏକ ଚା ଚାମଚ କୋରା ଗୁଡ଼ ପକାନ୍ତୁ, କିମ୍ବା ଟିକିଏ ପାଣି ମିଶାନ୍ତୁ। ପରଥର ତେନ୍ତୁଳିର ଛୋଟ ଗୋଲା ନିଅନ୍ତୁ।
seg.0a2bf657f386.back: Simmer a few more minutes, add a teaspoon of grated jaggery, or mix in a little water. Next time take a smaller ball of tamarind.

seg.f9a34864523d.src: What is the difference between egg pulusu and egg curry?
seg.f9a34864523d.t: ଅଣ୍ଡା ପୁଲୁସୁ ଓ ଅଣ୍ଡା କରି ମଧ୍ୟରେ ଫରକ କଣ?
seg.f9a34864523d.back: What is the difference between egg pulusu and egg curry?

seg.08bcae4f5075.src: Pulusu is a thinner, tangy tamarind gravy made to mix with rice. A regular egg curry is usually built on onion and tomato, with no tamarind and a thicker masala.
seg.08bcae4f5075.t: ପୁଲୁସୁ ହେଉଛି ଭାତରେ ମିଶାଇ ଖାଇବା ପାଇଁ ତିଆରି ପତଳା, ଖଟା ତେନ୍ତୁଳି ଗ୍ରେଭି। ସାଧାରଣ ଅଣ୍ଡା ତରକାରି ଅଧିକାଂଶ ସମୟରେ ପିଆଜ ଓ ଟମାଟା ଉପରେ ଆଧାରିତ, ତେନ୍ତୁଳି ବିନା ଓ ବହଳ ମସଲା ସହିତ।
seg.08bcae4f5075.back: Pulusu is a thin, sour tamarind gravy made for mixing into rice. Ordinary egg curry is mostly based on onion and tomato, without tamarind and with thick masala.

seg.6977652a1279.src: కోడి గుడ్డు పులుసు · Egg Pulusu Recipe | 1acrefarms
seg.6977652a1279.t: కోడి గుడ్డు పులుసు · ଅଣ୍ଡା ପୁଲୁସୁ ରେସିପି | 1acrefarms
seg.6977652a1279.back: కోడి గుడ్డు పులుసు · Egg Pulusu recipe | 1acrefarms

seg.4f1d5bbdf5db.src: కోడి గుడ్డు పులుసు. Kodi guddu pulusu, Andhra egg curry: boiled eggs simmered in a tangy tamarind-onion gravy coloured with Sannam chilli powder and turmeric. Serves 4.
seg.4f1d5bbdf5db.t: కోడి గుడ్డు పులుసు. କୋଡି ଗୁଡ୍ଡୁ ପୁଲୁସୁ, ଆନ୍ଧ୍ରର ଅଣ୍ଡା ତରକାରି: ସିଝା ଅଣ୍ଡାକୁ ସନ୍ନମ ଲଙ୍କା ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ଓ ହଳଦୀରେ ରଙ୍ଗିନ ଖଟା ତେନ୍ତୁଳି-ପିଆଜ ଗ୍ରେଭିରେ ଧିମା ଫୁଟାଯାଏ। 4 ଜଣଙ୍କ ପାଇଁ।
seg.4f1d5bbdf5db.back: కోడి గుడ్డు పులుసు. Kodi guddu pulusu, Andhra egg curry: boiled eggs simmered in a sour tamarind-onion gravy coloured with Sannam chilli powder and turmeric. For 4 people.

seg.24e368a0d7e4.src: Kodi Guddu Pulusu (Andhra Egg Curry in Tamarind Gravy) · 1acrefarms
seg.24e368a0d7e4.t: କୋଡି ଗୁଡ୍ଡୁ ପୁଲୁସୁ (ତେନ୍ତୁଳି ଗ୍ରେଭିରେ ଆନ୍ଧ୍ରର ଅଣ୍ଡା ତରକାରି) · 1acrefarms
seg.24e368a0d7e4.back: Kodi Guddu Pulusu (Andhra egg curry in tamarind gravy) · 1acrefarms

seg.583485fac40c.src: Kodi Guddu Pulusu: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.583485fac40c.t: କୋଡି ଗୁଡ୍ଡୁ ପୁଲୁସୁ: 1acrefarmsର ରେସିପି କାର୍ଡ, ଉପକରଣ ଓ ପ୍ରଣାଳୀ ସହିତ
seg.583485fac40c.back: Kodi Guddu Pulusu: 1acrefarms recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.722d155a3c4f.src: Gutti Vankaya Kura ⟦1⟧(Andhra Stuffed Brinjal Curry)⟦/1⟧
seg.722d155a3c4f.t: ଗୁତ୍ତି ଭଙ୍କାୟ କୂରା ⟦1⟧(ଆନ୍ଧ୍ରର ପୁର ଭରା ବାଇଗଣ ତରକାରି)⟦/1⟧
seg.722d155a3c4f.back: Gutti Vankaya Koora ⟦1⟧(Andhra stuffed brinjal curry)⟦/1⟧

seg.00fde8f92a7e.src: Gutti vankaya kura is the stuffed brinjal curry that Andhra homes make for Sunday lunches, weddings and when guests come over. Small, round purple brinjals are slit, packed with a roasted peanut, sesame and coconut masala, and cooked slowly in oil until they turn soft and the masala clings to them.
seg.00fde8f92a7e.t: ଗୁତ୍ତି ଭଙ୍କାୟ କୂରା ହେଉଛି ପୁର ଭରା ବାଇଗଣ ତରକାରି ଯାହା ଆନ୍ଧ୍ରର ଘରେ ରବିବାର ମଧ୍ୟାହ୍ନ ଭୋଜନ, ବିବାହ ଓ ଅତିଥି ଆସିଲେ ତିଆରି ହୁଏ। ଛୋଟ, ଗୋଲ, ବାଇଗଣୀ ବାଇଗଣକୁ ଚିରି, ଭଜା ଚିନାବାଦାମ, ରାଶି ଓ ନଡ଼ିଆ ମସଲା ଭରି, ନରମ ହୋଇ ମସଲା ଲାଖିଯିବା ଯାଏ ତେଲରେ ଧୀରେ ରନ୍ଧାଯାଏ।
seg.00fde8f92a7e.back: Gutti vankaya koora is the stuffed brinjal curry made in Andhra homes for Sunday lunch, weddings and when guests come. Small, round, purple brinjals are slit, filled with a roasted peanut, sesame and coconut masala, and slowly cooked in oil until soft and the masala clings.

seg.27fd58488499.src: Our Sannam chilli powder gives the stuffing its red colour and medium heat, and turmeric powder rounds it off. Serve it with hot rice or chapati. This recipe serves 4.
seg.27fd58488499.t: ଆମ ସନ୍ନମ ଲଙ୍କା ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ପୁରକୁ ଲାଲ ରଙ୍ଗ ଓ ମଧ୍ୟମ ରାଗ ଦିଏ, ଆଉ ହଳଦୀ ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ସ୍ୱାଦକୁ ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ କରେ। ଗରମ ଭାତ ବା ଚପାତି ସହିତ ପରଷନ୍ତୁ। ଏହି ରେସିପି 4 ଜଣଙ୍କ ପାଇଁ।
seg.27fd58488499.back: Our Sannam chilli powder gives the stuffing red colour and medium heat, and turmeric powder rounds out the flavour. Serve with hot rice or chapati. This recipe is for 4 people.

seg.dea818e2c052.src: Roast peanuts, sesame, dry coconut and coriander seeds, grind with Sannam chilli powder, turmeric powder and salt, stuff small brinjals and cook them slowly in oil until soft.
seg.dea818e2c052.t: ଚିନାବାଦାମ, ରାଶି, ଶୁଖିଲା ନଡ଼ିଆ ଓ ଧନିଆ ଭାଜି, ସନ୍ନମ ଲଙ୍କା ଗୁଣ୍ଡ, ହଳଦୀ ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ଓ ଲୁଣ ସହିତ ବାଟନ୍ତୁ, ଛୋଟ ବାଇଗଣରେ ଭରି ତେଲରେ ନରମ ହେବା ଯାଏ ଧୀରେ ରାନ୍ଧନ୍ତୁ।
seg.dea818e2c052.back: Roast peanuts, sesame, dry coconut and coriander seeds, grind with Sannam chilli powder, turmeric powder and salt, fill into small brinjals and cook slowly in oil until soft.

seg.1ba4509b5345.src: 3 tbsp peanuts ⟦1⟧raw, with or without skins⟦/1⟧
seg.1ba4509b5345.t: 3 ଟେବୁଲ ଚାମଚ ଚିନାବାଦାମ ⟦1⟧କଞ୍ଚା, ଚୋପା ସହିତ ବା ବିନା⟦/1⟧
seg.1ba4509b5345.back: 3 tablespoons peanuts ⟦1⟧raw, with or without skin⟦/1⟧

seg.b0b877b509dc.src: 2 tsp Sannam chilli powder ⟦1⟧up to 1 tbsp for a hotter curry⟦/1⟧
seg.b0b877b509dc.t: 2 ଚା ଚାମଚ ସନ୍ନମ ଲଙ୍କା ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ⟦1⟧ଅଧିକ ରାଗୁଆ ତରକାରି ପାଇଁ 1 ଟେବୁଲ ଚାମଚ ପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ⟦/1⟧
seg.b0b877b509dc.back: 2 teaspoons Sannam chilli powder ⟦1⟧up to 1 tablespoon for a hotter curry⟦/1⟧

seg.df2079b45203.src: 12 small brinjals ⟦1⟧about 500 g, small round purple ones⟦/1⟧
seg.df2079b45203.t: 12ଟି ଛୋଟ ବାଇଗଣ ⟦1⟧ପ୍ରାୟ 500 g, ଛୋଟ ଗୋଲ ବାଇଗଣୀ ରଙ୍ଗର⟦/1⟧
seg.df2079b45203.back: 12 small brinjals ⟦1⟧about 500 g, small round purple coloured⟦/1⟧

seg.3994d7458465.t: 2 ଟେବୁଲ ଚାମଚ ଧନିଆ ପତ୍ର ⟦1⟧କଟା, ଶେଷରେ ପକାଇବା ପାଇଁ⟦/1⟧
seg.3994d7458465.back: 2 tablespoons coriander leaves ⟦1⟧chopped, for adding at the end⟦/1⟧

seg.d56e638c12d0.src: Dry-roast the peanuts, sesame, coconut and coriander seeds; grind with the spices. Roast the peanuts first on medium-low heat for 3–4 minutes, then add the coriander seeds, cumin and sesame for 1 minute, and the coconut for the last 30 seconds, until it is light golden. Let it cool.
seg.d56e638c12d0.t: ଚିନାବାଦାମ, ରାଶି, ନଡ଼ିଆ ଓ ଧନିଆକୁ ତେଲ ବିନା ଭାଜନ୍ତୁ; ମସଲା ସହିତ ବାଟନ୍ତୁ। ପ୍ରଥମେ ଚିନାବାଦାମକୁ ମଧ୍ୟମରୁ କମ୍ ନିଆଁରେ 3–4 ମିନିଟ ଭାଜନ୍ତୁ, ତାପରେ ଧନିଆ, ଜିରା ଓ ରାଶି ପକାଇ 1 ମିନିଟ, ଆଉ ଶେଷ 30 ସେକେଣ୍ଡରେ ନଡ଼ିଆ ପକାନ୍ତୁ, ଯେପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ ତାହା ହାଲୁକା ସୁନେଲି ନ ହୁଏ। ଥଣ୍ଡା ହେବାକୁ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ।
seg.d56e638c12d0.back: Roast peanuts, sesame, coconut and coriander seeds without oil; grind with the spices. First roast the peanuts on medium-to-low flame 3–4 minutes, then add coriander, cumin and sesame for 1 minute, and add the coconut in the last 30 seconds, until it turns light golden. Let cool.

seg.26e4a965b3f7.src: In a mixer, grind the roasted mix with the garlic, Sannam chilli powder, turmeric powder, salt and tamarind to a coarse powder without water. It should clump when pressed.
seg.26e4a965b3f7.t: ମିକ୍ସିରେ ଭଜା ମିଶ୍ରଣକୁ ରସୁଣ, ସନ୍ନମ ଲଙ୍କା ଗୁଣ୍ଡ, ହଳଦୀ ଗୁଣ୍ଡ, ଲୁଣ ଓ ତେନ୍ତୁଳି ସହିତ ପାଣି ବିନା ଦରଦରା ଗୁଣ୍ଡ କରନ୍ତୁ। ଚାପିଲେ ଏହା ଗୁଣ୍ଡା ବାନ୍ଧିବା ଉଚିତ।
seg.26e4a965b3f7.back: In a mixie grind the roasted mixture with garlic, Sannam chilli powder, turmeric powder, salt and tamarind into a coarse powder without water. When pressed it should form a clump.

seg.5784e45d4bff.src: Wash the brinjals and trim the green cap a little, leaving the stalk on.
seg.5784e45d4bff.t: ବାଇଗଣ ଧୋଇ ସବୁଜ ଟୋପିକୁ ଟିକିଏ କାଟନ୍ତୁ, ଡେମ୍ଫ ରଖନ୍ତୁ।
seg.5784e45d4bff.back: Wash the brinjals and trim the green cap a little, keeping the stem.

seg.02665f13e5af.src: Slit each brinjal in a cross from the bottom, keeping the stem on, and pack in the stuffing. Cut about three-quarters of the way up so the four quarters stay joined at the top. Drop each one into a bowl of salted water as you go, then drain.
seg.02665f13e5af.t: ପ୍ରତ୍ୟେକ ବାଇଗଣକୁ ତଳୁ ଯୁକ୍ତ ଚିହ୍ନ ଆକାରରେ ଚିରନ୍ତୁ, ଡେମ୍ଫ ରଖି, ଓ ପୁର ଭରନ୍ତୁ। ପ୍ରାୟ ତିନି-ଚତୁର୍ଥାଂଶ ଉପର ଯାଏ କାଟନ୍ତୁ ଯେପରି ଚାରି ଭାଗ ଉପରେ ଯୋଡ଼ି ହୋଇ ରହେ। କାଟୁ କାଟୁ ପ୍ରତ୍ୟେକକୁ ଲୁଣ ପାଣି ବାଟିରେ ପକାନ୍ତୁ, ତାପରେ ପାଣି ଛାଣନ୍ତୁ।
seg.02665f13e5af.back: Slit each brinjal from the bottom in a plus-sign shape, keeping the stem, and fill with stuffing. Cut about three-quarters of the way up so the four parts stay joined at the top. As you cut, drop each into a bowl of salt water, then drain.

seg.498fc880430b.src: Press about 1 heaped tsp of stuffing into each brinjal. Keep the leftover stuffing aside.
seg.498fc880430b.t: ପ୍ରତ୍ୟେକ ବାଇଗଣରେ ପ୍ରାୟ 1 ଗଦା ଚା ଚାମଚ ପୁର ଚାପି ଭରନ୍ତୁ। ବଳକା ପୁର ଅଲଗା କରି ରଖନ୍ତୁ।
seg.498fc880430b.back: Press about 1 heaped teaspoon of stuffing into each brinjal. Keep the leftover stuffing aside.

seg.3daa0935ccba.src: Heat the oil in a wide, heavy pan on medium heat. Add the mustard seeds and, when they splutter, the curry leaves and onion, if using. Fry the onion until soft, about 3 minutes.
seg.3daa0935ccba.t: ଏକ ଚଉଡ଼ା, ମୋଟା ପ୍ୟାନରେ ମଧ୍ୟମ ନିଆଁରେ ତେଲ ଗରମ କରନ୍ତୁ। ସୋରିଷ ପକାନ୍ତୁ, ଫୁଟିଲେ ଭୃସଙ୍ଗ ପତ୍ର ଓ ବ୍ୟବହାର କରୁଥିଲେ ପିଆଜ ପକାନ୍ତୁ। ପିଆଜକୁ ନରମ ହେବା ଯାଏ ଭାଜନ୍ତୁ, ପ୍ରାୟ 3 ମିନିଟ।
seg.3daa0935ccba.back: Heat oil on medium flame in a wide, thick pan. Add mustard, when it splutters add curry leaves and the onion if using. Fry the onion until soft, about 3 minutes.

seg.3a140b72d6a0.src: Place the stuffed brinjals in a single layer in the pan.
seg.3a140b72d6a0.t: ପୁର ଭରା ବାଇଗଣକୁ ପ୍ୟାନରେ ଗୋଟିଏ ସ୍ତରରେ ରଖନ୍ତୁ।
seg.3a140b72d6a0.back: Place the stuffed brinjals in the pan in one layer.

seg.1ae98f10b6ed.src: Cook the brinjals in hot oil, covered, on a low flame, turning gently every 4–5 minutes. Use a spoon or tongs so the stuffing stays in, and cook for 15–18 minutes, until the skins wrinkle.
seg.1ae98f10b6ed.t: ଗରମ ତେଲରେ ବାଇଗଣକୁ ଘୋଡ଼ାଇ ଧିମା ନିଆଁରେ ରାନ୍ଧନ୍ତୁ, ପ୍ରତି 4–5 ମିନିଟରେ ଧୀରେ ଓଲଟାନ୍ତୁ। ପୁର ଯେପରି ଭିତରେ ରହେ ସେଥିପାଇଁ ଚାମଚ ବା ଚିମୁଟା ବ୍ୟବହାର କରନ୍ତୁ, ଆଉ ଚୋପା କୁଞ୍ଚିତ ହେବା ଯାଏ 15–18 ମିନିଟ ରାନ୍ଧନ୍ତୁ।
seg.1ae98f10b6ed.back: Cook the brinjals in the hot oil covered on low flame, turning gently every 4–5 minutes. Use a spoon or tongs so the stuffing stays inside, and cook 15–18 minutes until the skin wrinkles.

seg.50530663a626.src: Add the leftover stuffing with ½ cup water; simmer till the brinjals are soft. Cover and cook on low for 8–10 minutes more, until the masala thickens and oil shows at the sides.
seg.50530663a626.t: ବଳକା ପୁର ½ କପ ପାଣି ସହିତ ପକାନ୍ତୁ; ବାଇଗଣ ନରମ ହେବା ଯାଏ ଧିମା ଫୁଟାନ୍ତୁ। ଘୋଡ଼ାଇ ଧିମା ନିଆଁରେ ଆଉ 8–10 ମିନିଟ ରାନ୍ଧନ୍ତୁ, ଯେପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ ମସଲା ବହଳ ହୋଇ କଡ଼ରେ ତେଲ ନ ଦେଖାଯାଏ।
seg.50530663a626.back: Add the leftover stuffing with ½ cup water; simmer until the brinjals are soft. Cook covered on low flame 8–10 more minutes, until the masala thickens and oil shows at the sides.

seg.2a2726cfebd5.src: Check doneness: a knife should slide through the thickest brinjal with no resistance. Sprinkle the coriander leaves and switch off.
seg.2a2726cfebd5.t: ସିଝିଛି କି ନାହିଁ ଦେଖନ୍ତୁ: ସବୁଠୁ ମୋଟା ବାଇଗଣ ଭିତରେ ଛୁରୀ କୌଣସି ବାଧା ବିନା ପଶିଯିବା ଉଚିତ। ଧନିଆ ପତ୍ର ଛିଞ୍ଚି ନିଆଁ ବନ୍ଦ କରନ୍ତୁ।
seg.2a2726cfebd5.back: Check whether cooked: a knife should go into the thickest brinjal without any resistance. Sprinkle coriander leaves and turn off the flame.

seg.c2e59cef6130.src: Keep the stalks on so the brinjals hold together while they cook and turn.
seg.c2e59cef6130.t: ଡେମ୍ଫ ରଖନ୍ତୁ ଯେପରି ରାନ୍ଧିବା ଓ ଓଲଟାଇବା ବେଳେ ବାଇଗଣ ଯୋଡ଼ି ହୋଇ ରହେ।
seg.c2e59cef6130.back: Keep the stem so the brinjal stays joined while cooking and turning.

seg.15314c3b05cd.src: Pick small, glossy brinjals of the same size, so they cook evenly; large ones stay hard in the centre.
seg.15314c3b05cd.t: ସମାନ ଆକାରର ଛୋଟ, ଚକଚକିଆ ବାଇଗଣ ବାଛନ୍ତୁ ଯେପରି ସମାନ ଭାବେ ସିଝେ; ବଡ଼ ବାଇଗଣ ମଝିରେ ଟାଣ ରହିଯାଏ।
seg.15314c3b05cd.back: Choose small, shiny brinjals of the same size so they cook evenly; large brinjals stay hard in the middle.

seg.208cff8b9d46.src: Roast the peanuts and sesame on medium-low heat; burnt sesame makes the whole masala bitter.
seg.208cff8b9d46.t: ଚିନାବାଦାମ ଓ ରାଶିକୁ ମଧ୍ୟମରୁ କମ୍ ନିଆଁରେ ଭାଜନ୍ତୁ; ପୋଡ଼ା ରାଶି ପୂରା ମସଲାକୁ ପିତା କରିଦିଏ।
seg.208cff8b9d46.back: Roast the peanuts and sesame on medium-to-low flame; burnt sesame makes the whole masala bitter.

seg.7779355bd06d.src: For a milder curry, use 1½ tsp Sannam chilli powder; for more heat, go up to 1 tbsp.
seg.7779355bd06d.t: କମ୍ ରାଗୁଆ ତରକାରି ପାଇଁ 1½ ଚା ଚାମଚ ସନ୍ନମ ଲଙ୍କା ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ନିଅନ୍ତୁ; ଅଧିକ ରାଗ ପାଇଁ 1 ଟେବୁଲ ଚାମଚ ପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ ବଢ଼ାନ୍ତୁ।
seg.7779355bd06d.back: For a less hot curry take 1½ teaspoons Sannam chilli powder; for more heat increase up to 1 tablespoon.

seg.742d7eb81437.src: With onion masala: grind 1 small onion into the stuffing for a softer, slightly sweet gravy.
seg.742d7eb81437.t: ପିଆଜ ମସଲା ସହିତ: ନରମ ଓ ଟିକିଏ ମିଠା ଗ୍ରେଭି ପାଇଁ ପୁରରେ 1ଟି ଛୋଟ ପିଆଜ ବାଟି ମିଶାନ୍ତୁ।
seg.742d7eb81437.back: With onion masala: for a softer and slightly sweet gravy grind 1 small onion into the stuffing.

seg.abde9958c7fa.src: Without coconut: leave out the coconut and use 1 tbsp more peanuts and sesame.
seg.abde9958c7fa.t: ନଡ଼ିଆ ବିନା: ନଡ଼ିଆ ବାଦ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ ଓ 1 ଟେବୁଲ ଚାମଚ ଅଧିକ ଚିନାବାଦାମ ଓ ରାଶି ନିଅନ୍ତୁ।
seg.abde9958c7fa.back: Without coconut: leave out the coconut and take 1 tablespoon more peanuts and sesame.

seg.b9a6b34c8c73.src: Gravy style: add 1 cup water in place of ½ cup in the last step for a thinner curry to mix into rice.
seg.b9a6b34c8c73.t: ଗ୍ରେଭି ଶୈଳୀ: ଭାତରେ ମିଶାଇବା ପାଇଁ ପତଳା ତରକାରି ଚାହିଁଲେ ଶେଷ ଧାପରେ ½ କପ ବଦଳରେ 1 କପ ପାଣି ପକାନ୍ତୁ।
seg.b9a6b34c8c73.back: Gravy style: if you want a thinner curry for mixing into rice, add 1 cup water instead of ½ cup in the last step.

seg.80faf3a5e4b1.src: Serve hot with steamed rice and a spoon of ghee, or with chapati or jonna rotte.
seg.80faf3a5e4b1.t: ଗରମ ଭାତ ଓ ଚାମଚେ ଘିଅ ସହିତ, କିମ୍ବା ଚପାତି ବା ଜୋନ୍ନା ରୋଟ୍ଟେ ସହିତ ଗରମ ଗରମ ପରଷନ୍ତୁ।
seg.80faf3a5e4b1.back: Serve piping hot with hot rice and a spoon of ghee, or with chapati or jonna rotte.

seg.9adac1f51f99.src: Keep covered in the fridge and eat within 2 days. Warm gently with a splash of water.
seg.9adac1f51f99.t: ଘୋଡ଼ାଇ ଫ୍ରିଜରେ ରଖନ୍ତୁ ଓ 2 ଦିନ ଭିତରେ ଖାଆନ୍ତୁ। ଟିକିଏ ପାଣି ସହିତ ଧୀରେ ଗରମ କରନ୍ତୁ।
seg.9adac1f51f99.back: Keep covered in the fridge and eat within 2 days. Heat gently with a little water.

seg.83ffeb71bb2a.src: Which brinjals are best for gutti vankaya?
seg.83ffeb71bb2a.t: ଗୁତ୍ତି ଭଙ୍କାୟ ପାଇଁ କେଉଁ ବାଇଗଣ ସବୁଠୁ ଭଲ?
seg.83ffeb71bb2a.back: Which brinjal is best for gutti vankaya?

seg.76c81f4beef2.src: Small, round purple brinjals about the size of an egg, with a glossy skin and green stalk. They cook through in the time the masala takes and hold the stuffing well.
seg.76c81f4beef2.t: ଅଣ୍ଡା ଆକାରର ଛୋଟ, ଗୋଲ, ବାଇଗଣୀ ବାଇଗଣ, ଚକଚକିଆ ଚୋପା ଓ ସବୁଜ ଡେମ୍ଫ ସହିତ। ମସଲା ରାନ୍ଧିବାକୁ ଯେତିକି ସମୟ ଲାଗେ ସେତିକିରେ ଏଗୁଡ଼ିକ ଭିତର ଯାଏ ସିଝିଯାଏ ଓ ପୁର ଭଲ ଧରି ରଖେ।
seg.76c81f4beef2.back: Egg-sized small, round, purple brinjals, with shiny skin and green stem. In the time it takes to cook the masala these cook through to the inside and hold the stuffing well.

seg.71325f387d2a.src: How do I know the brinjals are cooked?
seg.71325f387d2a.t: ବାଇଗଣ ସିଝିଛି କି ନାହିଁ କିପରି ଜାଣିବି?
seg.71325f387d2a.back: How do I know whether the brinjal is cooked?

seg.c65656faa952.src: The skins wrinkle and soften, and a knife slides through the thickest brinjal with no resistance. Undercooked brinjals feel firm and spongy in the centre.
seg.c65656faa952.t: ଚୋପା କୁଞ୍ଚିତ ଓ ନରମ ହୁଏ, ଆଉ ସବୁଠୁ ମୋଟା ବାଇଗଣ ଭିତରେ ଛୁରୀ କୌଣସି ବାଧା ବିନା ପଶିଯାଏ। କମ୍ ସିଝା ବାଇଗଣ ମଝିରେ ଟାଣ ଓ ସ୍ପଞ୍ଜ ପରି ଲାଗେ।
seg.c65656faa952.back: The skin becomes wrinkled and soft, and a knife goes into the thickest brinjal without any resistance. Undercooked brinjal feels hard and spongy in the middle.

seg.297ebd94e89c.src: Can I make gutti vankaya without coconut?
seg.297ebd94e89c.t: ନଡ଼ିଆ ବିନା ଗୁତ୍ତି ଭଙ୍କାୟ ତିଆରି କରିପାରିବି କି?
seg.297ebd94e89c.back: Can I make gutti vankaya without coconut?

seg.f9ad1045b4c1.src: Yes. Use 1 tbsp more peanuts and 1 tbsp more sesame seeds in place of the coconut; the masala tastes nuttier.
seg.f9ad1045b4c1.t: ହଁ। ନଡ଼ିଆ ବଦଳରେ 1 ଟେବୁଲ ଚାମଚ ଅଧିକ ଚିନାବାଦାମ ଓ 1 ଟେବୁଲ ଚାମଚ ଅଧିକ ରାଶି ନିଅନ୍ତୁ; ମସଲାର ସ୍ୱାଦ ଅଧିକ ବାଦାମ ପରି ହୁଏ।
seg.f9ad1045b4c1.back: Yes. Instead of coconut take 1 tablespoon more peanuts and 1 tablespoon more sesame; the masala's taste becomes more nutty.

seg.534e126ba995.src: Why do my brinjals fall apart?
seg.534e126ba995.back: Why are my brinjals breaking apart?

seg.96bfe0b8ed06.src: The stalk was removed or the cross was cut all the way through. Keep the stalk on, stop the slit about a quarter from the top and turn them gently.
seg.96bfe0b8ed06.t: ଡେମ୍ଫ କାଢ଼ି ଦିଆଯାଇଥିଲା ବା ଯୁକ୍ତ ଚିହ୍ନ ପୂରା କାଟି ଦିଆଯାଇଥିଲା। ଡେମ୍ଫ ରଖନ୍ତୁ, ଉପରୁ ପ୍ରାୟ ଏକ-ଚତୁର୍ଥାଂଶ ବାକି ଥାଉ ଥାଉ ଚିରିବା ବନ୍ଦ କରନ୍ତୁ, ଆଉ ଧୀରେ ଓଲଟାନ୍ତୁ।
seg.96bfe0b8ed06.back: The stem was removed or the plus-sign was cut all the way through. Keep the stem, stop slitting while about one-quarter remains at the top, and turn gently.

seg.69e1140e9c6e.src: గుత్తి వంకాయ కూర · Gutti Vankaya Kura Recipe | 1acrefarms
seg.69e1140e9c6e.t: గుత్తి వంకాయ కూర · ଗୁତ୍ତି ଭଙ୍କାୟ କୂରା ରେସିପି | 1acrefarms
seg.69e1140e9c6e.back: గుత్తి వంకాయ కూర · Gutti Vankaya Koora recipe | 1acrefarms

seg.d09cc87e5fde.src: గుత్తి వంకాయ కూర. Small brinjals stuffed with roasted peanut, sesame and coconut, ground with Sannam chilli powder and turmeric powder, then slow-cooked in oil.
seg.d09cc87e5fde.t: గుత్తి వంకాయ కూర. ଭଜା ଚିନାବାଦାମ, ରାଶି ଓ ନଡ଼ିଆକୁ ସନ୍ନମ ଲଙ୍କା ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ଓ ହଳଦୀ ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ସହିତ ବାଟି ଭରା ଛୋଟ ବାଇଗଣ, ତାପରେ ତେଲରେ ଧୀରେ ରନ୍ଧା।
seg.d09cc87e5fde.back: గుత్తి వంకాయ కూర. Small brinjals filled with roasted peanuts, sesame and coconut ground with Sannam chilli powder and turmeric powder, then slowly cooked in oil.

seg.e6d2d516a538.src: Gutti Vankaya Kura (Andhra Stuffed Brinjal Curry) · 1acrefarms
seg.e6d2d516a538.t: ଗୁତ୍ତି ଭଙ୍କାୟ କୂରା (ଆନ୍ଧ୍ରର ପୁର ଭରା ବାଇଗଣ ତରକାରି) · 1acrefarms
seg.e6d2d516a538.back: Gutti Vankaya Koora (Andhra stuffed brinjal curry) · 1acrefarms

seg.edfa611d692c.src: Gutti Vankaya Kura: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.edfa611d692c.t: ଗୁତ୍ତି ଭଙ୍କାୟ କୂରା: 1acrefarmsର ରେସିପି କାର୍ଡ, ଉପକରଣ ଓ ପ୍ରଣାଳୀ ସହିତ
seg.edfa611d692c.back: Gutti Vankaya Koora: 1acrefarms recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.111c74722b7d.src: Jeedipappu pakodi is the cashew pakoda that Andhra sweet shops and homes fry for tea time, festivals and guests: whole cashews in a thin, spiced coat of besan and rice flour, fried till crisp. Made without onion, it keeps for days in a jar, so many homes fry a batch for Diwali and Sankranti visitors.
seg.111c74722b7d.t: ଜୀଡିପପ୍ପୁ ପକୋଡି ହେଉଛି କାଜୁ ପକୋଡ଼ି ଯାହା ଆନ୍ଧ୍ରର ମିଠା ଦୋକାନ ଓ ଘରେ ଚା ବେଳ, ପର୍ବ ଓ ଅତିଥିଙ୍କ ପାଇଁ ଭଜାଯାଏ: ଗୋଟା କାଜୁ ଉପରେ ବେସନ ଓ ଚାଉଳ ଗୁଣ୍ଡର ପତଳା ମସଲାଦାର ଆବରଣ, କୁରକୁରିଆ ହେବା ଯାଏ ଭଜା। ପିଆଜ ବିନା ତିଆରି ହେଉଥିବାରୁ ଏହା ଡବାରେ ଅନେକ ଦିନ ରହେ, ତେଣୁ ଅନେକ ଘରେ ଦୀପାବଳି ଓ ସଙ୍କ୍ରାନ୍ତିରେ ଆସୁଥିବା ଅତିଥିଙ୍କ ପାଇଁ ଏକ ଖେପ ଭାଜନ୍ତି।
seg.111c74722b7d.back: Jeedipappu pakodi is the cashew pakodi fried in Andhra sweet shops and homes for tea-time, festivals and guests: a thin spiced coating of besan and rice flour over whole cashews, fried until crunchy. Because it is made without onion it keeps many days in a tin, so many homes fry a batch for guests coming at Deepavali and Sankranti.

seg.b4f22aebea20.src: Whole cashews from our Jeedipappu pack stay crunchy inside the coating, and Sannam chilli powder gives a medium heat and a warm red colour. This recipe serves 4.
seg.b4f22aebea20.t: ଆମ ଜୀଡିପପ୍ପୁ ପ୍ୟାକେଟର ଗୋଟା କାଜୁ ଆବରଣ ଭିତରେ କୁରକୁରିଆ ରହେ, ଆଉ ସନ୍ନମ ଲଙ୍କା ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ମଧ୍ୟମ ରାଗ ଓ ଉଷୁମ ଲାଲ ରଙ୍ଗ ଦିଏ। ଏହି ରେସିପି 4 ଜଣଙ୍କ ପାଇଁ।
seg.b4f22aebea20.back: The whole cashews from our Jeedipappu packet stay crunchy inside the coating, and Sannam chilli powder gives medium heat and a warm red colour. This recipe is for 4 people.

seg.a21c4d5f661e.src: Total includes 5 minutes for the pakodi to cool and crisp.
seg.a21c4d5f661e.t: ମୋଟ ସମୟରେ ପକୋଡି ଥଣ୍ଡା ହୋଇ କୁରକୁରିଆ ହେବାର 5 ମିନିଟ ମଧ୍ୟ ଅଛି।
seg.a21c4d5f661e.back: The total time also includes 5 minutes for the pakodi to cool and turn crunchy.

seg.0f4b2d277930.src: Toss whole cashews with besan, rice flour, Sannam chilli powder, salt and a spoon of hot oil, sprinkle in just enough water to coat, and deep fry till golden and crisp.
seg.0f4b2d277930.t: ଗୋଟା କାଜୁକୁ ବେସନ, ଚାଉଳ ଗୁଣ୍ଡ, ସନ୍ନମ ଲଙ୍କା ଗୁଣ୍ଡ, ଲୁଣ ଓ ଚାମଚେ ଗରମ ତେଲ ସହିତ ମିଶାନ୍ତୁ, ଆବରଣ ହେବା ପାଇଁ ଯେତିକି ଦରକାର ସେତିକି ପାଣି ଛିଞ୍ଚନ୍ତୁ, ଆଉ ସୁନେଲି ଓ କୁରକୁରିଆ ହେବା ଯାଏ ଡିପ ଫ୍ରାଏ କରନ୍ତୁ।
seg.0f4b2d277930.back: Mix whole cashews with besan, rice flour, Sannam chilli powder, salt and a spoon of hot oil, sprinkle only as much water as needed to coat, and deep fry until golden and crunchy.

seg.d97defcf6bd2.src: 1 cup whole cashews ⟦1⟧about 150 g; split any very large ones in half⟦/1⟧
seg.d97defcf6bd2.t: 1 କପ ଗୋଟା କାଜୁ ⟦1⟧ପ୍ରାୟ 150 g; ବହୁତ ବଡ଼ ଥିଲେ ଅଧା କରନ୍ତୁ⟦/1⟧
seg.d97defcf6bd2.back: 1 cup whole cashews ⟦1⟧about 150 g; if very large halve them⟦/1⟧

seg.0fb432c2000d.src: ½ cup besan ⟦1⟧gram flour, about 50 g⟦/1⟧
seg.0fb432c2000d.t: ½ କପ ବେସନ ⟦1⟧ବୁଟ ଗୁଣ୍ଡ, ପ୍ରାୟ 50 g⟦/1⟧
seg.0fb432c2000d.back: ½ cup besan ⟦1⟧gram flour, about 50 g⟦/1⟧

seg.4530b28d3c24.src: 2 tbsp rice flour ⟦1⟧for a crisper coating⟦/1⟧
seg.4530b28d3c24.t: 2 ଟେବୁଲ ଚାମଚ ଚାଉଳ ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ⟦1⟧ଅଧିକ କୁରକୁରିଆ ଆବରଣ ପାଇଁ⟦/1⟧
seg.4530b28d3c24.back: 2 tablespoons rice flour ⟦1⟧for a crunchier coating⟦/1⟧

seg.069bf214d83d.src: 1 tsp Sannam chilli powder ⟦1⟧medium heat; add ½ tsp more for a hotter pakodi⟦/1⟧
seg.069bf214d83d.t: 1 ଚା ଚାମଚ ସନ୍ନମ ଲଙ୍କା ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ⟦1⟧ମଧ୍ୟମ ରାଗ; ଅଧିକ ରାଗୁଆ ପକୋଡି ପାଇଁ ½ ଚା ଚାମଚ ଅଧିକ⟦/1⟧
seg.069bf214d83d.back: 1 teaspoon Sannam chilli powder ⟦1⟧medium heat; for hotter pakodi ½ teaspoon more⟦/1⟧

seg.40a2a51a64aa.t: ½ ଚା ଚାମଚ ଲୁଣ ⟦1⟧କିମ୍ବା ସ୍ୱାଦ ଅନୁସାରେ⟦/1⟧
seg.40a2a51a64aa.back: ½ teaspoon salt ⟦1⟧or as per taste⟦/1⟧

seg.3a1f0206d086.t: 2 ଟେବୁଲ ଚାମଚ ଧନିଆ ପତ୍ର ⟦1⟧ମିହି କରି କଟା⟦/1⟧

seg.c5de5bb5101e.src: 1 tbsp hot oil ⟦1⟧taken from the frying oil⟦/1⟧
seg.c5de5bb5101e.t: 1 ଟେବୁଲ ଚାମଚ ଗରମ ତେଲ ⟦1⟧ଭାଜିବା ତେଲରୁ ନିଆଯାଇଥିବା⟦/1⟧
seg.c5de5bb5101e.back: 1 tablespoon hot oil ⟦1⟧taken from the frying oil⟦/1⟧

seg.a24adfc46507.src: 2–3 tbsp water ⟦1⟧sprinkled in a little at a time⟦/1⟧
seg.a24adfc46507.t: 2–3 ଟେବୁଲ ଚାମଚ ପାଣି ⟦1⟧ଅଳ୍ପ ଅଳ୍ପ କରି ଛିଞ୍ଚନ୍ତୁ⟦/1⟧

seg.9a0fd1249b07.src: oil for deep frying ⟦1⟧groundnut oil is the usual choice⟦/1⟧
seg.9a0fd1249b07.t: ଡିପ ଫ୍ରାଏ ପାଇଁ ତେଲ ⟦1⟧ସାଧାରଣତଃ ବାଦାମ ତେଲ⟦/1⟧
seg.9a0fd1249b07.back: Oil for deep frying ⟦1⟧usually groundnut oil⟦/1⟧

seg.8423a6481648.src: Rinse the cashews and drain them well; a slightly damp surface helps the flour stick.
seg.8423a6481648.t: କାଜୁକୁ ଧୋଇ ଭଲ କରି ପାଣି ଛାଣନ୍ତୁ; ଉପରେ ଟିକିଏ ଓଦା ଥିଲେ ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ଲାଗିବାରେ ସାହାଯ୍ୟ ହୁଏ।
seg.8423a6481648.back: Wash the cashews and drain well; a little wetness on the surface helps the flour stick.

seg.0d03259dc451.src: Heat the oil for deep frying in a kadai on medium heat.
seg.0d03259dc451.t: ଏକ କଡ଼ାଇରେ ମଧ୍ୟମ ନିଆଁରେ ଡିପ ଫ୍ରାଏ ପାଇଁ ତେଲ ଗରମ କରନ୍ତୁ।
seg.0d03259dc451.back: Heat oil for deep frying in a kadai on medium flame.

seg.c7fa1a156718.src: Mix the besan, rice flour, chilli powder, salt, ginger-garlic paste and curry leaves. Use a wide bowl, and add the green chillies, coriander leaves and asafoetida at the same time.
seg.c7fa1a156718.t: ବେସନ, ଚାଉଳ ଗୁଣ୍ଡ, ଲଙ୍କା ଗୁଣ୍ଡ, ଲୁଣ, ଅଦା-ରସୁଣ ବଟା ଓ ଭୃସଙ୍ଗ ପତ୍ର ମିଶାନ୍ତୁ। ଏକ ଚଉଡ଼ା ବାଟି ବ୍ୟବହାର କରନ୍ତୁ, ଆଉ ସେତିକିବେଳେ କଞ୍ଚା ଲଙ୍କା, ଧନିଆ ପତ୍ର ଓ ହେଙ୍ଗୁ ମଧ୍ୟ ପକାନ୍ତୁ।
seg.c7fa1a156718.back: Mix besan, rice flour, chilli powder, salt, ginger-garlic paste and curry leaves. Use a wide bowl, and at the same time add green chilli, coriander leaves and asafoetida too.

seg.346911fb291b.src: Rub in 1 tbsp hot oil, add the cashews and sprinkle water till the flour just coats them. Spoon the hot oil from the kadai with care and rub it into the flour mix with your fingertips first, then add the cashews and sprinkle the water 1 tbsp at a time, tossing, until the flour clings to every cashew. The mix should look like damp crumbs, not a batter.
seg.346911fb291b.t: 1 ଟେବୁଲ ଚାମଚ ଗରମ ତେଲ ଘଷି ମିଶାନ୍ତୁ, କାଜୁ ପକାନ୍ତୁ ଓ ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ଠିକ ଆବରଣ ହେବା ଯାଏ ପାଣି ଛିଞ୍ଚନ୍ତୁ। କଡ଼ାଇରୁ ଗରମ ତେଲ ଯତ୍ନରେ ଚାମଚରେ ନିଅନ୍ତୁ ଓ ପ୍ରଥମେ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ଟିପରେ ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ମିଶ୍ରଣରେ ଘଷି ମିଶାନ୍ତୁ, ତାପରେ କାଜୁ ପକାଇ ଥରକେ 1 ଟେବୁଲ ଚାମଚ କରି ପାଣି ଛିଞ୍ଚି ଘାଣ୍ଟନ୍ତୁ, ଯେପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ ପ୍ରତ୍ୟେକ କାଜୁରେ ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ଲାଗି ନ ଯାଏ। ମିଶ୍ରଣ ଓଦା ଗୁଣ୍ଡା ପରି ଦେଖାଯିବା ଉଚିତ, ଗୋଳା ପରି ନୁହେଁ।
seg.346911fb291b.back: Rub in 1 tablespoon hot oil, add the cashews and sprinkle water until the flour coats properly. Carefully take hot oil from the kadai with a spoon and first rub it into the flour mixture with your fingertips, then add the cashews and sprinkle water 1 tablespoon at a time and stir, until flour sticks to every cashew. The mixture should look like wet crumbs, not like batter.

seg.05a50e3b5ae8.src: Check the oil: a pinch of the mix dropped in should rise to the top in 2–3 seconds with steady bubbles. If it browns at once, the oil is too hot.
seg.05a50e3b5ae8.t: ତେଲ ଦେଖନ୍ତୁ: ଚିମୁଟାଏ ମିଶ୍ରଣ ପକାଇଲେ 2–3 ସେକେଣ୍ଡରେ ସ୍ଥିର ବୁଦବୁଦ ସହିତ ଉପରକୁ ଉଠିବା ଉଚିତ। ସଙ୍ଗେ ସଙ୍ଗେ ବାଦାମୀ ହୋଇଗଲେ ତେଲ ବହୁତ ଗରମ।
seg.05a50e3b5ae8.back: Check the oil: when a pinch of the mixture is dropped in it should rise to the top in 2–3 seconds with steady bubbles. If it turns brown at once the oil is too hot.

seg.f3e77b6c0f73.src: Drop small clusters into medium-hot oil. Pick up 3–4 coated cashews at a time with your fingers and let them fall loosely into the oil, without crowding the kadai.
seg.f3e77b6c0f73.t: ମଧ୍ୟମ ଗରମ ତେଲରେ ଛୋଟ ଛୋଟ ଗୁଚ୍ଛ ପକାନ୍ତୁ। ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠିରେ ଏକାଥରକେ 3–4ଟି ଆବରଣ ଲାଗିଥିବା କାଜୁ ଉଠାଇ ତେଲରେ ଢିଲା କରି ପକାନ୍ତୁ, କଡ଼ାଇରେ ଭିଡ଼ କରନ୍ତୁ ନାହିଁ।
seg.f3e77b6c0f73.back: Drop small clusters into medium-hot oil. Pick up 3–4 coated cashews at a time with your fingers and drop them loosely into the oil; do not crowd the kadai.

seg.5e4bfdad4c05.src: Fry, turning, till golden and crisp, 5–6 minutes; drain on paper. The bubbles around the pakodi get smaller and slow down when they are done.
seg.5e4bfdad4c05.t: ଓଲଟାଇ ଓଲଟାଇ ସୁନେଲି ଓ କୁରକୁରିଆ ହେବା ଯାଏ ଭାଜନ୍ତୁ, 5–6 ମିନିଟ; କାଗଜ ଉପରେ ତେଲ ଛାଣନ୍ତୁ। ସିଝିଗଲେ ପକୋଡି ଚାରିପାଖର ବୁଦବୁଦ ଛୋଟ ଓ ଧୀର ହୋଇଯାଏ।
seg.5e4bfdad4c05.back: Fry, turning and turning, until golden and crunchy, 5–6 minutes; drain the oil on paper. When done the bubbles around the pakodi become small and slow.

seg.eb1a58e02e89.src: Fry the rest in batches the same way, letting the oil come back to heat between batches.
seg.eb1a58e02e89.t: ବାକିତକ ସେହିପରି ଖେପ ଖେପ କରି ଭାଜନ୍ତୁ, ପ୍ରତି ଖେପ ମଝିରେ ତେଲକୁ ପୁଣି ଗରମ ହେବାକୁ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ।
seg.eb1a58e02e89.back: Fry the rest the same way in batches, letting the oil heat again between each batch.

seg.8ab193492427.src: Let the pakodi rest for 5 minutes on the paper; they crisp up further as they cool. Sprinkle a pinch of salt or chilli powder over the top, if you like.
seg.8ab193492427.t: ପକୋଡିକୁ କାଗଜ ଉପରେ 5 ମିନିଟ ରଖନ୍ତୁ; ଥଣ୍ଡା ହେବା ସହିତ ଏଗୁଡ଼ିକ ଆହୁରି କୁରକୁରିଆ ହୁଏ। ଇଚ୍ଛା ହେଲେ ଉପରେ ଚିମୁଟାଏ ଲୁଣ ବା ଲଙ୍କା ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ଛିଞ୍ଚନ୍ତୁ।
seg.8ab193492427.back: Keep the pakodi on paper 5 minutes; as they cool they become even crunchier. If you like sprinkle a pinch of salt or chilli powder on top.

seg.c8ded38fad10.src: Keep the batter thick and dry, not runny, or the pakodi turns soft.
seg.c8ded38fad10.t: ଗୋଳା ବହଳ ଓ ଶୁଖିଲା ରଖନ୍ତୁ, ପତଳା ନୁହେଁ, ନଚେତ୍ ପକୋଡି ନରମ ହୋଇଯାଏ।
seg.c8ded38fad10.back: Keep the mixture thick and dry, not thin, otherwise the pakodi becomes soft.

seg.9670def7c10b.src: Fry on medium heat: cashews brown fast, and on high heat the coating colours before the cashew inside is toasted.
seg.9670def7c10b.t: ମଧ୍ୟମ ନିଆଁରେ ଭାଜନ୍ତୁ: କାଜୁ ଶୀଘ୍ର ବାଦାମୀ ହୁଏ, ଆଉ ତେଜ ନିଆଁରେ ଭିତରର କାଜୁ ଭଜା ହେବା ଆଗରୁ ଆବରଣର ରଙ୍ଗ ବଦଳିଯାଏ।
seg.9670def7c10b.back: Fry on medium flame: cashews brown quickly, and on high flame the coating changes colour before the cashew inside is roasted.

seg.76602f605fc8.src: The spoon of hot oil rubbed into the flour makes the pakodi light and crisp.
seg.76602f605fc8.t: ଗୁଣ୍ଡରେ ଘଷି ମିଶା ଚାମଚେ ଗରମ ତେଲ ପକୋଡିକୁ ହାଲୁକା ଓ କୁରକୁରିଆ କରେ।
seg.76602f605fc8.back: A spoon of hot oil rubbed into the flour makes the pakodi light and crunchy.

seg.2494998e92ed.src: Sannam chilli powder gives a medium heat and a good red colour; use ½ tsp for children.
seg.2494998e92ed.t: ସନ୍ନମ ଲଙ୍କା ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ମଧ୍ୟମ ରାଗ ଓ ଭଲ ଲାଲ ରଙ୍ଗ ଦିଏ; ପିଲାଙ୍କ ପାଇଁ ½ ଚା ଚାମଚ ନିଅନ୍ତୁ।
seg.2494998e92ed.back: Sannam chilli powder gives medium heat and a good red colour; for children take ½ teaspoon.

seg.7f70d313349e.src: Hotter: replace half the Sannam chilli powder with Teja chilli powder, which is much hotter.
seg.7f70d313349e.t: ଅଧିକ ରାଗୁଆ: ଅଧା ସନ୍ନମ ଲଙ୍କା ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ବଦଳରେ ତେଜା ଲଙ୍କା ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ନିଅନ୍ତୁ, ଯାହା ବହୁତ ବେଶି ରାଗୁଆ।
seg.7f70d313349e.back: Hotter: instead of half the Sannam chilli powder take Teja chilli powder, which is much hotter.

seg.2b2be3846a1d.src: With onion: add 1 small onion, thinly sliced, with the cashews for a softer, sweeter pakodi, and eat it the same day.
seg.2b2be3846a1d.t: ପିଆଜ ସହିତ: ନରମ ଓ ଅଧିକ ମିଠା ପକୋଡି ପାଇଁ କାଜୁ ସହିତ 1ଟି ଛୋଟ ପତଳା କଟା ପିଆଜ ପକାନ୍ତୁ, ଆଉ ସେହି ଦିନ ହିଁ ଖାଆନ୍ତୁ।
seg.2b2be3846a1d.back: With onion: for a softer and sweeter pakodi add 1 small thinly sliced onion with the cashews, and eat it that same day.

seg.7f852eddc8b5.src: Mint: add 2 tbsp chopped mint leaves along with the coriander leaves.
seg.7f852eddc8b5.t: ପୋଦିନା: ଧନିଆ ପତ୍ର ସହିତ 2 ଟେବୁଲ ଚାମଚ କଟା ପୋଦିନା ପତ୍ର ପକାନ୍ତୁ।
seg.7f852eddc8b5.back: Mint: add 2 tablespoons chopped mint leaves with the coriander leaves.

seg.cd47edc05460.src: Serve warm with evening tea or filter coffee. They also go into lunch boxes or onto the side of a rice-and-pappu meal.
seg.cd47edc05460.t: ସନ୍ଧ୍ୟା ଚା ବା ଫିଲ୍ଟର କଫି ସହିତ ଉଷୁମ ଉଷୁମ ପରଷନ୍ତୁ। ଟିଫିନ ବାକ୍ସରେ ବା ଭାତ-ପପ୍ପୁ ଖାଇବା ସହିତ ପାଖ ଖାଦ୍ୟ ଭାବେ ମଧ୍ୟ ଚଳେ।
seg.cd47edc05460.back: Serve warm with evening tea or filter coffee. Also does in a tiffin box or as a side with a rice-pappu meal.

seg.e2777b4dabb7.src: Once fully cooled, keep them in an airtight jar at room temperature and eat within 4–5 days. If they soften, warm them in a dry pan on low heat for 2–3 minutes.
seg.e2777b4dabb7.t: ପୂରା ଥଣ୍ଡା ହେବା ପରେ ବାୟୁରୋଧୀ ଡବାରେ ସାଧାରଣ ତାପମାତ୍ରାରେ ରଖନ୍ତୁ ଓ 4–5 ଦିନ ଭିତରେ ଖାଆନ୍ତୁ। ନରମ ହୋଇଗଲେ ଶୁଖିଲା ପ୍ୟାନରେ ଧିମା ନିଆଁରେ 2–3 ମିନିଟ ଗରମ କରନ୍ତୁ।
seg.e2777b4dabb7.back: After cooling completely keep in an airtight tin at room temperature and eat within 4–5 days. If they turn soft heat in a dry pan on low flame 2–3 minutes.

seg.f8c9120f7f67.src: Why did my cashew pakodi turn soft?
seg.f8c9120f7f67.t: ମୋ କାଜୁ ପକୋଡି କାହିଁକି ନରମ ହୋଇଗଲା?
seg.f8c9120f7f67.back: Why did my cashew pakodi become soft?

seg.346050614d3a.src: Too much water in the flour, or frying on low heat. Keep the mix like damp crumbs and fry on medium heat until the bubbles slow down.
seg.346050614d3a.t: ଗୁଣ୍ଡରେ ବହୁତ ବେଶି ପାଣି, କିମ୍ବା ଧିମା ନିଆଁରେ ଭାଜିବା ଯୋଗୁଁ। ମିଶ୍ରଣକୁ ଓଦା ଗୁଣ୍ଡା ପରି ରଖନ୍ତୁ ଓ ବୁଦବୁଦ ଧୀର ହେବା ଯାଏ ମଧ୍ୟମ ନିଆଁରେ ଭାଜନ୍ତୁ।
seg.346050614d3a.back: Because of too much water in the flour, or frying on low flame. Keep the mixture like wet crumbs and fry on medium flame until the bubbles slow.

seg.921421ebf2c6.src: Should I soak cashews before making pakodi?
seg.921421ebf2c6.t: ପକୋଡି କରିବା ଆଗରୁ କାଜୁ ଭିଜାଇବା ଦରକାର କି?
seg.921421ebf2c6.back: Do the cashews need soaking before making pakodi?

seg.e6e487728264.src: No soak is needed. A quick rinse is enough to help the flour stick; cashews soaked for long lose some of their crunch.
seg.e6e487728264.t: ଭିଜାଇବା ଦରକାର ନାହିଁ। ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ଲାଗିବା ପାଇଁ ଥରେ ଧୋଇଦେବା ଯଥେଷ୍ଟ; ବହୁତ ସମୟ ଭିଜା କାଜୁ ତାର କିଛି କୁରକୁରିଆ ଭାବ ହରାଏ।
seg.e6e487728264.back: No need to soak. Washing once is enough for the flour to stick; cashews soaked a long time lose some of their crunch.

seg.905443e515e2.src: Can I make cashew pakodi without rice flour?
seg.905443e515e2.t: ଚାଉଳ ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ବିନା କାଜୁ ପକୋଡି ତିଆରି କରିପାରିବି କି?
seg.905443e515e2.back: Can I make cashew pakodi without rice flour?

seg.72a2c55cca9c.src: Yes. Use 2 tbsp more besan, or 1 tbsp cornflour. Rice flour gives the crispest coating, so the pakodi will be a little softer without it.
seg.72a2c55cca9c.t: ହଁ। 2 ଟେବୁଲ ଚାମଚ ଅଧିକ ବେସନ, ବା 1 ଟେବୁଲ ଚାମଚ କର୍ନଫ୍ଲାୱାର ନିଅନ୍ତୁ। ଚାଉଳ ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ସବୁଠୁ କୁରକୁରିଆ ଆବରଣ ଦିଏ, ତେଣୁ ତା ବିନା ପକୋଡି ଟିକିଏ ନରମ ହେବ।
seg.72a2c55cca9c.back: Yes. Take 2 tablespoons more besan, or 1 tablespoon cornflour. Rice flour gives the crunchiest coating, so without it the pakodi will be a little softer.

seg.f129edc737b1.src: How long does cashew pakodi stay crisp?
seg.f129edc737b1.t: କାଜୁ ପକୋଡି କେତେ ଦିନ କୁରକୁରିଆ ରହେ?
seg.f129edc737b1.back: How many days does cashew pakodi stay crunchy?

seg.d73ef4b28b6d.src: About 4–5 days in an airtight jar, as long as it cools completely before it goes in.
seg.d73ef4b28b6d.t: ବାୟୁରୋଧୀ ଡବାରେ ପ୍ରାୟ 4–5 ଦିନ, ଯଦି ଡବାରେ ରଖିବା ଆଗରୁ ପୂରା ଥଣ୍ଡା ହୋଇଥାଏ।
seg.d73ef4b28b6d.back: About 4–5 days in an airtight tin, if it has cooled completely before going into the tin.

seg.62c3aa71c55a.src: జీడిపప్పు పకోడీ. Crisp cashew pakodi with whole cashews from our Jeedipappu pack, besan, rice flour and Sannam chilli powder. Step-by-step method, tips and FAQs.
seg.62c3aa71c55a.t: జీడిపప్పు పకోడీ. ଆମ ଜୀଡିପପ୍ପୁ ପ୍ୟାକେଟର ଗୋଟା କାଜୁ, ବେସନ, ଚାଉଳ ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ଓ ସନ୍ନମ ଲଙ୍କା ଗୁଣ୍ଡରେ କୁରକୁରିଆ କାଜୁ ପକୋଡି। ଧାପେ ଧାପେ ପ୍ରଣାଳୀ, ଟିପ୍ସ ଓ ପ୍ରଶ୍ନୋତ୍ତର।
seg.62c3aa71c55a.back: జీడిపప్పు పకోడీ. Crunchy cashew pakodi with whole cashews from our Jeedipappu packet, besan, rice flour and Sannam chilli powder. Step-by-step method, tips and Q&A.

seg.f560ff3badb6.src: Jeedipappu Pakodi: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.f560ff3badb6.t: ଜୀଡିପପ୍ପୁ ପକୋଡି: 1acrefarmsର ରେସିପି କାର୍ଡ, ଉପକରଣ ଓ ପ୍ରଣାଳୀ ସହିତ
seg.f560ff3badb6.back: Jeedipappu Pakodi: 1acrefarms recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.a64f3158d8da.src: Upma is the everyday Andhra tiffin: semolina cooked soft in a seasoned water with onion, green chillies and curry leaves. Jeedipappu upma is the dressed-up version, with a good handful of cashews fried golden in ghee, the way it is made for guests, for festival mornings and at weddings, often served next to pesarattu or with a spoon of sugar.
seg.a64f3158d8da.t: ଉପମା ହେଉଛି ଆନ୍ଧ୍ରର ପ୍ରତିଦିନର ଜଳଖିଆ: ପିଆଜ, କଞ୍ଚା ଲଙ୍କା ଓ ଭୃସଙ୍ଗ ପତ୍ର ସହିତ ଛୁଙ୍କ ଦିଆ ପାଣିରେ ସୁଜିକୁ ନରମ କରି ରନ୍ଧାଯାଏ। ଜୀଡିପପ୍ପୁ ଉପମା ହେଉଛି ଏହାର ସଜା ରୂପ, ମୁଠାଏ କାଜୁ ଘିଅରେ ସୁନେଲି କରି ଭଜା, ଯେପରି ଅତିଥିଙ୍କ ପାଇଁ, ପର୍ବ ସକାଳେ ଓ ବିବାହରେ ତିଆରି ହୁଏ, ଅନେକ ସମୟରେ ପେସରଟ୍ଟୁ ପାଖରେ ବା ଚାମଚେ ଚିନି ସହିତ ପରଷାଯାଏ।
seg.a64f3158d8da.back: Upma is Andhra's everyday breakfast: semolina cooked soft in tempered water with onion, green chilli and curry leaves. Jeedipappu upma is its dressed-up form, with a handful of cashews fried golden in ghee, as made for guests, on festival mornings and at weddings, often served beside pesarattu or with a spoon of sugar.

seg.f9bc03f64077.src: Our Jeedipappu cashews are whole and plain, so they fry evenly and stay crunchy against the soft rava. It is on the table in about 25 minutes. This recipe serves 3.
seg.f9bc03f64077.t: ଆମ ଜୀଡିପପ୍ପୁ କାଜୁ ଗୋଟା ଓ ସାଦା, ତେଣୁ ସମାନ ଭାବେ ଭଜା ହୁଏ ଓ ନରମ ସୁଜି ମଝିରେ କୁରକୁରିଆ ରହେ। ପ୍ରାୟ 25 ମିନିଟରେ ଥାଳିରେ ପହଞ୍ଚେ। ଏହି ରେସିପି 3 ଜଣଙ୍କ ପାଇଁ।
seg.f9bc03f64077.back: Our Jeedipappu cashews are whole and plain, so they fry evenly and stay crunchy amid the soft semolina. It reaches the plate in about 25 minutes. This recipe is for 3 people.

seg.5ef4d1713249.src: Roast rava, fry cashews in ghee, then temper and soften onion and chillies. Boil water with salt, stir in the rava, cover and finish with the cashews.
seg.5ef4d1713249.t: ସୁଜି ଭାଜନ୍ତୁ, କାଜୁକୁ ଘିଅରେ ଭାଜନ୍ତୁ, ତାପରେ ଛୁଙ୍କ ଦେଇ ପିଆଜ ଓ ଲଙ୍କା ନରମ କରନ୍ତୁ। ଲୁଣ ସହିତ ପାଣି ଫୁଟାଇ ସୁଜି ମିଶାନ୍ତୁ, ଘୋଡ଼ାନ୍ତୁ ଓ ଶେଷରେ କାଜୁ ପକାନ୍ତୁ।
seg.5ef4d1713249.back: Roast the semolina, fry the cashews in ghee, then temper and soften onion and chilli. Boil water with salt and mix in the semolina, cover, and at the end add the cashews.

seg.5f9c9ea52cc5.src: 1 cup bombay rava ⟦1⟧medium semolina (sooji), about 170 g⟦/1⟧
seg.5f9c9ea52cc5.t: 1 କପ ବମ୍ବେ ସୁଜି ⟦1⟧ମଧ୍ୟମ ଦାନା ସୁଜି, ପ୍ରାୟ 170 g⟦/1⟧
seg.5f9c9ea52cc5.back: 1 cup Bombay rava ⟦1⟧medium-grain semolina, about 170 g⟦/1⟧

seg.30102cb3f08b.src: 2½ cups water ⟦1⟧use 2 cups for a firmer upma⟦/1⟧
seg.30102cb3f08b.t: 2½ କପ ପାଣି ⟦1⟧ଟାଣ ଉପମା ପାଇଁ 2 କପ ନିଅନ୍ତୁ⟦/1⟧
seg.30102cb3f08b.back: 2½ cups water ⟦1⟧for a firm upma take 2 cups⟦/1⟧

seg.be0ebf4a6ec1.src: ¼ cup cashews ⟦1⟧whole or halved, about 35 g⟦/1⟧
seg.be0ebf4a6ec1.t: ¼ କପ କାଜୁ ⟦1⟧ଗୋଟା ବା ଅଧା, ପ୍ରାୟ 35 g⟦/1⟧
seg.be0ebf4a6ec1.back: ¼ cup cashews ⟦1⟧whole or halves, about 35 g⟦/1⟧

seg.0e1b40869004.src: 3 tbsp ghee ⟦1⟧or 2 tbsp oil plus 1 tbsp ghee⟦/1⟧
seg.0e1b40869004.t: 3 ଟେବୁଲ ଚାମଚ ଘିଅ ⟦1⟧କିମ୍ବା 2 ଟେବୁଲ ଚାମଚ ତେଲ ସହିତ 1 ଟେବୁଲ ଚାମଚ ଘିଅ⟦/1⟧
seg.0e1b40869004.back: 3 tablespoons ghee ⟦1⟧or 2 tablespoons oil with 1 tablespoon ghee⟦/1⟧

seg.07a870690b21.src: 2 green chillies ⟦1⟧slit; use 3 for a hotter upma⟦/1⟧
seg.07a870690b21.t: 2ଟି କଞ୍ଚା ଲଙ୍କା ⟦1⟧ଚିରା; ଅଧିକ ରାଗୁଆ ଉପମା ପାଇଁ 3ଟି⟦/1⟧
seg.07a870690b21.back: 2 green chillies ⟦1⟧slit; for a hotter upma 3⟦/1⟧

seg.5fe03b6066ae.src: Chop the onion, ginger and coriander leaves, slit the green chillies, and measure out the water.
seg.5fe03b6066ae.t: ପିଆଜ, ଅଦା ଓ ଧନିଆ ପତ୍ର କାଟନ୍ତୁ, କଞ୍ଚା ଲଙ୍କା ଚିରନ୍ତୁ, ଆଉ ପାଣି ମାପି ରଖନ୍ତୁ।
seg.5fe03b6066ae.back: Chop the onion, ginger and coriander leaves, slit the green chillies, and keep the water measured.

seg.015e5d6ef88c.src: Roast the rava in a dry pan till it smells toasty, about 5 minutes. Keep it pale. Stir all the time on medium-low heat, then tip it onto a plate.
seg.015e5d6ef88c.t: ଶୁଖିଲା ପ୍ୟାନରେ ସୁଜିକୁ ଭଜା ବାସନା ଆସିବା ଯାଏ ଭାଜନ୍ତୁ, ପ୍ରାୟ 5 ମିନିଟ। ରଙ୍ଗ ଫିକା ରଖନ୍ତୁ। ମଧ୍ୟମରୁ କମ୍ ନିଆଁରେ ସବୁବେଳେ ଘାଣ୍ଟନ୍ତୁ, ତାପରେ ଏକ ଥାଳିରେ ଢାଳି ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ।
seg.015e5d6ef88c.back: Roast the semolina in a dry pan until a roasted aroma comes, about 5 minutes. Keep the colour pale. Stir all the time on medium-to-low flame, then pour it out onto a plate.

seg.2ccb9bbfe373.src: Heat the ghee in a wide, heavy pan on medium-low heat.
seg.2ccb9bbfe373.t: ଏକ ଚଉଡ଼ା, ମୋଟା ପ୍ୟାନରେ ମଧ୍ୟମରୁ କମ୍ ନିଆଁରେ ଘିଅ ଗରମ କରନ୍ତୁ।
seg.2ccb9bbfe373.back: Heat ghee in a wide, thick pan on medium-to-low flame.

seg.827cce77ebf1.src: Fry the cashews in the ghee till golden; lift them out. This takes about 1–2 minutes; keep the ghee in the pan.
seg.827cce77ebf1.t: କାଜୁକୁ ଘିଅରେ ସୁନେଲି ହେବା ଯାଏ ଭାଜନ୍ତୁ; ଉଠାଇ ନିଅନ୍ତୁ। ଏଥିରେ ପ୍ରାୟ 1–2 ମିନିଟ ଲାଗେ; ଘିଅ ପ୍ୟାନରେ ରଖନ୍ତୁ।
seg.827cce77ebf1.back: Fry the cashews in the ghee until golden; lift them out. This takes about 1–2 minutes; keep the ghee in the pan.

seg.57b61920de4c.src: Temper mustard, dals and curry leaves. Soften the onion and chillies, add water and salt, and boil. Let the mustard seeds splutter and the dals turn light golden before the curry leaves go in, then add the ginger with the onion and cook for 3–4 minutes till the onion is soft.
seg.57b61920de4c.t: ସୋରିଷ, ଡାଲି ଓ ଭୃସଙ୍ଗ ପତ୍ରର ଛୁଙ୍କ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ। ପିଆଜ ଓ ଲଙ୍କା ନରମ କରି ପାଣି ଓ ଲୁଣ ପକାଇ ଫୁଟାନ୍ତୁ। ଭୃସଙ୍ଗ ପତ୍ର ପକାଇବା ଆଗରୁ ସୋରିଷ ଫୁଟିବାକୁ ଓ ଡାଲି ହାଲୁକା ସୁନେଲି ହେବାକୁ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ, ତାପରେ ପିଆଜ ସହିତ ଅଦା ପକାଇ ପିଆଜ ନରମ ହେବା ଯାଏ 3–4 ମିନିଟ ରାନ୍ଧନ୍ତୁ।
seg.57b61920de4c.back: Give a tempering of mustard, dal and curry leaves. Soften the onion and chilli, add water and salt and boil. Let the mustard splutter and the dal turn light golden before adding curry leaves, then add ginger with the onion and cook 3–4 minutes until the onion is soft.

seg.be01d433ae80.src: Taste the water once it boils; it should taste a little salty, as the rava will take up the salt.
seg.be01d433ae80.t: ପାଣି ଫୁଟିଲେ ଚାଖନ୍ତୁ; ଏହା ଟିକିଏ ଲୁଣିଆ ଲାଗିବା ଉଚିତ, କାରଣ ସୁଜି ଲୁଣ ଟାଣିନେବ।
seg.be01d433ae80.back: When the water boils taste it; it should taste a little salty, because the semolina will draw in the salt.

seg.b99b11495ead.src: Turn the heat to low. Pour in the rava in a thin stream, stirring. Cover on low for 3 minutes; top with the cashews.
seg.b99b11495ead.t: ନିଆଁ ଧିମା କରନ୍ତୁ। ଘାଣ୍ଟୁ ଘାଣ୍ଟୁ ସରୁ ଧାରରେ ସୁଜି ଢାଳନ୍ତୁ। ଘୋଡ଼ାଇ ଧିମା ନିଆଁରେ 3 ମିନିଟ ରଖନ୍ତୁ; ଉପରେ କାଜୁ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ।
seg.b99b11495ead.back: Lower the flame. Stirring and stirring, pour in the semolina in a thin stream. Cover and keep 3 minutes on low flame; put the cashews on top.

seg.fbf1f55f7751.src: Before adding the cashews, check the upma: the rava should be soft with no hard grains, and the upma should leave the sides of the pan. If it is still grainy, sprinkle in 2 tbsp hot water, cover and cook 1 minute more.
seg.fbf1f55f7751.t: କାଜୁ ପକାଇବା ଆଗରୁ ଉପମା ଦେଖନ୍ତୁ: ସୁଜି ନରମ ହୋଇ କୌଣସି ଟାଣ ଦାନା ନ ଥିବା ଉଚିତ, ଆଉ ଉପମା ପ୍ୟାନର କଡ଼ ଛାଡ଼ିବା ଉଚିତ। ଏବେ ବି ଦାନାଦାର ଥିଲେ 2 ଟେବୁଲ ଚାମଚ ଗରମ ପାଣି ଛିଞ୍ଚି, ଘୋଡ଼ାଇ ଆଉ 1 ମିନିଟ ରାନ୍ଧନ୍ତୁ।
seg.fbf1f55f7751.back: Check the upma before adding the cashews: the semolina should be soft with no hard grains, and the upma should leave the sides of the pan. If still grainy sprinkle 2 tablespoons hot water, cover and cook 1 more minute.

seg.28e90add4ba6.src: Stir in the extra spoon of ghee and the coriander leaves, if using, along with most of the cashews.
seg.28e90add4ba6.t: ଅଧିକ ଚାମଚେ ଘିଅ ଓ ବ୍ୟବହାର କରୁଥିଲେ ଧନିଆ ପତ୍ର, ଅଧିକାଂଶ କାଜୁ ସହିତ ମିଶାନ୍ତୁ।
seg.28e90add4ba6.back: Mix in the extra spoon of ghee and the coriander leaves if using, together with most of the cashews.

seg.351e9512c914.src: Serve hot, with the rest of the cashews on top.
seg.351e9512c914.t: ବାକି କାଜୁ ଉପରେ ଦେଇ ଗରମ ଗରମ ପରଷନ୍ତୁ।
seg.351e9512c914.back: Put the remaining cashews on top and serve piping hot.

seg.4643e12d303d.src: Pour the rava in a thin stream while stirring so no lumps form.
seg.4643e12d303d.t: ଗୁଣ୍ଡା ନ ବାନ୍ଧିବା ପାଇଁ ଘାଣ୍ଟୁ ଘାଣ୍ଟୁ ସରୁ ଧାରରେ ସୁଜି ଢାଳନ୍ତୁ।
seg.4643e12d303d.back: To avoid lumps pour in the semolina in a thin stream while stirring.

seg.3c98bb62770b.src: Roasting the rava first keeps each grain separate; skip it and the upma turns sticky.
seg.3c98bb62770b.t: ପ୍ରଥମେ ସୁଜି ଭାଜିଲେ ପ୍ରତ୍ୟେକ ଦାନା ଅଲଗା ରହେ; ନ ଭାଜିଲେ ଉପମା ଅଠାଳିଆ ହୋଇଯାଏ।
seg.3c98bb62770b.back: Roasting the semolina first keeps every grain separate; if not roasted the upma becomes sticky.

seg.fc5bc0e0bf4e.src: Fry the cashews on medium-low heat and lift them out as soon as they turn golden; they keep darkening in the hot ghee.
seg.fc5bc0e0bf4e.t: କାଜୁକୁ ମଧ୍ୟମରୁ କମ୍ ନିଆଁରେ ଭାଜନ୍ତୁ ଓ ସୁନେଲି ହେବା ମାତ୍ରେ ଉଠାଇ ନିଅନ୍ତୁ; ଗରମ ଘିଅରେ ଏଗୁଡ଼ିକ ଗାଢ଼ ହେଉଥାଏ।
seg.fc5bc0e0bf4e.back: Fry the cashews on medium-to-low flame and lift them out as soon as they turn golden; in hot ghee they keep darkening.

seg.975560a8a158.src: Upma firms up as it stands, so take it off the heat when it is a little softer than you want.
seg.975560a8a158.t: ଉପମା ରହିଲେ ଟାଣ ହୁଏ, ତେଣୁ ଆପଣ ଚାହୁଁଥିବାଠୁ ଟିକିଏ ନରମ ଥାଉ ଥାଉ ନିଆଁରୁ ଓହ୍ଲାନ୍ତୁ।
seg.975560a8a158.back: Upma becomes firm as it stands, so take it off the flame while it is a little softer than you want.

seg.508f0ab3992d.src: Vegetable upma: add ½ cup chopped carrot, beans and green peas with the onion and cook them for 3–4 minutes before the water goes in.
seg.508f0ab3992d.t: ପରିବା ଉପମା: ପିଆଜ ସହିତ ½ କପ କଟା ଗାଜର, ବିନ୍ସ ଓ ମଟର ପକାନ୍ତୁ ଓ ପାଣି ପକାଇବା ଆଗରୁ 3–4 ମିନିଟ ରାନ୍ଧନ୍ତୁ।
seg.508f0ab3992d.back: Vegetable upma: add ½ cup chopped carrot, beans and peas with the onion and cook 3–4 minutes before adding water.

seg.1742d7bd0e23.src: Tomato upma: add 1 chopped tomato after the onion and cook till soft before adding the water.
seg.1742d7bd0e23.t: ଟମାଟା ଉପମା: ପିଆଜ ପରେ 1ଟି କଟା ଟମାଟା ପକାଇ ପାଣି ପକାଇବା ଆଗରୁ ନରମ ହେବା ଯାଏ ରାନ୍ଧନ୍ତୁ।
seg.1742d7bd0e23.back: Tomato upma: after the onion add 1 chopped tomato and cook until soft before adding water.

seg.1981c7f3fc60.src: Godhuma rava upma: use the same amount of wheat rava with 3 cups water and cook it covered for 5–6 minutes.
seg.1981c7f3fc60.t: ଗୋଧୁମ ରବା ଉପମା: ସେତିକି ପରିମାଣର ଗହମ ସୁଜି 3 କପ ପାଣି ସହିତ ନେଇ ଘୋଡ଼ାଇ 5–6 ମିନିଟ ରାନ୍ଧନ୍ତୁ।
seg.1981c7f3fc60.back: Godhuma rava upma: take the same amount of wheat semolina with 3 cups water and cook covered 5–6 minutes.

seg.01300d94ad36.src: Serve hot as a breakfast tiffin with coconut chutney, allam pachadi or a spoon of sugar, or next to pesarattu for pesarattu upma.
seg.01300d94ad36.t: ସକାଳ ଜଳଖିଆ ଭାବେ ନଡ଼ିଆ ଚଟଣି, ଅଲ୍ଲମ ପଚ୍ଚଡ଼ି (ଅଦା ଚଟଣି) ବା ଚାମଚେ ଚିନି ସହିତ, କିମ୍ବା ପେସରଟ୍ଟୁ ଉପମା ପାଇଁ ପେସରଟ୍ଟୁ ପାଖରେ ଗରମ ଗରମ ପରଷନ୍ତୁ।
seg.01300d94ad36.back: As a morning breakfast serve piping hot with coconut chutney, allam pachadi (ginger chutney) or a spoon of sugar, or for pesarattu upma beside pesarattu.

seg.3316a3d82f44.src: Upma is best eaten hot, soon after it is made. Keep leftovers covered in the fridge for up to 1 day and sprinkle with water before reheating.
seg.3316a3d82f44.t: ଉପମା ତିଆରି ହେବା ପରେ ଶୀଘ୍ର ଗରମ ଗରମ ଖାଇବା ସବୁଠୁ ଭଲ। ବଳକା ଘୋଡ଼ାଇ ଫ୍ରିଜରେ 1 ଦିନ ପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ ରଖନ୍ତୁ ଓ ପୁଣି ଗରମ କରିବା ଆଗରୁ ପାଣି ଛିଞ୍ଚନ୍ତୁ।
seg.3316a3d82f44.back: Upma is best eaten piping hot soon after it is made. Keep leftovers covered in the fridge up to 1 day and sprinkle water before reheating.

seg.b53646711bf0.src: How do I make upma without lumps?
seg.b53646711bf0.t: ଗୁଣ୍ଡା ନ ବାନ୍ଧି ଉପମା କିପରି ତିଆରି କରିବି?
seg.b53646711bf0.back: How do I make upma without lumps?

seg.429b54b4ab3a.src: Keep the water at a boil, turn the heat to low and pour in the rava in a thin stream with one hand while you stir with the other.
seg.429b54b4ab3a.t: ପାଣିକୁ ଫୁଟୁଥିବା ଅବସ୍ଥାରେ ରଖନ୍ତୁ, ନିଆଁ ଧିମା କରନ୍ତୁ, ଆଉ ଗୋଟିଏ ହାତରେ ସରୁ ଧାରରେ ସୁଜି ଢାଳୁ ଢାଳୁ ଅନ୍ୟ ହାତରେ ଘାଣ୍ଟନ୍ତୁ।
seg.429b54b4ab3a.back: Keep the water at a boil, lower the flame, and with one hand pour the semolina in a thin stream while stirring with the other hand.

seg.0c2874233201.src: What is the right rava to water ratio for upma?
seg.0c2874233201.t: ଉପମା ପାଇଁ ସୁଜି ଓ ପାଣିର ଠିକ ଅନୁପାତ କଣ?
seg.0c2874233201.back: What is the right ratio of semolina and water for upma?

seg.91a8fe1a38a5.src: For a soft Andhra-style upma, use 2½ cups water to 1 cup bombay rava. Use 2 cups for a firmer, more separate upma.
seg.91a8fe1a38a5.t: ନରମ ଆନ୍ଧ୍ର ଶୈଳୀର ଉପମା ପାଇଁ 1 କପ ବମ୍ବେ ସୁଜିରେ 2½ କପ ପାଣି ନିଅନ୍ତୁ। ଟାଣ ଓ ଅଧିକ ଝରଝର ଉପମା ପାଇଁ 2 କପ ନିଅନ୍ତୁ।
seg.91a8fe1a38a5.back: For soft Andhra-style upma take 2½ cups water to 1 cup Bombay rava. For a firm and more separate-grained upma take 2 cups.

seg.bd11a83d27d8.src: The rava was not roasted, or too much water went in. Roast the rava till it smells toasty, and stay close to 2½ cups water per cup.
seg.bd11a83d27d8.t: ସୁଜି ଭଜା ହୋଇ ନ ଥିଲା, କିମ୍ବା ବହୁତ ବେଶି ପାଣି ପଡ଼ିଗଲା। ସୁଜିକୁ ଭଜା ବାସନା ଆସିବା ଯାଏ ଭାଜନ୍ତୁ, ଆଉ ପ୍ରତି କପରେ ପ୍ରାୟ 2½ କପ ପାଣି ରଖନ୍ତୁ।
seg.bd11a83d27d8.back: The semolina was not roasted, or too much water went in. Roast the semolina until a roasted aroma comes, and keep about 2½ cups water per cup.

seg.247181e411d9.src: When should I add cashews to upma?
seg.247181e411d9.back: When should I add the cashews to upma?

seg.83f262d9c56e.src: Fry them in the ghee first and lift them out, then stir them in at the end. Added early, they turn soft in the upma.
seg.83f262d9c56e.t: ପ୍ରଥମେ ଘିଅରେ ଭାଜି ଉଠାଇ ନିଅନ୍ତୁ, ତାପରେ ଶେଷରେ ମିଶାନ୍ତୁ। ଆଗରୁ ପକାଇଲେ ଉପମାରେ ନରମ ହୋଇଯାଏ।
seg.83f262d9c56e.back: First fry in ghee and lift out, then mix in at the end. If added earlier they go soft in the upma.

seg.8b57b24af158.src: జీడిపప్పు ఉప్మా. Andhra rava upma with Jeedipappu cashews fried golden in ghee, a soft and quick morning tiffin. Step-by-step method, tips and FAQs. Serves 3.
seg.8b57b24af158.t: జీడిపప్పు ఉప్మా. ଘିଅରେ ସୁନେଲି କରି ଭଜା ଜୀଡିପପ୍ପୁ କାଜୁ ସହିତ ଆନ୍ଧ୍ରର ସୁଜି ଉପମା, ନରମ ଓ ଶୀଘ୍ର ତିଆରି ହେଉଥିବା ସକାଳ ଜଳଖିଆ। ଧାପେ ଧାପେ ପ୍ରଣାଳୀ, ଟିପ୍ସ ଓ ପ୍ରଶ୍ନୋତ୍ତର। 3 ଜଣଙ୍କ ପାଇଁ।
seg.8b57b24af158.back: జీడిపప్పు ఉప్మా. Andhra semolina upma with Jeedipappu cashews fried golden in ghee, a soft and quickly made morning breakfast. Step-by-step method, tips and Q&A. For 3 people.

seg.661f01591624.src: Jeedipappu Upma: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.661f01591624.t: ଜୀଡିପପ୍ପୁ ଉପମା: 1acrefarmsର ରେସିପି କାର୍ଡ, ଉପକରଣ ଓ ପ୍ରଣାଳୀ ସହିତ
seg.661f01591624.back: Jeedipappu Upma: 1acrefarms recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.992a8475993f.src: Kodi vepudu is the dry Andhra chicken fry: small pieces of chicken cooked in their own juices, then fried hard in oil with curry leaves, green chillies and a just-roasted masala until dark and sticky with spice. It is the starter at Andhra weddings and the side that sits next to rasam rice or pappu at home.
seg.992a8475993f.t: କୋଡି ଭେପୁଡୁ ହେଉଛି ଶୁଖିଲା ଆନ୍ଧ୍ର ଚିକେନ ଭଜା: ଛୋଟ ଛୋଟ ଚିକେନ ଖଣ୍ଡକୁ ନିଜ ରସରେ ସିଝାଇ, ତାପରେ ଭୃସଙ୍ଗ ପତ୍ର, କଞ୍ଚା ଲଙ୍କା ଓ ସଦ୍ୟ ଭଜା ମସଲା ସହିତ ତେଲରେ କଡ଼ା କରି ଭଜାଯାଏ, ଯେପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ ଗାଢ଼ ରଙ୍ଗ ହୋଇ ମସଲା ଲାଖି ନ ଯାଏ। ଏହା ଆନ୍ଧ୍ର ବିବାହରେ ପ୍ରଥମ ଖାଦ୍ୟ (ଷ୍ଟାର୍ଟର), ଆଉ ଘରେ ରସମ ଭାତ ବା ପପ୍ପୁ ପାଖରେ ରହୁଥିବା ପାଖ ଖାଦ୍ୟ।
seg.992a8475993f.back: Kodi vepudu is the dry Andhra chicken fry: small chicken pieces are cooked in their own juices, then fried hard in oil with curry leaves, green chilli and freshly roasted masala, until they turn dark coloured and the masala clings. It is the first dish (starter) at Andhra weddings, and at home a side dish kept beside rasam rice or pappu.

seg.db90598234ea.src: Our Teja chilli powder gives it the deep red colour and the heat Andhra fries are known for, our turmeric powder goes into the marinade, and our whole cashew kernels, fried golden, go in at the end. Serves 4 as a side.
seg.db90598234ea.t: ଆମ ତେଜା ଲଙ୍କା ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ଏହାକୁ ଗାଢ଼ ଲାଲ ରଙ୍ଗ ଓ ଆନ୍ଧ୍ର ଭଜା ପାଇଁ ଜଣାଶୁଣା ରାଗ ଦିଏ, ଆମ ହଳଦୀ ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ମାରିନେଡରେ ପଡ଼େ, ଆଉ ଆମ ଗୋଟା କାଜୁ ସୁନେଲି କରି ଭଜା ହୋଇ ଶେଷରେ ପଡ଼େ। ପାଖ ଖାଦ୍ୟ ଭାବେ 4 ଜଣଙ୍କ ପାଇଁ।
seg.db90598234ea.back: Our Teja chilli powder gives it a deep red colour and the heat Andhra fries are known for, our turmeric powder goes into the marinade, and our whole cashews are fried golden and go in at the end. As a side dish for 4 people.

seg.22b3994cc48a.src: Marinate chicken in Teja chilli powder, turmeric powder, ginger-garlic paste and lemon, cook it in its own juices, then fry it dry with curry leaves, green chillies, a roasted masala and cashews.
seg.22b3994cc48a.t: ଚିକେନକୁ ତେଜା ଲଙ୍କା ଗୁଣ୍ଡ, ହଳଦୀ ଗୁଣ୍ଡ, ଅଦା-ରସୁଣ ବଟା ଓ ଲେମ୍ବୁରେ ମାରିନେଟ କରନ୍ତୁ, ନିଜ ରସରେ ସିଝାନ୍ତୁ, ତାପରେ ଭୃସଙ୍ଗ ପତ୍ର, କଞ୍ଚା ଲଙ୍କା, ଭଜା ମସଲା ଓ କାଜୁ ସହିତ ଶୁଖିଲା କରି ଭାଜନ୍ତୁ।
seg.22b3994cc48a.back: Marinate the chicken in Teja chilli powder, turmeric powder, ginger-garlic paste and lemon, cook in its own juices, then fry dry with curry leaves, green chilli, roasted masala and cashews.

seg.4cb33a348eb8.src: 500 g boneless chicken ⟦1⟧cut into 1-inch pieces; or 600 g small bone-in pieces⟦/1⟧
seg.4cb33a348eb8.t: 500 g ହାଡ଼ ବିନା ଚିକେନ ⟦1⟧1 ଇଞ୍ଚ ଖଣ୍ଡ କରି କଟା; କିମ୍ବା 600 g ହାଡ଼ ସହିତ ଛୋଟ ଖଣ୍ଡ⟦/1⟧
seg.4cb33a348eb8.back: 500 g boneless chicken ⟦1⟧cut into 1 inch pieces; or 600 g bone-in small pieces⟦/1⟧

seg.57789012bc80.src: 15 cashews ⟦1⟧whole cashew kernels; halve any large ones⟦/1⟧
seg.57789012bc80.t: 15ଟି କାଜୁ ⟦1⟧ଗୋଟା କାଜୁ; ବଡ଼ ଥିଲେ ଅଧା କରନ୍ତୁ⟦/1⟧
seg.57789012bc80.back: 15 cashews ⟦1⟧whole cashews; if large halve them⟦/1⟧

seg.8df3bc4567e3.src: Pat the chicken dry with a cloth so the marinade sticks.
seg.8df3bc4567e3.t: ମାରିନେଡ ଲାଗିବା ପାଇଁ ଚିକେନକୁ କପଡ଼ାରେ ପୋଛି ଶୁଖାନ୍ତୁ।
seg.8df3bc4567e3.back: Pat the chicken dry with a cloth so the marinade sticks.

seg.075327f4deca.src: Marinate the chicken in Teja chilli powder, turmeric, ginger-garlic paste, lemon juice and salt, 30 minutes. Mix well with your hands so every piece is coated.
seg.075327f4deca.t: ଚିକେନକୁ ତେଜା ଲଙ୍କା ଗୁଣ୍ଡ, ହଳଦୀ, ଅଦା-ରସୁଣ ବଟା, ଲେମ୍ବୁ ରସ ଓ ଲୁଣରେ 30 ମିନିଟ ମାରିନେଟ କରନ୍ତୁ। ହାତରେ ଭଲ କରି ମିଶାନ୍ତୁ ଯେପରି ପ୍ରତ୍ୟେକ ଖଣ୍ଡରେ ଲାଗେ।
seg.075327f4deca.back: Marinate the chicken 30 minutes in Teja chilli powder, turmeric, ginger-garlic paste, lemon juice and salt. Mix well by hand so it coats every piece.

seg.63af904bba96.src: Meanwhile, dry-roast the coriander seeds, cumin seeds, fennel seeds, cloves and cinnamon in a small pan on low heat until fragrant and a shade darker, about 2 minutes. Cool and grind to a coarse powder. This is the fry masala.
seg.63af904bba96.t: ଏହି ସମୟରେ ଏକ ଛୋଟ ପ୍ୟାନରେ ଧିମା ନିଆଁରେ ଧନିଆ, ଜିରା, ପାନମଧୁରୀ, ଲବଙ୍ଗ ଓ ଦାଲଚିନିକୁ ତେଲ ବିନା ବାସନା ଆସି ଏକ ଛାଇ ଗାଢ଼ ହେବା ଯାଏ ଭାଜନ୍ତୁ, ପ୍ରାୟ 2 ମିନିଟ। ଥଣ୍ଡା କରି ଦରଦରା ଗୁଣ୍ଡ କରନ୍ତୁ। ଏହା ହେଉଛି ଭଜା ମସଲା।
seg.63af904bba96.back: Meanwhile in a small pan on low flame dry-roast coriander seeds, cumin, fennel, cloves and cinnamon without oil until aromatic and one shade darker, about 2 minutes. Cool and grind to a coarse powder. This is the roasted masala.

seg.4406ac2e72fe.src: Put the chicken in a heavy kadai with no water, cover and set it on medium heat.
seg.4406ac2e72fe.t: ଚିକେନକୁ ପାଣି ବିନା ଏକ ମୋଟା କଡ଼ାଇରେ ରଖି, ଘୋଡ଼ାଇ ମଧ୍ୟମ ନିଆଁରେ ବସାନ୍ତୁ।
seg.4406ac2e72fe.back: Put the chicken without water in a thick kadai, cover and set on medium flame.

seg.93ccca0c5178.src: Cook it covered in its own juices till no pink remains, about 12 minutes. Stir once or twice; the chicken releases water as it cooks.
seg.93ccca0c5178.t: ଘୋଡ଼ାଇ ନିଜ ରସରେ କୌଣସି ଗୋଲାପି ଅଂଶ ନ ରହିବା ଯାଏ ରାନ୍ଧନ୍ତୁ, ପ୍ରାୟ 12 ମିନିଟ। ଥରେ ଦୁଇଥର ଘାଣ୍ଟନ୍ତୁ; ସିଝିବା ବେଳେ ଚିକେନରୁ ପାଣି ବାହାରେ।
seg.93ccca0c5178.back: Cook covered in its own juices until no pink part remains, about 12 minutes. Stir once or twice; water comes out of the chicken as it cooks.

seg.32f3a3f56679.src: Uncover and cook on high, stirring, until the liquid has almost dried up, 3–4 minutes. Tip the chicken out onto a plate and wipe the kadai.
seg.32f3a3f56679.t: ଖୋଲି ତେଜ ନିଆଁରେ ଘାଣ୍ଟି ଘାଣ୍ଟି ରାନ୍ଧନ୍ତୁ, ଯେପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ ରସ ପ୍ରାୟ ଶୁଖି ନ ଯାଏ, 3–4 ମିନିଟ। ଚିକେନକୁ ଏକ ଥାଳିରେ ଢାଳି କଡ଼ାଇ ପୋଛି ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ।
seg.32f3a3f56679.back: Uncover and cook on high flame stirring and stirring, until the juices have almost dried, 3–4 minutes. Tip the chicken onto a plate and wipe the kadai.

seg.f3e846aa4edd.src: Heat the oil in the kadai on medium heat.
seg.f3e846aa4edd.t: କଡ଼ାଇରେ ମଧ୍ୟମ ନିଆଁରେ ତେଲ ଗରମ କରନ୍ତୁ।
seg.f3e846aa4edd.back: Heat oil in the kadai on medium flame.

seg.e210c9534a07.src: Fry the cashews in oil till golden; lift out. They take under a minute, so stir them all the time and lift them out with a slotted spoon.
seg.e210c9534a07.t: କାଜୁକୁ ତେଲରେ ସୁନେଲି ହେବା ଯାଏ ଭାଜନ୍ତୁ; ଉଠାଇ ନିଅନ୍ତୁ। ଏଥିରେ ଏକ ମିନିଟରୁ କମ୍ ଲାଗେ, ତେଣୁ ସବୁବେଳେ ଘାଣ୍ଟନ୍ତୁ ଓ ଛିଦ୍ର ଥିବା ଚାମଚରେ ଉଠାନ୍ତୁ।
seg.e210c9534a07.back: Fry the cashews in the oil until golden; lift out. This takes less than a minute, so stir all the time and lift out with a slotted spoon.

seg.09e282d2e36f.src: Add the onion, if using, and fry until golden. Fry the green chillies and curry leaves. Stand back; the leaves crackle and spit.
seg.09e282d2e36f.t: ବ୍ୟବହାର କରୁଥିଲେ ପିଆଜ ପକାଇ ସୁନେଲି ହେବା ଯାଏ ଭାଜନ୍ତୁ। କଞ୍ଚା ଲଙ୍କା ଓ ଭୃସଙ୍ଗ ପତ୍ର ଭାଜନ୍ତୁ। ଟିକିଏ ଦୂରରେ ଠିଆ ହୁଅନ୍ତୁ; ପତ୍ର ଫୁଟି ତେଲ ଛିଟିକେ।
seg.09e282d2e36f.back: If using, add the onion and fry until golden. Fry the green chillies and curry leaves. Stand a little back; the leaves splutter and the oil spatters.

seg.1fae224eb27a.src: Add the chicken and fry masala. Fry on high till dry and dark, then toss in the cashews. Keep tossing for 6–8 minutes, until the masala clings to the pieces and the edges turn dark and crisp.
seg.1fae224eb27a.t: ଚିକେନ ଓ ଭଜା ମସଲା ପକାନ୍ତୁ। ତେଜ ନିଆଁରେ ଶୁଖିଲା ଓ ଗାଢ଼ ହେବା ଯାଏ ଭାଜନ୍ତୁ, ତାପରେ କାଜୁ ମିଶାନ୍ତୁ। 6–8 ମିନିଟ ଓଲଟାଉ ଥାଆନ୍ତୁ, ଯେପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ ମସଲା ଖଣ୍ଡରେ ଲାଖି ଯାଇ କଡ଼ ଗାଢ଼ ଓ କୁରକୁରିଆ ନ ହୁଏ।
seg.1fae224eb27a.back: Add the chicken and roasted masala. Fry on high flame until dry and dark, then mix in the cashews. Keep turning 6–8 minutes, until the masala clings to the pieces and the edges become dark and crunchy.

seg.0b62f402945c.src: Taste, add salt if needed, scatter the coriander leaves and serve hot.
seg.0b62f402945c.t: ଚାଖି ଦରକାର ହେଲେ ଲୁଣ ପକାନ୍ତୁ, ଧନିଆ ପତ୍ର ଛିଞ୍ଚି ଗରମ ଗରମ ପରଷନ୍ତୁ।
seg.0b62f402945c.back: Taste and add salt if needed, sprinkle coriander leaves and serve piping hot.

seg.349c72ce839a.src: Fry it on high heat at the end so the masala clings to every piece.
seg.349c72ce839a.t: ଶେଷରେ ତେଜ ନିଆଁରେ ଭାଜନ୍ତୁ ଯେପରି ମସଲା ପ୍ରତ୍ୟେକ ଖଣ୍ଡରେ ଲାଖିଯାଏ।
seg.349c72ce839a.back: Fry on high flame at the end so the masala clings to every piece.

seg.d287ba2c2c11.src: Teja chilli powder is very hot. For medium heat use 1 tsp, or swap in Sannam chilli powder for the red colour with less fire.
seg.d287ba2c2c11.t: ତେଜା ଲଙ୍କା ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ବହୁତ ରାଗୁଆ। ମଧ୍ୟମ ରାଗ ପାଇଁ 1 ଚା ଚାମଚ ନିଅନ୍ତୁ, କିମ୍ବା ଲାଲ ରଙ୍ଗ ସହିତ କମ୍ ରାଗ ପାଇଁ ତା ବଦଳରେ ସନ୍ନମ ଲଙ୍କା ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ।
seg.d287ba2c2c11.back: Teja chilli powder is very hot. For medium heat take 1 teaspoon, or for less heat with red colour use Sannam chilli powder instead.

seg.a0ef9b138cd4.src: Cut the pieces small and even so they cook through at the same time and crisp up well in the fry.
seg.a0ef9b138cd4.t: ଖଣ୍ଡଗୁଡ଼ିକ ଛୋଟ ଓ ସମାନ କରି କାଟନ୍ତୁ ଯେପରି ଏକା ସମୟରେ ସିଝେ ଓ ଭାଜିବାରେ ଭଲ କୁରକୁରିଆ ହୁଏ।
seg.a0ef9b138cd4.back: Cut the pieces small and even so they cook in the same time and get nicely crunchy in the frying.

seg.d72b3c1c529a.src: Grind the fry masala just before you cook; the roasted spice smell is the soul of a good vepudu.
seg.d72b3c1c529a.t: ରାନ୍ଧିବା ଠିକ ଆଗରୁ ଭଜା ମସଲା ଗୁଣ୍ଡ କରନ୍ତୁ; ଭଜା ମସଲାର ବାସନା ହିଁ ଭଲ ଭେପୁଡୁର ପ୍ରାଣ।
