seg.d72b3c1c529a.back: Grind the roasted masala just before cooking; the aroma of the roasted masala is the soul of a good vepudu.

seg.62d6684e446e.src: Bone-in: use 600 g small bone-in pieces and cook them in their juices for 18–20 minutes, until no pink remains near the bone.
seg.62d6684e446e.t: ହାଡ଼ ସହିତ: 600 g ହାଡ଼ ସହିତ ଛୋଟ ଖଣ୍ଡ ନିଅନ୍ତୁ ଓ ନିଜ ରସରେ 18–20 ମିନିଟ ରାନ୍ଧନ୍ତୁ, ଯେପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ ହାଡ଼ ପାଖରେ କୌଣସି ଗୋଲାପି ଅଂଶ ନ ରହେ।
seg.62d6684e446e.back: Bone-in: take 600 g bone-in small pieces and cook in their own juices 18–20 minutes, until no pink part remains near the bone.

seg.6960fe7f3ff8.src: Kobbari vepudu: add 3 tbsp grated dry coconut to the fry with the masala and toss until it browns.
seg.6960fe7f3ff8.t: କୋବ୍ବରି ଭେପୁଡୁ: ମସଲା ସହିତ ଭଜାରେ 3 ଟେବୁଲ ଚାମଚ କୋରା ଶୁଖିଲା ନଡ଼ିଆ ପକାଇ ବାଦାମୀ ହେବା ଯାଏ ଓଲଟାନ୍ତୁ।
seg.6960fe7f3ff8.back: Kobbari vepudu: add 3 tablespoons grated dry coconut with the masala in the frying and turn until brown.

seg.afd92118eb80.src: Mutton vepudu: pressure-cook 500 g boneless mutton with the marinade and ½ cup water for 5–6 whistles, then fry it the same way.
seg.afd92118eb80.t: ମଟନ ଭେପୁଡୁ: 500 g ହାଡ଼ ବିନା ମଟନକୁ ମାରିନେଡ ଓ ½ କପ ପାଣି ସହିତ ପ୍ରେସର କୁକରରେ 5–6 ସିଟି ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ, ତାପରେ ସେହିପରି ଭାଜନ୍ତୁ।
seg.afd92118eb80.back: Mutton vepudu: give 500 g boneless mutton 5–6 whistles in a pressure cooker with the marinade and ½ cup water, then fry the same way.

seg.2c4ab1a1a5de.src: Serve hot as a side with rasam rice, pappu and rice or sambar rice, or on its own as a starter with sliced onion and lemon wedges.
seg.2c4ab1a1a5de.t: ରସମ ଭାତ, ପପ୍ପୁ ଭାତ ବା ସାମ୍ବର ଭାତ ସହିତ ପାଖ ଖାଦ୍ୟ ଭାବେ, କିମ୍ବା କଟା ପିଆଜ ଓ ଲେମ୍ବୁ ଖଣ୍ଡ ସହିତ ଏକା ଷ୍ଟାର୍ଟର ଭାବେ ଗରମ ଗରମ ପରଷନ୍ତୁ।
seg.2c4ab1a1a5de.back: Serve piping hot as a side with rasam rice, pappu rice or sambar rice, or alone as a starter with chopped onion and lemon wedges.

seg.b7598301bd86.src: Keep covered in the fridge for up to 2 days. Reheat in a hot pan with a few drops of oil until steaming hot all the way through; it crisps up again.
seg.b7598301bd86.t: ଘୋଡ଼ାଇ ଫ୍ରିଜରେ 2 ଦିନ ପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ ରଖନ୍ତୁ। ଗରମ ପ୍ୟାନରେ କିଛି ଟୋପା ତେଲ ସହିତ ଭିତର ଯାଏ ଭଲ ଭାବେ ଗରମ ହୋଇ ବାଷ୍ପ ବାହାରିବା ଯାଏ ପୁଣି ଗରମ କରନ୍ତୁ; ଏହା ପୁଣି କୁରକୁରିଆ ହୋଇଯାଏ।
seg.b7598301bd86.back: Keep covered in the fridge up to 2 days. Reheat in a hot pan with a few drops of oil until well heated through to the inside and steam comes out; it becomes crunchy again.

seg.551573b4b443.src: What is the difference between chicken fry and chicken curry in Andhra?
seg.551573b4b443.t: ଆନ୍ଧ୍ରରେ ଚିକେନ ଫ୍ରାଏ ଓ ଚିକେନ କରି ମଧ୍ୟରେ ଫରକ କଣ?
seg.551573b4b443.back: In Andhra what is the difference between chicken fry and chicken curry?

seg.dbeff7335e31.src: Vepudu is dry: the chicken is cooked in its own juices, then fried until the masala coats it with no gravy. Kodi kura is a curry with an onion-tomato gravy for rice.
seg.dbeff7335e31.t: ଭେପୁଡୁ ଶୁଖିଲା: ଚିକେନକୁ ନିଜ ରସରେ ସିଝାଇ, ତାପରେ ଗ୍ରେଭି ବିନା ମସଲା ଲାଖିବା ଯାଏ ଭଜାଯାଏ। କୋଡି କୂରା ହେଉଛି ଭାତ ପାଇଁ ପିଆଜ-ଟମାଟା ଗ୍ରେଭି ଥିବା ତରକାରି।
seg.dbeff7335e31.back: Vepudu is dry: the chicken is cooked in its own juices, then fried without gravy until the masala clings. Kodi koora is a curry with an onion-tomato gravy for rice.

seg.439aacfe8e34.src: Should I use boneless or bone-in chicken for vepudu?
seg.439aacfe8e34.t: ଭେପୁଡୁ ପାଇଁ ହାଡ଼ ବିନା ନା ହାଡ଼ ସହିତ ଚିକେନ ନେବି?
seg.439aacfe8e34.back: For vepudu should I take boneless or bone-in chicken?

seg.982f470b118d.src: Both work. Boneless cooks faster and crisps more; small bone-in pieces have more flavour but need about 8 minutes longer in their juices.
seg.982f470b118d.t: ଦୁହେଁ ଚଳେ। ହାଡ଼ ବିନା ଶୀଘ୍ର ସିଝେ ଓ ଅଧିକ କୁରକୁରିଆ ହୁଏ; ହାଡ଼ ସହିତ ଛୋଟ ଖଣ୍ଡରେ ଅଧିକ ସ୍ୱାଦ ଥାଏ କିନ୍ତୁ ନିଜ ରସରେ ପ୍ରାୟ 8 ମିନିଟ ଅଧିକ ଲାଗେ।
seg.982f470b118d.back: Both do. Boneless cooks quickly and becomes crunchier; bone-in small pieces have more flavour but take about 8 minutes more in their own juices.

seg.ade697e78f9b.src: Cut open the thickest piece. The chicken is cooked when no pink remains in the middle (or near the bone) and the juices run clear.
seg.ade697e78f9b.t: ସବୁଠୁ ମୋଟା ଖଣ୍ଡଟିକୁ କାଟି ଦେଖନ୍ତୁ। ମଝିରେ (କିମ୍ବା ହାଡ଼ ପାଖରେ) କୌଣସି ଗୋଲାପି ଅଂଶ ନ ରହିଲେ ଓ ରସ ସ୍ୱଚ୍ଛ ବାହାରିଲେ ଚିକେନ ସିଝିଯାଇଛି।
seg.ade697e78f9b.back: Cut and check the thickest piece. If no pink part remains in the middle (or near the bone) and the juice comes out clear, the chicken is cooked.

seg.eddd3046275b.src: How do I make kodi vepudu less spicy?
seg.eddd3046275b.t: କୋଡି ଭେପୁଡୁକୁ କିପରି କମ୍ ରାଗୁଆ କରିବି?
seg.eddd3046275b.back: How do I make kodi vepudu less hot?

seg.9b5459aec9d6.src: Use 1 tsp Teja chilli powder, or swap in Sannam chilli powder, and slit only 2 green chillies. The cashews and curry leaves keep the flavour full.
seg.9b5459aec9d6.t: 1 ଚା ଚାମଚ ତେଜା ଲଙ୍କା ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ନିଅନ୍ତୁ, କିମ୍ବା ତା ବଦଳରେ ସନ୍ନମ ଲଙ୍କା ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ, ଆଉ କେବଳ 2ଟି କଞ୍ଚା ଲଙ୍କା ଚିରନ୍ତୁ। କାଜୁ ଓ ଭୃସଙ୍ଗ ପତ୍ର ସ୍ୱାଦକୁ ଭରପୂର ରଖେ।
seg.9b5459aec9d6.back: Take 1 teaspoon Teja chilli powder, or use Sannam chilli powder instead, and slit only 2 green chillies. The cashews and curry leaves keep the flavour full.

seg.a00af5cf9954.src: కోడి వేపుడు · Kodi Vepudu (Andhra Chicken Fry) | 1acrefarms
seg.a00af5cf9954.t: కోడి వేపుడు · କୋଡି ଭେପୁଡୁ (ଆନ୍ଧ୍ର ଚିକେନ ଫ୍ରାଏ) | 1acrefarms
seg.a00af5cf9954.back: కోడి వేపుడు · Kodi Vepudu (Andhra Chicken Fry) | 1acrefarms

seg.1af4fbb646e3.src: కోడి వేపుడు. Andhra chicken fry: chicken in Teja chilli powder and turmeric powder, fried dry with curry leaves, green chillies, a roasted masala and our cashews.
seg.1af4fbb646e3.t: కోడి వేపుడు. ଆନ୍ଧ୍ର ଚିକେନ ଫ୍ରାଏ: ତେଜା ଲଙ୍କା ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ଓ ହଳଦୀ ଗୁଣ୍ଡରେ ଚିକେନ, ଭୃସଙ୍ଗ ପତ୍ର, କଞ୍ଚା ଲଙ୍କା, ଭଜା ମସଲା ଓ ଆମ କାଜୁ ସହିତ ଶୁଖିଲା କରି ଭଜା।
seg.1af4fbb646e3.back: కోడి వేపుడు. Andhra chicken fry: chicken in Teja chilli powder and turmeric powder, fried dry with curry leaves, green chilli, roasted masala and our cashews.

seg.917dba1166ab.src: Kodi Vepudu: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.917dba1166ab.t: କୋଡି ଭେପୁଡୁ: 1acrefarmsର ରେସିପି କାର୍ଡ, ଉପକରଣ ଓ ପ୍ରଣାଳୀ ସହିତ
seg.917dba1166ab.back: Kodi Vepudu: 1acrefarms recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.f9771e2222df.src: Nimmakaya pulihora is the bright yellow lemon rice of Andhra homes: cooked rice tossed with a crackling tempering of peanuts, chana dal, urad dal, mustard seeds, green chillies and curry leaves, then soured with lemon juice. It is the rice packed for train journeys, school tiffin boxes and temple days, and it is made in big batches for festivals and pujas.
seg.f9771e2222df.t: ନିମ୍ମକାୟ ପୁଳିହୋରା ହେଉଛି ଆନ୍ଧ୍ରର ଘରର ଉଜ୍ଜ୍ୱଳ ହଳଦିଆ ଲେମ୍ବୁ ଭାତ: ସିଝା ଭାତକୁ ଚିନାବାଦାମ, ବୁଟ ଡାଲି, ବିରି ଡାଲି, ସୋରିଷ, କଞ୍ଚା ଲଙ୍କା ଓ ଭୃସଙ୍ଗ ପତ୍ରର ଛଣଛଣିଆ ଛୁଙ୍କ ସହିତ ମିଶାଇ, ତାପରେ ଲେମ୍ବୁ ରସରେ ଖଟା କରାଯାଏ। ଏହା ଟ୍ରେନ ଯାତ୍ରା, ସ୍କୁଲ ଟିଫିନ ବାକ୍ସ ଓ ମନ୍ଦିର ଦିନ ପାଇଁ ବନ୍ଧା ହେଉଥିବା ଭାତ, ଆଉ ପର୍ବ ଓ ପୂଜା ପାଇଁ ବଡ଼ ପରିମାଣରେ ତିଆରି ହୁଏ।
seg.f9771e2222df.back: Nimmakaya pulihora is the bright yellow lemon rice of Andhra homes: cooked rice is mixed with a sizzling tempering of peanuts, chana dal, urad dal, mustard, green chilli and curry leaves, then soured with lemon juice. It is the rice packed for train journeys, school tiffin boxes and temple days, and it is made in large quantities for festivals and puja.

seg.ac569e0882d5.src: Our turmeric powder goes into the hot oil for a few seconds, which turns every grain an even golden yellow and takes away its raw edge. This recipe serves 4.
seg.ac569e0882d5.t: ଆମ ହଳଦୀ ଗୁଣ୍ଡ କିଛି ସେକେଣ୍ଡ ପାଇଁ ଗରମ ତେଲରେ ପଡ଼େ, ଯାହା ପ୍ରତ୍ୟେକ ଦାନାକୁ ସମାନ ସୁନେଲି ହଳଦିଆ କରେ ଓ ତାର କଞ୍ଚା ଭାବ ଦୂର କରେ। ଏହି ରେସିପି 4 ଜଣଙ୍କ ପାଇଁ।
seg.ac569e0882d5.back: Our turmeric powder goes into the hot oil for a few seconds, which makes every grain an even golden yellow and removes its raw taste. This recipe is for 4 people.

seg.d194bee0cc5e.src: Total includes cooking the rice and a 15-minute rest so the flavours settle.
seg.d194bee0cc5e.t: ମୋଟ ସମୟରେ ଭାତ ରାନ୍ଧିବା ଓ ସ୍ୱାଦ ଥିର ହେବା ପାଇଁ 15 ମିନିଟ ରଖିବା ମଧ୍ୟ ଅଛି।
seg.d194bee0cc5e.back: The total time also includes cooking the rice and resting 15 minutes for the flavour to settle.

seg.1cfa4342f462.src: Fry peanuts, dals, mustard seeds, chillies and curry leaves in oil, add turmeric powder and hing, then toss with cooled rice, salt and lemon juice.
seg.1cfa4342f462.t: ଚିନାବାଦାମ, ଡାଲି, ସୋରିଷ, ଲଙ୍କା ଓ ଭୃସଙ୍ଗ ପତ୍ରକୁ ତେଲରେ ଭାଜନ୍ତୁ, ହଳଦୀ ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ଓ ହେଙ୍ଗୁ ପକାନ୍ତୁ, ତାପରେ ଥଣ୍ଡା ଭାତ, ଲୁଣ ଓ ଲେମ୍ବୁ ରସ ସହିତ ମିଶାନ୍ତୁ।
seg.1cfa4342f462.back: Fry peanuts, dal, mustard, chilli and curry leaves in oil, add turmeric powder and asafoetida, then mix with cooled rice, salt and lemon juice.

seg.2561142fed2c.src: 1 cup rice ⟦1⟧sona masoori, about 200 g; gives about 3 cups cooked⟦/1⟧
seg.2561142fed2c.t: 1 କପ ଚାଉଳ ⟦1⟧ସୋନା ମସୂରୀ, ପ୍ରାୟ 200 g; ପ୍ରାୟ 3 କପ ଭାତ ହୁଏ⟦/1⟧
seg.2561142fed2c.back: 1 cup rice ⟦1⟧Sona Masuri, about 200 g; makes about 3 cups cooked rice⟦/1⟧

seg.06ba75699134.src: 3 cups cooked rice ⟦1⟧cooked a little firm, grains separate⟦/1⟧
seg.06ba75699134.t: 3 କପ ଭାତ ⟦1⟧ଟିକିଏ ଟାଣ କରି ରନ୍ଧା, ଦାନା ଅଲଗା ଅଲଗା⟦/1⟧
seg.06ba75699134.back: 3 cups cooked rice ⟦1⟧cooked a little firm, grains separate⟦/1⟧

seg.fbba93c11bc9.src: 3 tbsp lemon juice ⟦1⟧from about 2 lemons; add more to taste⟦/1⟧
seg.fbba93c11bc9.t: 3 ଟେବୁଲ ଚାମଚ ଲେମ୍ବୁ ରସ ⟦1⟧ପ୍ରାୟ 2ଟି ଲେମ୍ବୁରୁ; ସ୍ୱାଦ ଅନୁସାରେ ଅଧିକ⟦/1⟧
seg.fbba93c11bc9.back: 3 tablespoons lemon juice ⟦1⟧from about 2 lemons; more as per taste⟦/1⟧

seg.e254f20f8f14.src: 3 tbsp oil ⟦1⟧groundnut oil is the usual choice⟦/1⟧

seg.bc63d9715c03.src: Wash the rice and cook it with 2 cups of water until just done, so the grains stay separate. You need about 3 cups of cooked rice.
seg.bc63d9715c03.t: ଚାଉଳ ଧୋଇ 2 କପ ପାଣିରେ ଠିକ ସିଝିବା ଯାଏ ରାନ୍ଧନ୍ତୁ, ଯେପରି ଦାନା ଅଲଗା ରହେ। ପ୍ରାୟ 3 କପ ଭାତ ଦରକାର।
seg.bc63d9715c03.back: Wash the rice and cook in 2 cups water until just cooked, so the grains stay separate. About 3 cups of cooked rice are needed.

seg.adb2b75edafc.src: Spread the cooked rice on a plate to cool; add the salt. Fluff it with a fork and let it sit about 10 minutes until warm, not hot, so the grains do not break when mixed.
seg.adb2b75edafc.t: ଭାତକୁ ଥଣ୍ଡା ହେବା ପାଇଁ ଥାଳିରେ ବିଛାନ୍ତୁ; ଲୁଣ ପକାନ୍ତୁ। କଣ୍ଟା ଚାମଚରେ ଝରଝର କରି ପ୍ରାୟ 10 ମିନିଟ ରଖନ୍ତୁ ଯେପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ ଉଷୁମ ହୁଏ, ଗରମ ନୁହେଁ, ଯେପରି ମିଶାଇବା ବେଳେ ଦାନା ନ ଭାଙ୍ଗେ।
seg.adb2b75edafc.back: Spread the rice on a plate to cool; add salt. Fluff with a fork and keep about 10 minutes until it is warm, not hot, so the grains do not break while mixing.

seg.e05322a3ed24.src: Heat the oil; fry the peanuts, dals, mustard seeds, chillies and curry leaves. Start with the peanuts on medium heat and fry them about 2 minutes until they crackle and the skins darken.
seg.e05322a3ed24.t: ତେଲ ଗରମ କରନ୍ତୁ; ଚିନାବାଦାମ, ଡାଲି, ସୋରିଷ, ଲଙ୍କା ଓ ଭୃସଙ୍ଗ ପତ୍ର ଭାଜନ୍ତୁ। ମଧ୍ୟମ ନିଆଁରେ ଚିନାବାଦାମରୁ ଆରମ୍ଭ କରି ପ୍ରାୟ 2 ମିନିଟ ଭାଜନ୍ତୁ ଯେପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ ଫୁଟି ଚୋପା ଗାଢ଼ ନ ହୁଏ।
seg.e05322a3ed24.back: Heat the oil; fry peanuts, dal, mustard, chilli and curry leaves. On medium flame start with the peanuts and fry about 2 minutes until they crackle and the skins darken.

seg.542a4fea7b18.src: Add the chana dal and urad dal and fry until light golden, about 1 minute.
seg.542a4fea7b18.t: ବୁଟ ଡାଲି ଓ ବିରି ଡାଲି ପକାଇ ହାଲୁକା ସୁନେଲି ହେବା ଯାଏ ଭାଜନ୍ତୁ, ପ୍ରାୟ 1 ମିନିଟ।
seg.542a4fea7b18.back: Add chana dal and urad dal and fry until light golden, about 1 minute.

seg.502483d7a042.src: Add the mustard seeds and let them splutter, then add the dry red chillies, green chillies, ginger and curry leaves and fry a few seconds until the leaves turn crisp.
seg.502483d7a042.t: ସୋରିଷ ପକାଇ ଫୁଟିବାକୁ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ, ତାପରେ ଶୁଖିଲା ଲାଲ ଲଙ୍କା, କଞ୍ଚା ଲଙ୍କା, ଅଦା ଓ ଭୃସଙ୍ଗ ପତ୍ର ପକାଇ ପତ୍ର କୁରକୁରିଆ ହେବା ଯାଏ କିଛି ସେକେଣ୍ଡ ଭାଜନ୍ତୁ।
seg.502483d7a042.back: Add mustard and let it splutter, then add dry red chilli, green chilli, ginger and curry leaves and fry a few seconds until the leaves are crisp.

seg.6e856356980b.src: Stir in the turmeric powder and hing; switch off. Stir for 5–10 seconds only so the turmeric cooks in the hot oil without burning.
seg.6e856356980b.t: ହଳଦୀ ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ଓ ହେଙ୍ଗୁ ମିଶାନ୍ତୁ; ନିଆଁ ବନ୍ଦ କରନ୍ତୁ। କେବଳ 5–10 ସେକେଣ୍ଡ ଘାଣ୍ଟନ୍ତୁ ଯେପରି ହଳଦୀ ଗରମ ତେଲରେ ନ ପୋଡ଼ି ରନ୍ଧାହୁଏ।
seg.6e856356980b.back: Mix in turmeric powder and asafoetida; turn off the flame. Stir only 5–10 seconds so the turmeric cooks in the hot oil without burning.

seg.dd6ccaf923d8.src: Pour over the rice, add the lemon juice and mix gently. Use your fingers or a flat spatula and lift the rice from below so every grain turns yellow without turning mushy.
seg.dd6ccaf923d8.t: ଭାତ ଉପରେ ଢାଳନ୍ତୁ, ଲେମ୍ବୁ ରସ ପକାଇ ଧୀରେ ମିଶାନ୍ତୁ। ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ବା ଚେପଟା ଖୁଣ୍ଟି ବ୍ୟବହାର କରି ତଳୁ ଭାତ ଉଠାଇ ମିଶାନ୍ତୁ ଯେପରି ପ୍ରତ୍ୟେକ ଦାନା ହଳଦିଆ ହୁଏ କିନ୍ତୁ ଚକଟି ନ ହୁଏ।
seg.dd6ccaf923d8.back: Pour over the rice, add lemon juice and mix gently. Using fingers or a flat spatula lift the rice from below and mix so every grain turns yellow but is not mashed.

seg.1bfc2c04d40e.src: Taste and add more salt or lemon juice if needed. The rice should taste clearly sour and salty, as the flavour softens on standing.
seg.1bfc2c04d40e.t: ଚାଖି ଦରକାର ହେଲେ ଅଧିକ ଲୁଣ ବା ଲେମ୍ବୁ ରସ ପକାନ୍ତୁ। ଭାତ ସ୍ପଷ୍ଟ ଖଟା ଓ ଲୁଣିଆ ଲାଗିବା ଉଚିତ, କାରଣ ରହିଲେ ସ୍ୱାଦ ନରମ ହୁଏ।
seg.1bfc2c04d40e.back: Taste and add more salt or lemon juice if needed. The rice should taste clearly sour and salty, because the flavour softens as it stands.

seg.8cea6688d0fb.src: Cover and rest the pulihora for 15 minutes before serving so the rice takes in the lemon and tempering.
seg.8cea6688d0fb.t: ପରଷିବା ଆଗରୁ ପୁଳିହୋରାକୁ ଘୋଡ଼ାଇ 15 ମିନିଟ ରଖନ୍ତୁ ଯେପରି ଭାତ ଲେମ୍ବୁ ଓ ଛୁଙ୍କର ସ୍ୱାଦ ନିଏ।
seg.8cea6688d0fb.back: Before serving keep the pulihora covered 15 minutes so the rice takes on the flavour of the lemon and tempering.

seg.c1a7043ce357.src: Add the lemon juice off the heat so it stays sharp. Cooked lemon juice turns bitter.
seg.c1a7043ce357.t: ଲେମ୍ବୁ ରସ ନିଆଁ ବାହାରେ ପକାନ୍ତୁ ଯେପରି ଖଟା ତୀକ୍ଷ୍ଣ ରହେ। ରନ୍ଧା ଲେମ୍ବୁ ରସ ପିତା ହୋଇଯାଏ।
seg.c1a7043ce357.back: Add the lemon juice off the flame so the sourness stays sharp. Cooked lemon juice turns bitter.

seg.b634a4257b6c.src: Cook the rice slightly firm and let it cool before mixing; hot, soft rice turns pasty.
seg.b634a4257b6c.t: ଭାତକୁ ଟିକିଏ ଟାଣ କରି ରାନ୍ଧନ୍ତୁ ଓ ମିଶାଇବା ଆଗରୁ ଥଣ୍ଡା ହେବାକୁ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ; ଗରମ, ନରମ ଭାତ ଲେଟି ହୋଇଯାଏ।
seg.b634a4257b6c.back: Cook the rice a little firm and let it cool before mixing; hot, soft rice turns mushy.

seg.a1d93274ea3f.src: Keep the turmeric powder in the oil for just a few seconds; burnt turmeric gives a dark colour and a bitter taste.
seg.a1d93274ea3f.t: ହଳଦୀ ଗୁଣ୍ଡକୁ କେବଳ କିଛି ସେକେଣ୍ଡ ତେଲରେ ରଖନ୍ତୁ; ପୋଡ଼ା ହଳଦୀ ଗାଢ଼ ରଙ୍ଗ ଓ ପିତା ସ୍ୱାଦ ଦିଏ।
seg.a1d93274ea3f.back: Keep the turmeric powder in the oil only a few seconds; burnt turmeric gives a dark colour and bitter taste.

seg.747474140bbf.src: Leftover rice from the morning works well, as the grains are already firm and separate.
seg.747474140bbf.t: ସକାଳର ବଳକା ଭାତ ଭଲ ଚଳେ, କାରଣ ଦାନା ଆଗରୁ ଟାଣ ଓ ଅଲଗା ଅଲଗା ଥାଏ।
seg.747474140bbf.back: Leftover rice from the morning does well, because the grains are already firm and separate.

seg.7a379d805448.src: Cashews: fry 10 cashew halves with the peanuts for a festive pulihora.
seg.7a379d805448.t: କାଜୁ: ପର୍ବର ପୁଳିହୋରା ପାଇଁ ଚିନାବାଦାମ ସହିତ 10ଟି ଅଧା କାଜୁ ଭାଜନ୍ତୁ।
seg.7a379d805448.back: Cashews: for festival pulihora fry 10 cashew halves with the peanuts.

seg.be93899ec308.src: Mamidikaya pulihora: in place of lemon juice, mix in 1 cup grated raw mango with the tempering.
seg.be93899ec308.t: ମାମିଡିକାୟ ପୁଳିହୋରା: ଲେମ୍ବୁ ରସ ବଦଳରେ ଛୁଙ୍କ ସହିତ 1 କପ କୋରା କଞ୍ଚା ଆମ୍ବ ମିଶାନ୍ତୁ।
seg.be93899ec308.back: Mamidikaya pulihora: instead of lemon juice mix 1 cup grated raw mango in with the tempering.

seg.867dba923c04.src: Grated coconut: add 2 tbsp grated coconut along with the lemon juice for a milder rice.
seg.867dba923c04.t: କୋରା ନଡ଼ିଆ: ନରମ ସ୍ୱାଦର ଭାତ ପାଇଁ ଲେମ୍ବୁ ରସ ସହିତ 2 ଟେବୁଲ ଚାମଚ କୋରା ନଡ଼ିଆ ପକାନ୍ତୁ।
seg.867dba923c04.back: Grated coconut: for a milder-tasting rice add 2 tablespoons grated coconut with the lemon juice.

seg.88b87529b506.src: Serve at room temperature with curd, a pickle or appadams. It is a classic tiffin-box and travel rice.
seg.88b87529b506.t: ସାଧାରଣ ତାପମାତ୍ରାରେ ଦହି, ଆଚାର ବା ପାମ୍ପଡ଼ ସହିତ ପରଷନ୍ତୁ। ଏହା ଟିଫିନ ବାକ୍ସ ଓ ଯାତ୍ରା ପାଇଁ ଏକ ପ୍ରସିଦ୍ଧ ଭାତ।
seg.88b87529b506.back: Serve at room temperature with curd, pickle or papad. It is a famous rice for tiffin boxes and travel.

seg.9791f1c7a8e4.src: It keeps well at room temperature for about 6 hours, which is why it travels. Keep leftovers covered in the fridge and eat within a day.
seg.9791f1c7a8e4.t: ସାଧାରଣ ତାପମାତ୍ରାରେ ଏହା ପ୍ରାୟ 6 ଘଣ୍ଟା ଭଲ ରହେ, ସେଥିପାଇଁ ଯାତ୍ରାରେ ନିଆଯାଏ। ବଳକା ଘୋଡ଼ାଇ ଫ୍ରିଜରେ ରଖନ୍ତୁ ଓ ଦିନେ ଭିତରେ ଖାଆନ୍ତୁ।
seg.9791f1c7a8e4.back: At room temperature it keeps well about 6 hours, which is why it is taken on journeys. Keep leftovers covered in the fridge and eat within a day.

seg.c12ab7274709.src: Why does my lemon rice taste bitter?
seg.c12ab7274709.t: ମୋ ଲେମ୍ବୁ ଭାତ କାହିଁକି ପିତା ଲାଗୁଛି?
seg.c12ab7274709.back: Why does my lemon rice taste bitter?

seg.44b56d19b9fb.src: Either the lemon juice was cooked or the turmeric burnt in the oil. Switch off the stove before the turmeric goes in, and add the lemon juice only to the rice, off the heat.
seg.44b56d19b9fb.t: ହୁଏତ ଲେମ୍ବୁ ରସ ରନ୍ଧା ହୋଇଗଲା ବା ହଳଦୀ ତେଲରେ ପୋଡ଼ିଗଲା। ହଳଦୀ ପକାଇବା ଆଗରୁ ଚୁଲି ବନ୍ଦ କରନ୍ତୁ, ଆଉ ଲେମ୍ବୁ ରସ କେବଳ ଭାତରେ, ନିଆଁ ବାହାରେ ପକାନ୍ତୁ।
seg.44b56d19b9fb.back: Perhaps the lemon juice got cooked or the turmeric burned in the oil. Turn off the stove before adding turmeric, and add the lemon juice only to the rice, off the flame.

seg.69e4bfb93ba8.src: What is the difference between pulihora and lemon rice?
seg.69e4bfb93ba8.t: ପୁଳିହୋରା ଓ ଲେମ୍ବୁ ଭାତ ମଧ୍ୟରେ ଫରକ କଣ?
seg.69e4bfb93ba8.back: What is the difference between pulihora and lemon rice?

seg.f2f993f1b94b.src: Pulihora is the Telugu name for soured rice. Chintapandu pulihora is soured with tamarind paste; nimmakaya pulihora is the lemon version, quicker to make and lighter in colour.
seg.f2f993f1b94b.t: ପୁଳିହୋରା ହେଉଛି ଖଟା ଭାତର ତେଲୁଗୁ ନାମ। ଚିନ୍ତପଣ୍ଡୁ ପୁଳିହୋରା ତେନ୍ତୁଳି ବଟାରେ ଖଟା କରାଯାଏ; ନିମ୍ମକାୟ ପୁଳିହୋରା ହେଉଛି ଲେମ୍ବୁ ପ୍ରକାର, ଶୀଘ୍ର ତିଆରି ହୁଏ ଓ ରଙ୍ଗ ହାଲୁକା।
seg.f2f993f1b94b.back: Pulihora is the Telugu name for sour rice. Chintapandu pulihora is soured with tamarind paste; nimmakaya pulihora is the lemon type, made quickly and lighter in colour.

seg.1ab5dcf1d80a.src: How do I stop lemon rice from getting mushy?
seg.1ab5dcf1d80a.t: ଲେମ୍ବୁ ଭାତକୁ ଲେଟି ହେବାରୁ କିପରି ରୋକିବି?
seg.1ab5dcf1d80a.back: How do I stop lemon rice from turning mushy?

seg.8a0fad2d4bfd.src: Cook the rice a little firm with less water, cool it on a plate, and mix gently by lifting from below instead of pressing.
seg.8a0fad2d4bfd.t: କମ୍ ପାଣିରେ ଭାତକୁ ଟିକିଏ ଟାଣ କରି ରାନ୍ଧନ୍ତୁ, ଥାଳିରେ ଥଣ୍ଡା କରନ୍ତୁ, ଆଉ ଚାପିବା ବଦଳରେ ତଳୁ ଉଠାଇ ଧୀରେ ମିଶାନ୍ତୁ।
seg.8a0fad2d4bfd.back: Cook the rice a little firm in less water, cool it on a plate, and mix gently by lifting from below instead of pressing.

seg.dd00224f5f94.src: How much lemon juice for 3 cups of rice?
seg.dd00224f5f94.t: 3 କପ ଭାତ ପାଇଁ କେତେ ଲେମ୍ବୁ ରସ?
seg.dd00224f5f94.back: How much lemon juice for 3 cups of rice?

seg.50f8efabb87e.src: About 3 tbsp, the juice of 2 medium lemons. Add it slowly and taste, because lemons vary in sourness.
seg.50f8efabb87e.t: ପ୍ରାୟ 3 ଟେବୁଲ ଚାମଚ, 2ଟି ମଧ୍ୟମ ଲେମ୍ବୁର ରସ। ଧୀରେ ଧୀରେ ପକାଇ ଚାଖନ୍ତୁ, କାରଣ ଲେମ୍ବୁର ଖଟା ଅଲଗା ଅଲଗା ହୁଏ।
seg.50f8efabb87e.back: About 3 tablespoons, the juice of 2 medium lemons. Add slowly and taste, because lemons differ in sourness.

seg.2d3c4d5f7608.src: నిమ్మకాయ పులిహోర. Andhra lemon rice: cooled rice tossed with a peanut and dal tempering, our turmeric powder and lemon juice. Step-by-step method, tips and FAQs.
seg.2d3c4d5f7608.t: నిమ్మకాయ పులిహోర. ଆନ୍ଧ୍ରର ଲେମ୍ବୁ ଭାତ: ଥଣ୍ଡା ଭାତକୁ ଚିନାବାଦାମ ଓ ଡାଲିର ଛୁଙ୍କ, ଆମ ହଳଦୀ ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ଓ ଲେମ୍ବୁ ରସ ସହିତ ମିଶାଯାଏ। ଧାପେ ଧାପେ ପ୍ରଣାଳୀ, ଟିପ୍ସ ଓ ପ୍ରଶ୍ନୋତ୍ତର।
seg.2d3c4d5f7608.back: నిమ్మకాయ పులిహోర. Andhra lemon rice: cooled rice mixed with a peanut and dal tempering, our turmeric powder and lemon juice. Step-by-step method, tips and Q&A.

seg.5f0282fcd0a8.src: Nimmakaya Pulihora: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.5f0282fcd0a8.t: ନିମ୍ମକାୟ ପୁଳିହୋରା: 1acrefarmsର ରେସିପି କାର୍ଡ, ଉପକରଣ ଓ ପ୍ରଣାଳୀ ସହିତ
seg.5f0282fcd0a8.back: Nimmakaya Pulihora: 1acrefarms recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.8922ef1e3767.src: Pasupu annam is plain rice turned bright yellow with turmeric and tossed in a crackling tempering of mustard seeds, chana dal, curry leaves and green chillies, with fried cashews on top. Andhra homes make it for lunch boxes, for quick weekday meals and as a prasadam on puja days, often with the morning's leftover rice.
seg.8922ef1e3767.t: ପସୁପୁ ଅନ୍ନମ ହେଉଛି ସାଦା ଭାତ, ଯାହାକୁ ହଳଦୀରେ ଉଜ୍ଜ୍ୱଳ ହଳଦିଆ କରି ସୋରିଷ, ବୁଟ ଡାଲି, ଭୃସଙ୍ଗ ପତ୍ର ଓ କଞ୍ଚା ଲଙ୍କାର ଛଣଛଣିଆ ଛୁଙ୍କରେ ମିଶାଯାଏ, ଉପରେ ଭଜା କାଜୁ ସହିତ। ଆନ୍ଧ୍ରର ଘରେ ଏହା ଟିଫିନ ବାକ୍ସ, ସପ୍ତାହ ଦିନର ଶୀଘ୍ର ଖାଇବା ଓ ପୂଜା ଦିନର ପ୍ରସାଦ ପାଇଁ ତିଆରି ହୁଏ, ଅନେକ ସମୟରେ ସକାଳର ବଳକା ଭାତରେ।
seg.8922ef1e3767.back: Pasupu annam is plain rice made bright yellow with turmeric and mixed into a sizzling tempering of mustard, chana dal, curry leaves and green chilli, with fried cashews on top. In Andhra homes it is made for tiffin boxes, quick weekday meals and puja-day prasadam, often with leftover rice from the morning.

seg.510252086556.src: Our hill turmeric powder (Konda Pasupu) gives the rice its deep yellow colour and an earthy turmeric smell, so half a teaspoon is enough for 4. Whole cashews (Jeedipappu) fried in the same oil add the crunch.
seg.510252086556.t: ଆମ ପାହାଡ଼ିଆ ହଳଦୀ ଗୁଣ୍ଡ (କୋଣ୍ଡା ପସୁପୁ) ଭାତକୁ ଗାଢ଼ ହଳଦିଆ ରଙ୍ଗ ଓ ମାଟିଆ ହଳଦୀ ବାସନା ଦିଏ, ତେଣୁ 4 ଜଣଙ୍କ ପାଇଁ ଅଧା ଚା ଚାମଚ ଯଥେଷ୍ଟ। ସେହି ତେଲରେ ଭଜା ଗୋଟା କାଜୁ (ଜୀଡିପପ୍ପୁ) କୁରକୁରିଆ ଭାବ ଆଣେ।
seg.510252086556.back: Our hill turmeric powder (konda pasupu) gives the rice a deep yellow colour and earthy turmeric aroma, so half a teaspoon is enough for 4 people. Whole cashews (jeedipappu) fried in the same oil bring a crunchy feel.

seg.38badedc8d11.src: Total includes about 15 minutes for the cooked rice to cool.
seg.38badedc8d11.t: ମୋଟ ସମୟରେ ରନ୍ଧା ଭାତ ଥଣ୍ଡା ହେବାର ପ୍ରାୟ 15 ମିନିଟ ମଧ୍ୟ ଅଛି।
seg.38badedc8d11.back: The total time also includes about 15 minutes for the cooked rice to cool.

seg.8ad70ebff643.src: Cook rice and let it cool. Fry cashews, mustard seeds, chana dal, chillies and curry leaves in oil, add hill turmeric powder and toss in the rice.
seg.8ad70ebff643.t: ଭାତ ରାନ୍ଧି ଥଣ୍ଡା ହେବାକୁ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ। କାଜୁ, ସୋରିଷ, ବୁଟ ଡାଲି, ଲଙ୍କା ଓ ଭୃସଙ୍ଗ ପତ୍ରକୁ ତେଲରେ ଭାଜନ୍ତୁ, ପାହାଡ଼ିଆ ହଳଦୀ ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ପକାଇ ଭାତ ମିଶାନ୍ତୁ।
seg.8ad70ebff643.back: Cook the rice and let it cool. Fry cashews, mustard, chana dal, chilli and curry leaves in oil, add hill turmeric powder and mix in the rice.

seg.bc286f12f1ba.src: 1 cup rice ⟦1⟧sona masoori, about 200 g; makes about 3 cups cooked⟦/1⟧
seg.bc286f12f1ba.t: 1 କପ ଚାଉଳ ⟦1⟧ସୋନା ମସୂରୀ, ପ୍ରାୟ 200 g; ପ୍ରାୟ 3 କପ ଭାତ ହୁଏ⟦/1⟧
seg.bc286f12f1ba.back: 1 cup rice ⟦1⟧Sona Masuri, about 200 g; makes about 3 cups cooked rice⟦/1⟧

seg.06cd9d581aec.src: ½ tsp hill turmeric powder ⟦1⟧Konda Pasupu⟦/1⟧
seg.06cd9d581aec.t: ½ ଚା ଚାମଚ ପାହାଡ଼ିଆ ହଳଦୀ ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ⟦1⟧କୋଣ୍ଡା ପସୁପୁ⟦/1⟧
seg.06cd9d581aec.back: ½ teaspoon hill turmeric powder ⟦1⟧konda pasupu⟦/1⟧

seg.399f19de4e13.src: 1 tbsp ghee (optional) ⟦1⟧stirred in at the end⟦/1⟧
seg.399f19de4e13.back: 1 tablespoon ghee (optional) ⟦1⟧for mixing in at the end⟦/1⟧

seg.53fcfe53b909.src: Wash the rice in 2–3 changes of water and drain it.
seg.53fcfe53b909.t: ଚାଉଳକୁ 2–3 ଥର ପାଣି ବଦଳାଇ ଧୋଇ ପାଣି ଛାଣନ୍ତୁ।
seg.53fcfe53b909.back: Wash the rice 2–3 times changing the water and drain.

seg.cdcf37be99e8.src: Cook the rice so the grains stay separate, then spread it on a plate to cool. Use 2 cups water to 1 cup rice in a pot or pressure cooker (2 whistles), and fluff it with a fork before spreading it out.
seg.cdcf37be99e8.t: ଦାନା ଅଲଗା ରହିବା ପରି ଭାତ ରାନ୍ଧନ୍ତୁ, ତାପରେ ଥଣ୍ଡା ହେବା ପାଇଁ ଥାଳିରେ ବିଛାନ୍ତୁ। ହାଣ୍ଡି ବା ପ୍ରେସର କୁକରରେ (2 ସିଟି) 1 କପ ଚାଉଳରେ 2 କପ ପାଣି ନିଅନ୍ତୁ, ଆଉ ବିଛାଇବା ଆଗରୁ କଣ୍ଟା ଚାମଚରେ ଝରଝର କରନ୍ତୁ।
seg.cdcf37be99e8.back: Cook the rice so the grains stay separate, then spread on a plate to cool. In a pot or pressure cooker (2 whistles) take 2 cups water to 1 cup rice, and fluff with a fork before spreading.

seg.296995189451.src: Let the rice cool for about 15 minutes until it is just warm. Sprinkle the salt over it.
seg.296995189451.t: ଭାତକୁ ପ୍ରାୟ 15 ମିନିଟ ଥଣ୍ଡା ହେବାକୁ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ, ଯେପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ କେବଳ ଉଷୁମ ରହେ। ଉପରେ ଲୁଣ ଛିଞ୍ଚନ୍ତୁ।
seg.296995189451.back: Let the rice cool about 15 minutes, until it is only warm. Sprinkle salt on top.

seg.48839bd22983.src: Heat the oil in a wide kadai on medium heat.
seg.48839bd22983.t: ଏକ ଚଉଡ଼ା କଡ଼ାଇରେ ମଧ୍ୟମ ନିଆଁରେ ତେଲ ଗରମ କରନ୍ତୁ।
seg.48839bd22983.back: Heat oil in a wide kadai on medium flame.

seg.bdc1a0df8ffc.src: Fry the cashews in the oil till golden; lift out. Add mustard seeds and chana dal. Keep the cashews on a plate; they turn golden in about 1 minute.
seg.bdc1a0df8ffc.t: କାଜୁକୁ ତେଲରେ ସୁନେଲି ହେବା ଯାଏ ଭାଜନ୍ତୁ; ଉଠାଇ ନିଅନ୍ତୁ। ସୋରିଷ ଓ ବୁଟ ଡାଲି ପକାନ୍ତୁ। କାଜୁକୁ ଥାଳିରେ ରଖନ୍ତୁ; ପ୍ରାୟ 1 ମିନିଟରେ ସେଗୁଡ଼ିକ ସୁନେଲି ହୁଏ।
seg.bdc1a0df8ffc.back: Fry the cashews in the oil until golden; lift out. Add mustard and chana dal. Keep the cashews on a plate; they turn golden in about 1 minute.

seg.0729c6efc94a.src: Once the mustard seeds splutter, add the urad dal and the dried red chillies and stir.
seg.0729c6efc94a.t: ସୋରିଷ ଫୁଟିବା ମାତ୍ରେ ବିରି ଡାଲି ଓ ଶୁଖିଲା ଲାଲ ଲଙ୍କା ପକାଇ ଘାଣ୍ଟନ୍ତୁ।
seg.0729c6efc94a.back: As soon as the mustard splutters add urad dal and dry red chilli and stir.

seg.2688182af66a.src: When the dal turns golden, add the chillies and curry leaves, then the turmeric on low heat. Add the ginger and asafoetida with the curry leaves, and stir the turmeric for only 5–10 seconds.
seg.2688182af66a.t: ଡାଲି ସୁନେଲି ହେଲେ ଲଙ୍କା ଓ ଭୃସଙ୍ଗ ପତ୍ର ପକାନ୍ତୁ, ତାପରେ ଧିମା ନିଆଁରେ ହଳଦୀ। ଭୃସଙ୍ଗ ପତ୍ର ସହିତ ଅଦା ଓ ହେଙ୍ଗୁ ପକାନ୍ତୁ, ଆଉ ହଳଦୀକୁ କେବଳ 5–10 ସେକେଣ୍ଡ ଘାଣ୍ଟନ୍ତୁ।
seg.2688182af66a.back: When the dal turns golden add chilli and curry leaves, then turmeric on low flame. Add ginger and asafoetida with the curry leaves, and stir the turmeric only 5–10 seconds.

seg.59fd9b87153d.src: Switch off the heat straight away so the turmeric does not burn.
seg.59fd9b87153d.t: ହଳଦୀ ଯେପରି ନ ପୋଡ଼େ ସେଥିପାଇଁ ସଙ୍ଗେ ସଙ୍ଗେ ନିଆଁ ବନ୍ଦ କରନ୍ତୁ।
seg.59fd9b87153d.back: Turn off the flame immediately so the turmeric does not burn.

seg.15dc85e42ca1.src: Tip in the rice, cashews and salt and toss gently till evenly yellow. Use a flat spatula and lift and fold rather than pressing down, so the grains stay whole.
seg.15dc85e42ca1.t: ଭାତ, କାଜୁ ଓ ଲୁଣ ପକାଇ ସମାନ ହଳଦିଆ ହେବା ଯାଏ ଧୀରେ ମିଶାନ୍ତୁ। ଚେପଟା ଖୁଣ୍ଟି ବ୍ୟବହାର କରି ଚାପିବା ବଦଳରେ ଉଠାଇ ଓଲଟାନ୍ତୁ, ଯେପରି ଦାନା ଗୋଟା ରହେ।
seg.15dc85e42ca1.back: Add the rice, cashews and salt and mix gently until evenly yellow. Use a flat spatula and lift and turn instead of pressing, so the grains stay whole.

seg.b005e5771235.src: Taste for salt, stir in the ghee if using, cover and leave for 5 minutes before serving so the rice takes on the tempering.
seg.b005e5771235.t: ଲୁଣ ଚାଖନ୍ତୁ, ବ୍ୟବହାର କରୁଥିଲେ ଘିଅ ମିଶାନ୍ତୁ, ଘୋଡ଼ାଇ ପରଷିବା ଆଗରୁ 5 ମିନିଟ ରଖନ୍ତୁ ଯେପରି ଭାତ ଛୁଙ୍କର ସ୍ୱାଦ ନିଏ।
seg.b005e5771235.back: Taste for salt, mix in ghee if using, cover and keep 5 minutes before serving so the rice takes on the flavour of the tempering.

seg.9bce1ed4dbee.src: Spread the rice to cool first so the grains do not break.
seg.9bce1ed4dbee.t: ଦାନା ନ ଭାଙ୍ଗିବା ପାଇଁ ପ୍ରଥମେ ଭାତକୁ ବିଛାଇ ଥଣ୍ଡା କରନ୍ତୁ।
seg.9bce1ed4dbee.back: To keep the grains from breaking, first spread and cool the rice.

seg.1f9a348f8750.src: Add the turmeric on low heat and stir for only a few seconds; burnt turmeric turns the rice bitter.
seg.1f9a348f8750.t: ଧିମା ନିଆଁରେ ହଳଦୀ ପକାଇ କେବଳ କିଛି ସେକେଣ୍ଡ ଘାଣ୍ଟନ୍ତୁ; ପୋଡ଼ା ହଳଦୀ ଭାତକୁ ପିତା କରିଦିଏ।
seg.1f9a348f8750.back: Add turmeric on low flame and stir only a few seconds; burnt turmeric makes the rice bitter.

seg.394d01a50207.src: Hill turmeric powder colours strongly; start with ½ tsp for 1 cup of rice and add a pinch more only if you want a deeper yellow.
seg.394d01a50207.t: ପାହାଡ଼ିଆ ହଳଦୀ ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ଗାଢ଼ ରଙ୍ଗ ଦିଏ; 1 କପ ଚାଉଳ ପାଇଁ ½ ଚା ଚାମଚରୁ ଆରମ୍ଭ କରନ୍ତୁ, ଆଉ ଗାଢ଼ ହଳଦିଆ ଚାହିଁଲେ ହିଁ ଚିମୁଟାଏ ଅଧିକ ପକାନ୍ତୁ।
seg.394d01a50207.back: Hill turmeric powder gives a deep colour; start with ½ teaspoon for 1 cup rice, and add a pinch more only if you want a deeper yellow.

seg.505872469eb9.src: Leftover rice from the morning works well, as long as the grains are separate.
seg.505872469eb9.t: ଦାନା ଅଲଗା ଅଲଗା ଥିଲେ ସକାଳର ବଳକା ଭାତ ଭଲ ଚଳେ।
seg.505872469eb9.back: If the grains are separate, leftover rice from the morning does well.

seg.ab1b24f9cf3d.src: Turmeric powder: our everyday Pasupu turmeric powder works the same way; use the same ½ tsp.
seg.ab1b24f9cf3d.t: ହଳଦୀ ଗୁଣ୍ଡ: ଆମ ପ୍ରତିଦିନର ପସୁପୁ ହଳଦୀ ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ସେହିପରି କାମ କରେ; ସେତିକି ½ ଚା ଚାମଚ ନିଅନ୍ତୁ।
seg.ab1b24f9cf3d.back: Turmeric powder: our everyday pasupu turmeric powder works the same way; take the same ½ teaspoon.

seg.302f50dc74c9.src: Peanuts: fry 2 tbsp raw peanuts in the oil before the cashews for extra crunch.
seg.302f50dc74c9.t: ଚିନାବାଦାମ: ଅଧିକ କୁରକୁରିଆ ପାଇଁ କାଜୁ ଆଗରୁ ତେଲରେ 2 ଟେବୁଲ ଚାମଚ କଞ୍ଚା ଚିନାବାଦାମ ଭାଜନ୍ତୁ।
seg.302f50dc74c9.back: Peanuts: for more crunch fry 2 tablespoons raw peanuts in the oil before the cashews.

seg.551f49339b3d.src: Lemon: squeeze in the juice of half a lemon with the rice for a tangy, pulihora-style rice.
seg.551f49339b3d.t: ଲେମ୍ବୁ: ଖଟା, ପୁଳିହୋରା ଶୈଳୀର ଭାତ ପାଇଁ ଭାତ ସହିତ ଅଧା ଲେମ୍ବୁର ରସ ଚିପୁଡ଼ନ୍ତୁ।
seg.551f49339b3d.back: Lemon: for a sour, pulihora-style rice squeeze the juice of half a lemon in with the rice.

seg.6b9e9c07efba.src: Coconut: toss in 2 tbsp grated coconut along with the rice.
seg.6b9e9c07efba.t: ନଡ଼ିଆ: ଭାତ ସହିତ 2 ଟେବୁଲ ଚାମଚ କୋରା ନଡ଼ିଆ ମିଶାନ୍ତୁ।
seg.6b9e9c07efba.back: Coconut: mix 2 tablespoons grated coconut in with the rice.

seg.d541a1d237fc.src: Serve warm or at room temperature with curd, appadalu or a dry potato fry. It also packs well for lunch boxes and travel.
seg.d541a1d237fc.t: ଦହି, ଅପ୍ପଡ଼ାଲୁ ବା ଶୁଖିଲା ଆଳୁ ଭଜା ସହିତ ଉଷୁମ ବା ସାଧାରଣ ତାପମାତ୍ରାରେ ପରଷନ୍ତୁ। ଟିଫିନ ବାକ୍ସ ଓ ଯାତ୍ରା ପାଇଁ ମଧ୍ୟ ଭଲ ବନ୍ଧା ହୁଏ।
seg.d541a1d237fc.back: Serve warm or at room temperature with curd, appadalu or dry potato fry. It also packs well for tiffin boxes and travel.

seg.db97e1ae49fa.src: Best eaten the same day. Keep leftovers covered in the fridge for up to 1 day and warm them with a sprinkle of water.
seg.db97e1ae49fa.t: ସେହି ଦିନ ଖାଇବା ସବୁଠୁ ଭଲ। ବଳକା ଘୋଡ଼ାଇ ଫ୍ରିଜରେ 1 ଦିନ ପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ ରଖନ୍ତୁ ଓ ଟିକିଏ ପାଣି ଛିଞ୍ଚି ଗରମ କରନ୍ତୁ।
seg.db97e1ae49fa.back: Best eaten the same day. Keep leftovers covered in the fridge up to 1 day and heat with a sprinkle of water.

seg.54acb7b11b4c.src: How do you make pasupu annam?
seg.54acb7b11b4c.back: How do you make pasupu annam?

seg.d99d12f26e71.src: Cook rice so the grains stay separate and let it cool. Fry cashews, mustard seeds, chana dal, chillies and curry leaves in oil, add turmeric on low heat for a few seconds, then toss in the rice with salt.
seg.d99d12f26e71.t: ଦାନା ଅଲଗା ରହିବା ପରି ଭାତ ରାନ୍ଧି ଥଣ୍ଡା ହେବାକୁ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ। କାଜୁ, ସୋରିଷ, ବୁଟ ଡାଲି, ଲଙ୍କା ଓ ଭୃସଙ୍ଗ ପତ୍ରକୁ ତେଲରେ ଭାଜନ୍ତୁ, ଧିମା ନିଆଁରେ କିଛି ସେକେଣ୍ଡ ପାଇଁ ହଳଦୀ ପକାନ୍ତୁ, ତାପରେ ଲୁଣ ସହିତ ଭାତ ମିଶାନ୍ତୁ।
seg.d99d12f26e71.back: Cook the rice so the grains stay separate and let it cool. Fry cashews, mustard, chana dal, chilli and curry leaves in oil, add turmeric on low flame for a few seconds, then mix in the rice with salt.

seg.a4a87b4f7d63.src: How much turmeric powder goes into turmeric rice?
seg.a4a87b4f7d63.t: ହଳଦୀ ଭାତରେ କେତେ ହଳଦୀ ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ପଡ଼େ?
seg.a4a87b4f7d63.back: How much turmeric powder goes into turmeric rice?

seg.aa37527cdcfb.src: About ½ tsp for 1 cup of raw rice (about 3 cups cooked). Hill turmeric powder colours strongly, so start with less and add a pinch more if needed.
seg.aa37527cdcfb.t: 1 କପ କଞ୍ଚା ଚାଉଳ (ପ୍ରାୟ 3 କପ ଭାତ) ପାଇଁ ପ୍ରାୟ ½ ଚା ଚାମଚ। ପାହାଡ଼ିଆ ହଳଦୀ ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ଗାଢ଼ ରଙ୍ଗ ଦିଏ, ତେଣୁ କମ୍ ରୁ ଆରମ୍ଭ କରନ୍ତୁ ଓ ଦରକାର ହେଲେ ଚିମୁଟାଏ ଅଧିକ ପକାନ୍ତୁ।
seg.aa37527cdcfb.back: About ½ teaspoon for 1 cup raw rice (about 3 cups cooked rice). Hill turmeric powder gives a deep colour, so start with less and add a pinch more if needed.

seg.3d200fb0e6fc.src: Why is my turmeric rice bitter?
seg.3d200fb0e6fc.t: ମୋ ହଳଦୀ ଭାତ କାହିଁକି ପିତା ଲାଗୁଛି?
seg.3d200fb0e6fc.back: Why does my turmeric rice taste bitter?

seg.2c9da3559a42.src: The turmeric burnt in the hot oil, or too much went in. Add it on low heat, stir for only a few seconds and switch off before tipping in the rice.
seg.2c9da3559a42.t: ହଳଦୀ ଗରମ ତେଲରେ ପୋଡ଼ିଗଲା, ବା ବହୁତ ବେଶି ପଡ଼ିଗଲା। ଧିମା ନିଆଁରେ ପକାନ୍ତୁ, କେବଳ କିଛି ସେକେଣ୍ଡ ଘାଣ୍ଟନ୍ତୁ ଓ ଭାତ ପକାଇବା ଆଗରୁ ନିଆଁ ବନ୍ଦ କରନ୍ତୁ।
seg.2c9da3559a42.back: The turmeric burned in the hot oil, or too much went in. Add it on low flame, stir only a few seconds and turn off the flame before adding the rice.

seg.36ca370ac0d9.src: Can I make pasupu annam with leftover rice?
seg.36ca370ac0d9.t: ବଳକା ଭାତରେ ପସୁପୁ ଅନ୍ନମ ତିଆରି କରିପାରିବି କି?
seg.36ca370ac0d9.back: Can I make pasupu annam with leftover rice?

seg.71df75edcd26.src: Yes. Leftover rice with separate grains works well. Break up any lumps with your fingers before tossing it in the tempering.
seg.71df75edcd26.t: ହଁ। ଅଲଗା ଅଲଗା ଦାନା ଥିବା ବଳକା ଭାତ ଭଲ ଚଳେ। ଛୁଙ୍କରେ ମିଶାଇବା ଆଗରୁ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠିରେ ଗୁଣ୍ଡା ଭାଙ୍ଗି ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ।
seg.71df75edcd26.back: Yes. Leftover rice with separate grains does well. Break up the clumps with your fingers before mixing into the tempering.

seg.720281a9dc26.src: పసుపు అన్నం. Pasupu annam, Andhra turmeric rice: cooked rice tossed in a mustard, chana dal and curry leaf tempering with hill turmeric powder and fried cashews. Serves 4.
seg.720281a9dc26.t: పసుపు అన్నం. ପସୁପୁ ଅନ୍ନମ, ଆନ୍ଧ୍ରର ହଳଦୀ ଭାତ: ରନ୍ଧା ଭାତକୁ ସୋରିଷ, ବୁଟ ଡାଲି ଓ ଭୃସଙ୍ଗ ପତ୍ରର ଛୁଙ୍କ, ପାହାଡ଼ିଆ ହଳଦୀ ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ଓ ଭଜା କାଜୁ ସହିତ ମିଶାଯାଏ। 4 ଜଣଙ୍କ ପାଇଁ।
seg.720281a9dc26.back: పసుపు అన్నం. Pasupu annam, Andhra turmeric rice: cooked rice mixed with a tempering of mustard, chana dal and curry leaves, hill turmeric powder and fried cashews. For 4 people.

seg.a5bf108c0e27.src: Pasupu Annam: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.a5bf108c0e27.t: ପସୁପୁ ଅନ୍ନମ: 1acrefarmsର ରେସିପି କାର୍ଡ, ଉପକରଣ ଓ ପ୍ରଣାଳୀ ସହିତ
seg.a5bf108c0e27.back: Pasupu Annam: 1acrefarms recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.ed1a4a430aee.t: ½ ଚା ଚାମଚ ପାହାଡ଼ିଆ ହଳଦୀ ଗୁଣ୍ଡ

seg.cc1333072822.src: Ragi java is a pourable porridge of ragi flour cooked in water, a daily drink in many Andhra and Rayalaseema homes. The salted version is made with buttermilk; this sweet one is loosened with milk and sweetened with jaggery, and it is drunk warm from a steel tumbler at breakfast or in the evening.
seg.cc1333072822.t: ରାଗି ଜାଭା ହେଉଛି ପାଣିରେ ରନ୍ଧା ରାଗି (ମାଣ୍ଡିଆ) ଗୁଣ୍ଡର ଢାଳି ହେଉଥିବା ଜାଉ, ଆନ୍ଧ୍ର ଓ ରାୟଲସୀମାର ଅନେକ ଘରର ପ୍ରତିଦିନର ପାନୀୟ। ଲୁଣିଆ ପ୍ରକାର ଘୋଳ ସହିତ ତିଆରି ହୁଏ; ଏହି ମିଠା ପ୍ରକାରକୁ କ୍ଷୀରରେ ପତଳା କରି ଗୁଡ଼ରେ ମିଠା କରାଯାଏ, ଆଉ ସକାଳ ଜଳଖିଆ ବା ସନ୍ଧ୍ୟାରେ ଷ୍ଟିଲ ଟମ୍ବଲରରୁ ଉଷୁମ ଉଷୁମ ପିଆଯାଏ।
seg.cc1333072822.back: Ragi java is a pourable porridge of ragi (finger millet) flour cooked in water, the everyday drink of many homes in Andhra and Rayalaseema. The salty type is made with buttermilk; this sweet type is thinned with milk and sweetened with jaggery, and drunk warm from a steel tumbler at morning breakfast or in the evening.

seg.b29ec96bcd5c.src: Our Thati Bellam palm jaggery suits the earthy taste of ragi and gives the java a toffee-brown colour. It takes about 15 minutes from start to finish. This recipe serves 2.
seg.b29ec96bcd5c.t: ଆମ ତାଟି ବେଲ୍ଲମ ତାଳ ଗୁଡ଼ ରାଗିର ମାଟିଆ ସ୍ୱାଦ ସହିତ ମେଳ ଖାଏ ଓ ଜାଭାକୁ ଟଫି ପରି ବାଦାମୀ ରଙ୍ଗ ଦିଏ। ଆରମ୍ଭରୁ ଶେଷ ପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ ପ୍ରାୟ 15 ମିନିଟ ଲାଗେ। ଏହି ରେସିପି 2 ଜଣଙ୍କ ପାଇଁ।
seg.b29ec96bcd5c.back: Our tati bellam palm jaggery matches ragi's earthy taste and gives the java a toffee-like brown colour. It takes about 15 minutes from start to finish. This recipe is for 2 people.

seg.f65620e4f5c4.src: Total includes the 2-minute rest before the jaggery goes in.
seg.f65620e4f5c4.t: ମୋଟ ସମୟରେ ଗୁଡ଼ ପକାଇବା ଆଗରୁ 2 ମିନିଟ ରଖିବା ମଧ୍ୟ ଅଛି।
seg.f65620e4f5c4.back: The total time also includes resting 2 minutes before adding the jaggery.

seg.f0a8282433d4.src: Whisk ragi flour into water, cook it in boiling water till thick and glossy, then add milk. Off the heat, stir in palm jaggery and cardamom.
seg.f0a8282433d4.t: ରାଗି ଗୁଣ୍ଡକୁ ପାଣିରେ ଫେଣନ୍ତୁ, ଫୁଟୁଥିବା ପାଣିରେ ବହଳ ଓ ଚକଚକ ହେବା ଯାଏ ରାନ୍ଧନ୍ତୁ, ତାପରେ କ୍ଷୀର ପକାନ୍ତୁ। ନିଆଁ ବାହାରେ ତାଳ ଗୁଡ଼ ଓ ଅଳେଇଚ ମିଶାନ୍ତୁ।
seg.f0a8282433d4.back: Whisk the ragi flour in water, cook in boiling water until thick and glossy, then add milk. Off the flame mix in palm jaggery and cardamom.

seg.41bd564147d7.src: ¼ cup ragi flour ⟦1⟧finger millet flour, about 35 g⟦/1⟧
seg.41bd564147d7.t: ¼ କପ ରାଗି ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ⟦1⟧ମାଣ୍ଡିଆ ଗୁଣ୍ଡ, ପ୍ରାୟ 35 g⟦/1⟧
seg.41bd564147d7.back: ¼ cup ragi flour ⟦1⟧finger-millet flour, about 35 g⟦/1⟧

seg.d9504b3b8592.src: 2 cups water ⟦1⟧1 cup to mix the flour, 1 cup to boil⟦/1⟧
seg.d9504b3b8592.t: 2 କପ ପାଣି ⟦1⟧ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ଗୋଳିବା ପାଇଁ 1 କପ, ଫୁଟାଇବା ପାଇଁ 1 କପ⟦/1⟧
seg.d9504b3b8592.back: 2 cups water ⟦1⟧1 cup for mixing the flour, 1 cup for boiling⟦/1⟧

seg.0570314748ee.src: 3 tbsp grated palm jaggery ⟦1⟧about 30 g; add a spoon more if you like it sweeter⟦/1⟧
seg.0570314748ee.t: 3 ଟେବୁଲ ଚାମଚ କୋରା ତାଳ ଗୁଡ଼ ⟦1⟧ପ୍ରାୟ 30 g; ଅଧିକ ମିଠା ପସନ୍ଦ କଲେ ଚାମଚେ ଅଧିକ⟦/1⟧
seg.0570314748ee.back: 3 tablespoons grated palm jaggery ⟦1⟧about 30 g; a spoon more if you like it sweeter⟦/1⟧

seg.0a94735294ba.back: You can also sweeten it with ⟦1⟧sugarcane jaggery⟦/1⟧.

seg.2b7de8d37fd0.src: Put the ragi flour in a bowl.
seg.2b7de8d37fd0.back: Put the ragi flour in a bowl.

seg.fce6db4082ef.src: Whisk the ragi flour into 1 cup water till smooth, with no lumps. Use a whisk or a fork and break up any lumps against the side of the bowl.
seg.fce6db4082ef.t: ରାଗି ଗୁଣ୍ଡକୁ 1 କପ ପାଣିରେ ଗୁଣ୍ଡା ନ ରହିବା ଯାଏ ମସୃଣ କରି ଫେଣନ୍ତୁ। ଫେଣିବା ଯନ୍ତ୍ର ବା କଣ୍ଟା ଚାମଚ ବ୍ୟବହାର କରି ଗୁଣ୍ଡାକୁ ବାଟିର କଡ଼ରେ ଚାପି ଭାଙ୍ଗନ୍ତୁ।
seg.fce6db4082ef.back: Whisk the ragi flour smooth in 1 cup water until no lumps remain. Use a whisk or fork and break lumps by pressing them against the side of the bowl.

seg.ac6b0e0e7003.src: Pour the remaining 1 cup of water into a heavy-bottomed pan and set it on medium heat.
seg.ac6b0e0e7003.t: ବାକି 1 କପ ପାଣି ଏକ ମୋଟା ତଳ ପ୍ୟାନରେ ଢାଳି ମଧ୍ୟମ ନିଆଁରେ ବସାନ୍ତୁ।
seg.ac6b0e0e7003.back: Pour the remaining 1 cup water into a thick-bottomed pan and set on medium flame.

seg.ec55acf2b96a.src: Boil the other cup of water, pour in the ragi and stir on low heat till thick and glossy, 6–8 minutes. Stir the mix once more before pouring, as the flour settles at the bottom of the bowl.
seg.ec55acf2b96a.t: ଅନ୍ୟ କପ ପାଣି ଫୁଟାନ୍ତୁ, ରାଗି ଢାଳି ଧିମା ନିଆଁରେ ବହଳ ଓ ଚକଚକ ହେବା ଯାଏ ଘାଣ୍ଟନ୍ତୁ, 6–8 ମିନିଟ। ଢାଳିବା ଆଗରୁ ମିଶ୍ରଣକୁ ପୁଣି ଥରେ ଘାଣ୍ଟନ୍ତୁ, କାରଣ ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ବାଟିର ତଳେ ବସିଯାଏ।
seg.ec55acf2b96a.back: Boil the other cup of water, pour in the ragi and stir on low flame until thick and glossy, 6–8 minutes. Stir the mixture once more before pouring, because the flour settles at the bottom of the bowl.

seg.d0f8efa78d43.src: Keep stirring all the time. The java is cooked when it turns from dull pinkish-brown to a darker, glossy brown and coats the back of the spoon.
seg.d0f8efa78d43.t: ସବୁବେଳେ ଘାଣ୍ଟୁଥାନ୍ତୁ। ଜାଭା ଫିକା ଗୋଲାପି-ବାଦାମୀରୁ ଗାଢ଼, ଚକଚକିଆ ବାଦାମୀ ହୋଇ ଚାମଚର ପଛ ପଟରେ ଲାଗିଲେ ତାହା ରନ୍ଧା ହୋଇଯାଇଛି।
seg.d0f8efa78d43.back: Keep stirring all the time. When the java turns from pale pinkish-brown to a deep, glossy brown and coats the back of the spoon, it is cooked.

seg.e7ef07a808c5.src: Add the milk and simmer 2 minutes. Switch off and rest 2 minutes. Stir once or twice while it simmers so it does not catch.
seg.e7ef07a808c5.t: କ୍ଷୀର ପକାଇ 2 ମିନିଟ ଧିମା ଫୁଟାନ୍ତୁ। ନିଆଁ ବନ୍ଦ କରି 2 ମିନିଟ ରଖନ୍ତୁ। ଫୁଟୁଥିବା ବେଳେ ଥରେ ଦୁଇଥର ଘାଣ୍ଟନ୍ତୁ ଯେପରି ତଳେ ନ ଲାଗେ।
seg.e7ef07a808c5.back: Add the milk and simmer 2 minutes. Turn off the flame and keep 2 minutes. Stir once or twice while it boils so it does not stick to the bottom.

seg.8f86db3a6d08.src: Grate the palm jaggery finely while the java rests, so it melts quickly.
seg.8f86db3a6d08.t: ଜାଭା ରହିଥିବା ବେଳେ ତାଳ ଗୁଡ଼କୁ ମିହି କରି କୋରନ୍ତୁ, ଯେପରି ଶୀଘ୍ର ତରଳେ।
seg.8f86db3a6d08.back: While the java rests grate the palm jaggery finely, so it melts quickly.

seg.9cad3a0176bc.src: Stir in the palm jaggery and cardamom. Serve warm. Stir till the jaggery has fully melted, then taste and add a little more if needed.
seg.9cad3a0176bc.t: ତାଳ ଗୁଡ଼ ଓ ଅଳେଇଚ ମିଶାନ୍ତୁ। ଉଷୁମ ଉଷୁମ ପରଷନ୍ତୁ। ଗୁଡ଼ ପୂରା ତରଳିବା ଯାଏ ଘାଣ୍ଟନ୍ତୁ, ତାପରେ ଚାଖି ଦରକାର ହେଲେ ଟିକିଏ ଅଧିକ ପକାନ୍ତୁ।
seg.9cad3a0176bc.back: Mix in palm jaggery and cardamom. Serve warm. Stir until the jaggery melts completely, then taste and add a little more if needed.

seg.a8de8fe6382d.src: Pour into tumblers or bowls. If it is too thick to drink, stir in a few spoons of warm milk.
seg.a8de8fe6382d.t: ଟମ୍ବଲର ବା ବାଟିରେ ଢାଳନ୍ତୁ। ପିଇବା ପାଇଁ ବହୁତ ବହଳ ହେଲେ କିଛି ଚାମଚ ଉଷୁମ କ୍ଷୀର ମିଶାନ୍ତୁ।
seg.a8de8fe6382d.back: Pour into a tumbler or bowl. If too thick to drink mix in a few spoons of warm milk.

seg.c3916a972329.src: Always mix the ragi flour in water first; flour added straight to boiling water forms lumps that do not break up.
seg.c3916a972329.t: ସବୁବେଳେ ରାଗି ଗୁଣ୍ଡକୁ ପ୍ରଥମେ ପାଣିରେ ଗୋଳନ୍ତୁ; ସିଧା ଫୁଟୁଥିବା ପାଣିରେ ପକାଇଲେ ଗୁଣ୍ଡା ବାନ୍ଧେ ଯାହା ଭାଙ୍ଗେ ନାହିଁ।
seg.c3916a972329.back: Always mix the ragi flour in water first; added straight into boiling water it forms lumps that do not break.

seg.966098732312.src: Do not rush the cooking; undercooked ragi tastes raw and floury.
seg.966098732312.t: ତରବରରେ ରାନ୍ଧନ୍ତୁ ନାହିଁ; କମ୍ ରନ୍ଧା ରାଗି କଞ୍ଚା ଓ ଗୁଣ୍ଡିଆ ଲାଗେ।
seg.966098732312.back: Do not cook in a hurry; undercooked ragi tastes raw and floury.

seg.7c0f350f3691.src: For a thinner java to drink from a tumbler, use 2 tbsp ragi flour; for a spoonable porridge, use ⅓ cup.
seg.7c0f350f3691.t: ଟମ୍ବଲରରୁ ପିଇବା ପାଇଁ ପତଳା ଜାଭା ଚାହିଁଲେ 2 ଟେବୁଲ ଚାମଚ ରାଗି ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ନିଅନ୍ତୁ; ଚାମଚରେ ଖାଇବା ଜାଉ ପାଇଁ ⅓ କପ ନିଅନ୍ତୁ।
seg.7c0f350f3691.back: If you want a thinner java to drink from a tumbler take 2 tablespoons ragi flour; for a porridge to eat with a spoon take ⅓ cup.

seg.146636ba6c2e.src: With dry fruit: stir in a few chopped cashews or almonds and a spoon of raisins at the end.
seg.146636ba6c2e.t: ଶୁଖିଲା ଫଳ ସହିତ: ଶେଷରେ କିଛି କଟା କାଜୁ ବା ଆଲମଣ୍ଡ ଓ ଚାମଚେ କିସମିସ ମିଶାନ୍ତୁ।
seg.146636ba6c2e.back: With dry fruits: at the end mix in some chopped cashews or almonds and a spoon of raisins.

seg.6fc3ada569ad.src: Without milk: cook the ragi in 2½ cups water and stir in the jaggery once it has stopped bubbling, for a thinner, darker java.
seg.6fc3ada569ad.t: କ୍ଷୀର ବିନା: ପତଳା ଓ ଗାଢ଼ ରଙ୍ଗର ଜାଭା ପାଇଁ ରାଗିକୁ 2½ କପ ପାଣିରେ ରାନ୍ଧନ୍ତୁ, ଆଉ ଫୁଟିବା ବନ୍ଦ ହେବା ପରେ ଗୁଡ଼ ମିଶାନ୍ତୁ।
seg.6fc3ada569ad.back: Without milk: for a thinner and darker java cook the ragi in 2½ cups water, and mix in the jaggery after it stops boiling.

seg.639ea388ead3.src: Serve warm in a steel tumbler or bowl for breakfast, or as an evening drink with a few biscuits or murukulu. Some like it chilled in summer.
seg.639ea388ead3.t: ସକାଳ ଜଳଖିଆ ପାଇଁ ଷ୍ଟିଲ ଟମ୍ବଲର ବା ବାଟିରେ ଉଷୁମ ଉଷୁମ ପରଷନ୍ତୁ, କିମ୍ବା ସନ୍ଧ୍ୟା ପାନୀୟ ଭାବେ କିଛି ବିସ୍କୁଟ ବା ମୁରୁକୁଲୁ ସହିତ। ଗ୍ରୀଷ୍ମରେ କେହି କେହି ଏହାକୁ ଥଣ୍ଡା କରି ପିଅନ୍ତି।
seg.639ea388ead3.back: Serve warm in a steel tumbler or bowl for morning breakfast, or as an evening drink with some biscuits or murukulu. In summer some people drink it chilled.

seg.e770a9eec01e.src: Best drunk the day it is made. Keep leftovers covered in the fridge for up to 1 day and stir in a little warm milk, off the heat, when reheating.
seg.e770a9eec01e.t: ତିଆରି ଦିନ ପିଇବା ସବୁଠୁ ଭଲ। ବଳକା ଘୋଡ଼ାଇ ଫ୍ରିଜରେ 1 ଦିନ ପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ ରଖନ୍ତୁ, ଆଉ ପୁଣି ଗରମ କଲାବେଳେ ନିଆଁ ବାହାରେ ଟିକିଏ ଉଷୁମ କ୍ଷୀର ମିଶାନ୍ତୁ।
seg.e770a9eec01e.back: Best drunk on the day it is made. Keep leftovers covered in the fridge up to 1 day, and when reheating mix in a little warm milk off the flame.

seg.a10b6147a5ac.src: How do I make ragi java without lumps?
seg.a10b6147a5ac.t: ଗୁଣ୍ଡା ନ ବାନ୍ଧି ରାଗି ଜାଭା କିପରି ତିଆରି କରିବି?
seg.a10b6147a5ac.back: How do I make ragi java without lumps?

seg.ca8628b7e082.src: Whisk the ragi flour into room-temperature water first until smooth, then pour this into boiling water while stirring all the time.
seg.ca8628b7e082.t: ପ୍ରଥମେ ରାଗି ଗୁଣ୍ଡକୁ ସାଧାରଣ ତାପମାତ୍ରାର ପାଣିରେ ମସୃଣ ହେବା ଯାଏ ଫେଣନ୍ତୁ, ତାପରେ ସବୁବେଳେ ଘାଣ୍ଟୁ ଘାଣ୍ଟୁ ଏହାକୁ ଫୁଟୁଥିବା ପାଣିରେ ଢାଳନ୍ତୁ।
seg.ca8628b7e082.back: First whisk the ragi flour smooth in room-temperature water, then pour it into boiling water while stirring all the time.

seg.8bd78affc52d.src: How do I know ragi java is cooked?
seg.8bd78affc52d.t: ରାଗି ଜାଭା ରନ୍ଧା ହୋଇଛି କି ନାହିଁ କିପରି ଜାଣିବି?
seg.8bd78affc52d.back: How do I know whether ragi java is cooked?

seg.9b05db7490cb.src: It turns darker and glossy, thickens enough to coat the back of a spoon, and no longer tastes floury. This takes about 6–8 minutes on low heat.
seg.9b05db7490cb.t: ଏହା ଗାଢ଼ ଓ ଚକଚକିଆ ହୁଏ, ଚାମଚର ପଛ ପଟରେ ଲାଗିବା ପରି ବହଳ ହୁଏ, ଆଉ ଗୁଣ୍ଡିଆ ସ୍ୱାଦ ଆଉ ରହେ ନାହିଁ। ଧିମା ନିଆଁରେ ଏଥିରେ ପ୍ରାୟ 6–8 ମିନିଟ ଲାଗେ।
seg.9b05db7490cb.back: It becomes deep coloured and glossy, thick enough to coat the back of a spoon, and the floury taste no longer remains. On low flame this takes about 6–8 minutes.

seg.6d748d67adfb.src: Can I use palm jaggery in ragi java?
seg.6d748d67adfb.t: ରାଗି ଜାଭାରେ ତାଳ ଗୁଡ଼ ବ୍ୟବହାର କରିପାରିବି କି?
seg.6d748d67adfb.back: Can I use palm jaggery in ragi java?

seg.06e768643767.src: Yes. Grate the palm jaggery (thati bellam) finely and stir it in after switching off the stove, so the milk does not split. It gives a deeper colour and a slightly smoky sweetness.
seg.06e768643767.t: ହଁ। ତାଳ ଗୁଡ଼ (ତାଟି ବେଲ୍ଲମ)କୁ ମିହି କରି କୋରି ଚୁଲି ବନ୍ଦ କରିବା ପରେ ମିଶାନ୍ତୁ, ଯେପରି କ୍ଷୀର ନ ଫାଟେ। ଏହା ଗାଢ଼ ରଙ୍ଗ ଓ ଟିକିଏ ଧୂଆଁ ପରି ମିଠା ଦିଏ।
seg.06e768643767.back: Yes. Grate palm jaggery (tati bellam) finely and mix in after turning off the stove, so the milk does not curdle. It gives a deep colour and a slightly smoky sweetness.

seg.9a71713417de.src: What is the difference between ragi java and ragi malt?
seg.9a71713417de.t: ରାଗି ଜାଭା ଓ ରାଗି ମାଲ୍ଟ ମଧ୍ୟରେ ଫରକ କଣ?
seg.9a71713417de.back: What is the difference between ragi java and ragi malt?

seg.c2632b6d0b4f.src: They are the same drink with different names. Ragi java is the Telugu name; ragi malt is what it is often called in shops and on menus.
seg.c2632b6d0b4f.t: ଦୁହେଁ ସେହି ଏକା ପାନୀୟ, କେବଳ ନାମ ଅଲଗା। ରାଗି ଜାଭା ହେଉଛି ତେଲୁଗୁ ନାମ; ଦୋକାନ ଓ ମେନୁରେ ଅନେକ ସମୟରେ ଏହାକୁ ରାଗି ମାଲ୍ଟ କୁହାଯାଏ।
seg.c2632b6d0b4f.back: Both are that same drink, only the name differs. Ragi java is the Telugu name; in shops and menus it is often called ragi malt.

seg.6134777fbfa8.src: రాగి జావ · Sweet Ragi Java Recipe | 1acrefarms
seg.6134777fbfa8.t: రాగి జావ · ମିଠା ରାଗି ଜାଭା ରେସିପି | 1acrefarms
seg.6134777fbfa8.back: రాగి జావ · Sweet Ragi Java recipe | 1acrefarms

seg.708e3c523d72.src: రాగి జావ. Sweet ragi java, the Andhra way: ragi flour cooked in water till glossy, loosened with milk and sweetened with Thati Bellam palm jaggery. Method and tips.
seg.708e3c523d72.t: రాగి జావ. ଆନ୍ଧ୍ର ଢଙ୍ଗର ମିଠା ରାଗି ଜାଭା: ରାଗି ଗୁଣ୍ଡକୁ ପାଣିରେ ଚକଚକିଆ ହେବା ଯାଏ ରାନ୍ଧି, କ୍ଷୀରରେ ପତଳା କରି ତାଟି ବେଲ୍ଲମ ତାଳ ଗୁଡ଼ରେ ମିଠା କରାଯାଏ। ପ୍ରଣାଳୀ ଓ ଟିପ୍ସ।
seg.708e3c523d72.back: రాగి జావ. Andhra-style sweet ragi java: ragi flour cooked in water until glossy, thinned with milk and sweetened with tati bellam palm jaggery. Method and tips.

seg.2889ed2cf93b.src: Ragi Java: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.2889ed2cf93b.t: ରାଗି ଜାଭା: 1acrefarmsର ରେସିପି କାର୍ଡ, ଉପକରଣ ଓ ପ୍ରଣାଳୀ ସହିତ
seg.2889ed2cf93b.back: Ragi Java: 1acrefarms recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.671d48882eed.src: Iguru is the Andhra way of cooking meat or prawns down in a thick onion masala until almost dry, so the spices cling to every piece. Royyala iguru comes from the coastal districts, from Nellore to Godavari to Srikakulam, where prawns from the backwaters and the sea are a Sunday lunch with rice.
seg.671d48882eed.t: ଇଗୁରୁ ହେଉଛି ମାଂସ ବା ଚିଙ୍ଗୁଡ଼ିକୁ ବହଳ ପିଆଜ ମସଲାରେ ପ୍ରାୟ ଶୁଖିଲା ହେବା ଯାଏ ରାନ୍ଧିବାର ଆନ୍ଧ୍ର ଢଙ୍ଗ, ଯେପରି ମସଲା ପ୍ରତ୍ୟେକ ଖଣ୍ଡରେ ଲାଖିଯାଏ। ରୋୟ୍ୟଲ ଇଗୁରୁ ଉପକୂଳ ଜିଲ୍ଲାରୁ ଆସିଛି, ନେଲ୍ଲୋରରୁ ଗୋଦାବରୀ ହୋଇ ଶ୍ରୀକାକୁଲମ ପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ, ଯେଉଁଠି ବ୍ୟାକୱାଟର ଓ ସମୁଦ୍ରର ଚିଙ୍ଗୁଡ଼ି ଭାତ ସହିତ ରବିବାର ମଧ୍ୟାହ୍ନ ଭୋଜନ।
seg.671d48882eed.back: Iguru is the Andhra way of cooking meat or prawns in a thick onion masala until almost dry, so the masala clings to every piece. Royyala iguru comes from the coastal districts, from Nellore through Godavari to Srikakulam, where backwater and sea prawns with rice are Sunday lunch.

seg.ff39877dbdbd.src: Our hill turmeric powder (Konda Pasupu) goes on the prawns first and into the masala. Teja chilli powder brings the deep red colour and strong heat coastal homes like, so scale it to your table.
seg.ff39877dbdbd.t: ଆମ ପାହାଡ଼ିଆ ହଳଦୀ ଗୁଣ୍ଡ (କୋଣ୍ଡା ପସୁପୁ) ପ୍ରଥମେ ଚିଙ୍ଗୁଡ଼ିରେ ଲାଗେ ଓ ମସଲାରେ ପଡ଼େ। ତେଜା ଲଙ୍କା ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ଗାଢ଼ ଲାଲ ରଙ୍ଗ ଓ ଉପକୂଳର ଘରେ ପସନ୍ଦର କଡ଼ା ରାଗ ଆଣେ, ତେଣୁ ଆପଣଙ୍କ ପରିବାରର ପସନ୍ଦ ଅନୁସାରେ ପରିମାଣ ଠିକ କରନ୍ତୁ।
seg.ff39877dbdbd.back: Our hill turmeric powder (konda pasupu) first goes on the prawns and into the masala. Teja chilli powder brings a deep red colour and the strong heat liked in coastal homes, so adjust the amount to your family's liking.

seg.885826f68de3.src: Prep includes cleaning the prawns and the 10-minute rest with turmeric.
seg.885826f68de3.t: ପ୍ରସ୍ତୁତି ସମୟରେ ଚିଙ୍ଗୁଡ଼ି ସଫା କରିବା ଓ ହଳଦୀ ସହିତ 10 ମିନିଟ ରଖିବା ଅଛି।
seg.885826f68de3.back: The preparation time includes cleaning the prawns and keeping them 10 minutes with turmeric.

seg.cff5bbd725a6.src: Rub prawns with turmeric and salt. Fry onions and ginger-garlic paste, add Teja chilli powder and coriander powder, then cook the prawns in the masala till it coats them.
seg.cff5bbd725a6.t: ଚିଙ୍ଗୁଡ଼ିରେ ହଳଦୀ ଓ ଲୁଣ ଘଷନ୍ତୁ। ପିଆଜ ଓ ଅଦା-ରସୁଣ ବଟା ଭାଜି, ତେଜା ଲଙ୍କା ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ଓ ଧନିଆ ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ପକାନ୍ତୁ, ତାପରେ ମସଲା ଲାଖିବା ଯାଏ ଚିଙ୍ଗୁଡ଼ିକୁ ମସଲାରେ ରାନ୍ଧନ୍ତୁ।
seg.cff5bbd725a6.back: Rub turmeric and salt onto the prawns. Fry onion and ginger-garlic paste, add Teja chilli powder and coriander powder, then cook the prawns in the masala until the masala clings.

seg.cf489166a3fd.src: 500 g prawns ⟦1⟧medium size, shelled and deveined, weighed after cleaning⟦/1⟧
seg.cf489166a3fd.t: 500 g ଚିଙ୍ଗୁଡ଼ି ⟦1⟧ମଧ୍ୟମ ଆକାର, ଚୋପା ଓ କଳା ଶିରା ବାହାର କରା, ସଫା କରିବା ପରେ ଓଜନ⟦/1⟧
seg.cf489166a3fd.back: 500 g prawns ⟦1⟧medium size, shell and black vein removed, weight after cleaning⟦/1⟧

seg.141eb60cb009.src: ¾ tsp salt ⟦1⟧divided, or to taste⟦/1⟧
seg.141eb60cb009.t: ¾ ଚା ଚାମଚ ଲୁଣ ⟦1⟧ଦୁଇ ଭାଗରେ, କିମ୍ବା ସ୍ୱାଦ ଅନୁସାରେ⟦/1⟧
seg.141eb60cb009.back: ¾ teaspoon salt ⟦1⟧in two parts, or as per taste⟦/1⟧

seg.716dc45cf0b3.src: ½ tsp hill turmeric powder ⟦1⟧Konda Pasupu; ¼ tsp for the prawns, ¼ tsp for the masala⟦/1⟧
seg.716dc45cf0b3.t: ½ ଚା ଚାମଚ ପାହାଡ଼ିଆ ହଳଦୀ ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ⟦1⟧କୋଣ୍ଡା ପସୁପୁ; ¼ ଚା ଚାମଚ ଚିଙ୍ଗୁଡ଼ି ପାଇଁ, ¼ ଚା ଚାମଚ ମସଲା ପାଇଁ⟦/1⟧
seg.716dc45cf0b3.back: ½ teaspoon hill turmeric powder ⟦1⟧konda pasupu; ¼ teaspoon for the prawns, ¼ teaspoon for the masala⟦/1⟧

seg.f7ec1e72abc0.src: 1½ tsp Teja chilli powder ⟦1⟧very hot; use 1 tsp for medium heat, ½ tsp for mild⟦/1⟧
seg.f7ec1e72abc0.t: 1½ ଚା ଚାମଚ ତେଜା ଲଙ୍କା ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ⟦1⟧ବହୁତ ରାଗୁଆ; ମଧ୍ୟମ ରାଗ ପାଇଁ 1 ଚା ଚାମଚ, କମ୍ ରାଗ ପାଇଁ ½ ଚା ଚାମଚ⟦/1⟧
seg.f7ec1e72abc0.back: 1½ teaspoons Teja chilli powder ⟦1⟧very hot; for medium heat 1 teaspoon, for less heat ½ teaspoon⟦/1⟧

seg.fce641038ff4.src: Shell and devein the prawns, rinse them well and drain in a colander.
seg.fce641038ff4.t: ଚିଙ୍ଗୁଡ଼ିର ଚୋପା ଓ କଳା ଶିରା ବାହାର କରନ୍ତୁ, ଭଲ କରି ଧୋଇ ଚଲାଣିରେ ପାଣି ଛାଣନ୍ତୁ।
seg.fce641038ff4.back: Remove the shell and black vein of the prawns, wash well and drain in a colander.

seg.152d1d89f6a5.src: Rub the prawns with half the turmeric and a little salt; set aside 10 minutes. Use ¼ tsp turmeric and ¼ tsp of the salt.
seg.152d1d89f6a5.t: ଚିଙ୍ଗୁଡ଼ିରେ ଅଧା ହଳଦୀ ଓ ଟିକିଏ ଲୁଣ ଘଷନ୍ତୁ; 10 ମିନିଟ ଅଲଗା ରଖନ୍ତୁ। ¼ ଚା ଚାମଚ ହଳଦୀ ଓ ଲୁଣରୁ ¼ ଚା ଚାମଚ ନିଅନ୍ତୁ।
seg.152d1d89f6a5.back: Rub half the turmeric and a little salt onto the prawns; keep aside 10 minutes. Take ¼ teaspoon turmeric and ¼ teaspoon of the salt.

seg.9e027c56020d.src: Heat the oil in a heavy kadai on medium heat and add the mustard seeds. When they splutter, add the green chillies and curry leaves.
seg.9e027c56020d.t: ଏକ ମୋଟା କଡ଼ାଇରେ ମଧ୍ୟମ ନିଆଁରେ ତେଲ ଗରମ କରି ସୋରିଷ ପକାନ୍ତୁ। ଫୁଟିଲେ କଞ୍ଚା ଲଙ୍କା ଓ ଭୃସଙ୍ଗ ପତ୍ର ପକାନ୍ତୁ।
seg.9e027c56020d.back: Heat oil in a thick kadai on medium flame and add mustard. When it splutters add green chilli and curry leaves.

seg.5d608fabeb97.src: Fry the onions in the oil till golden, then the ginger-garlic paste till it smells cooked. The onions take about 8–10 minutes; the paste about 1 minute, until the raw smell goes.
seg.5d608fabeb97.t: ପିଆଜକୁ ତେଲରେ ସୁନେଲି ହେବା ଯାଏ ଭାଜନ୍ତୁ, ତାପରେ ଅଦା-ରସୁଣ ବଟାକୁ ରନ୍ଧା ବାସନା ଆସିବା ଯାଏ। ପିଆଜରେ ପ୍ରାୟ 8–10 ମିନିଟ ଲାଗେ; ବଟାରେ ପ୍ରାୟ 1 ମିନିଟ, କଞ୍ଚା ଗନ୍ଧ ଯିବା ଯାଏ।
seg.5d608fabeb97.back: Fry the onion in the oil until golden, then the ginger-garlic paste until a cooked aroma comes. The onion takes about 8–10 minutes; the paste about 1 minute, until the raw smell goes.

seg.7677bdc79559.src: If using the tomato, add it now and cook until soft and pulpy, about 4 minutes.
seg.7677bdc79559.t: ଟମାଟା ବ୍ୟବହାର କରୁଥିଲେ ଏବେ ପକାଇ ନରମ ଓ ଚକଟା ହେବା ଯାଏ ରାନ୍ଧନ୍ତୁ, ପ୍ରାୟ 4 ମିନିଟ।
seg.7677bdc79559.back: If using tomato add it now and cook until soft and mashed, about 4 minutes.

seg.5aff56b73c8a.src: Turn the heat to low. Add the rest of the turmeric, Teja chilli powder and coriander powder; fry 1 minute. Add the remaining salt and stir so the spices do not catch.
seg.5aff56b73c8a.t: ନିଆଁ ଧିମା କରନ୍ତୁ। ବାକି ହଳଦୀ, ତେଜା ଲଙ୍କା ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ଓ ଧନିଆ ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ପକାନ୍ତୁ; 1 ମିନିଟ ଭାଜନ୍ତୁ। ବାକି ଲୁଣ ପକାଇ ଘାଣ୍ଟନ୍ତୁ ଯେପରି ମସଲା ତଳେ ନ ଲାଗେ।
seg.5aff56b73c8a.back: Lower the flame. Add the remaining turmeric, Teja chilli powder and coriander powder; fry 1 minute. Add the remaining salt and stir so the masala does not stick to the bottom.

seg.ba25fbb9cf98.src: Pour in the water and cook the masala on medium heat until the oil starts to separate at the edges, about 3–4 minutes.
seg.ba25fbb9cf98.t: ପାଣି ଢାଳି ମଧ୍ୟମ ନିଆଁରେ ମସଲାକୁ କଡ଼ରେ ତେଲ ଅଲଗା ହେବା ଆରମ୍ଭ ହେବା ଯାଏ ରାନ୍ଧନ୍ତୁ, ପ୍ରାୟ 3–4 ମିନିଟ।
seg.ba25fbb9cf98.back: Pour in water and on medium flame cook the masala until oil begins to separate at the sides, about 3–4 minutes.

seg.e60a6389cdf2.src: Add the prawns and cook till they curl and turn pink, 5–6 minutes. Finish with garam masala. Stir often on medium-high heat so the masala dries and coats the prawns.
seg.e60a6389cdf2.t: ଚିଙ୍ଗୁଡ଼ି ପକାଇ ମୋଡ଼ି ହୋଇ ଗୋଲାପି ହେବା ଯାଏ ରାନ୍ଧନ୍ତୁ, 5–6 ମିନିଟ। ଶେଷରେ ଗରମ ମସଲା ପକାନ୍ତୁ। ମଧ୍ୟମରୁ ତେଜ ନିଆଁରେ ବାରମ୍ବାର ଘାଣ୍ଟନ୍ତୁ ଯେପରି ମସଲା ଶୁଖି ଚିଙ୍ଗୁଡ଼ିରେ ଲାଖିଯାଏ।
seg.e60a6389cdf2.back: Add the prawns and cook until they curl and turn pink, 5–6 minutes. At the end add garam masala. On medium-to-high flame stir often so the masala dries and clings to the prawns.

seg.af87e48d1429.src: Check doneness: prawns are cooked when they are pink and opaque all the way through and curled into a loose C. Cut one open if unsure; there should be no grey, see-through centre.
seg.af87e48d1429.t: ସିଝିଛି କି ନାହିଁ ଦେଖନ୍ତୁ: ଚିଙ୍ଗୁଡ଼ି ଭିତର ଯାଏ ଗୋଲାପି ଓ ଅସ୍ୱଚ୍ଛ ହୋଇ ଢିଲା C ଆକାରରେ ମୋଡ଼ି ହେଲେ ସିଝିଯାଇଛି। ନିଶ୍ଚିତ ନ ଥିଲେ ଗୋଟିଏ କାଟି ଦେଖନ୍ତୁ; ମଝିରେ ଧୂସର, ସ୍ୱଚ୍ଛ ଅଂଶ ନ ଥିବା ଉଚିତ।
seg.af87e48d1429.back: Check whether cooked: when the prawns turn pink and opaque through to the inside and curl into a loose C shape, they are cooked. If not sure cut one and check; there should be no grey, translucent part in the middle.

seg.32e58c09609e.src: Taste for salt, scatter the coriander leaves and switch off. Do not keep cooking once the prawns are done, or they turn rubbery.
seg.32e58c09609e.t: ଲୁଣ ଚାଖନ୍ତୁ, ଧନିଆ ପତ୍ର ଛିଞ୍ଚି ନିଆଁ ବନ୍ଦ କରନ୍ତୁ। ଚିଙ୍ଗୁଡ଼ି ସିଝିଗଲା ପରେ ଆଉ ରାନ୍ଧନ୍ତୁ ନାହିଁ, ନଚେତ୍ ରବର ପରି ଟାଣ ହୋଇଯାଏ।
seg.32e58c09609e.back: Taste for salt, sprinkle coriander leaves and turn off the flame. Do not cook the prawns any more after they are cooked, otherwise they turn rubbery-hard.

seg.89a9cb293875.src: Teja is very hot: 1½ tsp makes a fiery iguru the way coastal homes like it; use 1 tsp for medium heat, or ½ tsp for mild.
seg.89a9cb293875.t: ତେଜା ବହୁତ ରାଗୁଆ: 1½ ଚା ଚାମଚରେ ଉପକୂଳର ଘରେ ପସନ୍ଦର ଭଳି ବହୁତ ରାଗୁଆ ଇଗୁରୁ ହୁଏ; ମଧ୍ୟମ ରାଗ ପାଇଁ 1 ଚା ଚାମଚ, କିମ୍ବା କମ୍ ରାଗ ପାଇଁ ½ ଚା ଚାମଚ ନିଅନ୍ତୁ।
seg.89a9cb293875.back: Teja is very hot: 1½ teaspoons makes a very hot iguru as liked in coastal homes; for medium heat take 1 teaspoon, or for less heat ½ teaspoon.

seg.095c6105ce36.src: Fry the onions until properly golden; the colour and body of an iguru come from well-browned onions.
seg.095c6105ce36.t: ପିଆଜକୁ ଠିକ ଭାବେ ସୁନେଲି ହେବା ଯାଏ ଭାଜନ୍ତୁ; ଇଗୁରୁର ରଙ୍ଗ ଓ ବହଳତା ଭଲ ଭଜା ପିଆଜରୁ ହିଁ ଆସେ।
seg.095c6105ce36.back: Fry the onion properly until golden; the colour and thickness of the iguru come from well-fried onion alone.

seg.04fb6307d058.src: Prawns cook fast. A loose C shape means done; a tight O means overcooked and chewy.
seg.04fb6307d058.t: ଚିଙ୍ଗୁଡ଼ି ଶୀଘ୍ର ସିଝେ। ଢିଲା C ଆକାର ମାନେ ସିଝିଗଲା; ଟାଣ O ଆକାର ମାନେ ବେଶି ସିଝି ରବର ପରି ହୋଇଗଲା।
seg.04fb6307d058.back: Prawns cook quickly. A loose C shape means cooked; a tight O shape means overcooked and rubbery.

seg.a5e6a832090a.src: Pat the prawns dry after rinsing so they fry in the masala instead of stewing in water.
seg.a5e6a832090a.t: ଧୋଇବା ପରେ ଚିଙ୍ଗୁଡ଼ିକୁ ପୋଛି ଶୁଖାନ୍ତୁ, ଯେପରି ପାଣିରେ ସିଝିବା ବଦଳରେ ମସଲାରେ ଭଜା ହୁଏ।
seg.a5e6a832090a.back: After washing pat the prawns dry, so they fry in the masala instead of boiling in water.

seg.4145e1ca56b5.src: Gongura royyalu: stir in ½ cup gongura leaves, wilted in a little oil and mashed, with the prawns.
seg.4145e1ca56b5.t: ଗୋଙ୍ଗୁରା ରୋୟ୍ୟଲୁ: ଅଳ୍ପ ତେଲରେ ଅଉଁଳାଇ ଚକଟା ½ କପ ଗୋଙ୍ଗୁରା ପତ୍ର ଚିଙ୍ଗୁଡ଼ି ସହିତ ମିଶାନ୍ତୁ।
seg.4145e1ca56b5.back: Gongura royyalu: mix ½ cup gongura leaves wilted in a little oil and mashed in with the prawns.

seg.e52b316e5c51.src: Coconut: add 2 tbsp grated coconut or 3 tbsp thick coconut milk in the last 2 minutes for a softer, richer masala.
seg.e52b316e5c51.t: ନଡ଼ିଆ: ନରମ ଓ ଭରପୂର ମସଲା ପାଇଁ ଶେଷ 2 ମିନିଟରେ 2 ଟେବୁଲ ଚାମଚ କୋରା ନଡ଼ିଆ ବା 3 ଟେବୁଲ ଚାମଚ ବହଳ ନଡ଼ିଆ କ୍ଷୀର ପକାନ୍ତୁ।
seg.e52b316e5c51.back: Coconut: for a softer and richer masala add 2 tablespoons grated coconut or 3 tablespoons thick coconut milk in the last 2 minutes.

seg.fc55c7b1a788.src: Gravy style: add ¾ cup water after the prawns for a thinner royyala kura to pour over rice.
seg.fc55c7b1a788.t: ଗ୍ରେଭି ଶୈଳୀ: ଭାତ ଉପରେ ଢାଳିବା ପାଇଁ ପତଳା ରୋୟ୍ୟଲ କୂରା ଚାହିଁଲେ ଚିଙ୍ଗୁଡ଼ି ପରେ ¾ କପ ପାଣି ପକାନ୍ତୁ।
seg.fc55c7b1a788.back: Gravy style: if you want a thinner royyala koora for pouring over rice add ¾ cup water after the prawns.

seg.8ccb6d545dd0.src: Serve hot with steamed rice and a spoon of ghee, or with rasam or sambar rice. It also goes well with chapati.
seg.8ccb6d545dd0.t: ଗରମ ଭାତ ଓ ଚାମଚେ ଘିଅ ସହିତ, କିମ୍ବା ରସମ ବା ସାମ୍ବର ଭାତ ସହିତ ଗରମ ଗରମ ପରଷନ୍ତୁ। ଚପାତି ସହିତ ମଧ୍ୟ ଭଲ ଲାଗେ।
seg.8ccb6d545dd0.back: Serve piping hot with hot rice and a spoon of ghee, or with rasam or sambar rice. Also goes well with chapati.

seg.d51021b311d0.src: Keep leftovers covered in the fridge and eat within 1 day. Warm gently in a pan; long reheating makes the prawns tough.
seg.d51021b311d0.t: ବଳକା ଘୋଡ଼ାଇ ଫ୍ରିଜରେ ରଖନ୍ତୁ ଓ 1 ଦିନ ଭିତରେ ଖାଆନ୍ତୁ। ପ୍ୟାନରେ ଧୀରେ ଗରମ କରନ୍ତୁ; ବହୁତ ସମୟ ଗରମ କଲେ ଚିଙ୍ଗୁଡ଼ି ଟାଣ ହୋଇଯାଏ।
seg.d51021b311d0.back: Keep leftovers covered in the fridge and eat within 1 day. Heat gently in a pan; heating a long time makes the prawns hard.

seg.8381d6ac4e4f.src: How do I know when prawns are cooked?
seg.8381d6ac4e4f.t: ଚିଙ୍ଗୁଡ଼ି ସିଝିଛି କି ନାହିଁ କିପରି ଜାଣିବି?
seg.8381d6ac4e4f.back: How do I know whether the prawns are cooked?

seg.45cd36ecb77b.src: They turn pink and opaque all the way through and curl into a loose C shape, usually in 5–6 minutes in the hot masala. A grey, see-through centre means they need a little longer.
seg.45cd36ecb77b.t: ଏଗୁଡ଼ିକ ଭିତର ଯାଏ ଗୋଲାପି ଓ ଅସ୍ୱଚ୍ଛ ହୋଇ ଢିଲା C ଆକାରରେ ମୋଡ଼ି ହୁଏ, ଗରମ ମସଲାରେ ସାଧାରଣତଃ 5–6 ମିନିଟରେ। ମଝିରେ ଧୂସର, ସ୍ୱଚ୍ଛ ଅଂଶ ଥିଲେ ଆଉ ଟିକିଏ ସମୟ ଦରକାର।
seg.45cd36ecb77b.back: They turn pink and opaque through to the inside and curl into a loose C shape, usually in 5–6 minutes in hot masala. If there is a grey, translucent part in the middle they need a little more time.

seg.2e4c4a4632d7.src: What is the difference between iguru and vepudu?
seg.2e4c4a4632d7.t: ଇଗୁରୁ ଓ ଭେପୁଡୁ ମଧ୍ୟରେ ଫରକ କଣ?
seg.2e4c4a4632d7.back: What is the difference between iguru and vepudu?

seg.1ee73f38a967.src: Iguru is cooked down in an onion masala until thick and almost dry, with the masala clinging to the prawns. Vepudu is a fry, with less or no onion gravy, cooked until the prawns are crisp at the edges.
seg.1ee73f38a967.t: ଇଗୁରୁକୁ ପିଆଜ ମସଲାରେ ବହଳ ଓ ପ୍ରାୟ ଶୁଖିଲା ହେବା ଯାଏ ରନ୍ଧାଯାଏ, ମସଲା ଚିଙ୍ଗୁଡ଼ିରେ ଲାଖି ରହେ। ଭେପୁଡୁ ହେଉଛି ଭଜା, କମ୍ ବା ପିଆଜ ଗ୍ରେଭି ବିନା, ଚିଙ୍ଗୁଡ଼ିର କଡ଼ କୁରକୁରିଆ ହେବା ଯାଏ ରନ୍ଧା।
seg.1ee73f38a967.back: Iguru is cooked in onion masala until thick and almost dry, the masala clinging to the prawns. Vepudu is a fry, with little or no onion gravy, cooked until the edges of the prawns are crunchy.

seg.d248a2970455.src: How can I make royyala iguru less spicy?
seg.d248a2970455.t: ରୋୟ୍ୟଲ ଇଗୁରୁକୁ କିପରି କମ୍ ରାଗୁଆ କରିବି?
seg.d248a2970455.back: How do I make royyala iguru less hot?

seg.8c9c12b68361.src: Use 1 tsp Teja chilli powder for medium heat or ½ tsp for mild, and skip the green chillies. A tablespoon of curd or coconut milk at the end also softens the heat.
seg.8c9c12b68361.t: ମଧ୍ୟମ ରାଗ ପାଇଁ 1 ଚା ଚାମଚ ବା କମ୍ ରାଗ ପାଇଁ ½ ଚା ଚାମଚ ତେଜା ଲଙ୍କା ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ନିଅନ୍ତୁ, ଆଉ କଞ୍ଚା ଲଙ୍କା ବାଦ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ। ଶେଷରେ ଟେବୁଲ ଚାମଚେ ଦହି ବା ନଡ଼ିଆ କ୍ଷୀର ମଧ୍ୟ ରାଗ ନରମ କରେ।
seg.8c9c12b68361.back: Take 1 teaspoon Teja chilli powder for medium heat or ½ teaspoon for less heat, and leave out the green chillies. A tablespoon of curd or coconut milk at the end also softens the heat.

seg.9cd9740c2604.src: Yes. Thaw them in the fridge, drain them well and pat them dry before rubbing with turmeric and salt. Frozen prawns release more water, so cook the masala a little longer.
seg.9cd9740c2604.t: ହଁ। ଫ୍ରିଜରେ ବରଫ ତରଳାନ୍ତୁ, ଭଲ କରି ପାଣି ଛାଣନ୍ତୁ ଓ ହଳଦୀ ଓ ଲୁଣ ଘଷିବା ଆଗରୁ ପୋଛି ଶୁଖାନ୍ତୁ। ଫ୍ରୋଜେନ ଚିଙ୍ଗୁଡ଼ିରୁ ଅଧିକ ପାଣି ବାହାରେ, ତେଣୁ ମସଲାକୁ ଟିକିଏ ଅଧିକ ସମୟ ରାନ୍ଧନ୍ତୁ।
seg.9cd9740c2604.back: Yes. Thaw in the fridge, drain the water well and pat dry before rubbing on turmeric and salt. Frozen prawns release more water, so cook the masala a little longer.

seg.0484ea984ed7.src: రొయ్యల ఇగురు. Royyala iguru, the coastal Andhra prawn roast: prawns cooked down in onion masala with hill turmeric powder and fiery Teja chilli powder. Serves 4.
seg.0484ea984ed7.t: రొయ్యల ఇగురు. ରୋୟ୍ୟଲ ଇଗୁରୁ, ଉପକୂଳ ଆନ୍ଧ୍ରର ଚିଙ୍ଗୁଡ଼ି ରୋଷ୍ଟ: ପାହାଡ଼ିଆ ହଳଦୀ ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ଓ ବହୁତ ରାଗୁଆ ତେଜା ଲଙ୍କା ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ସହିତ ପିଆଜ ମସଲାରେ ରନ୍ଧା ଚିଙ୍ଗୁଡ଼ି। 4 ଜଣଙ୍କ ପାଇଁ।
seg.0484ea984ed7.back: రొయ్యల ఇగురు. Royyala iguru, coastal Andhra prawn roast: prawns cooked in onion masala with hill turmeric powder and very hot Teja chilli powder. For 4 people.

seg.1b1d6a89c215.src: Royyala Iguru: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.1b1d6a89c215.t: ରୋୟ୍ୟଲ ଇଗୁରୁ: 1acrefarmsର ରେସିପି କାର୍ଡ, ଉପକରଣ ଓ ପ୍ରଣାଳୀ ସହିତ
seg.1b1d6a89c215.back: Royyala Iguru: 1acrefarms recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.965a1e93fb08.src: Sunnundalu are the urad dal laddus of Andhra: split urad dal roasted till nutty, ground fine with jaggery and pressed together with hot ghee. There is no cooking of syrup, so they come together in about half an hour. Andhra homes make a tin for Sankranti and Diwali, pack them for relatives travelling abroad, and keep them for an evening sweet with tea.
seg.965a1e93fb08.t: ସୁନ୍ନୁଣ୍ଡଲୁ ହେଉଛି ଆନ୍ଧ୍ରର ବିରି ଡାଲି ଲଡୁ: ଛୋଟ ବିରି ଡାଲିକୁ ବାଦାମ ପରି ବାସନା ଆସିବା ଯାଏ ଭାଜି, ଗୁଡ଼ ସହିତ ମିହି କରି ବାଟି, ଗରମ ଘିଅ ସହିତ ଚାପି ଲଡୁ କରାଯାଏ। ପାଗ ରାନ୍ଧିବା ଦରକାର ନାହିଁ, ତେଣୁ ପ୍ରାୟ ଅଧ ଘଣ୍ଟାରେ ତିଆରି ହୋଇଯାଏ। ଆନ୍ଧ୍ରର ଘରେ ସଙ୍କ୍ରାନ୍ତି ଓ ଦୀପାବଳି ପାଇଁ ଏକ ଡବା ତିଆରି କରନ୍ତି, ବିଦେଶ ଯାଉଥିବା ସମ୍ପର୍କୀୟଙ୍କ ପାଇଁ ବାନ୍ଧି ଦିଅନ୍ତି, ଆଉ ସନ୍ଧ୍ୟାରେ ଚା ସହିତ ମିଠା ଭାବେ ରଖନ୍ତି।
seg.965a1e93fb08.back: Sunnundalu is Andhra's urad dal laddu: small urad dal is roasted until a nutty aroma comes, ground fine with jaggery, and pressed into laddus with hot ghee. No syrup needs cooking, so it gets made in about half an hour. Andhra homes make a tin for Sankranti and Deepavali, pack them for relatives going abroad, and keep them as a sweet with evening tea.

seg.e564344550cd.src: Our Thati Bellam palm jaggery gives sunnundalu a deep brown colour and a rich, slightly smoky sweetness that suits the roasted dal. This recipe makes about 15 laddus.
seg.e564344550cd.t: ଆମ ତାଟି ବେଲ୍ଲମ ତାଳ ଗୁଡ଼ ସୁନ୍ନୁଣ୍ଡଲୁକୁ ଗାଢ଼ ବାଦାମୀ ରଙ୍ଗ ଓ ଭରପୂର, ଟିକିଏ ଧୂଆଁ ପରି ମିଠା ଦିଏ ଯାହା ଭଜା ଡାଲି ସହିତ ମେଳ ଖାଏ। ଏହି ରେସିପିରେ ପ୍ରାୟ 15ଟି ଲଡୁ ହୁଏ।
seg.e564344550cd.back: Our tati bellam palm jaggery gives sunnundalu a dark brown colour and a rich, slightly smoky sweetness that matches the roasted dal. This recipe makes about 15 laddus.

seg.b1400f429b2f.src: Total includes cooling the roasted dal before grinding.
seg.b1400f429b2f.t: ମୋଟ ସମୟରେ ବାଟିବା ଆଗରୁ ଭଜା ଡାଲି ଥଣ୍ଡା କରିବା ସମୟ ମଧ୍ୟ ଅଛି।
seg.b1400f429b2f.back: The total time also includes time for cooling the roasted dal before grinding.

seg.6c6369238635.src: Roast urad dal till golden, cool and grind fine, then grind in palm jaggery and cardamom. Mix with hot ghee and shape into laddus.
seg.6c6369238635.t: ବିରି ଡାଲିକୁ ସୁନେଲି ହେବା ଯାଏ ଭାଜି, ଥଣ୍ଡା କରି ମିହି କରି ବାଟନ୍ତୁ, ତାପରେ ତାଳ ଗୁଡ଼ ଓ ଅଳେଇଚ ମିଶାଇ ବାଟନ୍ତୁ। ଗରମ ଘିଅ ସହିତ ମିଶାଇ ଲଡୁ ଗଢ଼ନ୍ତୁ।
seg.6c6369238635.back: Roast the urad dal until golden, cool and grind fine, then add palm jaggery and cardamom and grind. Mix with hot ghee and shape laddus.

seg.890ddaaca185.src: 1 cup white urad dal ⟦1⟧split, skinless (minapappu), about 200 g⟦/1⟧
seg.890ddaaca185.t: 1 କପ ଧଳା ବିରି ଡାଲି ⟦1⟧ଛୋଟ, ଚୋପା ବିନା (ମିନପପ୍ପୁ), ପ୍ରାୟ 200 g⟦/1⟧
seg.890ddaaca185.back: 1 cup white urad dal ⟦1⟧small, without skin (minapappu), about 200 g⟦/1⟧

seg.06c2723f717d.src: 1 cup grated palm jaggery ⟦1⟧about 180 g, lightly packed; pound or grate the pieces first⟦/1⟧
seg.06c2723f717d.t: 1 କପ କୋରା ତାଳ ଗୁଡ଼ ⟦1⟧ପ୍ରାୟ 180 g, ହାଲୁକା ଚାପି ମାପନ୍ତୁ; ପ୍ରଥମେ ଖଣ୍ଡଗୁଡ଼ିକୁ କୁଟନ୍ତୁ ବା କୋରନ୍ତୁ⟦/1⟧
seg.06c2723f717d.back: 1 cup grated palm jaggery ⟦1⟧about 180 g, measure lightly pressed; first pound or grate the pieces⟦/1⟧

seg.25c886ef1375.src: ½ cup ghee ⟦1⟧melted and hot; keep 1–2 tbsp extra on hand⟦/1⟧
seg.25c886ef1375.t: ½ କପ ଘିଅ ⟦1⟧ତରଳା ଓ ଗରମ; 1–2 ଟେବୁଲ ଚାମଚ ଅଧିକ ପାଖରେ ରଖନ୍ତୁ⟦/1⟧
seg.25c886ef1375.back: ½ cup ghee ⟦1⟧melted and hot; keep 1–2 tablespoons more at hand⟦/1⟧

seg.99983266b588.src: Pick through the urad dal for any small stones. Do not wash it; it must stay dry for roasting.
seg.99983266b588.t: ବିରି ଡାଲିରୁ ଛୋଟ ପଥର ବାଛି ବାହାର କରନ୍ତୁ। ଧୁଅନ୍ତୁ ନାହିଁ; ଭାଜିବା ପାଇଁ ଏହା ଶୁଖିଲା ରହିବା ଦରକାର।
seg.99983266b588.back: Pick out small stones from the urad dal. Do not wash it; it needs to stay dry for roasting.

seg.2f2807ce216b.src: Put the dal in a heavy pan on a low flame.
seg.2f2807ce216b.t: ଡାଲିକୁ ଏକ ମୋଟା ପ୍ୟାନରେ ଧିମା ନିଆଁରେ ରଖନ୍ତୁ।
seg.2f2807ce216b.back: Put the dal in a thick pan on low flame.

seg.65588a76c883.src: Dry-roast the urad dal on a low flame till golden and nutty, about 10 minutes. Stir all the time so every grain colours evenly; it should smell toasty and snap when you bite a grain.
seg.65588a76c883.t: ବିରି ଡାଲିକୁ ଧିମା ନିଆଁରେ ତେଲ ବିନା ସୁନେଲି ହୋଇ ବାଦାମ ପରି ବାସନା ଆସିବା ଯାଏ ଭାଜନ୍ତୁ, ପ୍ରାୟ 10 ମିନିଟ। ସବୁବେଳେ ଘାଣ୍ଟନ୍ତୁ ଯେପରି ପ୍ରତ୍ୟେକ ଦାନା ସମାନ ରଙ୍ଗ ହୁଏ; ଏଥିରୁ ଭଜା ବାସନା ଆସିବା ଉଚିତ ଓ ଗୋଟିଏ ଦାନା କାମୁଡ଼ିଲେ ମଚମଚ କରି ଭାଙ୍ଗିବା ଉଚିତ।
seg.65588a76c883.back: Roast the urad dal on low flame without oil until golden and a nutty aroma comes, about 10 minutes. Stir all the time so every grain gets the same colour; it should give a roasted aroma and one grain should snap crisply when bitten.

seg.9e8dc23d38fa.src: Tip the dal onto a plate and spread it out. Cool it, then grind to a fine powder. Grind in short bursts so the mixer does not heat up, and sieve out any coarse bits to grind again.
seg.9e8dc23d38fa.t: ଡାଲିକୁ ଏକ ଥାଳିରେ ଢାଳି ବିଛାନ୍ତୁ। ଥଣ୍ଡା କରି ମିହି ଗୁଣ୍ଡ କରନ୍ତୁ। ମିକ୍ସି ଗରମ ନ ହେବା ପାଇଁ ଅଳ୍ପ ଅଳ୍ପ ସମୟ ଚଲାନ୍ତୁ, ଆଉ ଦରଦରା ଅଂଶକୁ ଚଲାଣିରେ ଛାଣି ପୁଣି ବାଟନ୍ତୁ।
seg.9e8dc23d38fa.back: Tip the dal onto a plate and spread it. Cool and grind to a fine powder. Run the mixie in short bursts so it does not heat up, and sieve out the coarse part and grind again.

seg.edfa5bb66e59.src: Grate the palm jaggery finely, or pound the pieces in a mortar, breaking up any hard lumps.
seg.edfa5bb66e59.t: ତାଳ ଗୁଡ଼କୁ ମିହି କରି କୋରନ୍ତୁ, କିମ୍ବା ଖଲରେ ଖଣ୍ଡଗୁଡ଼ିକୁ କୁଟନ୍ତୁ, ଟାଣ ଗୁଣ୍ଡା ଭାଙ୍ଗି ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ।
seg.edfa5bb66e59.back: Grate the palm jaggery finely, or pound the pieces in a mortar, breaking up hard lumps.

seg.fcf7bce21bc5.src: Add the jaggery and cardamom powder to the dal powder in the mixer jar. Grind in the jaggery and cardamom till evenly mixed. A few pulses are enough; tip it all into a wide bowl.
seg.fcf7bce21bc5.t: ମିକ୍ସି ଜାରରେ ଡାଲି ଗୁଣ୍ଡରେ ଗୁଡ଼ ଓ ଅଳେଇଚ ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ପକାନ୍ତୁ। ଗୁଡ଼ ଓ ଅଳେଇଚ ସମାନ ଭାବେ ମିଶିବା ଯାଏ ବାଟନ୍ତୁ। କିଛି ପଲ୍ସ ଯଥେଷ୍ଟ; ସବୁକୁ ଏକ ଚଉଡ଼ା ବାଟିରେ ଢାଳନ୍ତୁ।
seg.fcf7bce21bc5.back: In the mixie jar add jaggery and cardamom powder to the dal powder. Grind until the jaggery and cardamom are evenly mixed. A few pulses are enough; pour everything into a wide bowl.

seg.1cd01dc31b1a.src: Melt the ghee in a small pan until it is hot but not smoking.
seg.1cd01dc31b1a.t: ଏକ ଛୋଟ ପ୍ୟାନରେ ଘିଅକୁ ଗରମ ହେବା ଯାଏ ତରଳାନ୍ତୁ, କିନ୍ତୁ ଧୂଆଁ ନ ବାହାରୁ।
seg.1cd01dc31b1a.back: In a small pan melt the ghee until hot, but not smoking.

seg.0b0ec921a239.src: Pour in the hot ghee, mix well and press into small balls. Start with most of the ghee, mix with a spoon, then use your hands once it is cool enough to touch.
seg.0b0ec921a239.t: ଗରମ ଘିଅ ଢାଳି ଭଲ କରି ମିଶାନ୍ତୁ ଓ ଛୋଟ ଛୋଟ ଲଡୁ ଚାପି ଗଢ଼ନ୍ତୁ। ପ୍ରଥମେ ଅଧିକାଂଶ ଘିଅ ପକାଇ ଚାମଚରେ ମିଶାନ୍ତୁ, ତାପରେ ଛୁଇଁବା ପରି ଥଣ୍ଡା ହେଲେ ହାତ ବ୍ୟବହାର କରନ୍ତୁ।
seg.0b0ec921a239.back: Pour in the hot ghee, mix well and press into small laddus. First add most of the ghee and mix with a spoon, then use your hands when it is cool enough to touch.

seg.0c005163369c.src: Take a small handful and squeeze it firmly in your fist, then roll it round between your palms. If it crumbles, add a spoon more hot ghee to the bowl and mix.
seg.0c005163369c.t: ଛୋଟ ମୁଠାଏ ନେଇ ମୁଠିରେ ଦୃଢ଼ ଭାବେ ଚାପନ୍ତୁ, ତାପରେ ପାପୁଲି ମଧ୍ୟରେ ଗୋଲ କରି ଗଡ଼ାନ୍ତୁ। ଝଡ଼ିଗଲେ ବାଟିରେ ଚାମଚେ ଅଧିକ ଗରମ ଘିଅ ପକାଇ ମିଶାନ୍ତୁ।
seg.0c005163369c.back: Take a small handful and press firmly in your fist, then roll round between your palms. If it crumbles add a spoon more hot ghee to the bowl and mix.

seg.7ac27bb5fb12.src: Set the laddus on a plate to firm up for 15–20 minutes before storing.
seg.7ac27bb5fb12.t: ରଖିବା ଆଗରୁ ଲଡୁକୁ ଏକ ଥାଳିରେ 15–20 ମିନିଟ ଟାଣ ହେବାକୁ ରଖନ୍ତୁ।
seg.7ac27bb5fb12.back: Before storing keep the laddus on a plate 15–20 minutes to firm up.

seg.591b2b7e4ef4.src: Roast the dal on a low flame so it cooks through without burning.
seg.591b2b7e4ef4.t: ଡାଲିକୁ ଧିମା ନିଆଁରେ ଭାଜନ୍ତୁ ଯେପରି ନ ପୋଡ଼ି ଭିତର ଯାଏ ଭଜା ହୁଏ।
seg.591b2b7e4ef4.back: Roast the dal on low flame so it roasts through to the inside without burning.

seg.07daa833e53a.src: Grind the dal only after it has cooled completely; warm dal turns pasty in the mixer.
seg.07daa833e53a.t: ଡାଲି ପୂରା ଥଣ୍ଡା ହେବା ପରେ ହିଁ ବାଟନ୍ତୁ; ଉଷୁମ ଡାଲି ମିକ୍ସିରେ ଲେଟି ହୋଇଯାଏ।
seg.07daa833e53a.back: Grind the dal only after it has cooled completely; warm dal turns pasty in the mixie.

seg.33701abc66f0.src: Shape the laddus while the mixture is still warm; it binds best with the heat of the ghee.
seg.33701abc66f0.t: ମିଶ୍ରଣ ଉଷୁମ ଥାଉ ଥାଉ ଲଡୁ ଗଢ଼ନ୍ତୁ; ଘିଅର ଗରମରେ ଏହା ସବୁଠୁ ଭଲ ବାନ୍ଧେ।
seg.33701abc66f0.back: Shape the laddus while the mixture is still warm; it binds best with the heat of the ghee.

seg.b6fb58b6b287.src: Palm jaggery pieces vary in hardness, so grate or pound them small before they go into the mixer.
seg.b6fb58b6b287.t: ତାଳ ଗୁଡ଼ ଖଣ୍ଡର କଠିନତା ଅଲଗା ଅଲଗା, ତେଣୁ ମିକ୍ସିରେ ପକାଇବା ଆଗରୁ କୋରି ବା କୁଟି ଛୋଟ କରନ୍ତୁ।
seg.b6fb58b6b287.back: Palm jaggery pieces differ in hardness, so grate or pound them small before putting them in the mixie.

seg.1797acff16a2.src: Cane jaggery: use the same amount of grated cane jaggery for a lighter colour and a caramel-like sweetness.
seg.1797acff16a2.t: ଆଖୁ ଗୁଡ଼: ହାଲୁକା ରଙ୍ଗ ଓ କ୍ୟାରାମେଲ ପରି ମିଠା ପାଇଁ ସେତିକି ପରିମାଣର କୋରା ଆଖୁ ଗୁଡ଼ ନିଅନ୍ତୁ।
seg.1797acff16a2.back: Sugarcane jaggery: for a lighter colour and caramel-like sweetness take the same amount of grated sugarcane jaggery.

seg.f95b0650add7.src: With skin: use black split urad dal with its skin for darker, grainier sunnundalu, the way some village homes make them.
seg.f95b0650add7.t: ଚୋପା ସହିତ: ଗାଢ଼ ଓ ଦାନାଦାର ସୁନ୍ନୁଣ୍ଡଲୁ ପାଇଁ ଚୋପା ଥିବା କଳା ଛୋଟ ବିରି ଡାଲି ନିଅନ୍ତୁ, ଯେପରି କିଛି ଗାଁ ଘରେ ତିଆରି ହୁଏ।
seg.f95b0650add7.back: With skin: for dark and grainy sunnundalu take black small urad dal with skin, as made in some village homes.

seg.07498f6166e4.src: With sugar: use ¾ cup powdered sugar in place of the jaggery for pale, crisp-melting laddus.
seg.07498f6166e4.t: ଚିନି ସହିତ: ଫିକା ରଙ୍ଗର, ମୁହଁରେ ମିଳେଇଯାଉଥିବା ମଚମଚିଆ ଲଡୁ ପାଇଁ ଗୁଡ଼ ବଦଳରେ ¾ କପ ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ଚିନି ନିଅନ୍ତୁ।
seg.07498f6166e4.back: With sugar: for pale-coloured, melt-in-the-mouth crumbly laddus take ¾ cup powdered sugar instead of jaggery.

seg.8fea3a4a695f.src: Serve as an evening sweet with tea or coffee, or as part of the Sankranti and Diwali sweet plate.
seg.8fea3a4a695f.t: ସନ୍ଧ୍ୟାରେ ଚା ବା କଫି ସହିତ ମିଠା ଭାବେ, କିମ୍ବା ସଙ୍କ୍ରାନ୍ତି ଓ ଦୀପାବଳିର ମିଠା ଥାଳିର ଅଂଶ ଭାବେ ପରଷନ୍ତୁ।
seg.8fea3a4a695f.back: Serve as a sweet with evening tea or coffee, or as part of the Sankranti and Deepavali sweet plate.

seg.83b4edc5c69d.src: Keep in an airtight steel tin at room temperature and eat within 2 weeks. In warm weather they keep longer in the fridge; let them come to room temperature before eating.
seg.83b4edc5c69d.t: ବାୟୁରୋଧୀ ଷ୍ଟିଲ ଡବାରେ ସାଧାରଣ ତାପମାତ୍ରାରେ ରଖନ୍ତୁ ଓ 2 ସପ୍ତାହ ଭିତରେ ଖାଆନ୍ତୁ। ଗରମ ପାଗରେ ଫ୍ରିଜରେ ଅଧିକ ଦିନ ରହେ; ଖାଇବା ଆଗରୁ ସାଧାରଣ ତାପମାତ୍ରାକୁ ଆସିବାକୁ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ।
seg.83b4edc5c69d.back: Keep in an airtight steel tin at room temperature and eat within 2 weeks. In hot weather they keep more days in the fridge; let them come to room temperature before eating.

seg.c0ae9315eb0e.src: Why are my sunnundalu not holding shape?
seg.c0ae9315eb0e.back: Why are my sunnundalu not holding shape?

seg.03c64235659e.src: The mixture needs more hot ghee, or it has cooled down. Warm a spoon or two of ghee, mix it in and shape the laddus while the mixture is still warm.
seg.03c64235659e.t: ମିଶ୍ରଣରେ ଅଧିକ ଗରମ ଘିଅ ଦରକାର, କିମ୍ବା ତାହା ଥଣ୍ଡା ହୋଇଯାଇଛି। ଚାମଚେ ଦୁଇ ଚାମଚ ଘିଅ ଗରମ କରି ମିଶାନ୍ତୁ ଓ ମିଶ୍ରଣ ଉଷୁମ ଥାଉ ଥାଉ ଲଡୁ ଗଢ଼ନ୍ତୁ।
seg.03c64235659e.back: The mixture needs more hot ghee, or it has gone cold. Heat a spoon or two of ghee and mix in, and shape the laddus while the mixture is still warm.

seg.c125d749f215.src: Can I make sunnundalu with palm jaggery?
seg.c125d749f215.t: ତାଳ ଗୁଡ଼ରେ ସୁନ୍ନୁଣ୍ଡଲୁ ତିଆରି କରିପାରିବି କି?
seg.c125d749f215.back: Can I make sunnundalu with palm jaggery?

seg.7b13a91f65e1.src: Yes. Grate or pound the palm jaggery (thati bellam) finely and use the same amount as cane jaggery. The laddus turn darker and taste deeper and slightly smoky.
seg.7b13a91f65e1.t: ହଁ। ତାଳ ଗୁଡ଼ (ତାଟି ବେଲ୍ଲମ)କୁ ମିହି କରି କୋରନ୍ତୁ ବା କୁଟନ୍ତୁ ଓ ଆଖୁ ଗୁଡ଼ ପରି ସେତିକି ପରିମାଣ ନିଅନ୍ତୁ। ଲଡୁ ଗାଢ଼ ରଙ୍ଗର ହୁଏ ଓ ସ୍ୱାଦ ଗଭୀର ଓ ଟିକିଏ ଧୂଆଁ ପରି ଲାଗେ।
seg.7b13a91f65e1.back: Yes. Grate or pound palm jaggery (tati bellam) finely and take the same amount as sugarcane jaggery. The laddus turn dark coloured and the taste feels deep and a little smoky.

seg.946f64207639.back: How many days do sunnundalu keep?

seg.b2aed25ebff6.src: About 2 weeks in an airtight tin at room temperature, and longer in the fridge. Use a dry spoon or dry hands to take them out.
seg.b2aed25ebff6.t: ବାୟୁରୋଧୀ ଡବାରେ ସାଧାରଣ ତାପମାତ୍ରାରେ ପ୍ରାୟ 2 ସପ୍ତାହ, ଆଉ ଫ୍ରିଜରେ ଅଧିକ ଦିନ। ବାହାର କରିବା ପାଇଁ ଶୁଖିଲା ଚାମଚ ବା ଶୁଖିଲା ହାତ ବ୍ୟବହାର କରନ୍ତୁ।
seg.b2aed25ebff6.back: About 2 weeks in an airtight tin at room temperature, and more days in the fridge. Use a dry spoon or dry hands to take them out.

seg.e750875c4912.src: Should I use urad dal with or without skin?
seg.e750875c4912.t: ଚୋପା ସହିତ ନା ଚୋପା ବିନା ବିରି ଡାଲି ନେବି?
seg.e750875c4912.back: Should I take urad dal with skin or without skin?

seg.b12320430e22.src: Both are made in Andhra. White skinless urad dal gives smooth, light brown laddus; black urad dal with skin gives darker, grainier ones.
seg.b12320430e22.t: ଆନ୍ଧ୍ରରେ ଦୁହେଁ ତିଆରି ହୁଏ। ଚୋପା ବିନା ଧଳା ବିରି ଡାଲିରେ ମସୃଣ, ହାଲୁକା ବାଦାମୀ ଲଡୁ ହୁଏ; ଚୋପା ଥିବା କଳା ବିରି ଡାଲିରେ ଗାଢ଼ ଓ ଦାନାଦାର ଲଡୁ ହୁଏ।
seg.b12320430e22.back: Both are made in Andhra. White urad dal without skin makes smooth, light brown laddus; black urad dal with skin makes dark and grainy laddus.

seg.d8e8e5770555.src: సున్నుండలు. Andhra sunnundalu: roasted urad dal ground with Thati Bellam palm jaggery and bound with hot ghee into laddus. Step-by-step method, tips and FAQs.
seg.d8e8e5770555.t: సున్నుండలు. ଆନ୍ଧ୍ରର ସୁନ୍ନୁଣ୍ଡଲୁ: ଭଜା ବିରି ଡାଲିକୁ ତାଟି ବେଲ୍ଲମ ତାଳ ଗୁଡ଼ ସହିତ ବାଟି ଗରମ ଘିଅରେ ବାନ୍ଧି ଲଡୁ କରାଯାଏ। ଧାପେ ଧାପେ ପ୍ରଣାଳୀ, ଟିପ୍ସ ଓ ପ୍ରଶ୍ନୋତ୍ତର।
seg.d8e8e5770555.back: సున్నుండలు. Andhra sunnundalu: roasted urad dal ground with tati bellam palm jaggery and bound with hot ghee into laddus. Step-by-step method, tips and Q&A.

seg.c61b125404d0.src: Sunnundalu: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.c61b125404d0.t: ସୁନ୍ନୁଣ୍ଡଲୁ: 1acrefarmsର ରେସିପି କାର୍ଡ, ଉପକରଣ ଓ ପ୍ରଣାଳୀ ସହିତ
seg.c61b125404d0.back: Sunnundalu: 1acrefarms recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.02d0a5789a02.src: Tomato pachadi is the everyday chutney of Andhra kitchens: ripe tomatoes cooked down in oil with roasted dals, then ground coarse with chilli, garlic and a little tamarind. Many homes still grind it in the stone roti for a rough, spoonable texture, though a mixer in short pulses does the job. It goes with hot rice and ghee, dosa, idli and pesarattu.
seg.02d0a5789a02.t: ଟମାଟା ପଚ୍ଚଡ଼ି ହେଉଛି ଆନ୍ଧ୍ର ରୋଷେଇଘରର ପ୍ରତିଦିନର ଚଟଣି: ପାଚିଲା ଟମାଟାକୁ ଭଜା ଡାଲି ସହିତ ତେଲରେ ଗଳାଇ, ତାପରେ ଲଙ୍କା, ରସୁଣ ଓ ଅଳ୍ପ ତେନ୍ତୁଳି ସହିତ ଦରଦରା କରି ବଟାଯାଏ। ଅନେକ ଘରେ ଏବେ ବି ଦରଦରା, ଚାମଚରେ ଖାଇହେବା ପରି ଗଠନ ପାଇଁ ପଥର ରୋଲୁରେ ବାଟନ୍ତି, ଯଦିଓ ମିକ୍ସିରେ ଛୋଟ ପଲ୍ସ କଲେ ମଧ୍ୟ କାମ ହୁଏ। ଏହା ଗରମ ଭାତ ଓ ଘିଅ, ଦୋସା, ଇଡ଼ଲି ଓ ପେସରଟ୍ଟୁ ସହିତ ଖିଆଯାଏ।
seg.02d0a5789a02.back: Tomato pachadi is the everyday chutney of the Andhra kitchen: ripe tomatoes are melted in oil with roasted dal, then ground coarse with chilli, garlic and a little tamarind. Many homes still grind it on a stone rolu for a coarse, spoonable texture, though short pulses in a mixie also work. It is eaten with hot rice and ghee, dosa, idli and pesarattu.

seg.7735dff0ccd2.src: Our Sannam chilli powder gives it a deep red colour and steady, medium heat, and a little turmeric powder goes in with the tomatoes. This recipe makes about 1½ cups.
seg.7735dff0ccd2.t: ଆମ ସନ୍ନମ ଲଙ୍କା ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ଏହାକୁ ଗାଢ଼ ଲାଲ ରଙ୍ଗ ଓ ସ୍ଥିର ମଧ୍ୟମ ରାଗ ଦିଏ, ଆଉ ଟମାଟା ସହିତ ଅଳ୍ପ ହଳଦୀ ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ପଡ଼େ। ଏହି ରେସିପିରେ ପ୍ରାୟ 1½ କପ ହୁଏ।
seg.7735dff0ccd2.back: Our Sannam chilli powder gives it a deep red colour and a steady medium heat, and a little turmeric powder goes in with the tomatoes. This recipe makes about 1½ cups.

seg.44c4d82a4524.src: Total includes 5 minutes for the tomatoes to cool before grinding.
seg.44c4d82a4524.t: ମୋଟ ସମୟରେ ବାଟିବା ଆଗରୁ ଟମାଟା ଥଣ୍ଡା ହେବାର 5 ମିନିଟ ମଧ୍ୟ ଅଛି।
seg.44c4d82a4524.back: The total time also includes 5 minutes for the tomatoes to cool before grinding.

seg.827e4421a48d.src: Fry dals and methi in oil, cook tomatoes down with turmeric and salt, then grind coarsely with Sannam chilli powder, garlic and tamarind. Finish with a mustard and curry-leaf tempering.
seg.827e4421a48d.t: ଡାଲି ଓ ମେଥି ତେଲରେ ଭାଜନ୍ତୁ, ଟମାଟାକୁ ହଳଦୀ ଓ ଲୁଣ ସହିତ ଗଳାନ୍ତୁ, ତାପରେ ସନ୍ନମ ଲଙ୍କା ଗୁଣ୍ଡ, ରସୁଣ ଓ ତେନ୍ତୁଳି ସହିତ ଦରଦରା ବାଟନ୍ତୁ। ଶେଷରେ ସୋରିଷ ଓ ଭୃସଙ୍ଗ ପତ୍ରର ଛୁଙ୍କ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ।
seg.827e4421a48d.back: Fry dal and fenugreek in oil, melt the tomatoes with turmeric and salt, then grind coarse with Sannam chilli powder, garlic and tamarind. At the end give a tempering of mustard and curry leaves.

seg.4171dd59d18a.t: 2 ଟେବୁଲ ଚାମଚ ତେଲ ⟦1⟧ବାଦାମ ବା ରାଶି ତେଲ⟦/1⟧

seg.826b52ef9f19.src: ¼ tsp methi seeds ⟦1⟧fenugreek seeds; no more, or the pachadi turns bitter⟦/1⟧
seg.826b52ef9f19.t: ¼ ଚା ଚାମଚ ମେଥି ⟦1⟧ମେଥି ମଞ୍ଜି; ଏହାଠୁ ବେଶି ନୁହେଁ, ନଚେତ୍ ପଚ୍ଚଡ଼ି ପିତା ହୋଇଯାଏ⟦/1⟧
seg.826b52ef9f19.back: ¼ teaspoon fenugreek ⟦1⟧fenugreek seeds; not more than this, otherwise the pachadi turns bitter⟦/1⟧

seg.6cd60f9cc4c2.src: 5 medium tomatoes ⟦1⟧about 500 g, ripe and red, chopped⟦/1⟧
seg.6cd60f9cc4c2.t: 5ଟି ମଧ୍ୟମ ଟମାଟା ⟦1⟧ପ୍ରାୟ 500 g, ପାଚିଲା ଓ ଲାଲ, କଟା⟦/1⟧
