seg.6cd60f9cc4c2.back: 5 medium tomatoes ⟦1⟧about 500 g, ripe and red, chopped⟦/1⟧

seg.29558a247c61.src: 2 tsp Sannam chilli powder ⟦1⟧up to 1 tbsp for a hotter pachadi⟦/1⟧
seg.29558a247c61.t: 2 ଚା ଚାମଚ ସନ୍ନମ ଲଙ୍କା ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ⟦1⟧ଅଧିକ ରାଗୁଆ ପଚ୍ଚଡ଼ି ପାଇଁ 1 ଟେବୁଲ ଚାମଚ ପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ⟦/1⟧
seg.29558a247c61.back: 2 teaspoons Sannam chilli powder ⟦1⟧up to 1 tablespoon for a hotter pachadi⟦/1⟧

seg.f7c3bb463ff4.t: ମାର୍ବଲ ଆକାରର ତେନ୍ତୁଳି ⟦1⟧ପ୍ରାୟ 5 g, ମଞ୍ଜି ବାହାର କରା⟦/1⟧

seg.2c1074e3a23e.src: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a kadai on medium-low heat.
seg.2c1074e3a23e.t: ଏକ କଡ଼ାଇରେ ମଧ୍ୟମରୁ କମ୍ ନିଆଁରେ 2 ଟେବୁଲ ଚାମଚ ତେଲ ଗରମ କରନ୍ତୁ।
seg.2c1074e3a23e.back: Heat 2 tablespoons oil in a kadai on medium-to-low flame.

seg.9d0674551be0.src: Fry the urad dal, chana dal and methi in oil till golden; lift them out. This takes 2–3 minutes; stir all the time, as methi burns fast and turns bitter.
seg.9d0674551be0.t: ବିରି ଡାଲି, ବୁଟ ଡାଲି ଓ ମେଥିକୁ ତେଲରେ ସୁନେଲି ହେବା ଯାଏ ଭାଜନ୍ତୁ; ଉଠାଇ ନିଅନ୍ତୁ। ଏଥିରେ 2–3 ମିନିଟ ଲାଗେ; ସବୁବେଳେ ଘାଣ୍ଟନ୍ତୁ, କାରଣ ମେଥି ଶୀଘ୍ର ପୋଡ଼ି ପିତା ହୋଇଯାଏ।
seg.9d0674551be0.back: Fry urad dal, chana dal and fenugreek in the oil until golden; lift out. This takes 2–3 minutes; stir all the time, because fenugreek quickly burns and turns bitter.

seg.4727da6f2a95.src: In the same oil, add the chopped tomatoes and stir for a minute on medium heat.
seg.4727da6f2a95.t: ସେହି ତେଲରେ କଟା ଟମାଟା ପକାଇ ମଧ୍ୟମ ନିଆଁରେ ଏକ ମିନିଟ ଘାଣ୍ଟନ୍ତୁ।
seg.4727da6f2a95.back: In the same oil add the chopped tomatoes and stir one minute on medium flame.

seg.8032f2a2778c.src: Cook the tomatoes with turmeric and salt till soft and the juice dries up. Cover for the first 5 minutes, then cook uncovered, stirring now and then, about 12–15 minutes in all, until the tomatoes are pulpy and oil shows at the edges.
seg.8032f2a2778c.t: ଟମାଟାକୁ ହଳଦୀ ଓ ଲୁଣ ସହିତ ନରମ ହୋଇ ରସ ଶୁଖିବା ଯାଏ ରାନ୍ଧନ୍ତୁ। ପ୍ରଥମ 5 ମିନିଟ ଘୋଡ଼ାଇ ରଖନ୍ତୁ, ତାପରେ ଖୋଲା ରଖି ମଝିରେ ମଝିରେ ଘାଣ୍ଟି ରାନ୍ଧନ୍ତୁ, ମୋଟ ପ୍ରାୟ 12–15 ମିନିଟ, ଯେପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ ଟମାଟା ଚକଟା ହୋଇ କଡ଼ରେ ତେଲ ନ ଦେଖାଯାଏ।
seg.8032f2a2778c.back: Cook the tomatoes with turmeric and salt until soft and the juice dries. Keep covered the first 5 minutes, then cook uncovered stirring now and then, about 12–15 minutes in total, until the tomatoes are mashed and oil shows at the sides.

seg.d606b6ac13a2.src: Switch off, stir in the tamarind so it softens in the heat, and let everything cool for about 5 minutes.
seg.d606b6ac13a2.t: ନିଆଁ ବନ୍ଦ କରି ତେନ୍ତୁଳି ମିଶାନ୍ତୁ ଯେପରି ଗରମରେ ନରମ ହୁଏ, ଆଉ ସବୁକୁ ପ୍ରାୟ 5 ମିନିଟ ଥଣ୍ଡା ହେବାକୁ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ।
seg.d606b6ac13a2.back: Turn off the flame and mix in the tamarind so it softens in the heat, and let everything cool about 5 minutes.

seg.c1820dcae462.src: In the stone roti or a mixer jar, first grind the fried dals and methi to a coarse powder.
seg.c1820dcae462.t: ପଥର ରୋଲୁ ବା ମିକ୍ସି ଜାରରେ ପ୍ରଥମେ ଭଜା ଡାଲି ଓ ମେଥିକୁ ଦରଦରା ଗୁଣ୍ଡ କରନ୍ତୁ।
seg.c1820dcae462.back: In a stone rolu or mixie jar first make a coarse powder of the roasted dal and fenugreek.

seg.f07d8b97d1db.src: Grind the dals, garlic, tamarind, chilli powder and tomatoes coarsely. In a mixer, add the garlic, chilli powder and cooked tomatoes to the dal powder and pulse 4–5 times without water; stop while it still has texture. Stir in the coriander leaves, if using.
seg.f07d8b97d1db.t: ଡାଲି, ରସୁଣ, ତେନ୍ତୁଳି, ଲଙ୍କା ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ଓ ଟମାଟାକୁ ଦରଦରା ବାଟନ୍ତୁ। ମିକ୍ସିରେ ଡାଲି ଗୁଣ୍ଡରେ ରସୁଣ, ଲଙ୍କା ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ଓ ରନ୍ଧା ଟମାଟା ପକାଇ ପାଣି ବିନା 4–5 ଥର ପଲ୍ସ କରନ୍ତୁ; ଗଠନ ଥାଉ ଥାଉ ବନ୍ଦ କରନ୍ତୁ। ବ୍ୟବହାର କରୁଥିଲେ ଧନିଆ ପତ୍ର ମିଶାନ୍ତୁ।
seg.f07d8b97d1db.back: Grind the dal, garlic, tamarind, chilli powder and tomatoes coarse. In the mixie add garlic, chilli powder and the cooked tomatoes to the dal powder and pulse 4–5 times without water; stop while there is still texture. If using mix in coriander leaves.

seg.6675d75425f6.src: Taste and adjust: a pinch more salt, or a little more chilli powder pulsed in, if you want it hotter.
seg.6675d75425f6.t: ଚାଖି ଠିକ କରନ୍ତୁ: ଚିମୁଟାଏ ଅଧିକ ଲୁଣ, କିମ୍ବା ଅଧିକ ରାଗ ଚାହିଁଲେ ଟିକିଏ ଅଧିକ ଲଙ୍କା ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ପକାଇ ପଲ୍ସ କରନ୍ତୁ।
seg.6675d75425f6.back: Taste and adjust: a pinch more salt, or if you want more heat add a little more chilli powder and pulse.

seg.27426b7ca3c6.src: Spoon the pachadi into a bowl. Heat 1 tbsp oil in a small pan and add the mustard seeds; when they splutter, add the urad dal and fry until golden.
seg.27426b7ca3c6.t: ପଚ୍ଚଡ଼ିକୁ ଏକ ବାଟିରେ ଚାମଚରେ ରଖନ୍ତୁ। ଏକ ଛୋଟ ପ୍ୟାନରେ 1 ଟେବୁଲ ଚାମଚ ତେଲ ଗରମ କରି ସୋରିଷ ପକାନ୍ତୁ; ଫୁଟିଲେ ବିରି ଡାଲି ପକାଇ ସୁନେଲି ହେବା ଯାଏ ଭାଜନ୍ତୁ।
seg.27426b7ca3c6.back: Spoon the pachadi into a bowl. In a small pan heat 1 tablespoon oil and add mustard; when it splutters add urad dal and fry until golden.

seg.77131f9506c3.src: Add the red chillies, asafoetida and curry leaves and stir for a few seconds.
seg.77131f9506c3.t: ଲାଲ ଲଙ୍କା, ହେଙ୍ଗୁ ଓ ଭୃସଙ୍ଗ ପତ୍ର ପକାଇ କିଛି ସେକେଣ୍ଡ ଘାଣ୍ଟନ୍ତୁ।
seg.77131f9506c3.back: Add red chilli, asafoetida and curry leaves and stir a few seconds.

seg.d4a4b9439500.src: Temper with mustard, red chillies and curry leaves; pour over. Mix it in just before serving.
seg.d4a4b9439500.t: ସୋରିଷ, ଲାଲ ଲଙ୍କା ଓ ଭୃସଙ୍ଗ ପତ୍ରର ଛୁଙ୍କ ଦେଇ ଉପରେ ଢାଳନ୍ତୁ। ପରଷିବା ଠିକ ଆଗରୁ ମିଶାନ୍ତୁ।
seg.d4a4b9439500.back: Give a tempering of mustard, red chilli and curry leaves and pour on top. Mix just before serving.

seg.0f23e6b9231e.src: Cook the tomatoes till the juice dries up so the pachadi keeps longer and does not taste raw.
seg.0f23e6b9231e.t: ଟମାଟାର ରସ ଶୁଖିବା ଯାଏ ରାନ୍ଧନ୍ତୁ ଯେପରି ପଚ୍ଚଡ଼ି ଅଧିକ ଦିନ ରହେ ଓ କଞ୍ଚା ନ ଲାଗେ।
seg.0f23e6b9231e.back: Cook until the tomato juice dries so the pachadi keeps more days and does not taste raw.

seg.bad083b47507.src: Ripe, deep-red tomatoes give the best colour; if yours are sour, cut the tamarind to half.
seg.bad083b47507.t: ପାଚିଲା, ଗାଢ଼ ଲାଲ ଟମାଟା ସବୁଠୁ ଭଲ ରଙ୍ଗ ଦିଏ; ଆପଣଙ୍କ ଟମାଟା ଖଟା ହେଲେ ତେନ୍ତୁଳି ଅଧା କରନ୍ତୁ।
seg.bad083b47507.back: Ripe, deep red tomatoes give the best colour; if your tomatoes are sour halve the tamarind.

seg.99bd4830d431.src: Pulse, do not run the mixer: a coarse pachadi is how Andhra homes like it, and a smooth paste loses that texture.
seg.99bd4830d431.t: ପଲ୍ସ କରନ୍ତୁ, ମିକ୍ସି ଲଗାତାର ଚଲାନ୍ତୁ ନାହିଁ: ଆନ୍ଧ୍ରର ଘରେ ଦରଦରା ପଚ୍ଚଡ଼ି ପସନ୍ଦ, ଆଉ ମସୃଣ ବଟାରେ ସେହି ଗଠନ ହଜିଯାଏ।
seg.99bd4830d431.back: Pulse, do not run the mixie continuously: Andhra homes like a coarse pachadi, and a smooth paste loses that texture.

seg.27f2aaa2d25d.src: Sannam chilli powder gives medium heat. Start at 2 tsp and add more after tasting; the heat settles a little as the pachadi rests.
seg.27f2aaa2d25d.t: ସନ୍ନମ ଲଙ୍କା ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ମଧ୍ୟମ ରାଗ ଦିଏ। 2 ଚା ଚାମଚରୁ ଆରମ୍ଭ କରି ଚାଖିବା ପରେ ଅଧିକ ପକାନ୍ତୁ; ପଚ୍ଚଡ଼ି ରହିଲେ ରାଗ ଟିକିଏ କମେ।
seg.27f2aaa2d25d.back: Sannam chilli powder gives medium heat. Start with 2 teaspoons and add more after tasting; as the pachadi stands the heat lessens a little.

seg.5e0bf03c1b36.src: Green chilli: replace the chilli powder with 4–5 green chillies, fried with the dals.
seg.5e0bf03c1b36.t: କଞ୍ଚା ଲଙ୍କା: ଲଙ୍କା ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ବଦଳରେ 4–5ଟି କଞ୍ଚା ଲଙ୍କା ଡାଲି ସହିତ ଭାଜି ନିଅନ୍ତୁ।
seg.5e0bf03c1b36.back: Green chilli: instead of chilli powder take 4–5 green chillies fried with the dal.

seg.d7301a50c407.src: Onion-tomato: fry 1 sliced onion until soft before the tomatoes go in.
seg.d7301a50c407.t: ପିଆଜ-ଟମାଟା: ଟମାଟା ପକାଇବା ଆଗରୁ 1ଟି କଟା ପିଆଜ ନରମ ହେବା ଯାଏ ଭାଜନ୍ତୁ।
seg.d7301a50c407.back: Onion-tomato: before adding tomatoes fry 1 chopped onion until soft.

seg.bc90e2638112.src: Hotter: use 1 tsp Teja chilli powder in place of 1 tsp of the Sannam; Teja is very hot, so go slowly.
seg.bc90e2638112.t: ଅଧିକ ରାଗୁଆ: 1 ଚା ଚାମଚ ସନ୍ନମ ବଦଳରେ 1 ଚା ଚାମଚ ତେଜା ଲଙ୍କା ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ନିଅନ୍ତୁ; ତେଜା ବହୁତ ରାଗୁଆ, ତେଣୁ ଧୀରେ ଧୀରେ ବଢ଼ାନ୍ତୁ।
seg.bc90e2638112.back: Hotter: take 1 teaspoon Teja chilli powder instead of 1 teaspoon Sannam; Teja is very hot, so increase slowly.

seg.aab608a427a9.src: Without garlic: leave out the garlic and add a pinch more asafoetida to the tempering.
seg.aab608a427a9.t: ରସୁଣ ବିନା: ରସୁଣ ବାଦ ଦେଇ ଛୁଙ୍କରେ ଚିମୁଟାଏ ଅଧିକ ହେଙ୍ଗୁ ପକାନ୍ତୁ।
seg.aab608a427a9.back: Without garlic: leave out garlic and add a pinch more asafoetida in the tempering.

seg.62d9491c4e58.src: Mix a spoonful into hot rice with a little ghee, or serve alongside dosa, idli, pesarattu or upma.
seg.62d9491c4e58.t: ଗରମ ଭାତରେ ଅଳ୍ପ ଘିଅ ସହିତ ଚାମଚେ ମିଶାନ୍ତୁ, କିମ୍ବା ଦୋସା, ଇଡ଼ଲି, ପେସରଟ୍ଟୁ ବା ଉପମା ସହିତ ପରଷନ୍ତୁ।
seg.62d9491c4e58.back: Mix a spoonful into hot rice with a little ghee, or serve with dosa, idli, pesarattu or upma.

seg.3f0b892d2728.src: Keep it in a clean, dry glass jar in the fridge and eat within 4 days. Always use a dry spoon.
seg.3f0b892d2728.t: ଏକ ସଫା, ଶୁଖିଲା କାଚ ବୋତଲରେ ଫ୍ରିଜରେ ରଖନ୍ତୁ ଓ 4 ଦିନ ଭିତରେ ଖାଆନ୍ତୁ। ସବୁବେଳେ ଶୁଖିଲା ଚାମଚ ବ୍ୟବହାର କରନ୍ତୁ।
seg.3f0b892d2728.back: Keep in a clean, dry glass jar in the fridge and eat within 4 days. Always use a dry spoon.

seg.20425f76c6e2.src: How do you make Andhra tomato pachadi?
seg.20425f76c6e2.t: ଆନ୍ଧ୍ରର ଟମାଟା ପଚ୍ଚଡ଼ି କିପରି ତିଆରି କରିବେ?
seg.20425f76c6e2.back: How do you make Andhra tomato pachadi?

seg.32ae9ac6b03c.src: Fry urad dal, chana dal and methi in oil, cook chopped tomatoes with turmeric and salt until the juice dries up, then grind everything coarsely with chilli powder, garlic and tamarind. Finish with a mustard, red chilli and curry-leaf tempering.
seg.32ae9ac6b03c.t: ବିରି ଡାଲି, ବୁଟ ଡାଲି ଓ ମେଥି ତେଲରେ ଭାଜନ୍ତୁ, କଟା ଟମାଟାକୁ ହଳଦୀ ଓ ଲୁଣ ସହିତ ରସ ଶୁଖିବା ଯାଏ ରାନ୍ଧନ୍ତୁ, ତାପରେ ସବୁକୁ ଲଙ୍କା ଗୁଣ୍ଡ, ରସୁଣ ଓ ତେନ୍ତୁଳି ସହିତ ଦରଦରା ବାଟନ୍ତୁ। ଶେଷରେ ସୋରିଷ, ଲାଲ ଲଙ୍କା ଓ ଭୃସଙ୍ଗ ପତ୍ରର ଛୁଙ୍କ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ।
seg.32ae9ac6b03c.back: Fry urad dal, chana dal and fenugreek in oil, cook the chopped tomatoes with turmeric and salt until the juice dries, then grind everything coarse with chilli powder, garlic and tamarind. At the end give a tempering of mustard, red chilli and curry leaves.

seg.2e87824684cb.src: Why is my tomato pachadi bitter?
seg.2e87824684cb.t: ମୋ ଟମାଟା ପଚ୍ଚଡ଼ି କାହିଁକି ପିତା ଲାଗୁଛି?
seg.2e87824684cb.back: Why does my tomato pachadi taste bitter?

seg.b367557bedfc.src: Usually the methi seeds burnt or there were too many. Use only ¼ tsp for 500 g tomatoes and fry them on medium-low heat, lifting them out as soon as they turn golden.
seg.b367557bedfc.t: ସାଧାରଣତଃ ମେଥି ପୋଡ଼ିଯାଇଥିଲା ବା ବହୁତ ବେଶି ପଡ଼ିଥିଲା। 500 g ଟମାଟା ପାଇଁ କେବଳ ¼ ଚା ଚାମଚ ନିଅନ୍ତୁ ଓ ମଧ୍ୟମରୁ କମ୍ ନିଆଁରେ ଭାଜି ସୁନେଲି ହେବା ମାତ୍ରେ ଉଠାଇ ନିଅନ୍ତୁ।
seg.b367557bedfc.back: Usually the fenugreek burned or too much went in. For 500 g tomatoes take only ¼ teaspoon and fry on medium-to-low flame and lift out as soon as it turns golden.

seg.acdf33e5cc6d.src: Can I make tomato pachadi without tamarind?
seg.acdf33e5cc6d.t: ତେନ୍ତୁଳି ବିନା ଟମାଟା ପଚ୍ଚଡ଼ି ତିଆରି କରିପାରିବି କି?
seg.acdf33e5cc6d.back: Can I make tomato pachadi without tamarind?

seg.53fbd8949e0b.src: Yes, if your tomatoes are sour enough. Taste after cooking; ripe, sweet tomatoes need the small piece of tamarind for balance.
seg.53fbd8949e0b.t: ହଁ, ଯଦି ଆପଣଙ୍କ ଟମାଟା ଯଥେଷ୍ଟ ଖଟା। ରାନ୍ଧିବା ପରେ ଚାଖନ୍ତୁ; ପାଚିଲା, ମିଠା ଟମାଟାରେ ସନ୍ତୁଳନ ପାଇଁ ସେହି ଛୋଟ ଖଣ୍ଡ ତେନ୍ତୁଳି ଦରକାର।
seg.53fbd8949e0b.back: Yes, if your tomatoes are sour enough. Taste after cooking; with ripe, sweet tomatoes that small piece of tamarind is needed for balance.

seg.2938c7a0249e.src: How long does tomato pachadi last?
seg.2938c7a0249e.back: How many days does tomato pachadi keep?

seg.a35105e3a4af.src: About 4 days in the fridge in a clean, dry jar, as long as the tomatoes were cooked down well and you use a dry spoon.
seg.a35105e3a4af.t: ଟମାଟା ଭଲ ଭାବେ ଗଳାଯାଇଥିଲେ ଓ ଶୁଖିଲା ଚାମଚ ବ୍ୟବହାର କଲେ, ସଫା, ଶୁଖିଲା ବୋତଲରେ ଫ୍ରିଜରେ ପ୍ରାୟ 4 ଦିନ।
seg.a35105e3a4af.back: If the tomatoes were melted down well and a dry spoon is used, about 4 days in a clean, dry jar in the fridge.

seg.de4e2a65c3ae.src: టమాటా పచ్చడి. Andhra tomato pachadi: tomatoes cooked down with turmeric powder, ground coarse with Sannam chilli powder, garlic and tamarind, then tempered.
seg.de4e2a65c3ae.t: టమాటా పచ్చడి. ଆନ୍ଧ୍ରର ଟମାଟା ପଚ୍ଚଡ଼ି: ହଳଦୀ ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ସହିତ ଗଳା ଟମାଟା, ସନ୍ନମ ଲଙ୍କା ଗୁଣ୍ଡ, ରସୁଣ ଓ ତେନ୍ତୁଳି ସହିତ ଦରଦରା ବଟା, ତାପରେ ଛୁଙ୍କ ଦିଆଯାଏ।
seg.de4e2a65c3ae.back: టమాటా పచ్చడి. Andhra tomato pachadi: tomatoes melted with turmeric powder, ground coarse with Sannam chilli powder, garlic and tamarind, then tempered.

seg.03de1ac75259.src: Tomato Pachadi: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.03de1ac75259.t: ଟମାଟା ପଚ୍ଚଡ଼ି: 1acrefarmsର ରେସିପି କାର୍ଡ, ଉପକରଣ ଓ ପ୍ରଣାଳୀ ସହିତ
seg.03de1ac75259.back: Tomato Pachadi: 1acrefarms recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.3d323a4b41cc.src: Tomato pappu is the everyday dal of Andhra homes: toor dal (kandi pappu) cooked soft with tomatoes and green chillies, mashed smooth and finished with a garlic tempering. It is cooked most days of the week and eaten with hot rice, a spoon of ghee and an appadam or a pickle on the side.
seg.3d323a4b41cc.t: ଟମାଟା ପପ୍ପୁ ହେଉଛି ଆନ୍ଧ୍ରର ଘରର ପ୍ରତିଦିନର ଡାଲି: ହରଡ଼ ଡାଲି (କନ୍ଦି ପପ୍ପୁ)କୁ ଟମାଟା ଓ କଞ୍ଚା ଲଙ୍କା ସହିତ ନରମ କରି ସିଝାଇ, ମସୃଣ କରି ଚକଟି, ରସୁଣ ଛୁଙ୍କ ସହିତ ଶେଷ କରାଯାଏ। ସପ୍ତାହର ଅଧିକାଂଶ ଦିନ ଏହା ରନ୍ଧାଯାଏ ଓ ଗରମ ଭାତ, ଚାମଚେ ଘିଅ ଓ ପାଖରେ ପାମ୍ପଡ଼ ବା ଆଚାର ସହିତ ଖିଆଯାଏ।
seg.3d323a4b41cc.back: Tomato pappu is the everyday dal of Andhra homes: toor dal (kandi pappu) is boiled soft with tomato and green chilli, mashed smooth, and finished with a garlic tempering. It is cooked most days of the week and eaten with hot rice, a spoon of ghee and papad or pickle alongside.

seg.734276af9399.src: Our turmeric powder goes into the cooker with the dal and gives it a deep yellow colour. Sannam chilli powder adds a red tinge and a steady, medium heat that sits behind the sour tomato. This recipe serves 4.
seg.734276af9399.t: ଆମ ହଳଦୀ ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ଡାଲି ସହିତ କୁକରରେ ପଡ଼େ ଓ ଏହାକୁ ଗାଢ଼ ହଳଦିଆ ରଙ୍ଗ ଦିଏ। ସନ୍ନମ ଲଙ୍କା ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ଲାଲ ଆଭା ଓ ଖଟା ଟମାଟା ପଛରେ ରହୁଥିବା ସ୍ଥିର ମଧ୍ୟମ ରାଗ ଯୋଗ କରେ। ଏହି ରେସିପି 4 ଜଣଙ୍କ ପାଇଁ।
seg.734276af9399.back: Our turmeric powder goes into the cooker with the dal and gives it a deep yellow colour. Sannam chilli powder adds a red glow and a steady medium heat that stays behind the sour tomato. This recipe is for 4 people.

seg.8c5a5da215b1.src: Total includes letting the cooker release its steam.
seg.8c5a5da215b1.t: ମୋଟ ସମୟରେ କୁକରର ବାଷ୍ପ ବାହାରିବା ସମୟ ମଧ୍ୟ ଅଛି।
seg.8c5a5da215b1.back: The total time also includes the time for the cooker's steam to release.

seg.2c1a760b1cf8.src: Pressure-cook toor dal with tomatoes, green chillies and turmeric powder, mash it with Sannam chilli powder and salt, and finish with a garlic and mustard tempering.
seg.2c1a760b1cf8.t: ହରଡ଼ ଡାଲିକୁ ଟମାଟା, କଞ୍ଚା ଲଙ୍କା ଓ ହଳଦୀ ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ସହିତ ପ୍ରେସର କୁକରରେ ସିଝାନ୍ତୁ, ସନ୍ନମ ଲଙ୍କା ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ଓ ଲୁଣ ସହିତ ଚକଟନ୍ତୁ, ଆଉ ଶେଷରେ ରସୁଣ ଓ ସୋରିଷର ଛୁଙ୍କ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ।
seg.2c1a760b1cf8.back: Boil the toor dal in a pressure cooker with tomato, green chilli and turmeric powder, mash with Sannam chilli powder and salt, and at the end give a tempering of garlic and mustard.

seg.d102a6fa5887.src: ¾ cup toor dal ⟦1⟧kandi pappu, about 150 g⟦/1⟧
seg.d102a6fa5887.t: ¾ କପ ହରଡ଼ ଡାଲି ⟦1⟧କନ୍ଦି ପପ୍ପୁ, ପ୍ରାୟ 150 g⟦/1⟧
seg.d102a6fa5887.back: ¾ cup toor dal ⟦1⟧kandi pappu, about 150 g⟦/1⟧

seg.258b0303a820.src: ½ tsp turmeric powder ⟦1⟧goes in the cooker⟦/1⟧
seg.258b0303a820.t: ½ ଚା ଚାମଚ ହଳଦୀ ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ⟦1⟧କୁକରରେ ପଡ଼େ⟦/1⟧
seg.258b0303a820.back: ½ teaspoon turmeric powder ⟦1⟧goes in the cooker⟦/1⟧

seg.25c2493b65be.src: 1 tsp Sannam chilli powder ⟦1⟧goes in after mashing; up to 2 tsp for more heat⟦/1⟧
seg.25c2493b65be.t: 1 ଚା ଚାମଚ ସନ୍ନମ ଲଙ୍କା ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ⟦1⟧ଚକଟିବା ପରେ ପଡ଼େ; ଅଧିକ ରାଗ ପାଇଁ 2 ଚା ଚାମଚ ପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ⟦/1⟧
seg.25c2493b65be.back: 1 teaspoon Sannam chilli powder ⟦1⟧goes in after mashing; up to 2 teaspoons for more heat⟦/1⟧

seg.f4f5c6c6e2d3.src: 2½ cups water ⟦1⟧plus ½ cup to adjust⟦/1⟧
seg.f4f5c6c6e2d3.t: 2½ କପ ପାଣି ⟦1⟧ସହିତ ଠିକ କରିବା ପାଇଁ ½ କପ⟦/1⟧
seg.f4f5c6c6e2d3.back: 2½ cups water ⟦1⟧along with ½ cup for adjusting⟦/1⟧

seg.5f7d589d9776.src: 1 tbsp tamarind water (optional) ⟦1⟧if the tomatoes are not very sour⟦/1⟧
seg.5f7d589d9776.t: 1 ଟେବୁଲ ଚାମଚ ତେନ୍ତୁଳି ପାଣି (ଇଚ୍ଛାଧୀନ) ⟦1⟧ଟମାଟା ବେଶି ଖଟା ନ ହେଲେ⟦/1⟧
seg.5f7d589d9776.back: 1 tablespoon tamarind water (optional) ⟦1⟧if the tomatoes are not very sour⟦/1⟧

seg.4efa92e0ce99.src: Wash the toor dal in 2–3 changes of water and drain it.
seg.4efa92e0ce99.t: ହରଡ଼ ଡାଲିକୁ 2–3 ଥର ପାଣି ବଦଳାଇ ଧୋଇ ପାଣି ଛାଣନ୍ତୁ।
seg.4efa92e0ce99.back: Wash the toor dal 2–3 times changing the water and drain.

seg.3f536116a096.src: Put the dal in a pressure cooker with the tomatoes, green chillies, onion and 2½ cups of water.
seg.3f536116a096.t: ଡାଲିକୁ ଟମାଟା, କଞ୍ଚା ଲଙ୍କା, ପିଆଜ ଓ 2½ କପ ପାଣି ସହିତ ପ୍ରେସର କୁକରରେ ରଖନ୍ତୁ।
seg.3f536116a096.back: Put the dal in the pressure cooker with tomato, green chilli, onion and 2½ cups water.

seg.7d012f63f2a2.src: Pressure-cook the dal with the tomatoes, green chillies and turmeric powder for 4 whistles. Stir the turmeric powder into the water before closing the lid, then cook on medium heat.
seg.7d012f63f2a2.t: ଡାଲିକୁ ଟମାଟା, କଞ୍ଚା ଲଙ୍କା ଓ ହଳଦୀ ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ସହିତ 4 ସିଟି ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ। ଢାଙ୍କୁଣି ବନ୍ଦ କରିବା ଆଗରୁ ହଳଦୀ ଗୁଣ୍ଡକୁ ପାଣିରେ ଘାଣ୍ଟି ମିଶାନ୍ତୁ, ତାପରେ ମଧ୍ୟମ ନିଆଁରେ ରାନ୍ଧନ୍ତୁ।
seg.7d012f63f2a2.back: Give the dal 4 whistles with tomato, green chilli and turmeric powder. Before closing the lid stir the turmeric powder into the water, then cook on medium flame.

seg.5dccba018dbc.src: Let the pressure drop on its own, about 10 minutes. The dal is done when a grain mashes completely between two fingers.
seg.5dccba018dbc.t: ପ୍ରେସର ନିଜେ ନିଜେ କମିବାକୁ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ, ପ୍ରାୟ 10 ମିନିଟ। ଦୁଇ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ମଧ୍ୟରେ ଗୋଟିଏ ଦାନା ପୂରା ଚକଟି ହୋଇଗଲେ ଡାଲି ସିଝିଯାଇଛି।
seg.5dccba018dbc.back: Let the pressure release by itself, about 10 minutes. If one grain mashes completely between two fingers, the dal is cooked.

seg.da76f4c700ad.src: Mash well; add the chilli powder and salt. Use a wooden masher (pappu gutti) or the back of a ladle and mash while the dal is still hot, until the tomatoes and dal turn into one smooth mix.
seg.da76f4c700ad.t: ଭଲ କରି ଚକଟନ୍ତୁ; ଲଙ୍କା ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ଓ ଲୁଣ ପକାନ୍ତୁ। କାଠ ଘୋଟଣା (ପପ୍ପୁ ଗୁତ୍ତି) ବା ଡାଡ଼ୁର ପଛ ପଟ ବ୍ୟବହାର କରି ଡାଲି ଗରମ ଥାଉ ଥାଉ ଚକଟନ୍ତୁ, ଯେପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ ଟମାଟା ଓ ଡାଲି ଏକ ମସୃଣ ମିଶ୍ରଣ ନ ହୁଏ।
seg.da76f4c700ad.back: Mash well; add chilli powder and salt. Using a wooden masher (pappu gutti) or the back of a ladle mash the dal while still hot, until the tomato and dal become one smooth mixture.

seg.c1cb2443fbeb.src: Simmer 5 minutes with a splash of water. Add up to ½ cup water for a pouring consistency, and the tamarind water if using, and keep the heat on low so it does not catch.
seg.c1cb2443fbeb.t: ଟିକିଏ ପାଣି ସହିତ 5 ମିନିଟ ଧିମା ଫୁଟାନ୍ତୁ। ଢାଳି ହେବା ପରି ପତଳା କରିବାକୁ ½ କପ ପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ ପାଣି, ଆଉ ବ୍ୟବହାର କରୁଥିଲେ ତେନ୍ତୁଳି ପାଣି ପକାନ୍ତୁ, ଆଉ ତଳେ ନ ଲାଗିବା ପାଇଁ ନିଆଁ ଧିମା ରଖନ୍ତୁ।
seg.c1cb2443fbeb.back: Simmer 5 minutes with a little water. To thin it to pouring consistency add up to ½ cup water, and tamarind water if using, and keep the flame low so it does not stick to the bottom.

seg.b24472a45a67.src: Taste for salt and sourness, then stir in the coriander leaves and switch off.
seg.b24472a45a67.t: ଲୁଣ ଓ ଖଟା ଚାଖନ୍ତୁ, ତାପରେ ଧନିଆ ପତ୍ର ମିଶାଇ ନିଆଁ ବନ୍ଦ କରନ୍ତୁ।
seg.b24472a45a67.back: Taste for salt and sourness, then mix in coriander leaves and turn off the flame.

seg.6f90b7e4f66a.src: Heat the ghee in a small pan on medium heat and add the mustard seeds; let them splutter.
seg.6f90b7e4f66a.t: ଏକ ଛୋଟ ପ୍ୟାନରେ ମଧ୍ୟମ ନିଆଁରେ ଘିଅ ଗରମ କରି ସୋରିଷ ପକାନ୍ତୁ; ଫୁଟିବାକୁ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ।
seg.6f90b7e4f66a.back: In a small pan heat ghee on medium flame and add mustard; let it splutter.

seg.0d1dd3c84a64.src: Fry mustard, cumin, garlic and curry leaves in the ghee; pour over. Add the cumin, garlic and dry red chillies after the mustard and fry until the garlic turns golden, then add the curry leaves and hing, and pour the sizzling tempering over the dal.
seg.0d1dd3c84a64.t: ଘିଅରେ ସୋରିଷ, ଜିରା, ରସୁଣ ଓ ଭୃସଙ୍ଗ ପତ୍ର ଭାଜି ଉପରେ ଢାଳନ୍ତୁ। ସୋରିଷ ପରେ ଜିରା, ରସୁଣ ଓ ଶୁଖିଲା ଲାଲ ଲଙ୍କା ପକାଇ ରସୁଣ ସୁନେଲି ହେବା ଯାଏ ଭାଜନ୍ତୁ, ତାପରେ ଭୃସଙ୍ଗ ପତ୍ର ଓ ହେଙ୍ଗୁ ପକାଇ ଛଣଛଣ ଛୁଙ୍କକୁ ଡାଲି ଉପରେ ଢାଳନ୍ତୁ।
seg.0d1dd3c84a64.back: Fry mustard, cumin, garlic and curry leaves in the ghee and pour on top. After the mustard add cumin, garlic and dry red chilli and fry until the garlic is golden, then add curry leaves and asafoetida and pour the sizzling tempering over the dal.

seg.81a1668adc10.src: Cover for 2 minutes so the tempering flavours the dal, then stir and serve hot.
seg.81a1668adc10.t: ଛୁଙ୍କର ସ୍ୱାଦ ଡାଲିରେ ମିଶିବା ପାଇଁ 2 ମିନିଟ ଘୋଡ଼ାଇ ରଖନ୍ତୁ, ତାପରେ ଘାଣ୍ଟି ଗରମ ଗରମ ପରଷନ୍ତୁ।
seg.81a1668adc10.back: Keep covered 2 minutes for the tempering's flavour to blend into the dal, then stir and serve piping hot.

seg.f904a5f14a1b.src: Mash the dal while it is hot for a smooth pappu. Once it cools, the grains set and stay lumpy.
seg.f904a5f14a1b.t: ମସୃଣ ପପ୍ପୁ ପାଇଁ ଡାଲି ଗରମ ଥାଉ ଥାଉ ଚକଟନ୍ତୁ। ଥଣ୍ଡା ହୋଇଗଲେ ଦାନା ଜମିଯାଏ ଓ ଗୁଣ୍ଡା ଗୁଣ୍ଡା ରହେ।
seg.f904a5f14a1b.back: For a smooth pappu mash the dal while still hot. Once it cools the grains set and it stays lumpy.

seg.1a8211877e00.src: Sannam chilli powder is medium-hot. Start with 1 tsp; go up to 2 tsp for a spicier pappu.
seg.1a8211877e00.t: ସନ୍ନମ ଲଙ୍କା ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ମଧ୍ୟମ ରାଗୁଆ। 1 ଚା ଚାମଚରୁ ଆରମ୍ଭ କରନ୍ତୁ; ଅଧିକ ରାଗୁଆ ପପ୍ପୁ ପାଇଁ 2 ଚା ଚାମଚ ପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ ବଢ଼ାନ୍ତୁ।
seg.1a8211877e00.back: Sannam chilli powder is medium hot. Start with 1 teaspoon; for a hotter pappu increase up to 2 teaspoons.

seg.d85da2ea2cf7.src: Ripe, sour country tomatoes (natu tomatoes) give the best flavour; with mild hybrid tomatoes add the tamarind water.
seg.d85da2ea2cf7.t: ପାଚିଲା, ଖଟା ଦେଶୀ ଟମାଟା (ନାଟୁ ଟମାଟା) ସବୁଠୁ ଭଲ ସ୍ୱାଦ ଦିଏ; କମ୍ ଖଟା ହାଇବ୍ରିଡ ଟମାଟା ହେଲେ ତେନ୍ତୁଳି ପାଣି ପକାନ୍ତୁ।
seg.d85da2ea2cf7.back: Ripe, sour country tomatoes (natu tomato) give the best flavour; if they are less-sour hybrid tomatoes add tamarind water.

seg.37f3ad1bf7b9.src: Let the garlic turn golden in the tempering before the curry leaves go in; pale garlic tastes raw.
seg.37f3ad1bf7b9.t: ଭୃସଙ୍ଗ ପତ୍ର ପକାଇବା ଆଗରୁ ଛୁଙ୍କରେ ରସୁଣକୁ ସୁନେଲି ହେବାକୁ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ; ଫିକା ରସୁଣ କଞ୍ଚା ଲାଗେ।
seg.37f3ad1bf7b9.back: In the tempering let the garlic turn golden before adding curry leaves; pale garlic tastes raw.

seg.dfd3706fe457.src: Teja chilli powder: for a hotter pappu, use ½ tsp Teja chilli powder in place of the Sannam. Teja is very hot, so do not go over 1 tsp.
seg.dfd3706fe457.t: ତେଜା ଲଙ୍କା ଗୁଣ୍ଡ: ଅଧିକ ରାଗୁଆ ପପ୍ପୁ ପାଇଁ ସନ୍ନମ ବଦଳରେ ½ ଚା ଚାମଚ ତେଜା ଲଙ୍କା ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ନିଅନ୍ତୁ। ତେଜା ବହୁତ ରାଗୁଆ, ତେଣୁ 1 ଚା ଚାମଚରୁ ବେଶି ନିଅନ୍ତୁ ନାହିଁ।
seg.dfd3706fe457.back: Teja chilli powder: for a hotter pappu take ½ teaspoon Teja chilli powder instead of Sannam. Teja is very hot, so do not take more than 1 teaspoon.

seg.434f1a510bbb.src: Palakura tomato pappu: add 2 cups chopped spinach to the dal after mashing and simmer 5 minutes.
seg.434f1a510bbb.t: ପାଲକୂରା ଟମାଟା ପପ୍ପୁ: ଚକଟିବା ପରେ ଡାଲିରେ 2 କପ କଟା ପାଳଙ୍ଗ ପକାଇ 5 ମିନିଟ ଧିମା ଫୁଟାନ୍ତୁ।
seg.434f1a510bbb.back: Palakura tomato pappu: after mashing add 2 cups chopped spinach to the dal and simmer 5 minutes.

seg.8d7a932afdbe.src: Pesarapappu: make it with yellow moong dal and cook for 2 whistles only.
seg.8d7a932afdbe.t: ପେସରପପ୍ପୁ: ହଳଦିଆ ମୁଗ ଡାଲିରେ ତିଆରି କରନ୍ତୁ ଓ କେବଳ 2 ସିଟି ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ।
seg.8d7a932afdbe.back: Pesarapappu: make it with yellow moong dal and give only 2 whistles.

seg.94f44314ecbb.src: Serve hot with steamed rice, a spoon of ghee and an appadam or avakaya on the side. It also goes well with chapati.
seg.94f44314ecbb.t: ଗରମ ଭାତ, ଚାମଚେ ଘିଅ ଓ ପାଖରେ ପାମ୍ପଡ଼ ବା ଆବକାୟ (ଆମ୍ବ ଆଚାର) ସହିତ ଗରମ ଗରମ ପରଷନ୍ତୁ। ଚପାତି ସହିତ ମଧ୍ୟ ଭଲ ଲାଗେ।
seg.94f44314ecbb.back: Serve piping hot with hot rice, a spoon of ghee and papad or avakaya (mango pickle) alongside. Also goes well with chapati.

seg.29a23e2fa864.src: Keep leftovers covered in the fridge and eat within 2 days. The dal thickens when chilled; add a little hot water and heat through before serving.
seg.29a23e2fa864.t: ବଳକା ଘୋଡ଼ାଇ ଫ୍ରିଜରେ ରଖନ୍ତୁ ଓ 2 ଦିନ ଭିତରେ ଖାଆନ୍ତୁ। ଥଣ୍ଡା ହେଲେ ଡାଲି ବହଳ ହୁଏ; ପରଷିବା ଆଗରୁ ଟିକିଏ ଗରମ ପାଣି ମିଶାଇ ଭଲ କରି ଗରମ କରନ୍ତୁ।
seg.29a23e2fa864.back: Keep leftovers covered in the fridge and eat within 2 days. The dal thickens when cold; before serving mix in a little hot water and heat well.

seg.8e56f1d7c871.src: How many whistles for toor dal in a pressure cooker?
seg.8e56f1d7c871.t: ପ୍ରେସର କୁକରରେ ହରଡ଼ ଡାଲି ପାଇଁ କେତେ ସିଟି?
seg.8e56f1d7c871.back: How many whistles for toor dal in a pressure cooker?

seg.562abdd39933.src: About 4 whistles on medium heat, then let the pressure drop on its own. Older dal or dal that was not washed well may need 5.
seg.562abdd39933.t: ମଧ୍ୟମ ନିଆଁରେ ପ୍ରାୟ 4 ସିଟି, ତାପରେ ପ୍ରେସର ନିଜେ ନିଜେ କମିବାକୁ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ। ପୁରୁଣା ଡାଲି ବା ଭଲ କରି ଧୁଆ ହୋଇ ନ ଥିବା ଡାଲିରେ 5ଟି ଲାଗିପାରେ।
seg.562abdd39933.back: About 4 whistles on medium flame, then let the pressure release by itself. Old dal or dal not washed well may need 5.

seg.6a800f643cf1.src: What is the difference between tomato pappu and sambar?
seg.6a800f643cf1.t: ଟମାଟା ପପ୍ପୁ ଓ ସାମ୍ବର ମଧ୍ୟରେ ଫରକ କଣ?
seg.6a800f643cf1.back: What is the difference between tomato pappu and sambar?

seg.05135ac52968.src: Tomato pappu is a thick, mashed dal with a simple tempering and no sambar powder or vegetables. Sambar is thinner, uses tamarind, vegetables and a roasted spice powder.
seg.05135ac52968.t: ଟମାଟା ପପ୍ପୁ ହେଉଛି ସାଧା ଛୁଙ୍କ ଥିବା ବହଳ, ଚକଟା ଡାଲି, ସାମ୍ବର ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ବା ପରିବା ବିନା। ସାମ୍ବର ପତଳା, ଏଥିରେ ତେନ୍ତୁଳି, ପରିବା ଓ ଭଜା ମସଲା ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ପଡ଼େ।
seg.05135ac52968.back: Tomato pappu is a thick, mashed dal with a simple tempering, without sambar powder or vegetables. Sambar is thinner; tamarind, vegetables and roasted spice powder go into it.

seg.19117f898a31.src: Can I make tomato pappu without a pressure cooker?
seg.19117f898a31.t: ପ୍ରେସର କୁକର ବିନା ଟମାଟା ପପ୍ପୁ ତିଆରି କରିପାରିବି କି?
seg.19117f898a31.back: Can I make tomato pappu without a pressure cooker?

seg.631df239c7a7.src: Yes. Soak the dal for 30 minutes and cook it in a covered pot with 3½ cups of water for about 40–45 minutes, stirring now and then, until it mashes easily.
seg.631df239c7a7.t: ହଁ। ଡାଲିକୁ 30 ମିନିଟ ଭିଜାନ୍ତୁ ଓ ଘୋଡ଼ା ହାଣ୍ଡିରେ 3½ କପ ପାଣି ସହିତ ପ୍ରାୟ 40–45 ମିନିଟ ରାନ୍ଧନ୍ତୁ, ମଝିରେ ମଝିରେ ଘାଣ୍ଟନ୍ତୁ, ଯେପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ ସହଜରେ ଚକଟି ନ ହୁଏ।
seg.631df239c7a7.back: Yes. Soak the dal 30 minutes and cook in a covered pot with 3½ cups water about 40–45 minutes, stirring now and then, until it mashes easily.

seg.b1140d6c02b4.src: Why is my tomato pappu too sour?
seg.b1140d6c02b4.t: ମୋ ଟମାଟା ପପ୍ପୁ କାହିଁକି ବହୁତ ଖଟା?
seg.b1140d6c02b4.back: Why is my tomato pappu very sour?

seg.6fb0505bf751.src: Some tomatoes are very sour. Simmer the dal a few more minutes and stir in a pinch of jaggery or a spoon of extra mashed dal to balance it.
seg.6fb0505bf751.t: କିଛି ଟମାଟା ବହୁତ ଖଟା ହୁଏ। ଡାଲିକୁ ଆଉ କିଛି ମିନିଟ ଧିମା ଫୁଟାନ୍ତୁ ଓ ସନ୍ତୁଳନ ପାଇଁ ଚିମୁଟାଏ ଗୁଡ଼ ବା ଚାମଚେ ଅଧିକ ଚକଟା ଡାଲି ମିଶାନ୍ତୁ।
seg.6fb0505bf751.back: Some tomatoes are very sour. Simmer the dal a few more minutes and for balance mix in a pinch of jaggery or a spoon more of mashed dal.

seg.80a51a64344d.src: టమాటో పప్పు · Andhra Tomato Dal Recipe | 1acrefarms
seg.80a51a64344d.t: టమాటో పప్పు · ଆନ୍ଧ୍ରର ଟମାଟା ଡାଲି ରେସିପି | 1acrefarms
seg.80a51a64344d.back: టమాటో పప్పు · Andhra tomato dal recipe | 1acrefarms

seg.7b91fd1a3bc3.src: టమాటో పప్పు. Andhra tomato dal: toor dal cooked soft with tomatoes and green chillies, our turmeric and Sannam chilli powder, and a garlic tempering. Serves 4.
seg.7b91fd1a3bc3.t: టమాటో పప్పు. ଆନ୍ଧ୍ରର ଟମାଟା ଡାଲି: ଟମାଟା, କଞ୍ଚା ଲଙ୍କା, ଆମ ହଳଦୀ ଓ ସନ୍ନମ ଲଙ୍କା ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ସହିତ ନରମ କରି ସିଝା ହରଡ଼ ଡାଲି, ରସୁଣ ଛୁଙ୍କ ସହିତ। 4 ଜଣଙ୍କ ପାଇଁ।
seg.7b91fd1a3bc3.back: టమాటో పప్పు. Andhra tomato dal: toor dal boiled soft with tomato, green chilli, our turmeric and Sannam chilli powder, with a garlic tempering. For 4 people.

seg.bf96bcd14023.src: Tomato Pappu: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.bf96bcd14023.t: ଟମାଟା ପପ୍ପୁ: 1acrefarmsର ରେସିପି କାର୍ଡ, ଉପକରଣ ଓ ପ୍ରଣାଳୀ ସହିତ
seg.bf96bcd14023.back: Tomato Pappu: 1acrefarms recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.9078b361da10.src: ⟦#1⟧ · ⟦#2⟧ · Vellulli Kaaram · Lahsun Ki Sookhi Chutney
seg.9078b361da10.t: ⟦#1⟧ · ⟦#2⟧ · ଭେଲ୍ଲୁଲ୍ଲି କାରମ · ଲହସୁନ କୀ ସୂଖୀ ଚଟନୀ
seg.9078b361da10.back: ⟦#1⟧ · ⟦#2⟧ · Vellulli Karam · Lahsun ki sookhi chutney

seg.464f01dcf4e8.src: Vellulli kaaram is the garlic chilli podi kept on Andhra dining tables: red chilli powder pounded with plenty of garlic, roasted coriander and cumin, and salt. Mixed into the first handful of hot rice with ghee, or sprinkled over idli and dosa with a little oil, it is a quick meal on busy days and a staple in tiffin boxes.
seg.464f01dcf4e8.t: ଭେଲ୍ଲୁଲ୍ଲି କାରମ ହେଉଛି ଆନ୍ଧ୍ରର ଖାଇବା ଟେବୁଲରେ ରହୁଥିବା ରସୁଣ ଲଙ୍କା ପୋଡି: ଲାଲ ଲଙ୍କା ଗୁଣ୍ଡକୁ ପ୍ରଚୁର ରସୁଣ, ଭଜା ଧନିଆ ଓ ଜିରା, ଆଉ ଲୁଣ ସହିତ କୁଟାଯାଏ। ଗରମ ଭାତର ପ୍ରଥମ ମୁଠାରେ ଘିଅ ସହିତ ମିଶାଇ, କିମ୍ବା ଇଡ଼ଲି ଓ ଦୋସା ଉପରେ ଅଳ୍ପ ତେଲ ସହିତ ଛିଞ୍ଚି, ବ୍ୟସ୍ତ ଦିନରେ ଏହା ଶୀଘ୍ର ଖାଇବା, ଆଉ ଟିଫିନ ବାକ୍ସର ନିୟମିତ ଜିନିଷ।
seg.464f01dcf4e8.back: Vellulli karam is the garlic chilli podi kept on the Andhra dining table: red chilli powder is pounded with plenty of garlic, roasted coriander and cumin, and salt. Mixed with ghee into the first handful of hot rice, or sprinkled with a little oil over idli and dosa, it is a quick meal on busy days, and a regular item in tiffin boxes.

seg.a9654adade5e.src: Our Teja chilli powder makes it deep red and very hot, the way Guntur homes like it. For less heat, use half Sannam chilli powder.
seg.a9654adade5e.t: ଆମ ତେଜା ଲଙ୍କା ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ଏହାକୁ ଗାଢ଼ ଲାଲ ଓ ବହୁତ ରାଗୁଆ କରେ, ଯେପରି ଗୁଣ୍ଟୁରର ଘରେ ପସନ୍ଦ। କମ୍ ରାଗ ପାଇଁ ଅଧା ସନ୍ନମ ଲଙ୍କା ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ନିଅନ୍ତୁ।
seg.a9654adade5e.back: Our Teja chilli powder makes it deep red and very hot, as liked in Guntur homes. For less heat take half Sannam chilli powder.

seg.b43a6fdf4164.src: Total includes cooling the seeds and garlic before grinding.
seg.b43a6fdf4164.t: ମୋଟ ସମୟରେ ବାଟିବା ଆଗରୁ ମଞ୍ଜି ଓ ରସୁଣ ଥଣ୍ଡା କରିବା ସମୟ ମଧ୍ୟ ଅଛି।
seg.b43a6fdf4164.back: The total time also includes time for cooling the seeds and garlic before grinding.

seg.501bcac1011e.src: Roast coriander and cumin, grind them, then pulse with Teja chilli powder, salt and lightly warmed garlic into a coarse podi. Eat it with hot rice and ghee, idli or dosa.
seg.501bcac1011e.t: ଧନିଆ ଓ ଜିରା ଭାଜି ଗୁଣ୍ଡ କରନ୍ତୁ, ତାପରେ ତେଜା ଲଙ୍କା ଗୁଣ୍ଡ, ଲୁଣ ଓ ହାଲୁକା ଗରମ କରା ରସୁଣ ସହିତ ପଲ୍ସ କରି ଦରଦରା ପୋଡି କରନ୍ତୁ। ଗରମ ଭାତ ଓ ଘିଅ, ଇଡ଼ଲି ବା ଦୋସା ସହିତ ଖାଆନ୍ତୁ।
seg.501bcac1011e.back: Roast and powder coriander and cumin, then pulse with Teja chilli powder, salt and lightly warmed garlic into a coarse podi. Eat with hot rice and ghee, idli or dosa.

seg.e9ce857fe180.src: 25 garlic cloves ⟦1⟧about ½ cup, peeled; the thin inner skin can stay⟦/1⟧
seg.e9ce857fe180.t: 25ଟି ରସୁଣ କୋଳି ⟦1⟧ପ୍ରାୟ ½ କପ, ଚୋପା ଛଡ଼ା; ଭିତରର ପତଳା ଚୋପା ରହିପାରେ⟦/1⟧
seg.e9ce857fe180.back: 25 garlic cloves ⟦1⟧about ½ cup, peeled; the thin inner skin can stay⟦/1⟧

seg.47382aff4c0b.src: ¼ cup Teja chilli powder ⟦1⟧very hot; see the tips to make it milder⟦/1⟧
seg.47382aff4c0b.t: ¼ କପ ତେଜା ଲଙ୍କା ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ⟦1⟧ବହୁତ ରାଗୁଆ; କମ୍ ରାଗୁଆ କରିବା ପାଇଁ ଟିପ୍ସ ଦେଖନ୍ତୁ⟦/1⟧
seg.47382aff4c0b.back: ¼ cup Teja chilli powder ⟦1⟧very hot; see the tips for making it less hot⟦/1⟧

seg.33ac26ca8201.t: 1ଟି ଛୋଟ ମାର୍ବଲ ଆକାରର ତେନ୍ତୁଳି (ଇଚ୍ଛାଧୀନ) ⟦1⟧ଶୁଖିଲା, ମଞ୍ଜି ବାହାର କରା⟦/1⟧

seg.7bca54595a6a.src: Ghee or oil ⟦1⟧1 tsp per serving⟦/1⟧
seg.7bca54595a6a.t: ଘିଅ ବା ତେଲ ⟦1⟧ପ୍ରତି ଥାଳି ପାଇଁ 1 ଚା ଚାମଚ⟦/1⟧
seg.7bca54595a6a.back: Ghee or oil ⟦1⟧1 teaspoon per plate⟦/1⟧

seg.074d39a3f8b1.src: Peel the garlic and pat the cloves completely dry with a cloth; any water shortens how long the podi keeps.
seg.074d39a3f8b1.t: ରସୁଣର ଚୋପା ଛଡ଼ାଇ କୋଳିଗୁଡ଼ିକୁ କପଡ଼ାରେ ପୂରା ପୋଛି ଶୁଖାନ୍ତୁ; ଅଳ୍ପ ପାଣି ବି ପୋଡି କମ୍ ଦିନ ରହିବାର କାରଣ ହୁଏ।
seg.074d39a3f8b1.back: Peel the garlic and wipe the cloves completely dry with a cloth; even a little water causes the podi to keep fewer days.

seg.33bb0e9eea87.src: Dry-roast the coriander and cumin seeds till fragrant; let them cool. Use a small pan on medium-low heat; this takes 1–2 minutes, and the coriander should turn a shade darker, not brown.
seg.33bb0e9eea87.t: ଧନିଆ ଓ ଜିରାକୁ ତେଲ ବିନା ବାସନା ଆସିବା ଯାଏ ଭାଜନ୍ତୁ; ଥଣ୍ଡା ହେବାକୁ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ। ମଧ୍ୟମରୁ କମ୍ ନିଆଁରେ ଛୋଟ ପ୍ୟାନ ବ୍ୟବହାର କରନ୍ତୁ; ଏଥିରେ 1–2 ମିନିଟ ଲାଗେ, ଆଉ ଧନିଆ ଏକ ଛାଇ ଗାଢ଼ ହେବା ଉଚିତ, ବାଦାମୀ ନୁହେଁ।
seg.33bb0e9eea87.back: Roast coriander and cumin without oil until aromatic; let cool. Use a small pan on medium-to-low flame; this takes 1–2 minutes, and the coriander should turn one shade darker, not brown.

seg.a2f7a86fc993.src: Warm the garlic in 1 tsp oil for 2 minutes. Keep the heat low and stir; the cloves should soften slightly at the edges without browning. Let it cool.
seg.a2f7a86fc993.t: ରସୁଣକୁ 1 ଚା ଚାମଚ ତେଲରେ 2 ମିନିଟ ଗରମ କରନ୍ତୁ। ନିଆଁ ଧିମା ରଖି ଘାଣ୍ଟନ୍ତୁ; କୋଳିର କଡ଼ ଟିକିଏ ନରମ ହେବା ଉଚିତ କିନ୍ତୁ ବାଦାମୀ ନୁହେଁ। ଥଣ୍ଡା ହେବାକୁ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ।
seg.a2f7a86fc993.back: Warm the garlic in 1 teaspoon oil for 2 minutes. Keep the flame low and stir; the edges of the cloves should soften a little but not brown. Let cool.

seg.a4d0f7c87bd5.src: Grind the seeds to a powder, then pulse with the chilli powder and salt. Add the tamarind with the seeds, if using, so it breaks down evenly.
seg.a4d0f7c87bd5.t: ମଞ୍ଜିକୁ ଗୁଣ୍ଡ କରନ୍ତୁ, ତାପରେ ଲଙ୍କା ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ଓ ଲୁଣ ସହିତ ପଲ୍ସ କରନ୍ତୁ। ବ୍ୟବହାର କରୁଥିଲେ ତେନ୍ତୁଳି ମଞ୍ଜି ସହିତ ପକାନ୍ତୁ, ଯେପରି ସମାନ ଭାବେ ଭାଙ୍ଗିଯାଏ।
seg.a4d0f7c87bd5.back: Powder the seeds, then pulse with chilli powder and salt. If using, add the tamarind with the seeds, so it breaks up evenly.

seg.c12763cab28c.src: Add the garlic and pulse in short bursts to a coarse, moist powder. Stop and scrape down the jar after every 2–3 pulses, as garlic sticks to the sides.
seg.c12763cab28c.t: ରସୁଣ ପକାଇ ଛୋଟ ଛୋଟ ପଲ୍ସରେ ଦରଦରା, ଓଦା ଗୁଣ୍ଡ କରନ୍ତୁ। ପ୍ରତି 2–3 ପଲ୍ସ ପରେ ବନ୍ଦ କରି ଜାରର କଡ଼ରୁ ଚାଞ୍ଛି ଆଣନ୍ତୁ, କାରଣ ରସୁଣ କଡ଼ରେ ଲାଗିଯାଏ।
seg.c12763cab28c.back: Add the garlic and in short pulses make a coarse, moist powder. Stop after every 2–3 pulses and scrape down the sides of the jar, because garlic sticks to the sides.

seg.31358182425b.src: In a stone mortar, pound the seeds first, then the garlic with the salt, and work in the chilli powder last.
seg.31358182425b.t: ପଥର ଖଲରେ ପ୍ରଥମେ ମଞ୍ଜି କୁଟନ୍ତୁ, ତାପରେ ଲୁଣ ସହିତ ରସୁଣ, ଆଉ ଶେଷରେ ଲଙ୍କା ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ମିଶାନ୍ତୁ।
seg.31358182425b.back: In a stone mortar first pound the seeds, then the garlic with salt, and at the end mix in the chilli powder.

seg.29ac6dd20660.src: Taste a pinch with a little rice and ghee, and add salt if needed.
seg.29ac6dd20660.t: ଅଳ୍ପ ଭାତ ଓ ଘିଅ ସହିତ ଚିମୁଟାଏ ଚାଖନ୍ତୁ, ଦରକାର ହେଲେ ଲୁଣ ପକାନ୍ତୁ।
seg.29ac6dd20660.back: Taste a pinch with a little rice and ghee, and add salt if needed.

seg.b4ccc3b591dd.src: Spread the podi on a plate for 10 minutes so the steam escapes, then pack it into a clean, dry jar.
seg.b4ccc3b591dd.t: ବାଷ୍ପ ବାହାରିବା ପାଇଁ ପୋଡିକୁ ଏକ ଥାଳିରେ 10 ମିନିଟ ବିଛାଇ ରଖନ୍ତୁ, ତାପରେ ଏକ ସଫା, ଶୁଖିଲା ବୋତଲରେ ଭରନ୍ତୁ।
seg.b4ccc3b591dd.back: To let the steam escape keep the podi spread on a plate 10 minutes, then fill into a clean, dry jar.

seg.23d348ffe051.src: Teja is very hot; use half Sannam for a milder podi, or cut the chilli powder to 3 tbsp for the same garlic.
seg.23d348ffe051.t: ତେଜା ବହୁତ ରାଗୁଆ; କମ୍ ରାଗୁଆ ପୋଡି ପାଇଁ ଅଧା ସନ୍ନମ ନିଅନ୍ତୁ, କିମ୍ବା ସେତିକି ରସୁଣ ପାଇଁ ଲଙ୍କା ଗୁଣ୍ଡକୁ 3 ଟେବୁଲ ଚାମଚକୁ କମାନ୍ତୁ।
seg.23d348ffe051.back: Teja is very hot; for a less hot podi take half Sannam, or for the same garlic reduce the chilli powder to 3 tablespoons.

seg.948075d5f572.src: Dry the garlic well and warm it in oil; damp garlic makes the podi go off quickly.
seg.948075d5f572.t: ରସୁଣକୁ ଭଲ କରି ଶୁଖାଇ ତେଲରେ ଗରମ କରନ୍ତୁ; ଓଦା ରସୁଣ ପୋଡିକୁ ଶୀଘ୍ର ଖରାପ କରିଦିଏ।
seg.948075d5f572.back: Dry the garlic well and warm it in oil; wet garlic quickly spoils the podi.

seg.1a71c64c8c74.src: Pulse, do not run the mixer: run it long and the garlic turns into a paste.
seg.1a71c64c8c74.t: ପଲ୍ସ କରନ୍ତୁ, ମିକ୍ସି ଲଗାତାର ଚଲାନ୍ତୁ ନାହିଁ: ବହୁତ ସମୟ ଚଲାଇଲେ ରସୁଣ ବଟା ହୋଇଯାଏ।
seg.1a71c64c8c74.back: Pulse, do not run the mixie continuously: run too long and the garlic becomes a paste.

seg.d1432fb9a627.src: Mix 1 tsp podi with 1 tsp ghee into a cup of hot rice; adjust to taste.
seg.d1432fb9a627.t: ଏକ କପ ଗରମ ଭାତରେ 1 ଚା ଚାମଚ ପୋଡି ଓ 1 ଚା ଚାମଚ ଘିଅ ମିଶାନ୍ତୁ; ସ୍ୱାଦ ଅନୁସାରେ ଠିକ କରନ୍ତୁ।
seg.d1432fb9a627.back: Mix 1 teaspoon podi and 1 teaspoon ghee into a cup of hot rice; adjust to taste.

seg.bdc5e9728b98.src: With dals: dry-roast 1 tbsp chana dal and 1 tbsp urad dal with the seeds for a nuttier, slightly milder podi.
seg.bdc5e9728b98.t: ଡାଲି ସହିତ: ଅଧିକ ବାଦାମ ପରି ସ୍ୱାଦ ଓ ଟିକିଏ କମ୍ ରାଗ ପାଇଁ ମଞ୍ଜି ସହିତ 1 ଟେବୁଲ ଚାମଚ ବୁଟ ଡାଲି ଓ 1 ଟେବୁଲ ଚାମଚ ବିରି ଡାଲି ତେଲ ବିନା ଭାଜନ୍ତୁ।
seg.bdc5e9728b98.back: With dal: for a more nutty taste and a little less heat dry-roast 1 tablespoon chana dal and 1 tablespoon urad dal without oil with the seeds.

seg.4d03eacf7428.src: Raw garlic: skip warming the garlic for a sharper taste, and eat it within a week.
seg.4d03eacf7428.t: କଞ୍ଚା ରସୁଣ: ଅଧିକ ତୀକ୍ଷ୍ଣ ସ୍ୱାଦ ପାଇଁ ରସୁଣ ଗରମ କରିବା ବାଦ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ, ଆଉ ଏକ ସପ୍ତାହ ଭିତରେ ଖାଆନ୍ତୁ।
seg.4d03eacf7428.back: Raw garlic: for a sharper taste skip warming the garlic, and eat within a week.

seg.21139bdcd961.src: Medium heat: use 2 tbsp Teja and 2 tbsp Sannam chilli powder.
seg.21139bdcd961.t: ମଧ୍ୟମ ରାଗ: 2 ଟେବୁଲ ଚାମଚ ତେଜା ଓ 2 ଟେବୁଲ ଚାମଚ ସନ୍ନମ ଲଙ୍କା ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ନିଅନ୍ତୁ।
seg.21139bdcd961.back: Medium heat: take 2 tablespoons Teja and 2 tablespoons Sannam chilli powder.

seg.bceea7c8cb4f.src: Mix with the first handful of hot rice and ghee, or sprinkle over idli, dosa or pesarattu with a little oil or ghee.
seg.bceea7c8cb4f.t: ଗରମ ଭାତର ପ୍ରଥମ ମୁଠା ଓ ଘିଅ ସହିତ ମିଶାନ୍ତୁ, କିମ୍ବା ଇଡ଼ଲି, ଦୋସା ବା ପେସରଟ୍ଟୁ ଉପରେ ଅଳ୍ପ ତେଲ ବା ଘିଅ ସହିତ ଛିଞ୍ଚନ୍ତୁ।
seg.bceea7c8cb4f.back: Mix with the first handful of hot rice and ghee, or sprinkle over idli, dosa or pesarattu with a little oil or ghee.

seg.5fd9cf1554fd.src: Keep in a clean, dry, airtight jar for about 2 weeks at room temperature, or a month in the fridge. Always use a dry spoon.
seg.5fd9cf1554fd.t: ଏକ ସଫା, ଶୁଖିଲା, ବାୟୁରୋଧୀ ବୋତଲରେ ସାଧାରଣ ତାପମାତ୍ରାରେ ପ୍ରାୟ 2 ସପ୍ତାହ, କିମ୍ବା ଫ୍ରିଜରେ ଏକ ମାସ ରଖନ୍ତୁ। ସବୁବେଳେ ଶୁଖିଲା ଚାମଚ ବ୍ୟବହାର କରନ୍ତୁ।
seg.5fd9cf1554fd.back: Keep in a clean, dry, airtight jar at room temperature about 2 weeks, or in the fridge a month. Always use a dry spoon.

seg.c58bc6538b2f.src: How do you make vellulli kaaram?
seg.c58bc6538b2f.back: How do you make vellulli karam?

seg.0ecd3203de93.src: Roast coriander and cumin seeds, grind them, add chilli powder and salt, then pulse in peeled garlic cloves to a coarse, moist powder. Andhra homes often pound it in a stone mortar.
seg.0ecd3203de93.t: ଧନିଆ ଓ ଜିରା ଭାଜି ଗୁଣ୍ଡ କରନ୍ତୁ, ଲଙ୍କା ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ଓ ଲୁଣ ପକାନ୍ତୁ, ତାପରେ ଚୋପା ଛଡ଼ା ରସୁଣ କୋଳି ପକାଇ ପଲ୍ସ କରି ଦରଦରା, ଓଦା ଗୁଣ୍ଡ କରନ୍ତୁ। ଆନ୍ଧ୍ରର ଘରେ ଅନେକ ସମୟରେ ଏହାକୁ ପଥର ଖଲରେ କୁଟନ୍ତି।
seg.0ecd3203de93.back: Roast and powder coriander and cumin, add chilli powder and salt, then add peeled garlic cloves and pulse into a coarse, moist powder. In Andhra homes it is often pounded in a stone mortar.

seg.727d415cb888.src: How do I make garlic podi less spicy?
seg.727d415cb888.t: ରସୁଣ ପୋଡିକୁ କିପରି କମ୍ ରାଗୁଆ କରିବି?
seg.727d415cb888.back: How do I make garlic podi less hot?

seg.e4231ea5cf7a.src: Use half Sannam chilli powder in place of half the Teja, or use 3 tbsp chilli powder in all. Eating it with plenty of ghee also takes the edge off.
seg.e4231ea5cf7a.t: ଅଧା ତେଜା ବଦଳରେ ଅଧା ସନ୍ନମ ଲଙ୍କା ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ନିଅନ୍ତୁ, କିମ୍ବା ମୋଟ 3 ଟେବୁଲ ଚାମଚ ଲଙ୍କା ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ନିଅନ୍ତୁ। ପ୍ରଚୁର ଘିଅ ସହିତ ଖାଇଲେ ମଧ୍ୟ ରାଗର ତୀକ୍ଷ୍ଣତା କମେ।
seg.e4231ea5cf7a.back: Take half Sannam chilli powder instead of half the Teja, or take 3 tablespoons chilli powder in total. Eating it with plenty of ghee also lessens the sharpness of the heat.

seg.982e854e4417.src: How long does vellulli kaaram last?
seg.982e854e4417.back: How many days does vellulli karam keep?

seg.a620f29950c0.src: About 2 weeks at room temperature in a dry, airtight jar, or a month in the fridge. Dry the garlic well and warm it in oil first so it lasts longer.
seg.a620f29950c0.t: ଶୁଖିଲା, ବାୟୁରୋଧୀ ବୋତଲରେ ସାଧାରଣ ତାପମାତ୍ରାରେ ପ୍ରାୟ 2 ସପ୍ତାହ, କିମ୍ବା ଫ୍ରିଜରେ ଏକ ମାସ। ଅଧିକ ଦିନ ରଖିବା ପାଇଁ ରସୁଣକୁ ଭଲ କରି ଶୁଖାଇ ପ୍ରଥମେ ତେଲରେ ଗରମ କରନ୍ତୁ।
seg.a620f29950c0.back: About 2 weeks in a dry, airtight jar at room temperature, or a month in the fridge. To keep it longer dry the garlic well and first warm it in oil.

seg.4c626acd1bdd.src: Can I use whole dried red chillies instead of chilli powder?
seg.4c626acd1bdd.t: ଲଙ୍କା ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ବଦଳରେ ଗୋଟା ଶୁଖିଲା ଲାଲ ଲଙ୍କା ବ୍ୟବହାର କରିପାରିବି କି?
seg.4c626acd1bdd.back: Can I use whole dry red chillies instead of chilli powder?

seg.c796942589c3.src: Yes. Dry-roast about 20 dried red chillies with a few drops of oil until crisp, cool and grind them before adding the garlic.
seg.c796942589c3.t: ହଁ। ପ୍ରାୟ 20ଟି ଶୁଖିଲା ଲାଲ ଲଙ୍କାକୁ କିଛି ଟୋପା ତେଲ ସହିତ କୁରକୁରିଆ ହେବା ଯାଏ ଭାଜନ୍ତୁ, ଥଣ୍ଡା କରି ରସୁଣ ପକାଇବା ଆଗରୁ ଗୁଣ୍ଡ କରନ୍ତୁ।
seg.c796942589c3.back: Yes. Fry about 20 dry red chillies with a few drops of oil until crisp, cool and powder them before adding the garlic.

seg.c5afa85ab56d.src: వెల్లుల్లి కారం. Andhra garlic chilli podi: roasted coriander and cumin pounded with garlic, salt and Teja chilli powder. Mix with hot rice and ghee, or idli and dosa.
seg.c5afa85ab56d.t: వెల్లుల్లి కారం. ଆନ୍ଧ୍ରର ରସୁଣ ଲଙ୍କା ପୋଡି: ଭଜା ଧନିଆ ଓ ଜିରାକୁ ରସୁଣ, ଲୁଣ ଓ ତେଜା ଲଙ୍କା ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ସହିତ କୁଟାଯାଏ। ଗରମ ଭାତ ଓ ଘିଅ, କିମ୍ବା ଇଡ଼ଲି ଓ ଦୋସା ସହିତ ମିଶାଇ ଖାଆନ୍ତୁ।
seg.c5afa85ab56d.back: వెల్లుల్లి కారం. Andhra garlic chilli podi: roasted coriander and cumin pounded with garlic, salt and Teja chilli powder. Mix and eat with hot rice and ghee, or with idli and dosa.

seg.eff09f5a48ed.src: Vellulli Kaaram: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.eff09f5a48ed.t: ଭେଲ୍ଲୁଲ୍ଲି କାରମ: 1acrefarmsର ରେସିପି କାର୍ଡ, ଉପକରଣ ଓ ପ୍ରଣାଳୀ ସହିତ
seg.eff09f5a48ed.back: Vellulli Karam: 1acrefarms recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.3b01a30ec3ce.src: Rub the chicken with curd, Teja chilli powder, turmeric powder and salt. Rest 30 minutes. Cover the bowl and keep it in the fridge while it rests.
seg.3b01a30ec3ce.t: ଚିକେନରେ ଦହି, ତେଜା ଲଙ୍କା ଗୁଣ୍ଡ, ହଳଦୀ ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ଓ ଲୁଣ ଘଷି ଲଗାନ୍ତୁ। 30 ମିନିଟ ରଖନ୍ତୁ। ସେହି ସମୟରେ ବାଟିକୁ ଘୋଡ଼ାଇ ଫ୍ରିଜରେ ରଖନ୍ତୁ।
seg.3b01a30ec3ce.back: Rub curd, Teja chilli powder, turmeric powder and salt onto the chicken. Keep 30 minutes. During that time cover the bowl and keep it in the fridge.

seg.6cceb77cd01b.src: 500 g fish pieces ⟦1⟧firm fish cut into thick steaks: rohu, catla (bochcha), korameenu (murrel) or seer fish (vanjaram)⟦/1⟧
seg.6cceb77cd01b.t: 500 g ମାଛ ଖଣ୍ଡ ⟦1⟧ଟାଣ ମାଂସର ମାଛ, ମୋଟା ଖଣ୍ଡ କରି କଟା: ରୋହି, ଭାକୁର (ବୋଚ୍ଚା), କୋରମୀନୁ (ଶାଳ ମାଛ) ବା ସିର ମାଛ (ଭଞ୍ଜରମ)⟦/1⟧
seg.6cceb77cd01b.back: 500 g fish pieces ⟦1⟧firm-fleshed fish, cut into thick pieces: rohu, bhakura (boccha), korameenu (shal fish) or seer fish (vanjaram)⟦/1⟧

seg.3248f0a2bb4b.src: 40 g tamarind ⟦1⟧about two lemon-sized balls, soaked in 2 cups warm water for 15 minutes⟦/1⟧
seg.3248f0a2bb4b.t: 40 g ତେନ୍ତୁଳି ⟦1⟧ପ୍ରାୟ ଦୁଇଟି ଲେମ୍ବୁ ଆକାରର ଗୋଲା, 2 କପ ଉଷୁମ ପାଣିରେ 15 ମିନିଟ ଭିଜାଇଥିବା⟦/1⟧
seg.3248f0a2bb4b.back: 40 g tamarind ⟦1⟧about two lemon-sized balls, soaked 15 minutes in 2 cups lukewarm water⟦/1⟧

seg.6efbfa504170.src: Keep leftovers covered in the fridge and eat within 2 days. Reheat gently in the pan without stirring, until steaming hot all the way through.
seg.6efbfa504170.t: ବଳକା ଘୋଡ଼ାଇ ଫ୍ରିଜରେ ରଖନ୍ତୁ ଓ 2 ଦିନ ଭିତରେ ଖାଆନ୍ତୁ। ପ୍ୟାନରେ ନ ଘାଣ୍ଟି ଧୀରେ, ଭିତର ଯାଏ ପୂରା ଭାପ ଉଠିବା ଭଳି ଗରମ ହେବା ପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ ପୁଣି ଗରମ କରନ୍ତୁ।
seg.6efbfa504170.back: Cover the leftovers, keep in the fridge and eat within 2 days. In a pan, without stirring, slowly heat again until hot with steam rising fully all the way to the inside.

seg.379b410c6994.src: Firm river or sea fish cut into thick steaks: rohu, catla (bochcha), murrel (korameenu) or seer fish. Bony small fish also work but need gentle handling.
seg.379b410c6994.t: ମୋଟା ଖଣ୍ଡ କରି କଟା ନଦୀ ବା ସମୁଦ୍ରର ଟାଣ ମାଂସର ମାଛ: ରୋହି, ଭାକୁର (ବୋଚ୍ଚା), ଶାଳ ମାଛ (କୋରମୀନୁ) ବା ସିର ମାଛ। କଣ୍ଟା ଥିବା ଛୋଟ ମାଛ ମଧ୍ୟ ଚଳେ, କିନ୍ତୁ ଯତ୍ନରେ ସମ୍ଭାଳିବାକୁ ପଡ଼େ।
seg.379b410c6994.back: River or sea firm-fleshed fish cut into thick pieces: rohu, bhakura (boccha), shal fish (korameenu) or seer fish. Small fish with bones also work, but have to be handled with care.

seg.3af5b68fc2e1.src: Keep leftovers covered in the fridge and eat within 2 days. Warm the pulusu in a pan with a splash of water until steaming hot all the way through.
seg.3af5b68fc2e1.t: ବଳକା ଘୋଡ଼ାଇ ଫ୍ରିଜରେ ରଖନ୍ତୁ ଓ 2 ଦିନ ଭିତରେ ଖାଆନ୍ତୁ। ପୁଲୁସୁକୁ ପ୍ୟାନରେ ଟିକିଏ ପାଣି ସହିତ, ଭିତର ଯାଏ ପୂରା ଭାପ ଉଠିବା ଭଳି ଗରମ ହେବା ପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ ଗରମ କରନ୍ତୁ।
seg.3af5b68fc2e1.back: Cover the leftovers, keep in the fridge and eat within 2 days. Heat the pulusu in a pan with a little water until hot with steam rising fully all the way to the inside.

seg.b4d28033bb05.src: Mutton vepudu: pressure-cook 500 g boneless mutton with the marinade and ½ cup water for 5–6 whistles, until tender, then fry it the same way.
seg.b4d28033bb05.t: ମଟନ ଭେପୁଡୁ: 500 g ହାଡ଼ ବିନା ମଟନକୁ ମାରିନେଡ ଓ ½ କପ ପାଣି ସହିତ ପ୍ରେସର କୁକରରେ 5–6 ସିଟି ଦେଇ ନରମ ହେବା ଯାଏ ସିଝାନ୍ତୁ, ତାପରେ ସେହିପରି ଭାଜନ୍ତୁ।
seg.b4d28033bb05.back: Mutton vepudu: boil 500 g boneless mutton with the marinade and ½ cup water in a pressure cooker for 5–6 whistles until soft, then fry the same way.

seg.04112853a660.src: Both work. Boneless cooks faster and crisps more; small bone-in pieces have more flavour but need 6–8 minutes longer in their juices.
seg.04112853a660.t: ଦୁହେଁ ଚଳେ। ହାଡ଼ ବିନା ଶୀଘ୍ର ସିଝେ ଓ ଅଧିକ କୁରକୁରିଆ ହୁଏ; ହାଡ଼ ସହିତ ଛୋଟ ଖଣ୍ଡରେ ଅଧିକ ସ୍ୱାଦ ଥାଏ କିନ୍ତୁ ନିଜ ରସରେ 6–8 ମିନିଟ ଅଧିକ ଲାଗେ।
seg.04112853a660.back: Both work. Boneless cooks quickly and becomes crispier; small bone-in pieces have more flavour but take 6–8 minutes more in their own juice.

seg.d20a641bec03.src: Pack it for a lunch box or a short journey and eat it within about 4 hours. Keep leftovers covered in the fridge and eat them within a day.
seg.d20a641bec03.t: ଟିଫିନ ବା ଛୋଟ ଯାତ୍ରା ପାଇଁ ପ୍ୟାକ କଲେ ପ୍ରାୟ 4 ଘଣ୍ଟା ଭିତରେ ଖାଆନ୍ତୁ। ବଳକା ଘୋଡ଼ାଇ ଫ୍ରିଜରେ ରଖନ୍ତୁ ଓ ଦିନେ ଭିତରେ ଖାଆନ୍ତୁ।
seg.d20a641bec03.back: If packed for a tiffin or a short trip, eat within about 4 hours. Cover the leftovers, keep in the fridge and eat within a day.

seg.bc9078e02646.src: Either the lemon juice was cooked or the turmeric burnt in the oil. Add the turmeric last, switch off the stove right after and stir for only 5–10 seconds; add the lemon juice to the rice, off the heat.
seg.bc9078e02646.t: ହୁଏତ ଲେମ୍ବୁ ରସ ରନ୍ଧା ହୋଇଗଲା ବା ହଳଦୀ ତେଲରେ ପୋଡ଼ିଗଲା। ହଳଦୀ ସବୁଠୁ ଶେଷରେ ପକାନ୍ତୁ, ତୁରନ୍ତ ଚୁଲି ବନ୍ଦ କରନ୍ତୁ ଓ କେବଳ 5–10 ସେକେଣ୍ଡ ଘାଣ୍ଟନ୍ତୁ; ଲେମ୍ବୁ ରସ ନିଆଁ ବାହାରେ ଭାତରେ ପକାନ୍ତୁ।
seg.bc9078e02646.back: Perhaps the lemon juice got cooked or the turmeric burnt in the oil. Add turmeric at the very end, turn off the stove immediately and stir only 5–10 seconds; add the lemon juice to the rice off the fire.

seg.c288f67fcabb.src: Pour the other cup of water into a heavy-bottomed pan; a thin pan lets the ragi catch.
seg.c288f67fcabb.t: ଅନ୍ୟ କପ ପାଣି ଏକ ମୋଟା ତଳ ପ୍ୟାନରେ ଢାଳନ୍ତୁ; ପତଳା ପ୍ୟାନରେ ରାଗି ତଳେ ଲାଗିଯାଏ।
seg.c288f67fcabb.back: Pour the other cup of water into a thick-bottomed pan; in a thin pan the ragi sticks to the bottom.

seg.e87c26125f87.src: Can I use cane jaggery in ragi java?
seg.e87c26125f87.t: ରାଗି ଜାଭାରେ ଆଖୁ ଗୁଡ଼ ବ୍ୟବହାର କରିପାରିବି କି?
seg.e87c26125f87.back: Can I use sugarcane jaggery in ragi java?

seg.a9a06390a945.src: Yes. Use the same amount of grated cane jaggery (cheruku bellam) and stir it in after switching off the stove, so the milk does not split. It gives a lighter colour and a milder, caramel-like sweetness.
seg.a9a06390a945.t: ହଁ। ସେତିକି ପରିମାଣର କୋରା ଆଖୁ ଗୁଡ଼ (ଚେରୁକୁ ବେଲ୍ଲମ) ନିଅନ୍ତୁ ଓ ଚୁଲି ବନ୍ଦ କରିବା ପରେ ମିଶାନ୍ତୁ, ଯେପରି କ୍ଷୀର ନ ଫାଟେ। ଏହା ହାଲୁକା ରଙ୍ଗ ଓ ମୃଦୁ, କ୍ୟାରାମେଲ ପରି ମିଠା ଦିଏ।
seg.a9a06390a945.back: Yes. Take the same amount of grated sugarcane jaggery (cheruku bellam) and mix it in after turning off the stove, so the milk does not split. It gives a light colour and mild, caramel-like sweetness.

seg.e7cb15cc47e2.src: Keep leftovers covered in the fridge and eat within 1 day. Reheat in a pan only until steaming hot all the way through; longer reheating makes the prawns tough.
seg.e7cb15cc47e2.t: ବଳକା ଘୋଡ଼ାଇ ଫ୍ରିଜରେ ରଖନ୍ତୁ ଓ 1 ଦିନ ଭିତରେ ଖାଆନ୍ତୁ। ପ୍ୟାନରେ କେବଳ ଭିତର ଯାଏ ପୂରା ଭାପ ଉଠିବା ଭଳି ଗରମ ହେବା ପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ ଗରମ କରନ୍ତୁ; ଏହାଠୁ ଅଧିକ ସମୟ ଗରମ କଲେ ଚିଙ୍ଗୁଡ଼ି ଟାଣ ହୋଇଯାଏ।
seg.e7cb15cc47e2.back: Cover the leftovers, keep in the fridge and eat within 1 day. Heat in a pan only until hot with steam rising fully all the way to the inside; heating longer than this makes the prawns tough.

seg.ea5408ec0853.src: Can I make sunnundalu with cane jaggery?
seg.ea5408ec0853.t: ଆଖୁ ଗୁଡ଼ରେ ସୁନ୍ନୁଣ୍ଡଲୁ ତିଆରି କରିପାରିବି କି?
seg.ea5408ec0853.back: Can I make sunnundalu with sugarcane jaggery?

seg.ec48010dffbe.src: Yes. Grate the cane jaggery (cheruku bellam) finely and use the same amount as palm jaggery. The laddus turn lighter in colour, with a milder, caramel-like sweetness.
seg.ec48010dffbe.t: ହଁ। ଆଖୁ ଗୁଡ଼ (ଚେରୁକୁ ବେଲ୍ଲମ)କୁ ମିହି କରି କୋରନ୍ତୁ ଓ ତାଳ ଗୁଡ଼ ପରି ସେତିକି ପରିମାଣ ନିଅନ୍ତୁ। ଲଡୁ ହାଲୁକା ରଙ୍ଗର ହୁଏ, ମିଠା ମୃଦୁ ଓ କ୍ୟାରାମେଲ ପରି ଲାଗେ।
seg.ec48010dffbe.back: Yes. Grate sugarcane jaggery (cheruku bellam) finely and take the same amount as palm jaggery. The laddus become light-coloured, the sweetness tastes mild and caramel-like.

seg.767f9e16fa95.src: Raw garlic: skip warming the garlic for a sharper taste; keep it in the fridge and eat it within 3 days.
seg.767f9e16fa95.t: କଞ୍ଚା ରସୁଣ: ଅଧିକ ତୀକ୍ଷ୍ଣ ସ୍ୱାଦ ପାଇଁ ରସୁଣ ଗରମ କରିବା ବାଦ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ; ଫ୍ରିଜରେ ରଖନ୍ତୁ ଓ 3 ଦିନ ଭିତରେ ଖାଆନ୍ତୁ।
seg.767f9e16fa95.back: Raw garlic: for a sharper taste skip heating the garlic; keep in the fridge and eat within 3 days.

seg.8665687f81ce.src: Keep in a clean, dry, airtight jar in the fridge and use it within 2 weeks. Always use a dry spoon.
seg.8665687f81ce.t: ଏକ ସଫା, ଶୁଖିଲା, ବାୟୁରୋଧୀ ବୋତଲରେ ଫ୍ରିଜରେ ରଖନ୍ତୁ ଓ 2 ସପ୍ତାହ ଭିତରେ ବ୍ୟବହାର କରନ୍ତୁ। ସବୁବେଳେ ଶୁଖିଲା ଚାମଚ ବ୍ୟବହାର କରନ୍ତୁ।
seg.8665687f81ce.back: Keep in a clean, dry, airtight bottle in the fridge and use within 2 weeks. Always use a dry spoon.

seg.367798df40e3.src: Up to 2 weeks in a dry, airtight jar in the fridge. Dry the garlic well and warm it in oil first, and always use a dry spoon.
seg.367798df40e3.t: ଶୁଖିଲା, ବାୟୁରୋଧୀ ବୋତଲରେ ଫ୍ରିଜରେ 2 ସପ୍ତାହ ପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ। ରସୁଣକୁ ଭଲ କରି ଶୁଖାଇ ପ୍ରଥମେ ତେଲରେ ଗରମ କରନ୍ତୁ, ଆଉ ସବୁବେଳେ ଶୁଖିଲା ଚାମଚ ବ୍ୟବହାର କରନ୍ତୁ।
seg.367798df40e3.back: Up to 2 weeks in the fridge in a dry, airtight bottle. Dry the garlic well and first heat it in oil, and always use a dry spoon.

seg.1d41be2d17f9.src: Yes. Roast about 20 dried red chillies in a few drops of oil until crisp, cool and grind them before adding the garlic.
seg.1d41be2d17f9.t: ହଁ। ପ୍ରାୟ 20ଟି ଶୁଖିଲା ଲାଲ ଲଙ୍କାକୁ କିଛି ଟୋପା ତେଲରେ କୁରକୁରିଆ ହେବା ଯାଏ ଭାଜନ୍ତୁ, ଥଣ୍ଡା କରି ରସୁଣ ପକାଇବା ଆଗରୁ ଗୁଣ୍ଡ କରନ୍ତୁ।
seg.1d41be2d17f9.back: Yes. Fry about 20 dry red chillies in a few drops of oil until crisp, cool and powder them before adding the garlic.

seg.7099f7c35107.src: Bellam Atukulu ⟦1⟧(Sweet Poha with Palm Jaggery)⟦/1⟧
seg.7099f7c35107.back: Bellam Atukulu ⟦1⟧(palm jaggery's sweet chuda / flattened rice)⟦/1⟧

seg.c9c11f5b43da.src: Bellam atukulu is the 10-minute sweet of Telugu homes. It is the poha offered to Krishna on Krishnashtami, recalling Kuchela's gift, and it is also a quick sweet for children after school. The poha is only rinsed, never cooked in water, and then tossed in warm jaggery syrup.
seg.c9c11f5b43da.t: ବେଲ୍ଲମ ଅଟୁକୁଲୁ ତେଲୁଗୁ ଘରର 10 ମିନିଟର ମିଠା। କୃଷ୍ଣାଷ୍ଟମୀରେ କୃଷ୍ଣଙ୍କୁ ଯେଉଁ ଚୁଡ଼ା ଅର୍ପଣ କରାଯାଏ, କୁଚେଲାଙ୍କ ଉପହାରକୁ ମନେ ପକାଇ, ଏହା ସେହି ଚୁଡ଼ା; ସ୍କୁଲ ପରେ ପିଲାଙ୍କ ପାଇଁ ଶୀଘ୍ର ତିଆରି ମିଠା ମଧ୍ୟ। ଚୁଡ଼ାକୁ କେବଳ ଧୋଇ ଦିଆଯାଏ, ପାଣିରେ କେବେ ସିଝାଯାଏ ନାହିଁ, ତାପରେ ଉଷୁମ ଗୁଡ଼ ଶିରାରେ ମିଶାଇ ଘାଣ୍ଟି ଦିଆଯାଏ।
seg.c9c11f5b43da.back: Bellam Atukulu is a 10-minute sweet of the Telugu home. The flattened rice that is offered to Krishna on Krishnashtami, remembering Kuchela's gift, this is that flattened rice; also a quickly made sweet for children after school. The flattened rice is only washed, never boiled in water, then it is mixed and stirred in warm jaggery syrup.

seg.8594fedb25dc.src: Our Thati Bellam palm jaggery gives it a deep brown colour and a rich, slightly smoky sweetness. This recipe serves 2.
seg.8594fedb25dc.t: ଆମ ତାଟି ବେଲ୍ଲମ ତାଳ ଗୁଡ଼ ଏହାକୁ ଗାଢ଼ ବାଦାମୀ ରଙ୍ଗ ଓ ଭରପୂର, ହାଲୁକା ଧୂଆଁଳିଆ ସ୍ୱାଦର ମିଠା ଦିଏ। ଏହି ରେସିପି 2 ଜଣଙ୍କ ପାଇଁ।
seg.8594fedb25dc.back: Our Thati Bellam palm jaggery gives it a deep brown colour and a full, light smoky-tasting sweetness. This recipe is for 2 people.

seg.25e28614accb.src: Prep includes 5 minutes for the rinsed poha to soften.
seg.25e28614accb.t: ପ୍ରସ୍ତୁତି ସମୟରେ ଧୋଇଥିବା ଚୁଡ଼ା ନରମ ହେବାର 5 ମିନିଟ ମଧ୍ୟ ଅଛି।
seg.25e28614accb.back: In the preparation time the 5 minutes of the washed flattened rice becoming soft is also there.

seg.b9dedcd705aa.src: Soften thick poha, toss it in warm palm jaggery syrup with coconut and cardamom, and finish with ghee.
seg.b9dedcd705aa.t: ମୋଟା ଚୁଡ଼ାକୁ ନରମ କରନ୍ତୁ, ନଡ଼ିଆ ଓ ଅଳେଇଚ ସହିତ ଉଷୁମ ତାଳ ଗୁଡ଼ ଶିରାରେ ମିଶାଇ ଘାଣ୍ଟନ୍ତୁ, ଶେଷରେ ଘିଅ ପକାନ୍ତୁ।
seg.b9dedcd705aa.back: Make the thick flattened rice soft, mix and stir it with coconut and cardamom in warm palm jaggery syrup, at the end add ghee.

seg.04f65369bdaa.back: 1 cup thick flattened rice ⟦1⟧atukulu, about 100 g⟦/1⟧

seg.e13864ccb71f.src: ½ cup grated palm jaggery ⟦1⟧about 90 g⟦/1⟧
seg.e13864ccb71f.t: ½ କପ କୋରା ତାଳ ଗୁଡ଼ ⟦1⟧ପ୍ରାୟ 90 g⟦/1⟧
seg.e13864ccb71f.back: ½ cup grated palm jaggery ⟦1⟧about 90 g⟦/1⟧

seg.b78c520dca8d.src: ½ cup grated coconut ⟦1⟧white part only⟦/1⟧
seg.b78c520dca8d.t: ½ କପ କୋରା ନଡ଼ିଆ ⟦1⟧କେବଳ ଧଳା ଅଂଶ⟦/1⟧
seg.b78c520dca8d.back: ½ cup grated coconut ⟦1⟧only the white part⟦/1⟧

seg.2d6d2ff14f71.src: ¼ tsp cardamom powder ⟦1⟧or the crushed seeds of 2–3 pods⟦/1⟧
seg.2d6d2ff14f71.t: ¼ ଚା ଚାମଚ ଅଳେଇଚ ଗୁଣ୍ଡ ⟦1⟧କିମ୍ବା 2–3ଟି ଅଳେଇଚର ଛେଚା ମଞ୍ଜି⟦/1⟧
seg.2d6d2ff14f71.back: ¼ tea spoon cardamom powder ⟦1⟧or crushed seeds of 2–3 cardamoms⟦/1⟧

seg.5f1854fd1277.back: 6–8 cashews, as per wish ⟦1⟧fried golden in ghee⟦/1⟧

seg.fbe7b4b8afbc.src: Put the poha in a sieve and pick out any bits of husk.
seg.fbe7b4b8afbc.t: ଚୁଡ଼ାକୁ ଏକ ଛଣାରେ ରଖି ଭୁଷର ଖଣ୍ଡ ଥିଲେ ବାଛି ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ।
seg.fbe7b4b8afbc.back: Keep the flattened rice in a sieve and if there are pieces of husk pick them out.

seg.b0f730c0b062.src: Rinse the poha in a sieve under running water for a few seconds, drain, and leave it for 5 minutes to soften. It should feel soft when pressed, but not wet.
seg.b0f730c0b062.t: ଛଣାରେ ଚୁଡ଼ା ରଖି କିଛି ସେକେଣ୍ଡ ବହୁଥିବା ପାଣି ତଳେ ଧୋଇ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ, ପାଣି ଝରାଇ 5 ମିନିଟ ନରମ ହେବା ପାଇଁ ରଖନ୍ତୁ। ଚାପିଲେ ନରମ ଲାଗିବ, କିନ୍ତୁ ଓଦା ନୁହେଁ।
seg.b0f730c0b062.back: Keeping the flattened rice in the sieve wash it under flowing water for a few seconds, drain the water and keep it 5 minutes to become soft. When pressed it will feel soft, but not wet.

seg.0a3e2261d7bc.src: Grate the palm jaggery finely, breaking up any hard lumps.
seg.0a3e2261d7bc.t: ତାଳ ଗୁଡ଼କୁ ସରୁ କରି କୋରନ୍ତୁ, ଶକ୍ତ ଡେଲା ଥିଲେ ଭାଙ୍ଗି ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ।
seg.0a3e2261d7bc.back: Grate the palm jaggery finely, if there are hard lumps break them.

seg.d2b892bf70af.src: Melt the palm jaggery with 2 tbsp water on a low flame, then strain it. Wipe the pan and pour the syrup back in.
seg.d2b892bf70af.t: ଧୀମା ନିଆଁରେ 2 ଟେବୁଲ ଚାମଚ ପାଣି ସହିତ ତାଳ ଗୁଡ଼ ତରଳାନ୍ତୁ, ତାପରେ ଛାଣି ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ। କଡ଼େଇ ପୋଛି ଶିରାକୁ ପୁଣି ଢାଳି ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ।
seg.d2b892bf70af.back: On slow fire melt the palm jaggery with 2 table spoons water, then strain it. Wipe the kadai and pour the syrup back again.

seg.d073ead78aef.src: If you are using cashews, fry them in a little ghee till golden.
seg.d073ead78aef.t: କାଜୁ ଦେଉଥିଲେ ଟିକିଏ ଘିଅରେ ସୁନେଲି ହେବା ଯାଏ ଭାଜି ନିଅନ୍ତୁ।
seg.d073ead78aef.back: If adding cashews fry them in a little ghee until golden.

seg.62c17a0f01a5.src: Add the poha, coconut and cardamom to the warm syrup and toss gently on a low flame for 1–2 minutes, until every flake is coated. Use a light hand so the flakes do not break.
seg.62c17a0f01a5.t: ଉଷୁମ ଶିରାରେ ଚୁଡ଼ା, ନଡ଼ିଆ ଓ ଅଳେଇଚ ପକାଇ ଧୀମା ନିଆଁରେ 1–2 ମିନିଟ ଧୀରେ ଧୀରେ ଘାଣ୍ଟନ୍ତୁ, ପ୍ରତି ଚୁଡ଼ାରେ ଶିରା ଲାଗିବା ଯାଏ। ହାତ ହାଲୁକା ରଖନ୍ତୁ, ଯେପରି ଚୁଡ଼ା ନ ଭାଙ୍ଗେ।
seg.62c17a0f01a5.back: Putting the flattened rice, coconut and cardamom into the warm syrup, stir slowly slowly on slow fire 1–2 minutes, until syrup sticks on each flake. Keep the hand light, so that the flattened rice does not break.

seg.d1abe3d7557d.src: Take the pan off the heat as soon as the flakes are coated; longer cooking makes them chewy.
seg.d1abe3d7557d.t: ଚୁଡ଼ାରେ ଶିରା ଲାଗିବା କ୍ଷଣି କଡ଼େଇକୁ ନିଆଁରୁ ଓହ୍ଲାଇ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ; ଅଧିକ ସମୟ ରାନ୍ଧିଲେ ଚୁଡ଼ା ଚମଡ଼ା ପରି ହୋଇଯାଏ।
seg.d1abe3d7557d.back: The moment syrup sticks on the flattened rice take the kadai down from the fire; if cooked more time the flattened rice becomes like leather.

seg.c91ffab6359d.src: Finish with the ghee and cashews. Serve warm or at room temperature.
seg.c91ffab6359d.t: ଉପରେ ଘିଅ ଓ କାଜୁ ପକାନ୍ତୁ। ଉଷୁମ ବା ସାଧାରଣ ତାପମାତ୍ରାରେ ପରଷନ୍ତୁ।
seg.c91ffab6359d.back: On top put ghee and cashews. Serve warm or at normal temperature.

seg.544ea222a497.src: Use thick poha. Thin poha turns mushy in the syrup.
seg.544ea222a497.t: ମୋଟା ଚୁଡ଼ା ବ୍ୟବହାର କରନ୍ତୁ। ପତଳା ଚୁଡ଼ା ଶିରାରେ ଗଳିଯାଏ।
seg.544ea222a497.back: Use thick flattened rice. Thin flattened rice melts in the syrup.

seg.0f56d718ca89.src: Do not soak the poha in a bowl of water; a quick rinse is enough, or it turns soft and sticky.
seg.0f56d718ca89.t: ଚୁଡ଼ାକୁ ବାଟିରେ ପାଣିରେ ଭିଜାଇ ରଖନ୍ତୁ ନାହିଁ; ଥରେ ଧୋଇଦେଲେ ଯଥେଷ୍ଟ, ନଚେତ୍ ଏହା ନରମ ଓ ଅଠାଳିଆ ହୋଇଯାଏ।
seg.0f56d718ca89.back: Do not keep the flattened rice soaked in water in a bowl; washing it once is enough, otherwise it becomes soft and sticky.

seg.972f174730fe.src: Keep the syrup warm, not bubbling, when the poha goes in, so the flakes coat evenly.
seg.972f174730fe.t: ଚୁଡ଼ା ପକାଇବା ବେଳେ ଶିରା ଉଷୁମ ରଖନ୍ତୁ, ଫୁଟୁଥିବା ନୁହେଁ, ତେବେ ଚୁଡ଼ାରେ ସମାନ ଭାବେ ଲାଗିବ।
seg.972f174730fe.back: While putting in the flattened rice keep the syrup warm, not boiling, then it will stick on the flattened rice evenly.

seg.8496cfe4aa1d.src: With milk: pour 2–3 tbsp warm milk over the finished poha for a softer sweet.
seg.8496cfe4aa1d.t: କ୍ଷୀର ସହିତ: ତିଆରି ଚୁଡ଼ା ଉପରେ 2–3 ଟେବୁଲ ଚାମଚ ଉଷୁମ କ୍ଷୀର ଢାଳନ୍ତୁ, ମିଠା ଆହୁରି ନରମ ହେବ।
seg.8496cfe4aa1d.back: With milk: pour 2–3 table spoons warm milk over the made flattened rice, the sweet will be even softer.

seg.bb5e4ee879e6.src: With sesame: add 1 tbsp roasted sesame seeds along with the coconut.
seg.bb5e4ee879e6.t: ରାଶି ସହିତ: ନଡ଼ିଆ ସହିତ 1 ଟେବୁଲ ଚାମଚ ଭଜା ରାଶି ମିଶାନ୍ତୁ।
seg.bb5e4ee879e6.back: With sesame: mix 1 table spoon roasted sesame with the coconut.

seg.25d7247d3c7b.src: Serve it as naivedyam on Krishnashtami, or as a quick sweet for children after school.
seg.25d7247d3c7b.t: କୃଷ୍ଣାଷ୍ଟମୀରେ ନୈବେଦ୍ୟ ଭାବେ ପରଷନ୍ତୁ, ବା ସ୍କୁଲ ପରେ ପିଲାଙ୍କ ପାଇଁ ଶୀଘ୍ର ତିଆରି ମିଠା ଭାବେ।
seg.25d7247d3c7b.back: Serve as naivedya on Krishnashtami, or as a quickly made sweet for children after school.

seg.1170385c1b79.src: Best eaten the day it is made. Keep leftovers covered in the fridge and eat them the next day; the poha firms up as it stands.
seg.1170385c1b79.t: ଯେଉଁ ଦିନ ତିଆରି, ସେହି ଦିନ ଖାଇଲେ ସବୁଠୁ ଭଲ ଲାଗେ। ବଳିଲେ ଘୋଡ଼ାଇ ଫ୍ରିଜରେ ରଖି ପରଦିନ ଖାଆନ୍ତୁ; ରଖିଲେ ଚୁଡ଼ା ଶକ୍ତ ହୋଇଆସେ।
seg.1170385c1b79.back: Eaten the same day it is made, it tastes best of all. If left over cover it, keep in the fridge and eat the next day; if kept the flattened rice turns hard.

seg.6acb206e9df4.src: Which poha is best for bellam atukulu?
seg.6acb206e9df4.t: ବେଲ୍ଲମ ଅଟୁକୁଲୁ ପାଇଁ କେଉଁ ଚୁଡ଼ା ସବୁଠୁ ଭଲ?
seg.6acb206e9df4.back: Which flattened rice is best of all for Bellam Atukulu?

seg.7cb97f8423cf.src: Thick poha (atukulu). It holds its shape in the warm syrup; thin poha turns mushy.
seg.7cb97f8423cf.t: ମୋଟା ଚୁଡ଼ା (ଅଟୁକୁଲୁ)। ଉଷୁମ ଶିରାରେ ଏହା ନିଜ ଆକାର ଧରି ରଖେ; ପତଳା ଚୁଡ଼ା ଗଳିଯାଏ।
seg.7cb97f8423cf.back: Thick flattened rice (atukulu). In warm syrup it holds its own shape; thin flattened rice melts.

seg.ba8eb1721096.src: Can I make bellam atukulu with cane jaggery?
seg.ba8eb1721096.t: ଆଖୁ ଗୁଡ଼ରେ ବେଲ୍ଲମ ଅଟୁକୁଲୁ ତିଆରି କରିହେବ କି?
seg.ba8eb1721096.back: Can Bellam Atukulu be made with sugarcane jaggery?

seg.2a1aa941db07.src: Yes. Use the same amount of grated cane jaggery (cheruku bellam). It turns lighter in colour, with a caramel-like sweetness.
seg.2a1aa941db07.t: ହଁ। ସମାନ ପରିମାଣର କୋରା ଆଖୁ ଗୁଡ଼ (ଚେରୁକୁ ବେଲ୍ଲମ) ନିଅନ୍ତୁ। ରଙ୍ଗ ହାଲୁକା ହୁଏ, ଆଉ ମିଠାରେ କ୍ୟାରାମେଲ ପରି ସ୍ୱାଦ ଆସେ।
seg.2a1aa941db07.back: Yes. Take the same amount of grated sugarcane jaggery (cheruku bellam). The colour becomes light, and a caramel-like taste comes in the sweet.

seg.88008fa2d0e6.src: Why is my bellam atukulu sticky?
seg.88008fa2d0e6.t: ମୋ ବେଲ୍ଲମ ଅଟୁକୁଲୁ ଅଠାଳିଆ କାହିଁକି ହେଲା?
seg.88008fa2d0e6.back: Why did my Bellam Atukulu become sticky?

seg.a6945e480c9a.src: The poha was soaked or cooked too long. Rinse it for only a few seconds, and take the pan off the heat as soon as every flake is coated.
seg.a6945e480c9a.t: ଚୁଡ଼ାକୁ ବହୁତ ସମୟ ଭିଜାଯାଇଥିଲା କିମ୍ବା ରାନ୍ଧାଯାଇଥିଲା। କେବଳ କିଛି ସେକେଣ୍ଡ ଧୋଇ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ, ଆଉ ପ୍ରତି ଚୁଡ଼ାରେ ଶିରା ଲାଗିବା କ୍ଷଣି କଡ଼େଇକୁ ନିଆଁରୁ ଓହ୍ଲାଇ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ।
seg.a6945e480c9a.back: The flattened rice was soaked or cooked a long time. Wash only a few seconds, and the moment syrup sticks on each flake take the kadai down from the fire.

seg.d4c0fab65bf7.src: Why is it made on Krishnashtami?
seg.d4c0fab65bf7.back: Why is it made on Krishnashtami?

seg.51ab1914ac8d.src: It recalls the story of Kuchela, who brought a handful of poha to his friend Krishna as his only gift.
seg.51ab1914ac8d.t: ଏହା କୁଚେଲାଙ୍କ କାହାଣୀକୁ ମନେ ପକାଏ, ଯିଏ ବନ୍ଧୁ କୃଷ୍ଣଙ୍କ ପାଇଁ ମୁଠାଏ ଚୁଡ଼ା ଆଣିଥିଲେ, ସେହିଟି ଥିଲା ତାଙ୍କର ଏକମାତ୍ର ଉପହାର।
seg.51ab1914ac8d.back: It recalls the story of Kuchela, who had brought a handful of flattened rice for friend Krishna, that was his only gift.

seg.5080241b3883.src: బెల్లం అటుకులు. Andhra bellam atukulu: thick poha tossed in warm Thati Bellam palm jaggery syrup with coconut, cardamom and ghee. A 10-minute sweet, with tips and FAQs.
seg.5080241b3883.t: బెల్లం అటుకులు. ଆନ୍ଧ୍ରର ବେଲ୍ଲମ ଅଟୁକୁଲୁ: ମୋଟା ଚୁଡ଼ା ଉଷୁମ ତାଟି ବେଲ୍ଲମ ତାଳ ଗୁଡ଼ ଶିରାରେ ନଡ଼ିଆ, ଅଳେଇଚ ଓ ଘିଅ ସହିତ ମିଶାଇ ତିଆରି। 10 ମିନିଟର ମିଠା, ସହିତ ଟିପ୍ସ ଓ ପ୍ରଶ୍ନୋତ୍ତର।
seg.5080241b3883.back: బెల్లం అటుకులు. Andhra's Bellam Atukulu: thick flattened rice made by mixing in warm Thati Bellam palm jaggery syrup with coconut, cardamom and ghee. A 10-minute sweet, with tips and questions-answers.

seg.4239bed21420.src: Bellam Atukulu (Sweet Poha with Palm Jaggery) · 1acrefarms
seg.4239bed21420.back: Bellam Atukulu (palm jaggery's sweet flattened rice) · 1acrefarms

seg.8dafb14d8ade.src: Bellam Atukulu: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.8dafb14d8ade.t: ବେଲ୍ଲମ ଅଟୁକୁଲୁ: 1acrefarmsର ରେସିପି କାର୍ଡ, ଉପାଦାନ ଓ ପ୍ରଣାଳୀ ସହିତ
seg.8dafb14d8ade.back: Bellam Atukulu: 1acrefarms' recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.753ec27036d4.src: ⟦#1⟧ · ⟦#2⟧ · Kobbari Undalu · Nariyal Gud Ke Laddu
seg.753ec27036d4.t: ⟦#1⟧ · ⟦#2⟧ · କୋବ୍ବରି ଉଣ୍ଡାଲୁ · ନାରିୟଲ ଗୁଡ଼ କେ ଲଡ୍ଡୁ
seg.753ec27036d4.back: ⟦#1⟧ · ⟦#2⟧ · Kobbari Undalu · Nariyal Gud ke Laddu

seg.de7ddbad7bf0.src: Kobbari undalu are the coconut laddus Andhra homes make for festivals, naivedyam and an everyday sweet. They need only coconut, jaggery, cardamom and a spoon of ghee. The jaggery is melted and strained, the coconut is cooked in it on a low flame until the mix holds together, and the laddus are rolled by hand while still warm.
seg.de7ddbad7bf0.t: କୋବ୍ବରି ଉଣ୍ଡାଲୁ ହେଉଛି ନଡ଼ିଆ ଲଡୁ, ଯାହା ଆନ୍ଧ୍ରର ଘରେ ପର୍ବପର୍ବାଣୀରେ, ନୈବେଦ୍ୟରେ ଓ ଦୈନନ୍ଦିନ ମିଠା ଭାବେ ତିଆରି ହୁଏ। ଏଥିରେ ଲାଗେ କେବଳ ନଡ଼ିଆ, ଗୁଡ଼, ଅଳେଇଚ ଓ ଏକ ଚାମଚ ଘିଅ। ଗୁଡ଼କୁ ତରଳାଇ ଛାଣି ଦିଆଯାଏ, ତାକୁ ଧୀମା ନିଆଁରେ ନଡ଼ିଆ ସହିତ ରନ୍ଧାଯାଏ ଯେପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ ମିଶ୍ରଣ ଏକାଠି ନ ଲାଗେ, ଆଉ ଗରମ ଥାଉଁଥାଉଁ ହାତରେ ଲଡୁ ବାନ୍ଧାଯାଏ।
seg.de7ddbad7bf0.back: Kobbari Undalu is coconut laddu, which is made in Andhra homes at festivals, in naivedya and as a daily sweet. In it is needed only coconut, jaggery, cardamom and one spoon of ghee. The jaggery is melted and strained, it is cooked with coconut on slow fire until the mixture binds together, and while still hot the laddus are shaped by hand.

seg.089fb020d00e.src: Our Cheruku Bellam gives them a light golden colour and a mellow caramel taste. This recipe makes about 14 laddus.
seg.089fb020d00e.t: ଆମ ଚେରୁକୁ ବେଲ୍ଲମ ଏହାକୁ ହାଲୁକା ସୁନେଲି ରଙ୍ଗ ଓ କୋମଳ କ୍ୟାରାମେଲ ପରି ସ୍ୱାଦ ଦିଏ। ଏହି ରେସିପିରେ ପ୍ରାୟ 14ଟି ଲଡୁ ହୁଏ।
seg.089fb020d00e.back: Our Cheruku Bellam gives it a light golden colour and a soft caramel-like taste. This recipe makes about 14 laddus.

seg.d9e7175cce3e.src: Allow another 15 minutes for the laddus to cool before you store them.
seg.d9e7175cce3e.t: ଲଡୁ ରଖିବା ଆଗରୁ ଥଣ୍ଡା ହେବା ପାଇଁ ଆହୁରି 15 ମିନିଟ ସମୟ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ।
seg.d9e7175cce3e.back: Before storing the laddus give 15 more minutes of time for them to become cold.

seg.80b59063a128.src: Melt cane jaggery, cook it with grated coconut till it comes together, add cardamom and ghee, and roll into laddus.
seg.80b59063a128.t: ଆଖୁ ଗୁଡ଼ ତରଳାଇ କୋରା ନଡ଼ିଆ ସହିତ ଏକାଠି ନ ଲାଗିବା ଯାଏ ରାନ୍ଧନ୍ତୁ, ଅଳେଇଚ ଓ ଘିଅ ପକାନ୍ତୁ, ଆଉ ଲଡୁ ବାନ୍ଧନ୍ତୁ।
seg.80b59063a128.back: Melt sugarcane jaggery and cook with grated coconut until it binds together, add cardamom and ghee, and shape laddus.

seg.9dbfabbc7bd0.src: 2 cups grated coconut ⟦1⟧1 medium coconut; grate only the white part⟦/1⟧
seg.9dbfabbc7bd0.t: 2 କପ କୋରା ନଡ଼ିଆ ⟦1⟧1ଟି ମଝିଆ ନଡ଼ିଆ; କେବଳ ଧଳା ଅଂଶ କୋରନ୍ତୁ⟦/1⟧
seg.9dbfabbc7bd0.back: 2 cups grated coconut ⟦1⟧1 medium coconut; grate only the white part⟦/1⟧

seg.fa687abb7dd1.src: 1 cup grated cane jaggery ⟦1⟧about 180 g; pound or grate the pieces first⟦/1⟧
seg.fa687abb7dd1.t: 1 କପ କୋରା ଆଖୁ ଗୁଡ଼ ⟦1⟧ପ୍ରାୟ 180 g; ଆଗରୁ ଖଣ୍ଡଗୁଡ଼ିକୁ ଛେଚି ବା କୋରି ନିଅନ୍ତୁ⟦/1⟧
seg.fa687abb7dd1.back: 1 cup grated sugarcane jaggery ⟦1⟧about 180 g; first crush or grate the pieces⟦/1⟧

seg.1ca2ce946869.src: 1 tbsp ghee ⟦1⟧plus a little for greasing your palms⟦/1⟧
seg.1ca2ce946869.t: 1 ଟେବୁଲ ଚାମଚ ଘିଅ ⟦1⟧ଆଉ ପାପୁଲିରେ ଲଗାଇବା ପାଇଁ ଟିକିଏ⟦/1⟧
seg.1ca2ce946869.back: 1 table spoon ghee ⟦1⟧and a little for applying on the palms⟦/1⟧

seg.ccf1a746b971.src: 10 cashews, optional ⟦1⟧broken and fried golden in ghee⟦/1⟧
seg.ccf1a746b971.back: 10 cashews, as per wish ⟦1⟧broken and fried golden in ghee⟦/1⟧

seg.15ef8686cc9e.src: Grate the coconut, leaving out the brown skin so the laddus stay light in colour.
seg.15ef8686cc9e.t: ନଡ଼ିଆ କୋରନ୍ତୁ, ବାଦାମୀ ଖୋଳ ଛାଡ଼ି ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ, ତେବେ ଲଡୁର ରଙ୍ଗ ହାଲୁକା ରହିବ।
seg.15ef8686cc9e.back: Grate the coconut, leave out the brown shell/skin, then the colour of the laddu will stay light.

seg.00b442d7f507.src: Pound or grate the cane jaggery into small pieces so it melts evenly.
seg.00b442d7f507.t: ଆଖୁ ଗୁଡ଼କୁ ଛେଚି ବା କୋରି ଛୋଟ ଖଣ୍ଡ କରନ୍ତୁ, ଯେପରି ସମାନ ଭାବେ ତରଳେ।
seg.00b442d7f507.back: Crush or grate the sugarcane jaggery into small pieces, so that it melts evenly.

seg.c25e0610c714.src: Melt the jaggery with 2 tbsp water on a low flame, then strain it through a fine sieve. This catches any grit or bits of cane from the block.
seg.c25e0610c714.t: ଧୀମା ନିଆଁରେ 2 ଟେବୁଲ ଚାମଚ ପାଣି ସହିତ ଗୁଡ଼ ତରଳାନ୍ତୁ, ତାପରେ ସରୁ ଛଣାରେ ଛାଣି ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ। ଏହା ଗୁଡ଼ ଖଣ୍ଡରୁ ଆସିଥିବା ଛୋଟ ଛୋଟ କଣିକା ବା ଆଖୁର ଟୁକୁଡ଼ାକୁ ଅଟକାଏ।
seg.c25e0610c714.back: On slow fire melt the jaggery with 2 tablespoons of water, then strain with a fine strainer. This stops the small small particles or pieces of sugarcane that came from the jaggery pieces.

seg.3eb20f2a7136.src: Return it to the pan, add the coconut and cook on medium-low, stirring, until the mix leaves the sides of the pan and holds together, 12–15 minutes. Keep stirring so it does not catch at the bottom.
seg.3eb20f2a7136.t: ଏହାକୁ ପୁଣି କଡ଼େଇରେ ଢାଳି ନଡ଼ିଆ ପକାନ୍ତୁ ଏବଂ ମଧ୍ୟମ-ଧୀମା ନିଆଁରେ ଘାଣ୍ଟି ଘାଣ୍ଟି ରାନ୍ଧନ୍ତୁ, ଯେପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ ମିଶ୍ରଣ କଡ଼େଇର କଡ଼ ଛାଡ଼ି ଏକାଠି ନ ଲାଗେ, 12–15 ମିନିଟ। ଘାଣ୍ଟୁଥାଆନ୍ତୁ, ଯେପରି ତଳେ ଲାଗି ନଯାଏ।
seg.3eb20f2a7136.back: Pour it again into the kadai, put the coconut and cook stirring stirring on medium-slow fire, until the mixture leaves the side of the kadai and binds together, 12–15 minutes. Keep stirring, so that it does not stick at the bottom.

seg.e1985b8e5f9c.src: If you are using cashews, fry them in a little ghee till golden while the mix cooks.
seg.e1985b8e5f9c.t: କାଜୁ ଦେଉଥିଲେ ମିଶ୍ରଣ ରନ୍ଧା ହେଉଥିବା ବେଳେ ଟିକିଏ ଘିଅରେ ସୁନେଲି ହେବା ଯାଏ ଭାଜି ନିଅନ୍ତୁ।
seg.e1985b8e5f9c.back: If adding cashews, while the mixture is being cooked fry them in a little ghee until golden.

seg.1dc27e2d9b3e.src: Stir in the cardamom, ghee and cashews. Take the pan off the heat.
seg.1dc27e2d9b3e.t: ଅଳେଇଚ, ଘିଅ ଓ କାଜୁ ମିଶାଇ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ। କଡ଼େଇକୁ ନିଆଁରୁ ଓହ୍ଲାଇ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ।
seg.1dc27e2d9b3e.back: Mix in cardamom, ghee and cashews. Take the kadai down from the fire.

seg.d4ee96780aba.src: Let it cool till you can handle it, grease your palms with ghee and roll it into small balls. Press each one firmly so it holds together.
seg.d4ee96780aba.t: ହାତରେ ଧରିହେବା ପରି ଥଣ୍ଡା ହେଲେ ପାପୁଲିରେ ଘିଅ ଲଗାଇ ଛୋଟ ଛୋଟ ଗୋଲା ବାନ୍ଧନ୍ତୁ। ପ୍ରତିଟିକୁ ଶକ୍ତ କରି ଚାପନ୍ତୁ, ଯେପରି ଏକାଠି ରହେ।
seg.d4ee96780aba.back: When cold enough to hold in the hand, apply ghee on the palms and shape small small balls. Press each one firmly, so that it stays together.

seg.3753ea8bc7d0.src: Set the laddus on a greased plate and let them cool completely before you store them.
seg.3753ea8bc7d0.t: ଲଡୁଗୁଡ଼ିକୁ ଘିଅ ଲଗାଇଥିବା ଥାଳିରେ ରଖନ୍ତୁ ଏବଂ ରଖିବା ଆଗରୁ ପୂରା ଥଣ୍ଡା ହେବାକୁ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ।
seg.3753ea8bc7d0.back: Keep the laddus on a ghee-applied plate and before storing let them become fully cold.

seg.fb3de84de9f6.src: If the mix won't hold a shape, cook it 2 minutes more. If it sets too hard, sprinkle in a spoon of warm milk and press again.
seg.fb3de84de9f6.t: ମିଶ୍ରଣ ଆକାର ନ ଧରିଲେ ଆହୁରି 2 ମିନିଟ ରାନ୍ଧନ୍ତୁ। ବହୁତ ଶକ୍ତ ହୋଇଗଲେ ଏକ ଚାମଚ ଉଷୁମ କ୍ଷୀର ଛିଞ୍ଚି ପୁଣି ଚାପନ୍ତୁ।
seg.fb3de84de9f6.back: If the mixture does not take shape cook 2 more minutes. If it becomes very hard sprinkle one spoon of warm milk and press again.

seg.71475e1a7345.src: Keep the flame at medium-low; on a high flame the jaggery darkens and the laddus turn hard.
seg.71475e1a7345.t: ନିଆଁ ମଧ୍ୟମ-ଧୀମା ରଖନ୍ତୁ; ଅଧିକ ନିଆଁରେ ଗୁଡ଼ କଳା ପଡ଼ିଯାଏ ଓ ଲଡୁ ଶକ୍ତ ହୁଏ।
seg.71475e1a7345.back: Keep the fire medium-slow; on more fire the jaggery turns black and the laddu becomes hard.

seg.46a2e2b2d323.src: Roll the laddus while the mix is still warm; once it cools completely it will not bind.
seg.46a2e2b2d323.t: ମିଶ୍ରଣ ଗରମ ଥାଉଁଥାଉଁ ଲଡୁ ବାନ୍ଧନ୍ତୁ; ପୂରା ଥଣ୍ଡା ହୋଇଗଲେ ଆଉ ଲାଗିବ ନାହିଁ।
seg.46a2e2b2d323.back: Shape the laddus while the mixture is still hot; once fully cold it will not bind any more.

seg.b277c024adad.src: Palm jaggery: use the same amount of grated palm jaggery for darker laddus with a slightly smoky sweetness.
seg.b277c024adad.t: ତାଳ ଗୁଡ଼: ସମାନ ପରିମାଣର କୋରା ତାଳ ଗୁଡ଼ ନିଅନ୍ତୁ, ଲଡୁ ଗାଢ଼ ହେବ ଆଉ ମିଠାରେ ହାଲୁକା ଧୂଆଁଳିଆ ସ୍ୱାଦ ରହିବ।
seg.b277c024adad.back: Palm jaggery: take the same amount of grated palm jaggery, the laddu will be dark and in the sweet there will be a light smoky taste.

seg.7b597df04222.src: Dry coconut: use the same amount of grated dry coconut (kopra); the mix comes together faster, so watch it closely.
seg.7b597df04222.t: ଶୁଖିଲା ନଡ଼ିଆ: ସମାନ ପରିମାଣର କୋରା ଶୁଖିଲା ନଡ଼ିଆ (କୋପ୍ରା) ନିଅନ୍ତୁ; ମିଶ୍ରଣ ଶୀଘ୍ର ଏକାଠି ଲାଗେ, ତେଣୁ ନଜର ରଖନ୍ତୁ।
seg.7b597df04222.back: Dry coconut: take the same amount of grated dry coconut (kopra); the mixture binds together quickly, so keep watch.

seg.676bca051e10.src: Kobbari burfi: spread the cooked mix on a greased plate, let it set a little and cut it into squares instead of rolling laddus.
seg.676bca051e10.t: କୋବ୍ବରି ବରଫି: ରନ୍ଧା ମିଶ୍ରଣକୁ ଘିଅ ଲଗାଇଥିବା ଥାଳିରେ ବିଛାଇ ଟିକେ ଜମିବାକୁ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ, ଲଡୁ ନ ବାନ୍ଧି ଚାରିକୋଣିଆ କରି କାଟି ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ।
seg.676bca051e10.back: Kobbari Barfi: spread the cooked mixture on a ghee-applied plate and let it set a little, without shaping laddus cut it into four-cornered pieces.

seg.80538d77ab41.src: Serve as an everyday sweet, offer them as naivedyam, or add them to the festival sweet plate.
seg.80538d77ab41.t: ଦୈନନ୍ଦିନ ମିଠା ଭାବେ ପରଷନ୍ତୁ, ନୈବେଦ୍ୟ ଭାବେ ଅର୍ପଣ କରନ୍ତୁ, ବା ପର୍ବର ମିଠା ଥାଳିରେ ରଖନ୍ତୁ।
seg.80538d77ab41.back: Serve as a daily sweet, offer as naivedya, or keep on a festival sweets plate.

seg.6f3252f28ef8.src: Keep in an airtight container and eat within 3 days at room temperature, or within a week if kept in the fridge.
seg.6f3252f28ef8.t: ବାୟୁରୋଧୀ ଡବାରେ ରଖନ୍ତୁ; ସାଧାରଣ ତାପମାତ୍ରାରେ 3 ଦିନ ଭିତରେ ଖାଆନ୍ତୁ, ବା ଫ୍ରିଜରେ ରଖିଲେ ଏକ ସପ୍ତାହ ଭିତରେ।
seg.6f3252f28ef8.back: Keep in an air-proof box; eat within 3 days at normal temperature, or if kept in the fridge within one week.

seg.f232fb960e89.src: Why are my kobbari undalu not holding shape?
seg.f232fb960e89.t: ମୋ କୋବ୍ବରି ଉଣ୍ଡାଲୁ ଆକାର କାହିଁକି ଧରି ରଖୁ ନାହିଁ?
seg.f232fb960e89.back: Why is my Kobbari Undalu not holding shape?

seg.1cf59b528a13.src: The mix needs a little more cooking. Put it back on a low flame for 2 minutes, stirring, until it leaves the sides of the pan, then roll it while it is still warm.
seg.1cf59b528a13.t: ମିଶ୍ରଣକୁ ଆଉ ଟିକିଏ ରାନ୍ଧିବାକୁ ପଡ଼ିବ। ପୁଣି ଧୀମା ନିଆଁରେ 2 ମିନିଟ ଘାଣ୍ଟି ଘାଣ୍ଟି ରାନ୍ଧନ୍ତୁ, ଯେପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ କଡ଼େଇର କଡ଼ ଛାଡ଼େ, ତାପରେ ଗରମ ଥାଉଁଥାଉଁ ବାନ୍ଧନ୍ତୁ।
seg.1cf59b528a13.back: The mixture has to be cooked a little more. Again on slow fire cook 2 minutes stirring stirring, until it leaves the side of the kadai, then shape while still hot.

seg.9371fa8705cd.src: Why did my laddus turn hard?
seg.9371fa8705cd.back: Why did my laddus become hard?

seg.ee988ba3472f.src: The jaggery was cooked too long or on too high a flame. Sprinkle in a spoon of warm milk, mix and press again. Next time, take the pan off the heat as soon as the mix holds together.
seg.ee988ba3472f.t: ଗୁଡ଼ ବହୁତ ସମୟ ବା ଅଧିକ ନିଆଁରେ ରନ୍ଧାଯାଇଥିଲା। ଏକ ଚାମଚ ଉଷୁମ କ୍ଷୀର ଛିଞ୍ଚି ମିଶାଇ ପୁଣି ଚାପନ୍ତୁ। ଆଗକୁ ମିଶ୍ରଣ ଏକାଠି ଲାଗିବା କ୍ଷଣି କଡ଼େଇକୁ ନିଆଁରୁ ଓହ୍ଲାଇ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ।
seg.ee988ba3472f.back: The jaggery was cooked a long time or on more fire. Sprinkle one spoon of warm milk, mix and press again. Going forward, the moment the mixture binds together take the kadai down from the fire.

seg.d830316a6adb.src: Can I make kobbari undalu with palm jaggery?
seg.d830316a6adb.t: ତାଳ ଗୁଡ଼ରେ କୋବ୍ବରି ଉଣ୍ଡାଲୁ ତିଆରି କରିହେବ କି?
seg.d830316a6adb.back: Can Kobbari Undalu be made with palm jaggery?

seg.813bf680c8a8.src: Yes. Use the same amount of grated palm jaggery (thati bellam). The laddus turn darker, with a slightly smoky sweetness.
seg.813bf680c8a8.t: ହଁ। ସମାନ ପରିମାଣର କୋରା ତାଳ ଗୁଡ଼ (ତାଟି ବେଲ୍ଲମ) ନିଅନ୍ତୁ। ଲଡୁ ଗାଢ଼ ହେବ, ଆଉ ମିଠାରେ ହାଲୁକା ଧୂଆଁଳିଆ ସ୍ୱାଦ ରହିବ।
seg.813bf680c8a8.back: Yes. Take the same amount of grated palm jaggery (thati bellam). The laddu will be dark, and in the sweet there will be a light smoky taste.

seg.ea6121eb3993.src: How long do kobbari undalu keep?
seg.ea6121eb3993.back: How many days does Kobbari Undalu last?

seg.26aba27412dc.src: About 3 days in an airtight container at room temperature, and up to a week in the fridge.
seg.26aba27412dc.t: ବାୟୁରୋଧୀ ଡବାରେ ସାଧାରଣ ତାପମାତ୍ରାରେ ପ୍ରାୟ 3 ଦିନ, ଆଉ ଫ୍ରିଜରେ ଏକ ସପ୍ତାହ ପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ।
seg.26aba27412dc.back: In an air-proof box at normal temperature about 3 days, and in the fridge up to one week.

seg.0156a887ba6f.src: కొబ్బరి ఉండలు. Andhra kobbari undalu: grated coconut cooked with Cheruku Bellam cane jaggery, cardamom and ghee, then rolled into laddus. Step-by-step method, tips and FAQs.
seg.0156a887ba6f.t: కొబ్బరి ఉండలు. ଆନ୍ଧ୍ରର କୋବ୍ବରି ଉଣ୍ଡାଲୁ: କୋରା ନଡ଼ିଆ ଚେରୁକୁ ବେଲ୍ଲମ ଆଖୁ ଗୁଡ଼, ଅଳେଇଚ ଓ ଘିଅ ସହିତ ରାନ୍ଧି ଲଡୁ ବାନ୍ଧିବା। ଧାପେ ଧାପେ ପ୍ରଣାଳୀ, ଟିପ୍ସ ଓ ପ୍ରଶ୍ନୋତ୍ତର।
seg.0156a887ba6f.back: కొబ్బరి ఉండలు. Andhra's Kobbari Undalu: cooking grated coconut with Cheruku Bellam sugarcane jaggery, cardamom and ghee and shaping laddus. Step-by-step method, tips and questions-answers.

seg.fc0444bcc4df.src: Kobbari Undalu: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.fc0444bcc4df.t: କୋବ୍ବରି ଉଣ୍ଡାଲୁ: 1acrefarmsର ରେସିପି କାର୍ଡ, ଉପାଦାନ ଓ ପ୍ରଣାଳୀ ସହିତ
seg.fc0444bcc4df.back: Kobbari Undalu: 1acrefarms' recipe card, with ingredients and method
